article_content: Boeing, alongside BlackBerry, has designed the Boeing Black—a highly secure smartphone intended for government agencies and defense contractors. The phone’s standout feature is its self-destruct function, which erases all data if the device is tampered with. It runs a secure variant of Android, harnessing BlackBerry’s BES 12 platform for extra security. The Boeing Black supports dual SIM cards, providing connectivity on GSM, WCDMA, and LTE networks, and also includes HDMI, USB, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth. It can interface with biometric sensors and satellites if needed. Sales of this device are strictly limited to approved organizations, mostly in the government or defense sector. Buyers are required to keep details about the phone confidential, since much of its technical information is classified. An FCC filing revealed some information, such as its sealed design and two micro SIM slots, but most specifics remain secret. Tampering with the phone or trying to repair it activates a self-destruct mechanism that wipes data and makes the phone inoperable. BlackBerry CEO John Chen confirmed the partnership but emphasized that further details remain confidential for security reasons.

Boeing Black podržava dve SIM kartice i rad na GSM, WCDMA i LTE mrežama, a ima i HDMI, USB, Wi-Fi i Bluetooth. Uređaj po potrebi može da se poveže sa biometrijskim senzorima i satelitima. article_content: For most people, scrap wood is little more than an improvised doorstop or a replacement paperweight, if not simply destined for the bin. But for artist James McNabb, each offcut holds the potential to become a miniature home, office, or skyscraper. Based in Philadelphia, McNabb has carved thousands of scrap wood pieces and carefully assembled them to create sprawling city skylines. His wooden skyscrapers, crafted in various shapes and sizes, closely resemble Manhattan’s iconic skyline. Growing up in Montville, New Jersey, McNabb often admired the New York City skyline from nearby hilltops. This childhood fascination with cityscapes inspired his art. The collection, which includes a staggering five thousand individual buildings, also features a large ‘city wheel’ nearly five feet tall. Explaining his creative process, the 28-year-old artist said: 'I grabbed a piece of scrap wood and, without thinking, started making cuts. Soon, the wood looked strangely familiar—like a screwdriver or a miniature skyscraper.' He continued: 'I tried another piece and created an object that resembled a wrench or a table leg. Within an hour, I had made 15 more, working through the night and producing over 200 distinct pieces in 24 hours.' McNabb believes his use of scrap wood reflects the idea that success in the city requires the ability to make something out of nothing. With a decade of woodworking experience, McNabb sources most of his materials from his father's wood mill in New Jersey. He describes his process: 'I gather scrap wood, set it by the band saw, put on my headphones, and cut for hours—sometimes all through the night.' The collection continues to grow beyond 5,000 'skyscrapers.' For McNabb, his art celebrates creativity, resilience, and urban inspiration.
translated_content: Za većinu ljudi otpadno drvo je samo improvizovano stopalo za vrata ili zamenski držač za papire, ako već nije namenjeno za kantu. Ali za umetnika Džejmsa Meknaba, svaki ostatak drveta ima potencijal da postane minijaturna kuća, kancelarija ili neboder. Meknab, koji živi u Filadelfiji, isklesao je hiljade komada otpadnog drveta i pažljivo ih složio kako bi stvorio prostrane gradske panorame. Njegovi drveni neboderi, izrađeni u različitim oblicima i veličinama, veoma podsećaju na čuveni njujorški Menhetn. Odrastajući u Montvilu, Nju Džerzi, Meknab je često sa obližnjih brežuljaka posmatrao njujorški horizont. Ta dečačka fascinacija gradskim pejzažima inspiriše njegovo stvaralaštvo. Kolekcija, koja broji zapanjujućih pet hiljada pojedinačnih zgrada, takođe sadrži i veliki 'gradski točak' visok skoro pet stopa. Objašnjavajući svoj kreativni proces, 28-godišnji umetnik kaže: 'Uzeo sam komad otpadnog drveta i bez razmišljanja počeo da pravim zaseke. Ubrzo je deo drveta počeo da liči na šrafciger ili minijaturni neboder.' Dodaje: 'Pokušao sam još jedan komad i napravio predmet koji je podsećao na francuski ključ ili nogu od stola. Za sat vremena napravio sam još 15, radio sam celu noć i za 24 sata stvorio preko 200 različitih komada.' Meknab veruje da njegovo korišćenje otpadnog drveta odražava ideju da je za uspeh u gradu potrebno umeti napraviti nešto ni iz čega. Sa deset godina iskustva u obradi drveta, Meknab većinu materijala nabavlja iz pilane svog oca u Nju Džerziju. Svoj proces opisuje: 'Sakupim otpadno drvo, stavim ga pored tračne testere, stavim slušalice i satima sečem—nekad celu noć.' Kolekcija i dalje raste i sada broji više od 5.000 'nebodera.' Za Meknaba njegova umetnost slavi kreativnost, izdržljivost i inspiraciju iz urbanog života.

article_content: Online influence has become a major factor in today's digital world, with services like Klout offering a way to track it. Klout, launched four years ago, scores users on a 100-point scale by analyzing their activity and engagement across platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, and Google Plus. High-profile individuals stand out: Lady Gaga has a Klout score of 93, President Barack Obama 91, NBA standout Jeremy Lin 80, Microsoft Chairman Bill Gates 77, and Pope Benedict XVI 53. However, all fall behind pop star Justin Bieber, who achieves a perfect 100. Klout doesn't measure real-world impact. Instead, it evaluates a person’s capacity to spark reactions online—such as Twitter retweets or Facebook likes. The higher the engagement, the higher the Klout score. The San Francisco-based tech company now has scores for more than 100 million people. Joe Fernandez, Klout’s co-founder and CEO, shared that Klout aims to help people and organizations understand and measure influence online, a valuable asset in a rapidly growing digital landscape. Consistent content creation is the most effective way to raise a Klout score and keep networks engaged. Klout saw a surge of passionate feedback after major changes to its scoring system last year, with users reacting strongly to shifted scores. In response, Klout made its methods more transparent, leading to improved user response. Interestingly, the service’s creation was partly inspired by Fernandez’s personal circumstances: after a jaw injury left him unable to eat solid food in 2007, he realized the value of his online recommendations, particularly for taquerias, and how that expertise could be recognized—burritos even played a role in sparking the idea. Klout’s impact now extends beyond social media. Some job seekers list their Klout scores on resumes, and the ability to mobilize a network is prized in many workplaces. Businesses are increasingly paying attention to influential consumers online. For example, some hotels now use Klout scores to offer upgraded rooms at check-in, shifting rewards from purchase-based to influence-based criteria. Recently, Klout acquired Blockboard—a platform connecting neighbors—as part of a move to focus more on mobile and local influence, in response to the shift from desktop to mobile web use. Fernandez acknowledges Klout only measures online actions—not necessarily real-world results—as seen in cases where digital scores didn’t predict actual outcomes in politics or sports. Still, he emphasizes the value in understanding and optimizing digital influence. As one of the few Latino tech entrepreneurs, Fernandez notes the strong support from the online Latino community and expresses confidence that anyone with an idea and drive can thrive in tech, especially in diverse places like Silicon Valley. Klout’s future plans include enhancing user benefits by clarifying and increasing the usefulness of influence scores, expanding on mobile, and further improving transparency.

Klout, pokrenut pre četiri godine, ocenjuje korisnike na skali od 100 poena analizirajući njihovu aktivnost i angažovanost na platformama kao što su Facebook, Twitter i Google Plus. Istaknute ličnosti izdvajaju se: Lady Gaga ima Klout skor 93, predsednik Barack Obama 91, NBA zvezda Jeremy Lin 80, predsednik Microsofta Bill Gates 77, a papa Benedikt XVI 53. Međutim, svi zaostaju za pop zvezdom Justinom Bieberom, koji ima maksimalni skor od 100. Klout ne meri uticaj u stvarnom svetu, već procenjuje sposobnost osobe da izazove reakcije na internetu—na primer, putem Twitter retvitova ili Facebook lajkova. Što je veća angažovanost, skor je viši. Ova tehnološka kompanija iz San Franciska sada ima skor za više od 100 miliona ljudi. Suosnivač i izvršni direktor Klout-a, Joe Fernandez, kaže da je cilj servisa da pomogne ljudima i organizacijama da razumeju i mere svoj uticaj na internetu, što je vredna prednost u ubrzano rastućem digitalnom okruženju. Dosledno kreiranje sadržaja je najefikasniji način za povećanje Klout skora i održavanje angažovanosti mreže. Nakon velikih promena u svom sistemu bodovanja prošle godine, Klout je doživeo snažan odziv korisnika zbog izmena u skorovima. Kompanija je potom povećala transparentnost svojih metoda, što je dovelo do boljeg prijema među korisnicima. Zanimljivo je da je ideja za Klout delimično proistekla iz ličnog iskustva Fernandeza: nakon povrede vilice zbog koje nije mogao da jede čvrstu hranu 2007. godine, shvatio je vrednost svojih online preporuka, posebno za taquerije, i kako ta stručnost može biti priznata—čak su i burita bila deo inspiracije za ovaj servis. Uticaj Klout-a sada prelazi okvire društvenih mreža. Neki tražioci posla navode svoj Klout skor u biografijama, a sposobnost da se aktivira sopstvena mreža izuzetno se ceni u mnogim radnim okruženjima. Firmama je sve značajnije ko ima uticaj na internetu. Na primer, neki hoteli sada koriste Klout skorove da bi unapredili sobe gostima prilikom prijavljivanja, premeštajući nagrade sa kriterijuma potrošnje na kriterijum uticaja. Nedavno je Klout preuzeo Blockboard—platformu za povezivanje komšija—kao deo plana da se više posveti mobilnom i lokalnom uticaju, prateći trend prelaska korisnika sa desktop računara na mobilne uređaje. Fernandez priznaje da Klout meri samo online akcije, a ne nužno i rezultate u stvarnom svetu—što se pokazalo u slučajevima kada digitalni skorovi nisu predvideli ishod političkih ili sportskih događaja. Ipak, naglašava vrednost razumevanja i optimizacije digitalnog uticaja. Kao jedan od retkih latino osnivača u oblasti tehnologije, Fernandez ističe snažnu podršku latino zajednice na internetu i veruje da svako sa idejom i voljom može uspeti u tehnološkom sektoru, naročito u raznolikim sredinama kao što je Silicijumska dolina. Planovi za budućnost Klout-a uključuju dodatno povećanje korisničkih benefita kroz pojašnjenje i korisnost skorova za uticaj, širenje na mobilne platforme i još veću transparentnost.

article_content: Between January and September 2023, the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) in Edo State apprehended 252 individuals suspected of drug dealing and trafficking. This information was shared in Benin City on Thursday by Ondoimi Bebetu, the Assistant Commander for Media and Advocacy, representing State Commander Buba Wakawa. Some of those arrested, who were identified as drug users, received counseling and were released back to their families, as permitted by current laws. The NDLEA coordinated with police, Army, and other security agencies, conducting regular raids at hotels and event centers across the state. Wakawa stated that, as a result of these operations, some suspects have been imprisoned, others are undergoing trial, and some have participated in counseling programs.

Ovu informaciju u Beninu je u četvrtak saopštio pomoćnik komandanta za medije i zastupanje, Ondoimi Bebetu, u ime državnog komandanta Bube Wakave. Neki od uhapšenih, koji su prepoznati kao korisnici droga, dobili su savetovanje i pušteni su svojim porodicama, što je u skladu sa važećim zakonima. NDLEA je sarađivala sa policijom, vojskom i drugim bezbednosnim agencijama, sprovodeći redovne racije u hotelima i centrima za događaje širom države. Wakava je naveo da su, kao rezultat ovih akcija, neki osumnjičeni već u zatvoru, neki prolaze kroz sudski proces, dok su drugi prošli programe savetovanja.

article_content: Coinbase announced on Tuesday that it has added four national security experts to its global advisory council as the cryptocurrency industry faces increased regulatory scrutiny following the collapse of FTX, led by Sam Bankman-Fried. The new council members are Mark Esper, Stephanie Murphy, Frances Townsend, and David Urban. The council advises the company’s executive leadership. Esper is a former US Secretary of Defense, while Murphy is a former national security specialist for the Department of Defense. Townsend served as Counterterrorism and Homeland Security adviser to former President George W. Bush, and Urban was managing director at BRG Group, where he oversaw corporate affairs for ByteDance. According to Coinbase, these appointments will help the advisory council assess the impact of regulatory uncertainty on cryptocurrency in the United States, including potential long-term economic and national security effects.

Novi članovi odbora su Mark Esper, Stefani Marfi, Frensis Taunsend i Dejvid Urban. Odbor savetuje izvršni tim kompanije. Esper je bivši američki sekretar za odbranu, dok je Marfi bivša stručnjakinja za nacionalnu bezbednost u Ministarstvu odbrane. Taunsend je bila savetnica za borbu protiv terorizma i unutrašnju bezbednost predsedniku Džordžu V. Bušu, a Urban je bio generalni direktor u BRG Group, gde je nadgledao korporativne poslove za ByteDance. Prema Coinbase-u, ova imenovanja će pomoći savetodavnom odboru da proceni uticaj regulatorne neizvesnosti na kriptovalute u Sjedinjenim Državama, uključujući potencijalne dugoročne ekonomske i bezbednosne efekte.

Linda Ducharme has always been drawn to extraordinary relationships. Tall, silent, and steadfast, her partner isn't a typical boyfriend—he’s a 40-foot Ferris wheel she affectionately named Bruce. Their story began in 1982, when Linda encountered the Skydiver ride. Captivated, she joined the carnival to be close to Bruce, starting a bond unlike any other.

After years together, tragedy struck in 1986 when Bruce was damaged in a storm and transported to a Kansas scrapyard. Linda lost contact with him and entered a deep depression. Decades later, with the help of a friend, she tracked Bruce down. Reunited, Linda lovingly restored Bruce, and their connection reignited.

In Florida, Linda and Bruce exchanged vows in a ceremony conducted by a non-denominational preacher. Despite the marriage not being legally recognized, they later renewed their vows surrounded by friends. Linda, now 55, has experienced other relationships with objects—previously falling in love with an airplane and a train. Her attachment is identified as objectum sexuality, a condition where individuals form emotional and romantic relationships with inanimate objects.

Linda has faced challenges; her family strongly disapproved, and her mother considered her choices a violation of religious beliefs. Professionally, Linda lost her job as a train conductor after being seen in an intimate moment with a train. Yet, she remains committed to Bruce, expressing a desire to spend her life with him and eventually live together in peace.

Linda’s story is not unique. Erika Eiffel famously married the Eiffel Tower in 2007. Eija-Riitta Eklöf Berliner-Mauer announced her marriage to the Berlin Wall in 1979. Eva K from the Netherlands has also reported forming strong attachments to objects and even words. These stories highlight the seldom-discussed phenomenon of objectum sexuality, the powerful and deeply personal bonds some people experience with objects.

L&T Technology Services Limited (LTTS), an engineering services company, has partnered with NVIDIA to develop software-defined architectures for medical devices, focusing on endoscopy. According to a regulatory filing, the collaboration aims to enhance image quality and scalability while addressing industry challenges such as high cost, limited availability, and dependence on custom hardware. The jointly-developed platform supports multiple applications and equips healthcare professionals with real-time clinical decision-making tools.

The architecture provides an advanced image processing pipeline for noise reduction, edge and contrast enhancement, texture and color improvement, and speckle correction. Importantly, it integrates AI and machine learning models for detecting, identifying, and classifying polyps—abnormal growths commonly detected during colonoscopy.

Along with a user-friendly interface and seamless pipeline integration, the solution offers low-latency data transfer and high-performance image processing without performance bottlenecks, ensuring system scalability. The technology utilizes NVIDIA’s Holoscan and IGX Orin platforms to power multiple AI-enabled applications.

Shanker Trivedi, Senior Vice President of Enterprise Business at NVIDIA, commented, "Combining LTTS’ experience in medical-device development with NVIDIA’s edge AI computing platform delivers significant value to the medical technology industry by accelerating AI-enabled, software-defined medical devices."

Amit Chadha, CEO and Managing Director of LTTS, noted, "Our collaboration with NVIDIA pushes the boundaries of medical imaging. The platform fosters rapid development of AI-powered medical imaging solutions, improves image quality, and gives clinicians tools for real-time decision support, which can ultimately lead to better patient outcomes."

After caring for unwanted animals for 64 years, Mill House Animal Sanctuary in Fulwood, Sheffield, is facing possible closure due to a noise complaint from a neighbor about barking dogs. Twin sisters Pat Hartley and Jane Wright, who have operated the charity since 1948, received a noise abatement order from the local council. The order requires them to either find new homes for their 17 dogs or consider euthanasia, as they cannot afford the necessary soundproof fencing.

Pat and Jane, both in their seventies, have always maintained a no-kill policy at the sanctuary. They have devoted their lives and personal resources, alongside donations, to the care of dogs, cows, ponies, pigs, sheep, llamas, and goats—amounting to thousands of animals over the years. Although they've taken steps to reduce noise, such as bringing some dogs into their own house, they believe the complaint is overstated and insist barking is not a constant problem.

Operating costs for the sanctuary reach about £3,000 per week, leaving no funds for the required legal or construction expenses. With the holiday season near, the sisters anticipate receiving even more surrendered animals. The council reports ongoing cooperation to help the sanctuary comply with the order, but unless homes are found for the dogs, Mill House Animal Sanctuary may be forced to close. Anyone wishing to adopt an animal is encouraged to contact the sanctuary.

article_content: A December 22 briefing prepared by Maj. Gen. Michael Flynn, the top U.S. intelligence official in Afghanistan, outlines the strategy and strength of the Taliban and their allies. Flynn's assessment, obtained by CNN, concludes that the Taliban insurgency is becoming increasingly effective. The briefing indicates that the Taliban's organizational capabilities and operational reach are expanding both in quality and geography. The Taliban can now sustain a higher frequency and wider geographic range of attacks. The unclassified report attributes the resilience of the insurgency to three factors: the increased availability of bomb-making technology and materials; access to two major funding streams—from the opium trade and overseas donations, often transmitted through informal banks known as 'hawalas'; and the continued ability of the Taliban to recruit fighters, aided by perceptions of religious legitimacy, poverty, and tribal tensions. A chart in Flynn’s briefing shows that security incidents—including improvised explosive attacks, ambushes, and assaults—reached approximately 500 per week in the second half of 2009, compared to no more than 40 per week five years earlier. Incident counts have not dropped below 300 per week even during the slower winter fighting season. The briefing predicts that security incidents will be higher in 2010, with incidents up 300% since 2007 and 60% since 2008. Interrogations of captured insurgents reveal that the Taliban viewed 2009 as their most successful year, with expanded violence and a presidential election marked by low turnout and allegations of fraud. These individuals also indicated that the Taliban are seeking to portray themselves as a nationalist movement, seeking to expel foreign forces, and consider Al Qaeda a hindrance, although Al Qaeda continues to provide some support. According to Flynn’s briefing, foreign militant groups, including the Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, are operating in Afghanistan, and the Taliban maintain relationships with Chechen and Central Asian fighters. The Taliban carefully manage their ties with Al Qaeda to gain support without alienating local Afghans. Motivations for Taliban fighters include anti-U.S. sentiment, frustration over incomplete infrastructure projects, perceptions of government corruption, and widespread crime among security forces. The Taliban introduced a 'code of conduct' for their fighters in July 2009, urging respectful treatment of civilians and discouraging activities such as forced donations, kidnapping for money, and the use of child soldiers. Despite this code, a recent U.N. report found that Taliban attacks killed 1,630 civilians in 2009, a 40% increase from the previous year. Flynn’s briefing notes that the Taliban have largely re-established their former command structure, including an 18-member inner shura led by Mullah Omar, which passes decisions to regional and provincial councils and shadow governors. By 2009, the number of Taliban shadow governors had increased from 11 (in 2005) to 33. The Taliban's strategy for 2010 involves expanding into northern and western Afghanistan, sustaining operations during winter, and increasing influence around Kabul and Kandahar. Their aim is not to defeat international forces directly but to erode their resolve to remain in Afghanistan, partly through increased use of improvised explosive devices (IEDs). IEDs, primarily made from ammonium nitrate fertilizer, accounted for 80% of U.S. casualties in some regions. Casualty numbers from IEDs rose from 326 in 2005 to 6,037 in 2009, with the size of explosives also increasing. On Friday, President Karzai banned the use, production, storage, and sale of ammonium nitrate in Afghanistan. Flynn’s briefing identifies Taliban vulnerabilities, including internal disagreements, overdependence on marginalized ethnic Pashtuns, and reliance on external sanctuaries, particularly in Pakistan. The report concludes that the Taliban have not yet become a widespread popular movement, giving the United States and its allies a significant advantage. Officials also note positive trends, including fewer civilian deaths from U.S. and NATO operations, improved counter-insurgency tactics, and more effective partnering with Afghan forces.
translated_content: Izveštaj od 22. decembra, koji je pripremio general-major Majkl Flin, glavni američki obaveštajni oficir u Avganistanu, opisuje strategiju i snagu talibana i njihovih saveznika. Flinova procena, u koju je CNN imao uvid, zaključuje da talibanska pobuna postaje sve efikasnija. Izveštaj ukazuje na to da se organizacione sposobnosti i operativni domet talibana šire i po kvalitetu i po geografskom obuhvatu. Talibani sada mogu da održavaju veću učestalost i širi raspon napada. Neklasifikovani izveštaj navodi da se otpornost pobune zasniva na tri faktora: povećanoj dostupnosti tehnologije i materijala za izradu eksploziva; pristupu dvema glavnim izvorima finansiranja – trgovini opijumom i donacijama iz inostranstva, koje se često prenose preko neformalnih banaka poznatih kao 'hawala'; i sposobnosti talibana da kontinuirano regrutuju borce, podstaknuti percepcijom verske legitimnosti, siromaštvom i plemenskim tenzijama. Tabela u Flinovom izveštaju pokazuje da su bezbednosni incidenti – uključujući napade improvizovanim eksplozivima, zasede i napade minobacačima i raketama – dostigli oko 500 nedeljno u drugoj polovini 2009. godine, u poređenju sa najviše 40 nedeljno pre pet godina. Broj incidenata nije pao ispod 300 nedeljno čak ni tokom mirnije zimske sezone borbi. Izveštaj predviđa da će bezbednosni incidenti biti češći u 2010, sa porastom incidenata od 300% od 2007. i 60% od 2008. godine. Ispitivanja zarobljenih pobunjenika pokazuju da su talibani 2009. smatrali najuspešnijom godinom, s obzirom na širenje nasilja i predsedničke izbore obeležene niskom izlaznošću i tvrdnjama o prevarama. Takođe se navodi da talibani pokušavaju da se predstave kao nacionalistički pokret s ciljem izbacivanja stranih snaga i smatraju Al Kaidu za prepreku, iako Al Kaida i dalje pruža određenu podršku. Prema Flinovom izveštaju, strane militantne grupe, uključujući Islamski pokret Uzbekistana, aktivne su u Avganistanu, a talibani održavaju veze sa čečenskim i srednjoazijskim borcima. Talibani pažljivo upravljaju odnosima sa Al Kaidom kako bi dobili podršku ali bez otuđivanja lokalnog stanovništva. Motivi talibanskih boraca uključuju protivljenje SAD, razočaranje zbog nedovršenih infrastrukturnih projekata, percepciju korupcije vlasti i raširen kriminal u bezbednosnim snagama. Talibani su u julu 2009. uveli 'kodeks ponašanja' za svoje borce, pozivajući na poštovanje prema civilima i obeshrabrujući aktivnosti kao što su prinudne donacije, kidnapovanja zbog novca i upotreba dece vojnika. Uprkos ovom kodeksu, nedavni izveštaj UN pokazuje da su talibanski napadi u 2009. godini ubili 1.630 civila, što je povećanje od 40% u odnosu na prethodnu godinu. Flinov izveštaj navodi da su talibani u velikoj meri obnovili svoju raniju komandnu strukturu, uključujući unutrašnji šura od 18 članova na čelu sa mula Omarom, koja prenosi odluke regionalnim i provincijskim većima i senka guvernerima. Do 2009. broj talibanskih senka guvernera povećao se sa 11 (u 2005) na 33. Talibanska strategija za 2010. uključuje širenje ka severu i zapadu Avganistana, održavanje operacija tokom zime i povećanje uticaja oko Kabula i Kandahara. Cilj nije da se međunarodne snage direktno poraze, već da se oslabi njihova volja za ostanak, između ostalog, kroz pojačanu upotrebu improvizovanih eksplozivnih uređaja (IED). IED-ovi, koji se uglavnom prave od amonijum-nitrat đubriva, odgovorni su za 80% američkih žrtava u nekim oblastima. Broj žrtava od IED-ova porastao je sa 326 u 2005. na 6.037 u 2009, a veličina eksploziva je takođe povećana. Predsednik Karzai je u petak zabranio upotrebu, proizvodnju, skladištenje i prodaju amonijum-nitrata u Avganistanu. Flinov izveštaj navodi slabosti talibana, među kojima su unutrašnja neslaganja, prevelika zavisnost od marginalizovanih etničkih Paštuna i oslanjanje na spoljne baze, posebno u Pakistanu. Izveštaj zaključuje da talibani još nisu postali široko prihvaćen pokret, što daje SAD i saveznicima značajnu prednost. Zvaničnici navode pozitivne trendove, uključujući smanjenje civilnih žrtava od strane američkih i NATO snaga, bolje protivpobunjeničke taktike i efikasniju saradnju sa avganistanskim bezbednosnim snagama.

"Homework: A Source of Parent Debate Across America"

As a new school year begins, parents across the United States are expressing strong—and often contrasting—opinions about homework. A recent CNN Facebook forum revealed that some believe students are assigned too much homework, while others worry there is not enough. 

For many, managing take-home assignments brings daily stress. Some parents report their children are weary and overwhelmed, while others feel compelled to supplement with extra work at home. The debate extends beyond quantity to quality; critics see much homework as ineffective "busy work," while advocates say it strengthens skills essential for global competitiveness.

Lisa Morguess, a mother of seven from Fullerton, California, challenges homework in elementary school and documents her efforts on the Hometown Homework Chronicles blog. She adheres to guidance from national education organizations, limiting homework to 10 minutes per grade level and prioritizing time for nonacademic pursuits. She emphasizes how ingrained homework policies can be, making change difficult.

Conversely, Ann Gunty of Flagstaff, Arizona, considers substantial homework crucial for academic excellence, asserting that her four children’s one to two hours of nightly assignments strike the right balance.

Others, including Mozart Saint Cyr from Massachusetts, argue there is too little homework and that increased assignments could counteract distractions such as video games and social media.

Concerns about the substance of homework are shared by Francesca Price and Dr. Tish Howard, a retired school principal. Both argue that assignments should be purposeful, not mere routine. Dr. Howard recommends that extra support be integrated into the school day itself to help struggling students.

Some educators, like Florida’s Rhonda Lochiatto, prefer offering optional and interactive activities rather than obligatory homework, acknowledging the time constraints families face today.

Research into homework’s effectiveness shows mixed results. Some parents believe increased homework does not lead to better outcomes, while others cite international comparisons in support of more rigorous assignments. Studies have found only a modest connection between time spent on homework and grades, with more noticeable benefits for older children on standardized tests. Experts recommend that homework amounts be age-appropriate to avoid burnout.

As the conversation continues, families, teachers, and students are all striving to find the right homework balance—a challenge that has become a hallmark of the American education landscape.

"Domaći zadatak: Izvor rasprave među roditeljima u Americi"

Kako nova školska godina počinje, roditelji širom Sjedinjenih Država izražavaju snažna—često suprotstavljena—mišljenja o domaćim zadacima. Nedavna diskusija na CNN-ovoj Facebook stranici pokazala je da neki smatraju da učenici dobijaju previše zadataka, dok se drugi plaše da ih nema dovoljno.

Za mnoge, upravljanje obavezama kod kuće donosi svakodnevni stres. Neki roditelji izveštavaju da su im deca umorna i preopterećena, dok drugi osećaju potrebu da dodatno zadaju zadatke kod kuće. Debata prevazilazi samu količinu—kritičari misle da su mnogi zadaci beskorisno „zatupljivanje“, a zagovornici veruju da doprinose razvoju veština potrebnih za globalnu konkurentnost.

Lisa Morguess, majka sedmoro dece iz Fullertona u Kaliforniji, osporava domaći zadatak u osnovnoj školi i svoje napore beleži na blogu Hometown Homework Chronicles. Ona se pridržava preporuka nacionalnih obrazovnih organizacija, ograničavajući količinu domaćeg na 10 minuta po razredu i podstiče više neakademskih aktivnosti. Takođe naglašava koliko su politike o domaćim zadacima ukorenjene i teško promenljive.

Suprotno tome, Ann Gunty iz Flagstafa u Arizoni smatra da je obimniji domaći zadatak neophodan za akademski uspeh. Njena deca rade jedan do dva sata domaćeg zadatka svake večeri, što ona smatra pravom merom.

Drugi, poput Mozarta Saint Cyra iz Masačusetsa, tvrde da zadatka ima premalo i da bi povećanje moglo pomoći protiv ometanja kao što su video igre i društvene mreže.

Na sadržaj zadataka ukazuju i Francesca Price i dr Tish Howard, penzionisana direktorka škole. Obe smatraju da zadaci moraju imati smisla, a dr Howard preporučuje dodatnu podršku učenicima tokom samog nastave.

Neki prosvetni radnici, poput Rhonde Lochiatto sa Floride, nude opciono i interaktivno učenje umesto obaveznih zadataka, prepoznajući obim obaveza u savremenim porodicama.

Istraživanja su dala podeljene rezultate o korisnosti domaćih zadataka: neki roditelji smatraju da više zadataka ne daje bolje rezultate, dok drugi ukazuju na međunarodna poređenja za rigoroznije zadatke. Studije su pokazale umirenu vezu između vremena utrošenog na zadatke i ocena, dok su koristi izraženije kod starije dece na standardizovanim testovima. Stručnjaci savetuju zadatke prilagođene uzrastu kako bi se izbeglo preopterećenje.

Dok rasprava traje, porodice, nastavnici i učenici zajedno pokušavaju da pronađu pravu meru domaćih zadataka—što ostaje izazov američkog školstva.

article_content: During restoration work at Pentillie Castle in Cornwall, workers uncovered human remains believed to be those of Sir James Tillie, who built the castle at the end of the 17th century. Sir James, who died in 1713, was known for his unusual personality and left peculiar burial instructions. Instead of opting for a traditional grave, he requested to be dressed in his best clothes and placed, seated with his pipe, books, and wine, inside his favorite folly, awaiting resurrection. Local tradition had long maintained that his body was later moved to a church, but recent excavations in the castle's mausoleum have overturned that belief. Archaeologists discovered a bricked chamber beneath the granite floor containing human remains and an old chair, though his personal items were missing. Ted Coryton, who became the castle's owner in 2007, has led restoration efforts and researched Sir James's colorful life. Tillie, born to modest means, became the land agent for Sir John Coryton and later married Sir John's widow after the latter's sudden death, sparking rumors of an affair and even poisoning. Sir James obtained a knighthood from King James II, a distinction that reportedly drew scrutiny for its legitimacy. According to Ted Coryton, the discovery brings closure to one of the estate's long-standing mysteries. There are no plans to further disturb the remains or conduct DNA testing. While Pentillie Castle's gardens will be open to visitors soon, the mausoleum will remain closed to the public.
translated_content: Tokom restauracije dvorca Pentillie u Kornvolu, radnici su otkrili ljudske ostatke za koje se veruje da pripadaju seru Džejmsu Tiliu, graditelju ovog zamka s kraja 17. veka. Ser Džejms, koji je preminuo 1713. godine, bio je poznat po svom neobičnom karakteru i ostavio je neobične zahteve za sahranu. Umesto klasične grobnice, tražio je da ga obuku u najbolju odeću, postave u stolicu sa lulom, knjigama i vinom u njegovoj omiljenoj kućici, kako bi čekao vaskrsnuće. Dugogodišnja lokalna tradicija tvrdila je da je njegovo telo kasnije preneto u crkvu, ali su nedavna iskopavanja u mauzoleju zamka pokazala suprotno. Arheolozi su ispod granitnog poda pronašli zazidanu komoru sa ljudskim ostacima i starom stolicom, ali lične stvari nisu pronađene. Ted Koriton, koji je postao vlasnik zamka 2007. godine, vodi radove na renoviranju i istraživao je zanimljiv Tilijev život. Tili je rođen u skromnoj porodici, postao upravnik imanja ser Džona Koritona i kasnije oženio njegovu udovicu nakon iznenadne smrti gospodara, što je izazvalo tračeve o aferi, pa čak i trovanju. Ser Džejms je dobio titulu viteza od kralja Džejmsa II, ali je verodostojnost te titule kasnije bila predmet ispitivanja. Kako navodi Ted Koriton, ovo otkriće donosi rasplet jedne od dugogodišnjih misterija imanja. Nema planova za dalja iskopavanja ili DNK analizu. Dok će bašte Pentillie zamka uskoro biti otvorene za posetioce, mauzolej će ostati zatvoren za javnost.

article_content: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has stated that Israel will maintain security oversight in Gaza following the current war. This announcement comes amid heightened international scrutiny and a reported death toll in Gaza exceeding 10,000, including more than 4,000 children, according to health authorities overseen by Hamas. Despite increasing demands from world leaders and organizations for a ceasefire, and warnings from UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres about the grave impact on children in Gaza, Netanyahu reiterated that military action would continue until Hamas releases all hostages. The October 7 attack by Hamas resulted in 1,400 Israeli deaths and over 240 hostages, prompting Israel’s intensive attacks on Gaza. Israeli military operations have intensified, targeting Hamas's command centers and tunnel systems. The ground invasion has effectively cut off parts of Gaza and encircled Gaza City. Meanwhile, more than 1.5 million people in Gaza have been displaced and are seeking refuge with limited access to humanitarian aid. While the United States and other allies suggest brief humanitarian pauses to allow for aid delivery, Netanyahu insists these should be limited and that a comprehensive ceasefire can only happen once hostages are freed. Recent reports from Israeli forces note hundreds of airstrikes in just one day, and there have been casualties among Israeli soldiers, some of whom have publicly expressed concern for their safety. The conflict is rooted in a long and complex history: Israel withdrew from Gaza in 2005, followed by Hamas taking control after subsequent elections. The U.S. has proposed the Palestinian Authority govern Gaza post-war, a plan firmly opposed by Hamas. Instability has spread beyond Gaza, with rocket attacks from Lebanon and drone strikes claimed by Yemen’s Houthis against Israel. The U.S. has increased its military presence in the area to deter wider regional involvement. Evacuations of foreign nationals and limited aid shipments proceeded after the Rafah crossing briefly reopened, though humanitarian agencies warn that food, medicine, and water supplies remain far from meeting civilian needs. Protesters around the world, including a notable demonstration by Jewish Americans at the Statue of Liberty in New York, have called for ending attacks against civilians in Gaza. The article concludes with a section on Indian economic developments, unrelated to the main story about the Gaza conflict.
translated_content: Premijer Izraela Benjamin Netanjahu izjavio je da će Izrael zadržati nadzor nad bezbednošću u Gazi nakon trenutnog rata. Ova najava dolazi usred sve veće međunarodne pažnje i izveštaja da je broj žrtava u Gazi premašio 10.000, među kojima je više od 4.000 dece, prema zdravstvenim vlastima pod kontrolom Hamasa. Uprkos rastućim zahtevima svetskih lidera i organizacija za prekid vatre, kao i upozorenjima generalnog sekretara UN Antonija Gutereša o ozbiljnim posledicama po decu u Gazi, Netanjahu je ponovio da će vojne operacije trajati dok Hamas ne oslobodi sve taoce. Napad Hamasa 7. oktobra doveo je do smrti 1.400 Izraelaca i više od 240 otetih, što je pokrenulo intenzivne izraelske napade na Gazu. Izraelske vojne operacije su pojačane, ciljajući komandne centre Hamasa i sisteme tunela. Kopnena invazija je efektivno izolovala delove Gaze i okružila Gazu Siti. U međuvremenu, više od 1,5 miliona ljudi u Gazi je raseljeno i traži sklonište sa ograničenim pristupom humanitarnoj pomoći. Dok Sjedinjene Države i drugi saveznici predlažu kratkotrajne humanitarne pauze radi dostave pomoći, Netanjahu insistira da te pauze budu ograničene i da je sveobuhvatni prekid vatre moguć samo nakon oslobađanja talaca. Izraelske snage su nedavno izvestile o stotinama vazdušnih napada u samo jednom danu, a bilo je i žrtava među izraelskim vojnicima, od kojih su neki javno izrazili zabrinutost za svoju bezbednost. Sukob ima duboko ukorenjenu i složenu istoriju: Izrael se povukao iz Gaze 2005. godine, a Hamas je preuzeo vlast nakon kasnijih izbora. SAD su predložile da Palestinska uprava upravlja Gazom posle rata, što Hamas odlučno odbacuje. Nestabilnost se proširila i van Gaze, uz raketne napade iz Libana i napade dronovima koje jemenski Huti preuzimaju kao svoju odgovornost. SAD su pojačale vojno prisustvo u regionu kako bi sprečile širenje sukoba. Evakuacija stranih državljana i ograničena isporuka pomoći odvijale su se nakon što je granični prelaz Rafa privremeno otvoren, iako humanitarne organizacije upozoravaju da zalihe hrane, lekova i vode nisu dovoljne potrebama civilnog stanovništva. Širom sveta održani su protesti, uključujući veliki skup američkih Jevreja kod Kipa slobode u Njujorku, sa zahtevom za prekid napada na civile u Gazi. Članak se završava izveštajem o ekonomskim dešavanjima u Indiji, nepovezanim sa glavnom pričom o sukobu u Gazi.

article_content: During a lively matchup between the Boston Red Sox and Detroit Tigers, the crowd was treated to dramatic moments on and off the field. A luxurious four-bedroom apartment spanning nine floors within the clock tower of the historic Grade II* listed former St George's Church in central Manchester is now for sale at £1 million. This exceptional property masterfully combines modern amenities with preserved architectural heritage, featuring a bespoke spiral staircase, a private lift, a Jacuzzi-style bath, a gym, and a sauna, all while retaining the church’s original arches and ornate windows. The apartment covers 2,500 square feet, excluding its meticulously kept gardens.

The modern kitchen on the second floor is equipped with built-in appliances, including a coffee machine, washer/dryer, dishwasher, and stainless steel oven. The dining area showcases arched stainless steel radiators, a large dining table, and a blend of brick and glass flooring. The master bedroom is distinguished by a waterbed, velux window, telephone intercom, exposed beamed trusses, and fitted wardrobes. Internal corridors preserve the original arched features, leading towards a dedicated entertainment room on the ninth floor, which boasts a skylight and access to a terrace with panoramic views over Manchester.

Additional highlights include an en-suite bathroom with a Jacuzzi-style tub, opaque glass wash basin, extractor ceiling light, and designer tiled flooring. The sauna room offers an extra shower cubicle, modern tiling, and unique glass fixtures. The gym features a triple-height ceiling, multi-paned windows, and oak flooring, while the terrace encapsulates the church spire and offers striking stonework and views of the city.

Originally designed by renowned architect Francis Goodwin, who also created the original Manchester Town Hall, the church was constructed between 1826 and 1828 as a Commissioners’ church to commemorate victory at the Battle of Waterloo. After restoration in 1884 by J. S. Crowther, it was designated a Grade II* listed building in 1974 before closing as a church a decade later. According to estate agent Danielle Kelly at Bridgfords, the remarkable home has impressed prospective buyers with its unique design and high-quality finish, and is located in one of Manchester’s most desirable areas.

article_content: Delhi's air quality has plunged into the ‘severe’ category for the first time this season. This decline is due to slow winds, increased local pollution, and smoke coming from crop residue burning. On Thursday, the AQI worsened steadily, rising from 351 at 10 a.m. to 418 by 9 p.m., creating a hazy environment and reducing visibility. Meteorological reports indicate that in the morning, visibility was limited by shallow fog and suspended particles—only improving marginally during the day. Wind speeds were low (2–3 kmph), with different wind directions at nearby stations. Relative humidity decreased from high levels in the morning to 55% in the afternoon. Dr. Gufran Beig from SAFAR highlighted that a high number of crop fires is notably worsening the air. Stagnant weather and changing wind patterns have trapped pollutants close to the ground. The Central Pollution Control Board identified PM 2.5 as the dominant pollutant in Delhi on Thursday. There is unlikely to be relief soon. The weather forecast predicts low wind speeds and little chance of rain over the next few days. Other parts of NCR, such as Greater Noida and Jind, have also recorded ‘severe’ AQI. According to recent data, Punjab saw 1,921 instances of stubble burning on Wednesday, its fourth consecutive day over 1,000 cases. Experts estimate that biomass burning was responsible for about 18% of Delhi's PM 2.5 on Wednesday, potentially increasing to 22% on Thursday. In previous years, stubble burning's contribution to PM 2.5 peaked at 34% in 2022, and was higher in years before that. This year, not all data is available yet.

Dr Gufran Beig iz SAFAR-a je naglasio da veliki broj požara na poljima dodatno pogoršava vazduh. Mirno vreme i promena pravca vetra zadržavaju zagađivače blizu tla. Victoria Police have defended their investigation into a historic rape allegation made against Labor leader Bill Shorten, following criticism from the woman who accused him. The woman, Kathy, who has now publicly identified herself, claims the police failed to properly investigate her allegations regarding an incident in 1986. Kathy handed police a 19-page statement and information on possible witnesses but alleges that not all were contacted.

A spokesperson for Victoria Police stated that the case was handled as any allegation of sexual assault would be, including consulting the Office of Public Prosecutions. The office advised there was no reasonable prospect of conviction, and police subsequently closed the case. Bill Shorten has consistently denied the allegation, describing it as 'untrue and abhorrent.'

Kathy has expressed frustration with the investigative process and doubts that her claim was taken seriously, implying Shorten’s political status may have influenced proceedings. She detailed her allegations of being raped by Shorten at a Young Labor conference in Portarlington, Victoria, after the group returned to their camp. Despite providing witness details, she feels the investigation was insufficient.

Deputy Labor leader Tanya Plibersek stated that police had thoroughly investigated the matter and that Shorten had fully cooperated. She said this should mark the end of the issue. Authorities noted that anyone dissatisfied with the investigation's conduct could contact oversight agencies such as the professional standards command or the anti-corruption commission.

Mr Shorten released a statement after police dropped the case, emphasizing his cooperation and the distress the process caused his family. He has declined further comment. Supporters, including Parliamentary colleagues and friends, asserted their belief in his innocence and described the ordeal as one of the most difficult times for Shorten and his loved ones.

The Jigawa State Police Command has announced the arrest of four suspected kidnappers and an alleged firearms manufacturer. The Command’s Public Relations Officer, DSP Shiisu Adam, stated that these arrests were made through collaborative efforts between the police and local vigilante groups.

On November 16, 2023, in Yandutsen Kawari village, Ringim Local Government Area, officers and vigilante members apprehended Bashir Muhammed, 50, at his residence, where they found a pistol and two locally-made rifles. Muhammed reportedly confessed to producing and selling firearms to unidentified buyers and was transferred to the State Criminal Investigation Department in Dutse for further investigation.

In another incident on November 17, 2023, the police received a distress call about the kidnapping of a 63-year-old businessman, Alhaji Shehu Kwaimawa, in Kwaimawa village, Dutse LGA. Although the kidnappers had escaped with the victim before police arrival, Kwaimawa was released the same day in Baranda Forest, Dutse LGA.

Acting on a tip-off, a joint team including the police, State Intelligence Bureau, and the Vigilante Group of Nigeria raided the Rigija Fulani settlement in Hara Village, Dutse LGA, on November 18, recovering 39 cows, four sheep, a broken rifle butt, a chain, and a Boxer motorcycle (registration KMC 790 HJ Kano), believed to belong to the fleeing kidnappers. The items are now in police custody for investigation.

Further investigations led to the arrest of three men: Samaila Adamu, Illiyasu Abdu, and Mamman Abdullahi, who were identified by the released victim as his abductors. Police say all suspects remain under investigation and will face prosecution upon conclusion of inquiries.

Union Minister Pralhad Joshi, overseeing the BJP's campaign in Rajasthan, voiced strong optimism that the party is on track to secure convincing victories in the upcoming state elections in Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and Chhattisgarh. Joshi highlighted frequent collaboration with other BJP leaders and drew parallels to the party's decisive win in Rajasthan's 2013 elections. 

The BJP will release its Rajasthan election manifesto, known as the 'Sankalp Patra,' on November 16, with President JP Nadda officiating the launch. Although full details have not been disclosed, insiders suggest the document will propose new wage measures for government workers, support programs for the unorganized workforce, expansions to the Devnarayan scheme for religious sites, as well as promises like free education up to the postgraduate level and lower-priced gas cylinders for families under select social programs. According to party officials, input from a vast number of Rajasthani citizens was incorporated in drafting the manifesto. 

Rajasthan voters will go to the polls on November 25, with votes to be counted on December 3. In the previous 2018 election, Congress took 99 seats and, with support from the BSP and independents, formed the government, while BJP secured 73 seats. 

Meanwhile, in Madhya Pradesh, the BJP has already launched its 'Modi ki Guarantee, BJP ka Trust, Madhya Pradesh Sankalp Patra 2023' electoral manifesto. Elections in that state occur on November 17, with results being announced December 3.

article_content: In 2022, SpaceX COO Gwynne Shotwell emailed employees, asking them to focus on their jobs and SpaceX's mission to get humanity to Mars as quickly as possible. This message came after employees raised workplace concerns in an open letter, according to Reuters. The letter criticized what they said was SpaceX's dismissive attitude toward employee issues and inconsistent enforcement of disciplinary policies. Nine employees who participated in writing or supporting the open letter were fired, and eight of those have since filed unfair labor practice complaints with the National Labor Relations Board. A central issue highlighted by employees is safety procedures at SpaceX. Reuters' investigation found that at least 600 workers suffered injuries at SpaceX facilities across the US since 2014. The report also notes that, before 2021 and 2022, the company often failed to submit required workplace injury data. At three major SpaceX facilities, average injury rates significantly exceeded the broader space industry's average of 0.8 injuries per 100 workers in 2022. Brownsville, Texas, reported 4.8 injuries per 100 workers in 2022, Hawthorne, California had 1.8, and McGregor, Texas reported 2.7. Reported injuries included nine workers with head injuries (one with a traumatic brain injury) and seventeen workers with crushed hands or fingers. Additional issues detailed by current and former employees include allegations of workers using the stimulant Adderall without prescriptions, and some employees sleeping in bathrooms at the Brownsville site. Welding staff reportedly worked in tents in temperatures up to 100 degrees Fahrenheit and sometimes received IV treatments to combat heat-related illness. Employees told Reuters that CEO Elon Musk exhibited a relaxed attitude toward safety, sometimes playing with a novelty flamethrower and expressing a dislike for safety-yellow attire. Tom Moline, a former SpaceX engineer dismissed after raising workplace complaints, told Reuters that the company’s commitment to reaching Mars as quickly as possible often outweighed safety considerations. SpaceX did not respond to Insider's request for comment.
translated_content: Godine 2022, operativna direktorka SpaceX-a Gwynne Shotwell poslala je zaposlenima mejl u kojem ih je pozvala da se fokusiraju na svoj posao i misiju kompanije – da što pre odvedu čovečanstvo na Mars. Ova poruka usledila je nakon što su zaposleni uputili otvoreno pismo sa pritužbama na radno okruženje, navodi Reuters. U pismu se kritikuje, kako su zaposleni naveli, SpaceX-ov odbijajući stav prema njihovim problemima i nedosledno sprovođenje disciplinskih mera. Devetoro zaposlenih koji su učestvovali u pisanju ili podržali otvoreno pismo dobili su otkaz, a osmoro njih je nakon toga podnelo žalbe zbog nepoštene radne prakse Američkom odboru za radne odnose. Jedno od glavnih pitanja koje su zaposleni istakli jesu bezbednosne procedure u SpaceX-u. Reutersova istraga otkrila je da je najmanje 600 radnika pretrpelo povrede u SpaceX objektima širom SAD od 2014. godine. Izveštaj takođe navodi da kompanija pre 2021. i 2022. godine često nije dostavljala obavezne podatke o povredama na radu. U tri glavna SpaceX objekta, prosečne stope povreda znatno su prevazilazile prosek u industriji svemira, koji iznosi 0,8 povreda na 100 radnika u 2022. godini. Brownsville, Teksas je zabeležio 4,8 povreda, Hawthorne, Kalifornija 1,8, a McGregor, Teksas 2,7 povreda na 100 radnika tokom 2022. Prijavljene povrede uključuju devet radnika sa povredama glave (jedan sa traumatskom povredom mozga) i sedamnaestoro sa smrvljenim šakama ili prstima. Dodatni problemi koje su izneli sadašnji i bivši zaposleni obuhvataju navode da su radnici koristili stimulans Adderall bez recepta i da su neki spavali u toaletima na lokaciji u Brownsvilleu. Zavarivači su, navodno, radili u šatorima na temperaturama do 38°C i dobijali infuzije kako bi mogli da nastave da rade pri velikoj vrućini. Zaposleni su za Reuters rekli da CEO Elon Musk ima opušten stav prema bezbednosti, ponekad se igrajući sa improvizovanim bacačem plamena i izražavajući nesklonost ka zaštitnim fluorescentnim uniformama. Tom Moline, bivši inženjer SpaceX-a, otpušten nakon što je izneo pritužbe na radno mesto, rekao je za Reuters da predanost kompanije cilju odlaska na Mars često nadjačava brigu za bezbednost. SpaceX nije odgovorio na Insajderov zahtev za komentar.

article_content: Amsterdam-based engineer Nell Watson recently warned at a conference that future generations could be at risk from robots with advanced artificial intelligence if they are not programmed to value human life. According to Watson, it is not enough to teach machines kindness, as robots could interpret compassion in ways that harm humanity. She emphasized that ensuring machines understand human values is crucial to prevent them from causing harm. Watson explained that computer chips may soon reach the cognitive power of a bumblebee, which would allow machines to analyze social situations and understand their environment. She noted advancements in brain research and deep learning are increasing machines' awareness and capabilities, leading to significant changes in society. Tech companies like Google are developing AI-driven technologies, such as self-driving cars that can sense and respond to their environments. Google has also acquired robotics companies and established an ethics board to guide AI development, following concerns voiced by experts such as Elon Musk. Musk has invested in AI companies to monitor technological developments and prevent potential misuse. Shane Legg, co-founder of DeepMind, stated that AI may be the top risk facing humanity this century and could contribute to human extinction. DeepMind, founded by neuroscientist Demis Hassabis, creates software that mimics human thought processes. Japan is at the forefront of developing robots to assist the elderly and injured. While Watson's warnings are serious, she also noted that robots could help humanity achieve greater self-understanding. Similar concerns have been expressed by Elon Musk and highlighted in Nick Bostrom's book 'Superintelligence: Paths, Dangers, Strategies.' Musk has voiced the view that AI could surpass the threat posed by nuclear weapons, and has invested in companies such as Vicarious, which is developing technology to replicate human brain functions. AI company Vicarious is developing machine learning software that interprets images and videos similarly to humans, using a new computational approach. Their breakthroughs include algorithms capable of solving Captchas, which are used to distinguish humans from bots online. Physicist Stephen Hawking has also warned of the risks posed by AI, suggesting it could be the most significant and potentially last event in human history. He stated that dismissing concerns about AI as mere science fiction could be a grave mistake.
translated_content: Inženjerka iz Amsterdama, Nell Watson, nedavno je na konferenciji upozorila da buduće generacije mogu biti ugrožene od robota sa naprednom veštačkom inteligencijom ukoliko im se ne usade vrednosti ljudskog života. Prema njenim rečima, nije dovoljno naučiti mašine ljubaznosti, jer roboti mogu pogrešno protumačiti saosećanje i time naštetiti čovečanstvu. Istakla je da je od suštinske važnosti da mašine razumeju ljudske vrednosti kako bi se sprečila potencijalna šteta. Watson je objasnila da bi kompjuterski čipovi uskoro mogli dostići nivo kognitivne moći bumbara, što bi im omogućilo da analiziraju društvene situacije i razumeju svoju okolinu. Navela je da napredak u istraživanju mozga i deep learning tehnologijama povećava svest i sposobnosti mašina, što donosi velike promene u društvu. Tehnološke kompanije kao što je Google razvijaju tehnologije zasnovane na veštačkoj inteligenciji, poput automobila koji se sami voze i mogu da prepoznaju svoju okolinu i reaguju na nju. Google je takođe kupio nekoliko robotskih kompanija i osnovao etički odbor za nadzor razvoja AI, nakon upozorenja stručnjaka poput Elona Muska. Musk ulaže u AI kompanije kako bi pratio razvoj tehnologije i sprečio zloupotrebe. Shane Legg, suosnivač DeepMind-a, izjavio je da bi veštačka inteligencija mogla biti najveći rizik za čovečanstvo ovog veka i doprineti njegovom nestanku. DeepMind, koji je osnovao neuronaučnik Demis Hassabis, razvija softver koji imitira ljudske misaone procese. Japan prednjači u razvoju robota za pomoć starijima i povređenima. Iako su Watsonina upozorenja ozbiljna, ona smatra da roboti mogu pomoći čovečanstvu da bolje razume samo sebe. Slične zabrinutosti izneli su Elon Musk i Nick Bostrom u knjizi 'Superinteligencija: putevi, opasnosti, strategije.' Musk smatra da AI može predstavljati veću pretnju od nuklearnog oružja i investira u kompanije poput Vicarious-a, koja razvija tehnologiju za oponašanje funkcija ljudskog mozga. Kompanija Vicarious razvija softver za mašinsko učenje koji tumači slike i video materijal slično ljudima, koristeći novu računarsku metodologiju. Njihova dostignuća obuhvataju algoritme koji mogu rešavati Captcha testove, koji služe razlikovanju ljudi i botova na internetu. Fizičar Stephen Hawking takođe je upozorio na rizike od veštačke inteligencije, sugerišući da bi to mogao biti najvažniji, a možda i poslednji događaj u ljudskoj istoriji. On je istakao da bi ignorisanje ovih pitanja kao naučne fantastike bila ozbiljna greška.

article_content: Police are investigating whether a three-year-old boy from Oberon, in the NSW Central Tablelands, became critically injured after being knocked over by his family dogs. The incident occurred around 1pm on Sunday, while the boy was walking with his mother and stepfather in a park. He sustained head injuries after reportedly getting tangled in the leads of an Alsatian and a husky, according to Detective Inspector Luke Rankin from the Chifley Local Area Command, as reported by the Western Advocate. Police are working to determine if the child’s injuries are consistent with what his parents described. After the boy lost consciousness, he was taken home before emergency services were called. Paramedics treated him at the scene, and he was subsequently airlifted to Westmead Children's Hospital in Sydney, where he remains in critical but stabilizing condition as of Monday morning. A crime scene was established at the family’s home and the park. Forensic officers examined the locations and seized multiple boxes of ammunition from the property. The boy's mother and stepfather remain with him at the hospital and have been questioned by police. Police are appealing for witnesses and are working with the NSW Department of Community Services. A husky dog has been removed from the family home, according to the ABC.
translated_content: Policija istražuje da li je trogodišnji dečak iz Oberona, u centralnom delu Novog Južnog Velsa, zadobio teške povrede nakon što su ga oborili porodični psi. Incident se dogodio u nedelju oko 13 časova, dok je dečak šetao sa majkom i očuhom u parku. Prema navodima inspektora detektiva Luka Rankina iz lokalne policije Chifley, koje prenosi Western Advocate, dečak je povredio glavu nakon što se zapetljao u povodce nemačkog ovčara i haskija. Policija pokušava da utvrdi da li povrede odgovaraju opisu koji su dali roditelji. Nakon što je dečak izgubio svest, odveden je kući pre nego što su pozvane hitne službe. Hitna pomoć ga je zbrinula na licu mesta, a potom je helikopterom prebačen u dečju bolnicu Westmead u Sidneju, gde je i dalje u kritičnom, ali stabilnom stanju od ponedeljka ujutru. Kriminalistička istraga se sprovodila u porodičnoj kući i parku. Forenzičari su pregledali te lokacije i zaplenili više kutija municije iz kuće. Dečakova majka i očuh su uz njega u bolnici i ispitani su od strane policije. Policija apeluje na svedoke i sarađuje sa Odeljenjem za društvene usluge Novog Južnog Velsa. Pas haski je uklonjen iz porodične kuće, navodi ABC.

article_content:
Steven Gerrard expressed his satisfaction with Roy Hodgson's decision to select younger players for England's World Cup squad, noting that the team's energy is beneficial as he approaches his 34th birthday. Speaking on ITV ahead of the Champions League final, in which Real Madrid defeated Atletico Madrid 4-1, Gerrard welcomed the inclusion of players like Luke Shaw, Ross Barkley, and Raheem Sterling, who will travel to Brazil. Gerrard was greeted in the studio by former teammate Xabi Alonso, who was suspended for the Champions League final.

Gerrard stated, 'The team and the squad are full of energy and legs, which is good for me approaching my 34th birthday.' He added, 'Although we’ve only been together for four or five days, the atmosphere is positive and is building as the matches draw nearer. Winning games helps build team spirit as well.'

Reflecting on previous disappointments at major tournaments, Gerrard said these experiences drive him to try and bring success for England fans in what could be his last international competition.

Ahead of England's World Cup opener against Italy on June 14, Gerrard noted that Roy Hodgson would use the upcoming friendlies against Peru, Ecuador, and Honduras to finalize his preferred starting lineup, while possibly making a few adjustments.

Gerrard also praised Real Madrid’s Angel Di Maria for his relentless performance in the Champions League final, highlighting his impact in assisting Gareth Bale’s goal. He acknowledged that Madrid's substitutions, particularly bringing on Marcelo, proved to be crucial for their victory.

article_content: Seven years after her life was saved by a stem cell donation, Sofia Gardella, a nine-year-old from Nottingham, finally met her donor, Dana Ernst Behme. Dana, who lives in Germany, flew to the UK, and together they shared an emotional reunion at Birmingham Airport. When Sofia was just two, she was diagnosed with a rare genetic disorder, Congenital Amegakaryocytic Thrombocytopenia (CAMT), which limited her body's ability to produce crucial blood-clotting cells. Dana was found to be a genetic match through the Anthony Nolan charity and provided a stem cell transplant that transformed Sofia's life. Although they had exchanged emails for five years, this was their first meeting in person. Both expressed immense gratitude for the connection that brought them together. Anthony Nolan chief executive Henny Braund called the meeting deeply heartwarming, celebrating the chance for Sofia and Dana to finally meet.
translated_content: Sedam godina nakon što joj je život spašen donacijom matičnih ćelija, devetogodišnja Sofija Gardela iz Notingema konačno je upoznala svoju donorku, Danu Ernst Behme. Dana, koja živi u Nemačkoj, doputovala je u Veliku Britaniju, gde su se na aerodromu u Birmingemu emotivno susrele. Kada je Sofija imala samo dve godine, dijagnostikovana joj je retka genetska bolest, kongenitalna amegakariocitna trombocitopenija (CAMT), zbog koje njeno telo nije proizvodilo ključne ćelije za zgrušavanje krvi. Preko humanitarne organizacije Anthony Nolan, Dana je pronađena kao genetski podudaran donor i donirala je matične ćelije koje su promenile Sofijin život. Iako su pet godina bile u kontaktu putem mejla, ovo im je bio prvi susret uživo. Obe su iskazale veliku zahvalnost zbog veze koja ih je povezala. Izvršni direktor organizacije Anthony Nolan, Heni Braund, opisao je njihov susret kao veoma dirljiv, ističući radost što su Sofija i Dana napokon mogle da se upoznaju.

article_content: Prime Minister Rishi Sunak's cabinet reshuffle has drawn criticism from Brexit-supporting members of the Conservative Party, according to the Daily Telegraph. The paper reports that Sunak offered former Prime Minister David Cameron a cabinet post during a face-to-face meeting last Tuesday, preceding controversy over an article by Suella Braverman accusing the police of bias. Sources in Downing Street suggest Braverman's remarks prompted the reshuffle to be scheduled earlier. The Guardian states that former Conservative leader William Hague played a role in facilitating Lord Cameron's return. The changes are described as 'high-stakes,' targeting stronger support in traditional Conservative southern constituencies, known as the 'blue wall,' even if it risks losing votes in 'red wall' areas previously held by Labour. Some see this as a possible last chance for Sunak to revive his political standing. Headlining the move as a major risk, the Daily Mail highlights Esther McVey's appointment as 'minister for common sense,' with responsibilities including addressing 'woke' culture in the civil service and public sector. The Economist considers Cameron’s comeback 'peculiar,' observing that in British politics, the perception of competence often outweighs actual achievement. The Times features a photograph of a smiling Lord Cameron described as 'back from the wilderness,' while The Sun notes his preference for being called 'Dave.' Moving away from politics, the Daily Mail reports on a US study suggesting that losing ninety minutes of sleep a night may increase the risk of type two diabetes in women. Experts say sleep deprivation puts stress on insulin-producing cells, potentially raising blood sugar levels, with post-menopausal women most affected. The Daily Mirror outlines the new lineup for ITV's 'I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here,' including TV personalities Josie Gibson and Fred Sirieix, and former Brexit Party leader Nigel Farage, who bookmakers list at 10-1 odds.

Izvan politike, Daily Mail izveštava o američkoj studiji koja sugeriše da gubitak 90 minuta sna svakog dana može povećati rizik od dijabetesa tipa 2 kod žena. article_content: Zombies, 'World of Warcraft' characters, and showgirls in elaborate costumes packed Shanghai's New International Expo Centre from July 31 to August 3 for the 12th annual ChinaJoy event. One of the major highlights was the annual cosplay competition, where participants—individually or in teams—dressed up as characters from comic books, movies, and video games. They were judged based on their costumes, performances, and audience response. Many contestants spent months preparing, making the event visually spectacular. ChinaJoy, officially known as the China Digital Entertainment Expo and Conference, is the country's largest gaming and digital entertainment exhibition. This year's expo set a new attendance record with 250,224 visitors. Like Los Angeles' E3 and the Tokyo Game Show, ChinaJoy has grown from a local event focused on online games into the flagship exhibition for China's gaming industry, featuring online, mobile, and console games as well as other digital products.

Jedan od glavnih momenata bio je godišnji cosplay takmičenje, gde su se učesnici, pojedinačno ili u timovima, maskirali kao junaci iz stripova, filmova i video igara. Sudije su ih ocenjivale na osnovu kostima, nastupa i reakcije publike. Mnogi učesnici su se mesecima pripremali, zbog čega je događaj bio vizuelno spektakularan. ChinaJoy, zvanično poznat kao Kineski digitalni sajam zabave i konferencija, najveća je izložba igara i digitalne zabave u zemlji. Ovogodišnji sajam postavio je novi rekord posećenosti sa 250.224 posetilaca. Kao i E3 u Los Anđelesu i Tokyo Game Show, ChinaJoy je prerastao iz lokalnog događaja fokusiranog na onlajn igre u vodeću izložbu kineske gejming industrije koja obuhvata onlajn, mobilne i konzolne igre, kao i druge digitalne proizvode.

article_content: During the State Opening of Parliament in London, King Charles III delivered the legislative program for Britain’s Conservative government, emphasizing tougher sentences for major crimes and promising economic growth. The speech, composed by Prime Minister Rishi Sunak’s team, outlined plans described as 'difficult but necessary' for national improvement. Opposition leaders and business groups criticized the address as lacking effective strategies to revive the sluggish economy. This is likely the last King’s Speech before the general election, and it marks Sunak’s first chance to present major legislative plans since becoming prime minister a year ago. The previous session was opened by Boris Johnson under Queen Elizabeth II’s reign. After his mother’s death, Charles ascended the throne and paid tribute to her at the ceremony—his first King’s Speech since 1951. The legislative package signals the Conservatives’ election strategy, at a time when they trail Labour by as much as 20 percentage points in the polls. Law and order is a key focus, with proposals for stricter penalties, including life-without-parole for sadistic murders and ending early release for serious sexual offenders. Other laws include reforms in football club management and unlicensed taxi regulations. Some initiatives are promoted as post-Brexit 'freedoms,' such as streamlining data protection laws to replace the EU’s GDPR and banning live animal exports for slaughter. The government also plans to continue loosening environmental rules, including annually granting new licenses for North Sea oil and gas extraction—measures intended to protect jobs and energy supplies. However, environmentalists and opposition parties argue these policies will undermine the UK’s shift to renewable energy and its goal of net zero emissions by 2050. King Charles, obliged to remain impartial, showed no outward reaction to policies, even as a lifelong campaigner for environmental issues. The speech contained few detailed economic measures but announced bills aimed at regulating AI and self-driving cars, and opening up trade with Pacific Rim partners via the recently joined CPTPP agreement. Further economic policy details are expected from Chancellor Jeremy Hunt’s autumn budget on November 22. Other proposals include gradually raising the legal age for tobacco purchases—so no one turning 14 this year can ever legally buy cigarettes—and banning 'politically motivated' boycotts by public bodies, targeting actions like boycotting Israel. Some earlier pledged legislation, such as banning conversion therapy for LGBTQ+ people, was dropped, leading to criticism from organizations like Stonewall. The ceremonial opening combined royal tradition with political proceedings, including historical security checks and the king’s carriage procession. Monarchs remain barred from entering the House of Commons, a rule rooted in events from the 17th century’s English Civil War.

Među predloženim zakonima su i postepeno povećanje starosne granice za kupovinu duvana—tako da niko ko 2023. puni 14 godina više nikada neće moći legalno da kupi cigarete—kao i zabrana „politički motivisanih“ bojkota država od strane javnih tela, posebno usmereno na sprečavanje bojkota Izraela. Three women have filed a class action lawsuit accusing Stevens Transport, a trucking company, of discriminating against them based on gender. The plaintiffs—Kim Howard, Ashli Streeter, and a third woman listed anonymously—applied for driver positions at Stevens Transport between April and June 2023. According to the lawsuit, their hiring processes were either delayed or denied because there were not enough female trainers available.

Stevens Transport enforces a same-sex-only training policy, stating that women can only be trained by female trainers. As a result, the women were placed on a months-long waitlist, while male applicants were hired and began working sooner, the complaint says. Both Howard and Streeter reportedly expressed willingness to be trained by male trainers, but their requests were denied. Other female applicants were reportedly told there was a hiring freeze for women.

In response to these alleged practices, the nonprofit REAL Women in Trucking partnered with civil rights attorney Peter Romer-Friedman's law firm to file discrimination charges against Stevens Transport with the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC). Romer-Friedman stated that same-sex training policies are a significant barrier for women seeking jobs in trucking and described this as a well-documented case of discrimination. He emphasized that the EEOC complaint is a first step that could lead to a federal civil rights lawsuit.

Women remain underrepresented in the trucking industry. According to Bureau of Labor Statistics data, they accounted for about 5.5% of full-time drivers in 2018, rising to approximately 6.3% in 2022. Studies suggest women truck drivers have fewer accidents and are less likely to leave their jobs compared to male counterparts. Stevens Transport did not respond to requests for comment.

The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) of the Central Bank of Nigeria is expected to raise its Monetary Policy Rate (MPR) by at least 100 basis points during its meeting on November 20th and 21st. This comes after the MPC missed its September meeting following the appointment of the new CBN Governor. Since the last meeting in July, Nigeria’s monetary landscape has shifted quickly, largely due to policy measures introduced by the CBN starting in October.

A report by Cordros Capital, published on Friday and cited in The PUNCH, indicated that further hikes to the MPR would signal that the apex bank remains committed to its fight against inflation. Near-term inflation is anticipated to rise further, possibly peaking at 28.02% year-on-year in December. The report stated that keeping the MPR at current levels would not align with the recent increase in market interest rates. As such, the Committee is likely to favor another rate hike to ensure the MPR continues to signal overall market rates and address persistent inflationary pressures.

Significant policy changes since the last MPC meeting include the removal of the maximum cap on the Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) and the resumption of Open Market Operations (OMO) bill auctions after about eight months of inactivity. On August 10th, the CBN auctioned OMO bills which were oversubscribed; the stop rates averaged 12.49% across different tenors, considerably higher than the average 8.50% at the December 2022 auction. Subsequent auctions in late October and early November saw even higher yield rates, with a 365-day bill closing at 17.98% (effective yield: 21.91%).

The purpose of these frequent OMO auctions is twofold: absorbing excess system liquidity and encouraging foreign portfolio investment. As liquidity tightens, local yields are expected to rise, making naira-denominated assets more attractive to investors.

Inflation continues to rise, reaching 27.33% in October, up from 24.08% in July and 26.72% in September. Both food and core inflation are major contributors to this upward trend. Currency market pressures remain, but increased investor interest has been attributed to higher local yields and the CBN’s actions to address outstanding foreign exchange obligations.

As a result, experts expect the MPC to implement at least a 100 basis points increase to the MPR at the November meeting, reinforcing the CBN’s inflation-fighting stance and aligning with ongoing developments in Nigeria's financial markets.

Ovo sledi nakon što je MPC propustio septembarski sastanak zbog imenovanja novog guvernera CBN-a. Od poslednjeg sastanka u julu, monetarni ambijent Nigerije se brzo menja, uglavnom zahvaljujući merama koje je CBN uveo od oktobra.

Izveštaj kompanije Cordros Capital, objavljen u petak i citiran u The PUNCH-u, navodi da bi dalje povećanje MPR pokazalo odlučnost centralne banke u borbi protiv inflacije. Očekuje se da inflacija nastavi da raste i da dostigne vrhunac od 28,02% na godišnjem nivou u decembru. U izveštaju se takođe navodi da bi zadržavanje MPR na trenutnim nivoima bilo neusklađeno sa nedavnim rastom tržišnih kamata, pa se očekuje novo povećanje MPR kako bi nastavila da bude signal kamatama na tržištu i odgovorila na postojeće inflatorne pritiske.

Značajne promene od poslednjeg MPC sastanka uključuju ukidanje ograničenja na Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) i ponovno pokretanje OMO aukcija nakon osmomesečne pauze. Na aukciji 10. avgusta, OMO obveznice su imale prosečnu stopu od 12,49% na različite rokove, što je mnogo više u odnosu na 8,50% sa aukcije u decembru 2022. Sledeće aukcije krajem oktobra i početkom novembra imale su još veće prinose, pri čemu je obveznica na 365 dana zatvorena na 17,98% (efektivni prinos: 21,91%).

Cilj ovih čestih OMO aukcija je upijanje viška likvidnosti i privlačenje stranih portfeljskih investitora. Sa smanjenjem likvidnosti, očekuje se rast domaćih prinosa, što naira sredstva čini privlačnijim investitorima.

Inflacija stalno raste: oktobra je bila 27,33%, u julu 24,08%, a u septembru 26,72%. I rast cena hrane i osnovne inflacije značajno doprinose ovom trendu. Devizni pritisci i dalje postoje, ali raste interesovanje investitora zbog većih prinosa i napora CBN-a da reši devizne obaveze.

Zbog svega toga, stručnjaci očekuju da će MPC na novembarskom sastanku povećati MPR za najmanje 100 baznih poena, čime bi CBN dodatno istakao svoja nastojanja u suzbijanju inflacije i prilagodio se promenama na finansijskom tržištu Nigerije.
