Bayern Munich's sporting director, Matthias Sammer, says Arjen Robben is on the same level as Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi. Robben is among several Bayern players named in the 23-man shortlist for the 2014 Ballon d'Or after an outstanding year for both club and country.

'Sammer told German newspaper Bild, "Robben is a world-class player and matches Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo. He fully deserves all recognition. You can't put a price on Arjen, not as a player and not as a person. He benefits from having a balanced and stable life."'

Dubbed 'The Flying Dutchman,' Robben played a key role in Bayern Munich securing the domestic double last season. Sammer continued, "I don't know if he's better than ever before, but the consistency with which he performs in big games and his training intensity are extraordinary."

Robben has maintained his strong form this season, scoring six goals in nine appearances after helping Bayern win last season's domestic double.

Samer je za nemački list Bild rekao: „Roben je igrač svetske klase i ravnopravan je Mesiju i Ronaldu. Potpuno zaslužuje svako priznanje. Ne možete da odredite cenu za Arjena, ni kao igrača ni kao osobu. Prednost mu je što živi stabilnim i izbalansiranim životom.”

Poznat kao 'Leteći Holanđanin', Roben je odigrao ključnu ulogu u osvajanju duple krune za Bajern prošle sezone. Samer je dodao: „Ne znam da li je bolji nego ranije, ali doslednost kojom nastupa na najvišem nivou u velikim utakmicama i njegov intenzitet na treninzima su izuzetni.”

Roben je i ove sezone nastavio odličnu formu, postigavši šest golova u devet nastupa nakon što je pomogao Bajernu da osvoji prošlosezonsku duplu krunu.

article_content: U.S. Senator Tom Coburn announced on Thursday that he will retire at the end of the current congressional session, finishing his term in the Senate two years early. The 65-year-old Oklahoma Republican, who has been undergoing cancer treatment, insisted in his statement that his decision goes beyond health concerns. Coburn explained that he now feels he can best support his family by shifting his attention away from politics, and intends to conclude his remaining time in office with dedication. Before becoming a senator, Coburn worked as an obstetrician and first entered politics as a member of the U.S. House of Representatives from 1995 to 2001. He was elected to the Senate in 2004 and re-elected in 2010. Highlighting his roots, Coburn remarked on his journey from being a doctor in Muskogee with no prior political experience to holding public office, and encouraged greater civic involvement, emphasizing that meaningful change is possible when ordinary people participate in government. Coburn and his wife are parents to three children and have seven grandchildren. Consistent with a promise to limit his service, Coburn is stepping down after two Senate terms, maintaining his belief that public office is a responsibility rather than a lifelong career. His announcement closes with a call for citizen engagement and a focus on family. Dana Bash of CNN contributed to this report.

Suzanne Somers, the actress best known for her roles in the television sitcoms 'Three's Company' and 'Step by Step,' has died at age 76. According to her publicist, R. Couri Hay, Somers passed away early Sunday, on the eve of what would have been her 77th birthday, following a long battle with breast cancer that began more than twenty years ago. She was surrounded by her husband, Alan, her son, Bruce, and immediate family, who had gathered to celebrate her birthday. Instead, they will honor her extraordinary life and thank her many fans for their support.

In addition to her acting career, Somers was known for her successful business ventures in wellness, notably as the spokesperson for the ThighMaster. She authored 27 books, mainly focusing on natural health. First diagnosed with breast cancer in 2000, Somers became known for choosing alternative health treatments over chemotherapy, a decision that generated controversy. In a July social media post, she revealed that she had privately continued to fight cancer since her initial diagnosis, using both alternative and conventional treatments.

Somers first gained attention for her role in George Lucas' 'American Graffiti' (1973), where she famously mouthed 'I love you' to Richard Dreyfuss' character, a moment she later described as life-changing. She rose to fame as Chrissy Snow on 'Three's Company' from 1977 to 1981, playing the beloved 'dumb blonde' character with a unique and thoughtful approach. In a 2020 interview with CBS, Somers stated she was fired from the show for requesting equal pay to her male co-stars, noting that significant pay disparities existed.

Her longest-running television role was as a mother in a blended family on 'Step by Step,' a series that aired from 1991 to 1998. According to Hay, a private family burial will be held this week, with a memorial service planned for next month.

Sada će, umesto toga, obeležiti njen izuzetan život i zahvaliti se brojnim fanovima na podršci.

Pored glume, Somers je postala poznata i kao uspešna preduzetnica u oblasti zdravlja, posebno kao zaštitno lice ThighMaster uređaja. Napisala je 27 knjiga, uglavnom o prirodnom zdravlju. Prvi put joj je rak dojke dijagnostikovan 2000. godine, a poznata je i po tome što je izabrala alternativne tretmane umesto hemoterapije, što je izazvalo polemike. U objavi iz jula na društvenim mrežama otkrila je da se i dalje privatno suočava s rakom, koristeći i alternativne i konvencionalne metode.

article_content: On Wednesday, the House of Representatives gave the Accountant General of the Federation, Mrs. Oluwatoyin Madein, a 72-hour deadline to submit a comprehensive report detailing the use of N100 billion COVID-19 intervention funds. These funds were approved and disbursed by the administration of former President Muhammadu Buhari to various ministries, departments, and agencies (MDAs) between 2020 and 2022. Chairman of the House Committee on Public Accounts, Bamidele Salam, issued the notice in Abuja, expressing disappointment over the Accountant General’s failure to comply with the committee’s resolution, which required the submission of the report by October 27, 2023. Salam explained that the committee had been directed by the House to investigate expenses incurred under COVID-19 interventions, particularly from 2020 to 2022. He noted the Accountant General had been formally asked to provide details of all fund releases in line with the Appropriation Act, including interventions through the Central Bank of Nigeria for different MDAs. Although the committee expected the submission by October 27, it had yet to receive any documentation from the Accountant General’s office as of Salam’s announcement. He emphasized the report’s importance in guiding the committee’s investigation. Salam stated that the Deputy Director from the Accountant General’s office was being asked to notify Mrs. Madein that she had not fulfilled the committee’s request. If there were legitimate reasons for missing the deadline, she was expected to communicate with the committee and request an extension. Consequently, the AGF was directed to submit the requested report before the end of business on Friday, November 3, 2023. The House’s action followed a motion concerning the alleged mismanagement of COVID-19 intervention funds allocated by the Federal Government to MDAs between 2020 and 2022. During the debate, lawmaker Nyampa Zakari emphasized Parliament’s role in ensuring transparency in the use of public funds. He recalled the toll the COVID-19 pandemic had on lives, jobs, and economic opportunities both globally and in Nigeria. Zakari highlighted that the Federal Government took several measures, including budget allocations and securing support from international donors, to fight the pandemic. He noted N83.9 billion was appropriated for COVID-19 response in the 2020 Appropriation Act, along with over N100 billion provided through supplementary budgets and international donors. Citing Auditor-General’s reports and other sources, Zakari said significant COVID-19 relief funds and donations were allegedly diverted and unaccounted for by some MDAs. He expressed concern that poor accountability regarding these funds could harm Nigeria’s economic standing and future opportunities.

Ova sredstva je odobrila i isplatila administracija bivšeg predsednika Muhammadu Buharija raznim ministarstvima, odeljenjima i agencijama (MDA) između 2020. i 2022. godine. Predsedavajući Odbora za javne račune, Bamidele Salam, obavestio je u Abudži, izražavajući razočarenje što računovotkinja još nije ispunila odluku odbora da dostavi izveštaj do 27. oktobra 2023. godine. Salam je objasnio da je odbor dobio zadatak od Doma da istraži troškove u okviru COVID-19 intervencija, posebno od 2020. do 2022. godine. Naglasio je da je računovotkinja zvanično zamoljena da dostavi detalje o svim isplatama prema Zakonu o budžetu, uključujući intervencije preko Centralne banke Nigerije za različite MDA. Iako je odbor očekivao izveštaj do 27. oktobra, do Salamove izjave nije primljena nijedna dokumentacija iz kancelarije računovotkinje. On je istakao značaj izveštaja za sprovođenje istrage odbora. Salam je naveo da je zamenik direktora iz kancelarije računovotkinje poslat da obavesti gospođu Madein da nije ispunila zahtev odbora. Ako postoje opravdani razlozi za kašnjenje, očekuje se da to zvanično dostavi odboru i zatraži produženje roka. Računovotkinja je upućena da traženi izveštaj dostavi najkasnije do kraja radnog vremena u petak, 3. novembra 2023. godine. Ova odluka Doma usledila je nakon predloga o navodnom lošem upravljanju sredstvima za COVID-19 koja su dodeljena MDA-ima od strane Savezne vlade između 2020. i 2022. godine. Tokom rasprave, poslanik Nyampa Zakari naglasio je ulogu parlamenta za transparentnost u upravljanju javnim sredstvima. Podsetio je na posledice COVID-19 pandemije po živote, radna mesta i ekonomske prilike u zemlji i globalno. Zakari je istakao da je Savezna vlada preduzela više mera, uključujući budžetska izdvajanja i međunarodnu pomoć, za borbu protiv pandemije. Naveo je da je Zakonom o budžetu za 2020. izdvojeno 83,9 milijardi naira, kao i više od 100 milijardi kroz dodatne budžete i donacije. Pozivajući se na izveštaje generalnog revizora i druge izvore, Zakari tvrdi da su značajna sredstva i donacije za COVID-19 navodno preusmerena i bez evidencije kod pojedinih MDA-a. Izrazio je zabrinutost da bi loša odgovornost oko tih sredstava mogla negativno uticati na ekonomski rejting i buduće prilike Nigerije.

Continuing adventures can be found in popular series like Midsolar Murders, Seven Kennings, Empyrean, and Anita Blake. Highlights include an injured orc’s unforeseen journey, the conclusion of the Seven Kennings saga, and more from the world of Legends & Lattes. Other notable books involve breaking curses in Scottish castles, daring heists, the aftermath of war, and the complex lives of dragon-riders. Themes span supernatural investigations, magic-infused romance, self-discovery, and the nature of humanity in changing worlds. Readers will discover fantasy romance, Africanfuturist tales, feminist fantasy, and reimagined histories within the month’s offerings. Whether you’re looking for ongoing epic sagas or eager to dive into new adventures, November’s book releases promise magical quests, epic battles, diverse romances, and timely social issues—each unfolding in the vast imagination of speculative fiction.

article_content: Elon Musk’s social media platform X, formerly known as Twitter, has initiated a federal lawsuit against the non-profit Media Matters for America. The lawsuit alleges that Media Matters intentionally produced a report that showed advertisers’ posts next to neo-Nazi and white nationalist content to scare off brands and harm X’s reputation. Media Matters, headquartered in Washington, D.C., rejected the lawsuit as baseless and stands behind its reporting. The controversy intensified when major advertisers like IBM, NBCUniversal, and Comcast pulled their ads from X following Media Matters’ findings that their ads appeared alongside pro-Nazi content. This dispute comes at a challenging time for X, whose business model heavily depends on advertising revenue. Media Matters’ investigation also highlighted that ads from Apple and Oracle appeared next to antisemitic material, and later found ads from Amazon, NBA Mexico, and NBCUniversal next to white nationalist hashtags. X claims in its lawsuit filed in Fort Worth, Texas, that Media Matters fabricated these controversial placements by manipulating X's algorithms—specifically by using accounts that followed known extremist content and major advertisers to create rare scenarios where such ads would appear together. Media Matters President Angelo Carusone called the lawsuit an effort to silence critics and stated confidence in winning in court. Meanwhile, Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton announced an investigation into Media Matters concerning possible fraud connected to its report. Since Musk took over X more than a year ago, advertiser concerns over hate speech have grown. Recent backlash intensified after Musk agreed with a post suggesting Jews hate white people and are indifferent to antisemitism. X CEO Linda Yaccarino reiterated the company’s opposition to discrimination, stating that stopping discrimination is a value everyone should share.

Organizacija Media Matters iz Vašingtona odbacuje tužbu kao neosnovanu i naglašava da stoji iza svog izveštavanja. Kontroverza je eskalirala nakon što su veliki oglašivači, poput IBM-a, NBCUniversal-a i Comcasta, povukli reklame sa X-a zbog otkrića Media Matters-a da su se njihovi oglasi pojavili uz sadržaj koji veliča naciste. Ovaj spor dolazi u izazovnom periodu za X, koji u velikoj meri zavisi od prihoda od oglašavanja. Istraga Media Matters-a takođe je pokazala da su se reklame kompanija Apple i Oracle pojavile pored antisemitskog sadržaja, a kasnije su otkriveni oglasi Amazona, NBA Meksika i NBCUniversala uz heštagove belo-nacionalista. X u tužbi podnetoj u Fort Worthu, Texas, tvrdi da je Media Matters fabricirao ovakve kombinacije manipulacijom algoritma—posebno koristeći naloge koji prate naloge sa ekstremnim sadržajem i oglašivače kako bi stvorio retke situacije u kojima se takvi oglasi pojavljuju zajedno. Predsednik Media Matters-a, Andželo Karusone, tvrdi da je tužba pokušaj da se kritičari ućutkaju i ističe da organizacija očekuje pobedu na sudu. U međuvremenu, državni tužilac Teksasa Ken Pakston najavio je istragu zbog mogućih prevara povezanih sa izveštajem Media Matters-a. Od kada je Musk preuzeo X, zabrinutost oglašivača zbog govora mržnje na platformi raste. Nedavno su kritike pojačane pošto je Musk podržao objavu kojom se sugeriše da Jevreji mrze bele ljude i da su ravnodušni prema antisemitizmu. Izvršna direktorka X-a Linda Jakarino ponovila je stav kompanije protiv diskriminacije, naglašavajući da bi svi trebalo da budemo složni oko toga da svaka diskriminacija prestane.

The Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) reported on Saturday that Severe Cyclonic Storm 'Tej' is steadily advancing over the southwest Arabian Sea. Over the past six hours, the storm has moved west-northwest at a speed of 18 km/h. As of 5:30 PM IST on October 21, 'Tej' was located approximately 440 km east-southeast of Socotra, Yemen; 800 km south-southeast of Salalah, Oman; and 830 km southeast of Al Ghaidah, Yemen.

According to the IMD, the storm is expected to continue tracking west-northwest and will likely intensify into a 'very severe cyclonic storm' within the next 12 hours. Afterward, it is predicted to change direction, moving northwest until the morning of October 24, then shifting north-northwest. Landfall is anticipated between Al Ghaidah (Yemen) and Salalah (Oman) during the early hours of October 25.

In response, the IMD has issued weather warnings related to Cyclonic Storm 'Tej' for the southwest Arabian Sea. Fishermen are strongly advised to avoid venturing into the southwest Arabian Sea until October 25. Similar caution is advised in the westcentral Arabian Sea, with warnings remaining in place until the night of October 25. Those already at sea are urged to return to shore immediately.

article_content: Just hours after completing his move to Chelsea, Cesc Fabregas joined the Spanish national team as they prepared for their World Cup opener against Holland. The midfielder, who left Barcelona in a £30 million transfer and is set to earn £150,000 a week at Stamford Bridge, will start his new club career after competing in Brazil. The 27-year-old, who previously captained Arsenal, looked comfortable and cheerful in training alongside Chelsea striker Fernando Torres and Diego Costa, who is also rumored to be heading to Chelsea. Fabregas is set to join Chelsea on a five-year contract following Arsenal’s decision not to re-sign him. The London club invested £30 million to secure his talents, making him one of the top earners on the team. Spain coach Vicente del Bosque expressed confidence ahead of the rematch with Holland, the team they defeated in the 2010 World Cup final. He rejected the idea that Spain has reached its peak, suggesting that new talent continues to emerge from the U-21 squad. Del Bosque emphasized that the team is mature and unafraid of challenges, looking to maintain high standards throughout the tournament. He also praised Holland's football tradition and lauded coach Louis van Gaal’s preparations. Spain faces a demanding group stage, with matches against Holland, Chile, and Australia. Midfielder Xavi acknowledged the tough challenge posed by Holland, but stressed that Spain’s commitment to their own style has brought success in the past and should continue to do so. Meanwhile, veteran goalkeeper Iker Casillas identified Bayern Munich winger Arjen Robben as Holland’s key threat. Casillas, who shared a locker room with Robben at Real Madrid and has faced him several times since, described him as a talented winger. Casillas believes that maintaining their famous humility and enthusiasm will be vital for Spain’s performance. Elsewhere, Manchester United’s Juan Mata is unlikely to start for Spain, while striker David Villa is set to play in Australia’s A-League with Melbourne City next season.

article_content: Richard Mannington Bowes, a 68-year-old former accountant from Ealing, died three days after suffering head injuries sustained while he was attacked by rioters as he tried to put out a fire during the 2011 London riots. Tributes from residents described Bowes as a brave and civic-minded individual devoted to his neighborhood. Bowes had frequently confronted antisocial behavior near his home over several years, facing harassment and vandalism. Despite this, he continued to defend his community, and his actions during the riots ultimately resulted in fatal injuries. After his passing, local residents left flowers and messages of respect at the site of the attack. Neighbor Peter Firstbrook and a police officer attempted to aid Bowes after he was assaulted. Detective Chief Inspector John McFarlane called for witnesses to step forward, emphasizing how senseless and violent the incident was. Police questioned a 22-year-old man in connection with the case. Bowes had lived much of his life in seclusion and had not been in touch with his family for many years. The incident led to a reunion with his sister, Anne Wilderspin, who traveled to London after learning of his condition. Mayor Boris Johnson and Ealing Council Leader Julian Bell publicly recognized Bowes's bravery and discussed memorializing him, including the potential renaming of a street in his honor. The council is also planning an official tribute. The event deeply affected the Ealing community, with residents and business owners expressing shock that such violence took place in their area. Bowes was remembered for his integrity and public spirit. Messages left at the scene expressed appreciation for Bowes's courage and called for justice. Council leaders pledged continued support for his family as the community seeks to recover from the loss and the devastation caused by the riots.

Građani su ga u svojim počastima opisivali kao hrabrog i društveno odgovornog čoveka posvećenog svojoj zajednici. Bous se godinama suprotstavljao antisocijalnom ponašanju u blizini svog doma, trpeo je uznemiravanja i vandalizam. Uprkos svemu, stalno je branio svoje komšije, a njegova odlučnost da ne odustane na kraju ga je koštala života. Nakon njegove smrti, meštani su ostavljali cveće i poruke poštovanja na mestu napada. Komšija Piter Firstbruk i jedan policajac pokušali su da mu pomognu nakon napada. Detektiv glavni inspektor Džon Makfarlejn pozvao je svedoke da se jave, naglašavajući besmisao i brutalnost ovog zločina. Policija je privela 22-godišnjaka u vezi sa slučajem. Bous je veći deo života bio povučen i dugo nije bio u kontaktu sa porodicom. Ovaj tragični događaj doveo je do ponovnog povezivanja sa sestrom En Vajlderspin, koja je doputovala u London čim je saznala šta se dogodilo. Gradonačelnik Boris Džonson i predsednik opštine Iling Džulijan Bel istakli su Bousovu hrabrost i najavili da će zajednica trajno odati počast, možda i preimenovanjem ulice po njemu. Planira se i zvanična opštinska ceremonija. Nasilje je duboko potreslo Iling, a stanovnici i vlasnici radnji izražavali su šok što se ovo dogodilo u njihovom kraju. article_content: WASHINGTON -- President Joe Biden called America's veterans 'the steel spine of this nation' during a Veterans Day ceremony at Arlington National Cemetery. Speaking at the Memorial Amphitheater, Biden recounted notable battles fought by U.S. troops and described their service as 'linked in a chain of honor that stretches back to our founding days. Each bound by a sacred oath to support and defend—not a place, not a person, not a president, but an idea unlike any other in human history. That idea is the United States of America.' Veterans Day, originally called Armistice Day, commemorates the end of World War I on November 11, 1918. Biden noted that World War I was 'unlike any war the world had ever seen before.' The ceremony was personal for Biden and first lady Jill Biden, as their son Beau Biden enlisted in the Delaware Army National Guard in 2003 and served in Iraq in 2008 with the 261st Theater Tactical Signal Brigade. As a captain, Beau earned the Legion of Merit and Bronze Star, and later served two terms as Delaware’s attorney general before passing away in 2015 from brain cancer. 'We miss him,' Biden said, recalling how he had pinned the bars on his son the day he joined the Guard. Biden honored the generations of Americans who have 'stood on the front lines of freedom,' and praised the sacrifices made by veterans and their families. He described the privilege and honor he feels as both president and the father of a service member. He concluded by saying, 'Our veterans are the steel spine of this nation, and their families, like so many of you, are its courageous heart.'

Svaki od njih je vezan svetom zakletvom da štiti i brani—ne mesto, ne osobu, ne predsednika, već ideju, jedinstvenu u ljudskoj istoriji. Ta ideja su Sjedinjene Američke Države.“ Dan veterana, ranije poznat kao Dan primirja, obeležava kraj Prvog svetskog rata 11. novembra 1918. Bajden je naveo da je Prvi svetski rat bio „za razliku od bilo kog rata koji je svet ranije video.“ Ceremonija je bila lična za Bajdena i prvu damu Džil Bajden, jer je njihov sin Bo Bajden 2003. pristupio Nacionalnoj gardi Delavera, a 2008. služio u Iraku u 261. taktičkoj signalnoj brigadi. Kao kapetan, Bo je dobio Orden za zasluge i Bronzanu zvezdu, a kasnije je dva puta izabran za državnog tužioca Delavera pre nego što je preminuo od tumora na mozgu 2015. godine. „Nedostaje nam“, rekao je Bajden, prisećajući se kako je svom sinu prikačio činove na dan kada je pristupio Gardi. Bajden je odao počast generacijama Amerikanaca koji su „stali na prvu liniju slobode“ i pohvalio žrtve veterana i njihovih porodica. Opisao je tu privilegiju i čast kao predsednik i kao otac vojnika. Zaključio je rečima: „Naši veterani su čelična kičma ove nacije, a njihove porodice, poput mnogih od vas, njeno hrabro srce.“

article_content: Despite headlines stating that California's proposed $1-per-pack cigarette tax was defeated, the outcome remains uncertain, and officials say the final result may not be known for weeks. Proposition 29, which would generate an estimated $735 million per year—about three-quarters of it for cancer research—was initially shown as failing by around 65,000 votes out of nearly 4 million cast, a 50.8% to 49.2% margin. However, this count excludes a large number of mail-in and provisional ballots. As of Thursday night, at least 829,863 ballots had yet to be counted according to the California Secretary of State's office, with the actual total likely higher since some counties had not reported figures. 'We've asked counties to report their number of unprocessed ballots, but it's voluntary, so there's no way to know the exact number,' said Allie Schembra, spokeswoman for the Secretary of State. State law requires final vote tallies from counties by July 6, and Secretary of State Debra Bowen has until July 13 to certify the results. By Thursday night, the vote gap had shrunk to less than 53,000. A local weekly quipped, 'Proposition 29 results are close enough to make you want to chain smoke.' Doug Ulman, CEO of Livestrong, said, 'Supporters of Prop 29 are not conceding defeat. We will closely monitor the counting of absentee and provisional ballots. This race is still too close to call, and we remain hopeful for a positive outcome.' Proposition 29 was at the center of intense advertising campaigns. Opponents, largely funded by tobacco companies, spent nearly $47 million, arguing the measure would create a large and unaccountable bureaucracy. Supporters—including Livestrong, the American Cancer Society, the American Lung Association, and New York Mayor Michael Bloomberg—spent about $12 million.

Predlog 29, koji bi godišnje obezbedio oko 735 miliona dolara—od čega bi tri četvrtine išlo za istraživanje raka—prvobitno je prikazan kao neuspešan sa oko 65.000 glasova razlike od skoro 4 miliona datih, odnosno u odnosu 50,8% naspram 49,2%. Međutim, ovaj broj ne uključuje veliki broj glasova putem pošte i privremenih glasačkih listića. Do četvrtka uveče, najmanje 829.863 glasačka listića još nije bilo prebrojano prema podacima kancelarije državnog sekretara Kalifornije, a stvarni broj je verovatno veći jer neke okruge nisu dostavile podatke. 'Zamolili smo okruge da prijave broj neobrađenih glasova, ali to nije obavezno, tako da ne možemo znati tačan broj,' rekla je Ali Šembra, portparolka državnog sekretara. Zakon nalaže da okružni službenici za izbore dostave konačne rezultate do 6. jula, dok državna sekretarka Debra Bouen ima rok do 13. jula da overi rezultate. Do četvrtka uveče, razlika u glasovima smanjila se na manje od 53.000. Kako je primetio jedan lokalni nedeljnik: 'Rezultati Predloga 29 su toliko tesni da poželite da zapalite cigaretu za cigaretom.' Direktor Livestronga, Dag Ulman, izjavio je: 'Pristalice Predloga 29 nisu priznale poraz. Pažljivo ćemo pratiti brojanje kasnih glasova uzetih u obzir i privremenih listića. Ova trka je još uvek previše neizvesna za zaključak i ostajemo optimistični u pogledu ishoda.' Predlog 29 bio je u centru intenzivnih reklamnih kampanja. Protivnici, koje su uglavnom finansirale duvanske kompanije, potrošili su skoro 47 miliona dolara tvrdeći da bi mera stvorila veliku i nekontrolisanu birokratiju. Pristalice—uključujući Livestrong, Američko društvo za borbu protiv raka, Američko udruženje za pluća i njujorškog gradonačelnika Majkla Blumberga—potrošili su oko 12 miliona dolara.

article_content: It's widely known that every snowflake is one of a kind, but the fascinating process leading to their unique forms can only be witnessed through a microscope. Russian videographer Vyacheslav Ivanov has captured this delicate transformation in a stunning, two-minute microscopic time-lapse, revealing how ice crystals shape themselves into hexagonal snowflakes. A snowflake begins when a water droplet in the atmosphere freezes around a dust or pollen particle, creating a tiny ice crystal. As additional water molecules join, the crystal expands outward, developing the classic six-sided pattern. This symmetry results from the hydrogen bonding that organizes water molecules inside the ice. The final form of a snowflake depends largely on temperature and humidity. In milder conditions (around -5°C), snowflakes develop long, needle-like extensions; in colder situations (around -15°C), they become flatter and rounder. Since every snowflake takes a slightly different journey through the ever-changing atmosphere, no two are precisely alike. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) notes that the symmetry of snowflakes is a product of the internal arrangement of water molecules within the crystal, with each extending arm reflecting these precise molecular patterns. Even the smallest fluctuation in atmospheric conditions can dramatically reshape a snowflake as it falls, emphasizing the extraordinary complexity present in nature's smallest creations.
translated_content: Široko je poznato da je svaka pahulja snega jedinstvena, ali fascinantan proces koji dovodi do njihovih posebnih oblika može se videti samo pod mikroskopom. Ruski videograf Vjačeslav Ivanov zabeležio je ovu nežnu transformaciju u prelepom dvominutnom mikroskopskom tajm-lapsu, prikazujući kako se ledeni kristali pretvaraju u heksagonalne pahulje. Pahulja snega nastaje kad se kapljica vode u atmosferi zaledi oko čestice prašine ili polena, stvarajući sićušni ledeni kristal. Kako se pridružuju nove molekule vode, kristal se širi ka spolja i razvija prepoznatljiv šestougaoni oblik. Ova simetrija rezultat je vodoničnih veza koje organizuju molekule vode unutar leda. Konačan oblik pahulje najviše zavisi od temperature i vlažnosti. U blažim uslovima (oko -5°C), pahulje razvijaju duže, igličaste nastavke; u hladnijim uslovima (oko -15°C) postaju spljoštenije i zaobljenije. Pošto svaka pahulja prolazi svoj jedinstveni put kroz promenljivu atmosferu, nijedna nije potpuno ista kao druga. Nacionalna uprava za okeane i atmosferu (NOAA) napominje da simetrija pahulja nastaje zbog unutrašnje strukture molekula vode u kristalu, pri čemu svaki krak odražava te precizne molekularne obrasce. I najmanja promena atmosferskih uslova može dramatično izmeniti oblik pahulje dok pada, naglašavajući neverovatnu složenost prisutnu u najmanjim delovima prirode.

article_content: Daniel Lloyd, age 43, and Joe McCaughey, 26, have been convicted after running an extensive burglary operation at golf clubs over a 16-month period. The two disguised themselves as golfers in order to blend in, accessing changing rooms where they broke into roughly 1,000 lockers across 17 counties. Their tactics included socializing with legitimate club members, wearing hats and changing clothing to avoid being identified by CCTV cameras, and driving vehicles with false number plates. Lloyd and McCaughey targeted complete sets of high-end golf clubs, shoes, and apparel, primarily choosing the most valuable equipment. Investigators believe the pair struck at least 60 golf clubs, sometimes multiple times in the same day, and subsequently sold the stolen items both domestically and overseas. Although they appeared on BBC’s Crimewatch in 2010, their arrests resulted from an NCA investigation into a corrupt lawyer associated with Lloyd. Police searches uncovered evidence of targeted break-ins and research into lock-picking and security. Lloyd, from Bromley in southeast London, resided in a house valued at £800,000 and drove luxury cars like a Bentley and a Range Rover. Authorities found no tax records for his income, suspecting that his affluent lifestyle was financed through these burglaries. After a three-week trial at Birmingham Crown Court, both were found guilty of conspiracy to burgle. Lloyd was sentenced to five years in prison, while McCaughey, from Croydon, received a three-year sentence. Officials estimate that the pair stole more than £750,000 worth of equipment from golf clubs in Nottinghamshire, Yorkshire, Cheshire, Derbyshire, Wiltshire, Greater Manchester, and other counties. Police are now working to recover assets linked to their crimes.

article_content: A Southern California high school girls' basketball coach has been suspended and faces accusations of running up the score after his team won a game 161-2, one of the largest margins in state history. Arroyo Valley High coach Michael Anderson was suspended for two games following last week's win over Bloomington High. Anderson stated he did not intend to humiliate the opposing team. His squad had previously won four games by at least 70 points, and Bloomington had already lost a game by 91 points this season. Anderson said to the San Bernardino Sun on Friday, 'The game just got away from me. I didn't play any starters in the second half. I didn't expect them to struggle that much. I'm not trying to embarrass anybody.' He added that if given another chance, he would have played only reserves after the first quarter or would have preferred not to play the game at all. Bloomington coach Dale Chung criticized Anderson’s tactics, noting that Arroyo Valley used a full-court press for the entire first half, leading to a 104-1 halftime score. 'People shouldn't feel sorry for my team,' Chung said. 'They should feel sorry for his team, which isn't learning the game the right way.' Anderson has served one game of his suspension—during which Arroyo Valley still won, 80-19, against Indian Springs. He will return after missing one more game. 'He's a great X's and O's coach,' Chung said. 'Ethically? Not so much. He knows what he did was wrong.'

Trener Arroyo Valley High, Michael Anderson, suspendovan je na dve utakmice nakon prošlonedeljne pobede nad Bloomington High. Anderson je izjavio da nije imao nameru da ponizi protivnički tim. Njegov tim je prethodno pobedio u četiri utakmice sa najmanje 70 poena razlike, dok je Bloomington već jednom izgubio sa 91 poenom razlike ove sezone. Anderson je za San Bernardino Sun u petak rekao: „Utakmica mi je izmakla kontroli. Nisam igrao sa prvim timom u drugom poluvremenu. Nisam očekivao da će imati tolikih problema. Ne pokušavam nikog da ponizim.“ Dodao je da bi, kad bi mogao da ponovi, igrao samo sa rezervama već posle prve četvrtine ili bi najradije odustao od utakmice. Trener Bloomingtona, Dale Chung, kritikovao je Andersonovu taktiku, navodeći da je Arroyo Valley koristio presing po celom terenu tokom celog prvog poluvremena, što je dovelo do rezultata 104-1 na poluvremenu. „Ljudi ne treba da sažaljevaju moj tim“, rekao je Chung. „Trebalo bi da sažaljevaju njegov tim, koji ne uči igru na pravi način.“ Anderson je odslužio jednu utakmicu suspenzije — tokom koje je Arroyo Valley opet pobedio, ovog puta protiv Indian Springsa sa 80-19. Vratiće se nakon što propusti još jednu utakmicu. „On je sjajan trener po pitanju taktike“, rekao je Chung. „Ali što se tiče etike? Ne baš. On zna da je pogrešio.“

article_content: Digital gifts can be tricky to wrap, but they offer convenience for both givers and recipients. Digital presents such as albums from iTunes or Kindle e-books from Amazon have become popular choices, especially for last-minute shoppers or those buying for people who live far away. These items can be bought online with just a few clicks and delivered instantly, making them more environmentally friendly since there is no need for shipping. According to research firm Inside Network, revenue from virtual goods, including games and applications, is expected to reach $2.9 billion next year. When you include digital music downloads—which research firm Gartner says will generate $6.3 billion this year—and online video streaming from services such as Netflix and Hulu, the digital marketplace becomes massive. Gift cards remain a consistent alternative, but for those wanting to give specific presents, major digital retailers now provide options to send downloads via e-mail. A report from e-commerce provider Elastic Path notes that about a quarter of holiday shoppers plan to purchase virtual gifts this year. Children may be checking their e-mail for gifts on Christmas morning or each night of Hanukkah. Apple allows users to purchase and send apps, music, movies, and TV shows through its iTunes program on a computer. Gifts can be sent to a recipient’s e-mail address or printed as a certificate at home. The iTunes and App Store on Apple mobile devices also offer a gifting feature. However, Apple does not currently let shoppers gift e-books through iBooks. On Amazon, 'Give as a Gift' buttons appear under the 'buy' options for Kindle books and MP3 music. Introduced during last year’s holiday season, these gifts can be used on various devices thanks to standard formats and Amazon’s selection of apps. However, Amazon currently does not allow users to gift apps for devices such as the Kindle Fire tablet. Still, children can easily make purchases on their parents’ Kindle tablets due to tight integration with the Amazon store. Barnes & Noble offers Instant Gifting for both apps and e-books on Nook tablets and e-readers, and lets recipients exchange unwanted gifts for store credit. Google sells apps, e-books, movie rentals, and music downloads through the Android Market, but does not allow customers to purchase and deliver these as gifts, according to a spokesperson. Other popular online services—including Netflix and Pandora—offer subscriptions that can be presented as gifts. Spotify provides this option in some European countries, but not yet in the United States. In summary, stockings may be lighter this year, but inboxes are likely to be fuller with digital presents.

Digitalni pokloni poput iTunes albuma ili Kindle e-knjiga postaju sve popularniji, naročito za kupovinu u poslednjem trenutku ili za one koji kupuju za bližnje koji žive daleko. Ove poklone je moguće kupiti online za samo nekoliko sekundi i odmah ih isporučiti, što ih čini ekološki prihvatljivim jer nema potrebe za slanjem poštom. Prema istraživačkoj firmi Inside Network, prihod od virtuelnih dobara, uključujući igre i aplikacije, dostići će 2,9 milijardi dolara sledeće godine. Kad se dodaju digitalna muzika—za koju Gartner predviđa prihod od 6,3 milijarde dolara ove godine—i onlajn video striming servisa kao što su Netflix i Hulu, digitalno tržište postaje ogromno. Poklon-kartice su i dalje popularne, ali za one koji žele konkretan poklon, veliki digitalni prodavci sada nude opciju slanja poklona putem e-maila. Izveštaj kompanije Elastic Path ukazuje da oko četvrtine prazničnih kupaca planira da kupi virtuelne poklone ove godine. Deca bi ove praznike mogla da proveravaju svoj inbox u potrazi za poklonima, bilo na Božićno jutro ili tokom Hanuke. Apple omogućava kupovinu i slanje aplikacija, muzike, filmova i serija putem iTunes programa na računaru. Pokloni se mogu slati na e-mail adresu primaoca ili odštampati kao vaučer kod kuće. Gifting funkcija postoji i u iTunes i App Store aplikacijama na Apple mobilnim uređajima. Međutim, Apple trenutno ne omogućava poklanjanje e-knjiga preko iBooks-a. Na Amazonu je dostupno dugme 'Give as a Gift' ispod opcije kupovine za Kindle knjige i MP3 muziku. Ova opcija je predstavljena prošle praznične sezone, a pokloni se mogu koristiti na raznim uređajima, zahvaljujući standardnim formatima i Amazon aplikacijama. Amazon za sada ne dozvoljava poklanjanje aplikacija, na primer za Kindle Fire. Ipak, deca lako mogu praviti kupovine na roditeljskim Kindle uređajima zbog odlične integracije sa Amazon prodavnicom. Barnes & Noble nudi Instant Gifting za aplikacije i e-knjige na Nook tabletima i čitačima, a korisnici mogu menjati neželjene poklone za kredit u prodavnici. Google prodaje aplikacije, e-knjige, filmove i muziku putem Android Market-a, ali ne dozvoljava korisnicima da ih poklanjaju, prema navodima portparola. Ostali popularni online servisi—poput Netflix-a i Pandore—omogućavaju pretplate koje se mogu pokloniti. Spotify nudi ovu opciju u nekim delovima Evrope, ali još ne i u Sjedinjenim Državama. Dakle, čarape ispod jelke možda će ove godine biti praznije, ali inboxovi puni digitalnih poklona!

article_content: At the 67th Assembly of Presidents of the Association of Asia Pacific Airlines in Singapore, Air India's CEO Campbell Wilson announced that the carrier will take delivery of a new plane every six days for the next 18 months, fulfilling a massive 470-aircraft order aimed at powering India's growing economy. The airline is hiring more staff and improving training standards to boost reliability and punctuality, which are highly valued by its customers. Wilson mentioned that most of Air India’s grounded planes are now flying again, and that new aircraft are being used on international routes. He expressed confidence in Air India’s ability to compete globally and attract more travelers. Subash Menon, director general of the Association of Asia Pacific Airlines, pointed out that India's air travel demand is now 20% higher than pre-pandemic 2019 levels, partly because India reopened earlier than many other countries. Even so, Asia Pacific’s air travel recovery is at 69% of pre-pandemic figures—behind other regions—though passenger numbers in the region rose 171% over last year, with capacity lagging at 130%. Menon added that late resumption of international flights by Asian airlines meant some were unable to reclaim their European landing slots, which has hurt connectivity. He emphasized that international air transport is governed by ICAO rules, and warned that any one-sided changes could undermine safety, efficiency, and cross-border travel. In the broader economy, India’s industrial growth slowed in September to 5.8%, down from 10.3% in August, affected by a difficult base comparison and heavy rains. Ranjan Pai of Manipal Group has invested about $168 million (Rs 1,400 crore) in Byju’s subsidiary Aakash Institute. Meanwhile, Indian companies continue to prize young graduates for their digital expertise and adaptability, JSW Group’s chief HR officer Dilip Pattanayak said.

Avio-kompanija dodatno zapošljava i unapređuje standarde obuke kako bi poboljšala pouzdanost i tačnost letova, što je ključno za putnike. Wilson je izjavio da se većina ranije prizemljenih aviona Air India vratila u saobraćaj, a najnoviji avioni već lete na međunarodnim rutama. Izrazio je uverenje u sposobnost Air India da konkuriše na globalnom tržištu i privuče više putnika. Generalni direktor Udruženja azijsko-pacifičkih aviokompanija, Subash Menon, naglasio je da je potražnja za vazdušnim prevozom u Indiji sada 20% viša nego pre pandemije 2019. godine, delimično zahvaljujući ranijem otvaranju zemlje. Međutim, oporavak avio-saobraćaja u Azijsko-pacifičkom regionu je na 69% predpandemijskog nivoa, što je niže u odnosu na druge regione, iako je broj putnika porastao za 171% u odnosu na prethodnu godinu, dok je kapacitet porastao za 130%. Menon je dodao da su azijske avio-kompanije, zbog kasnijeg pokretanja međunarodnih linija, izgubile određene slotove za sletanje u Evropi, što je negativno uticalo na povezivanje regiona. On je istakao važnost poštovanja ICAO pravila u međunarodnom avio-saobraćaju i upozorio da jednostrane promene mogu ugroziti bezbednost, efikasnost i mobilnost putnika. U širem ekonomskom kontekstu, industrijski rast u Indiji je u septembru pao na 5,8%, sa 10,3% u avgustu, zbog nepovoljne baze i jakih padavina. Ranjan Pai iz Manipal grupe investirao je oko 168 miliona dolara (1.400 crore rupija) u Aakash Institute, podružnicu kompanije Byju’s. Istovremeno, indijske firme i dalje visoko cene mlade stručnjake zbog njihovih digitalnih kompetencija i prilagodljivosti, izjavio je Dilip Pattanayak, HR direktor JSW Group.

article_content: Gary Gensler, head of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), has sounded a warning about the expanding use of artificial intelligence in finance. He argues that if regulators don’t intervene soon, artificial intelligence could contribute to a financial crisis within the next decade. Speaking to the Financial Times, Gensler indicated that the main concern is the widespread use of only a few dominant AI models by large financial institutions. If these institutions rely on similar AI tools, they may engage in herd behavior—making uniform decisions that could trigger a domino effect in markets. Gensler stated, ‘I think we will have a financial crisis in the future,’ suggesting that after such an event, analysts might point to reliance on the same models or data providers. This could affect various sectors, like mortgages or equities. The finance sector is already heavily integrating AI technologies. As noted by the Financial Times, many firms employ AI for both internal operations and customer interaction. As AI becomes more affordable and widely available, its adoption quickens, while regulatory adaptation lags behind. Current agencies like the SEC have jurisdiction over the financial markets but lack oversight over AI systems produced by technology firms. The government has previously struggled to regulate Wall Street effectively, and many technological regulatory issues remain unresolved in Congress. Gensler highlighted that most regulation targets individual entities rather than collective risks associated with AI. He described it as a ‘cross-regulatory challenge,’ but promised to propose rules consistent with the law to protect the public interest.

article_content: Zappfresh, an omnichannel meat retailer based in Delhi NCR, has raised $4.3 million in a funding round led by social impact investor Heifer Impact Capital. Other participants included Hindustan Media Ventures, Ah! Ventures, and Unity SFB. While the latest valuation remains undisclosed, CEO and founder Deepanshu Manchanda stated it was more than double that of the previous round. In 2019, Zappfresh secured $2.2 million at a valuation of $22.9 million. Manchanda told ET that the new funds will help expand Zappfresh’s offerings—such as premium country meat—and strengthen its distribution network. The company is also planning to expand into new markets, acquire or acqui-hire other firms, and is currently in discussions with potential acquisition targets for FY25. Recently, Zappfresh acquired Bengaluru-based Dr. Meat in a $3 million deal. The online meat seller is one of the few profitable companies in the sector, posting a profit of Rs 3.5 crore on Rs 70 crore revenue in FY23. After stabilizing in Delhi NCR and Bengaluru, Zappfresh aims to enter two more cities over the next year, prioritizing sustainable growth and customer satisfaction. As part of Heifer Impact Capital’s investment, Zappfresh will partner with about 40,000 women farmers to source premium chicken meat.

Roger Federer is approaching the last part of his 2014 tennis season with significant goals ahead. He is on track to reach another semifinal at the ATP World Tour Finals in London, while also aiming for his first Davis Cup win with Switzerland. Federer’s teammate Stan Wawrinka started strong, defeating Tomas Berdych 6-1, 6-1 with ease.

Meanwhile, Andy Murray’s campaign may be in jeopardy after an initial loss to Kei Nishikori. He needs a win against Milos Raonic to stay in the tournament, making his chances to win on home turf increasingly slim. With the O2 Arena having only one more confirmed year as host, the event’s future could shift to cities like Moscow, Doha, Beijing, or possibly Rio de Janeiro.

World No. 1 Novak Djokovic also advanced comfortably by beating US Open champion Marin Cilic, mirroring Wawrinka’s convincing victory. Federer is set to play Nishikori next as he prepares for the Davis Cup final against France in Lille. Wawrinka believes that Federer’s exceptional ability to adapt between court surfaces will help him transition quickly to clay, boosting Switzerland’s hopes for their first ever Davis Cup title.

article_content: The ongoing conflict in Ukraine since Russia’s invasion has prompted an important question: why do NATO countries permit a continuing stalemate? The United States has not supplied Ukraine with enough weapons quickly enough to shift the conflict decisively, and both the US and Germany have opted for a gradual approach to military support. This situation resembles World War I-style trench warfare, leading to high casualties on both sides. Russia seems willing to accept these losses, potentially using the conflict as a tool for social engineering. For Ukraine, the prolonged fighting is a humanitarian disaster. Despite insufficient support from Western partners, Ukraine resists peace negotiations with President Putin. Reasons include Russia’s abduction of Ukrainian children, repeated violations of agreements, and the perception that compromising would show weakness. For more than twenty years, Russia has broken peace agreements in Chechnya, Georgia, Crimea, and Donbas. Western leaders have often urged victims to make peace, sometimes underestimating Putin’s motives. Examples include diplomatic interventions in Georgia in 2008 and US presidents’ attempts to improve relations with Russia. Currently, the Biden administration confronts multiple international crises and domestic political pressures, including an upcoming election against potential challenger Donald Trump. Putin’s strategy appears to involve creating multiple hotspots—Ukraine, Armenia, the Middle East, and others—to strain US focus and resources. The Kremlin employs hybrid tactics, including cyberwarfare and disinformation, to deepen divisions in democracies. While the Biden administration acknowledges the threat, it remains cautious about expanding US engagement in Ukraine, wary of broader instability. Some US political groups advocate focusing on domestic priorities over foreign interventions. Combined with recent developments, such as the Israel-Gaza conflict, this makes large-scale US support for Ukraine unlikely in the near future. Some argue that prolonging the war gradually weakens Russia and its allies, draining resources from authoritarian regimes supporting Putin. However, this approach results in prolonged suffering for Ukrainians. A rapid defeat of Russia could also carry risks, including instability, refugee flows, and potential nuclear escalation. In the end, the attritional strategy mirrors Cold War-era tactics but remains risky. Other international actors, like Iran and China, or political changes in Europe, could shift the balance. Throughout, Ukrainians endure extensive hardship, and there are concerns they may eventually feel abandoned by the West.

Ovakva situacija podseća na rovovski rat iz Prvog svetskog rata, što uzrokuje velike žrtve na obe strane. Izgleda da je Rusija voljna da prihvati ove gubitke, moguće koristeći sukob kao oruđe za društveni inženjering. Za Ukrajinu, produženi rat je humanitarna katastrofa. Uprkos nedostatku snažne podrške zapadnih partnera, Ukrajina odbija mirovne pregovore sa predsednikom Putinom. Razlozi su otmice ukrajinske dece od strane Rusije, višestruka kršenja sporazuma i shvatanje da bi kompromis pokazao slabost. Više od dvadeset godina, Rusija je prekršila mirovne sporazume u Čečeniji, Gruziji, na Krimu i u Donbasu. Zapadni lideri često su pozivali žrtve na mir, ponekad potcenjujući Putinove motive. Primeri su diplomatske intervencije u Gruziji 2008. i pokušaji američkih predsednika da unaprede odnose sa Rusijom. Trenutno se Bajdenova administracija suočava sa više međunarodnih kriza i domaćim političkim pritiscima, uključujući i nadolazeće izbore protiv potencijalnog rivala Donalda Trampa. Putinova strategija izgleda da obuhvata stvaranje brojnih kriznih žarišta—Ukrajina, Jermenija, Bliski istok i druge—kako bi opteretio američki fokus i resurse. Kremlj koristi hibridne taktike, uključujući sajber ratovanje i dezinformacije, da bi produbio podele u demokratskim društvima. Bajdenova administracija prepoznaje ovu pretnju, ali ostaje oprezna u vezi sa proširivanjem angažmana SAD u Ukrajini, strahujući od šire nestabilnosti. Neke političke grupe u SAD zagovaraju stavljanje domaćih prioriteta ispred međunarodnih intervencija. U kombinaciji sa aktuelnim dešavanjima, poput sukoba Izrael-Gaza, to otežava mogućnost opsežne američke pomoći Ukrajini u bliskoj budućnosti. Neki smatraju da produžetak rata postepeno slabi Rusiju i njene saveznike, iscrpljujući resurse autoritarnih režima koji podržavaju Putina. Ipak, ovaj pristup produžava patnje Ukrajinaca. Nagli poraz Rusije nosi sopstvene rizike, uključujući nestabilnost, izbegličke krize i potencijalnu nuklearnu eskalaciju. Na kraju, taktika iscrpljivanja podseća na periode Hladnog rata, ali je i dalje rizična. Drugi globalni akteri, kao što su Iran i Kina, ili političke promene u Evropi, mogu promeniti situaciju. Za to vreme, Ukrajinci prolaze kroz teške patnje, uz bojazan da će se kasnije osećati izneverenim od strane Zapada.

Many Britons choose bottled water over tap water, believing it to be healthier, even though it can cost up to 1,000 times more than tap water. However, research from university studies shows that bottled water is subject to less rigorous safety testing and may be more prone to contamination. In the UK, consumers spend over £1.5 billion each year on bottled water, with an average annual consumption of 33 liters per person. A Mintel survey found that almost a quarter of people who drink bottled water at home believe it is better for them than tap water.

In reality, tap water is subject to daily rigorous inspections and contains traces of chlorine to prevent bacterial infections. In contrast, bottled water companies are generally required to test only monthly at the source. Sealed bottles can sit for months before sale, and since bottled water has no disinfectant, it can become unsterile once opened and should be consumed within days.

According to Professor Paul Younger of Glasgow University, “Water coming from UK taps is the most stringently tested in the world. People think there must be something wrong with tap water because it is so cheap and plentiful. But from a safety and price perspective, tap water is better for you.” He adds that bottled water is subject to fewer safety checks and is more likely to be contaminated or become a source of infection, especially if the bottle is tampered with or left open.

Both bottled and tap water have faced contamination incidents. In 1990, Perrier recalled millions of bottles worldwide due to benzene contamination, and in 2004 Coca-Cola recalled hundreds of thousands of Dasani bottles after purification may have introduced a possible carcinogen. Similarly, in 1988, a treatment error in Camelford, Cornwall, polluted local tap water.

Sue Pennison of the Drinking Water Inspectorate said that out of more than four million samples of UK tap water tested last year, 99.96 percent met strict standards. She states, “Tap water is safe to drink; everything else is a personal lifestyle choice.” Jo Jacobius, director of British Bottled Water Producers, adds that all water sold in the UK is highly regulated and generally of good quality, with most bottled water companies also testing daily. Natural bottled mineral water must come from an officially recognized spring, be bottled at the source, and cannot be treated or filtered, while spring water must also be bottled at source but can be treated. Tap water is sourced from rivers, boreholes, and springs and always treated before distribution.

Mnogi Britanci biraju flaširanu vodu umesto vode iz česme, verujući da je zdravija, iako može biti čak i do 1.000 puta skuplja. Ipak, univerzitetska istraživanja pokazuju da flaširana voda prolazi kroz manje rigorozne bezbednosne provere i može biti podložnija kontaminaciji. U Velikoj Britaniji potrošači godišnje troše više od 1,5 milijardi funti na flaširanu vodu, a prosečna godišnja potrošnja iznosi 33 litra po osobi. Prema anketi agencije Mintel, skoro četvrtina onih koji kod kuće piju flaširanu vodu smatra da je ona zdravija od vode iz česme.

Zapravo, voda iz česme svakodnevno prolazi detaljne kontrole i sadrži tragove hlora koji sprečava širenje bakterijskih infekcija. Nasuprot tome, proizvođači flaširane vode obavezni su da sprovode testiranja samo jednom mesečno na samom izvoru. Zapečaćene flaše mogu stajati mesecima pre prodaje, a kako ne sadrže dezinfekciona sredstva, flaširana voda može postati nesterilna nakon otvaranja i trebalo bi je popiti u roku od nekoliko dana.

Profesor Pol Janger sa Univerziteta u Glazgovu ističe: „Voda iz slavine u Velikoj Britaniji je najstrože testirana na svetu. Ljudi misle da nešto nije u redu sa vodom iz česme jer je jeftina i lako dostupna, ali sa aspekta bezbednosti i cene, voda iz česme je bolja za vas.“ On dodaje da flaširana voda prolazi ređe provere bezbednosti i da je sklonija kontaminaciji ili može postati izvor infekcije, posebno ako je flaša otvorena ili nije odmah potrošena.

I flaširana i voda iz česme su imale slučajeve kontaminacije. Godine 1990. Perrier je povukao milione flaša u celom svetu zbog prisustva benzena, a 2004. godine Coca-Cola je povukla stotine hiljada boca Dasani jer je proces „pročišćavanja“ mogao da uvede potencijalno kancerogenu supstancu. Slično tome, 1988. godine greška u tretmanu u Camelfordu, Cornwall, dovela je do zagađenja lokalne vode iz česme.

Sue Pennison iz Inspektorata za kontrolu vode navodi da je od više od četiri miliona testiranih uzoraka vode iz česme prošle godine, 99,96 procenata zadovoljilo stroge standarde. Ona kaže: „Voda iz česme je bezbedna za piće, sve ostalo je stvar ličnog izbora načina života.“ Jo Jacobius, direktorka Britanskih proizvođača flaširane vode, dodaje da je sva voda koja se prodaje u Velikoj Britaniji visoko regulisana i generalno dobrog kvaliteta, a većina proizvođača flaširane vode sprovodi i svakodnevna testiranja. Prirodna flaširana mineralna voda mora poticati iz zvanično priznatog izvora, biti flaširana na izvoru i ne sme biti tretirana niti filtrirana, dok izvorska voda takođe mora biti flaširana na izvoru, ali može biti tretirana. Voda iz česme potiče iz reka, bunara i izvora i uvek se dodatno tretira pre distribucije.

article_content: After a sharp rise in shootings during a sweltering weekend, the NYPD has increased its patrols across New York City. More uniformed officers are being stationed at public housing complexes, while plainclothes police will join local anti-crime units during periods when shootings are most likely. Last weekend, as temperatures exceeded 90 degrees Fahrenheit, the city was hit by a spike in gun violence: 26 people were shot over three days, seven of whom died. Deputy Commissioner Paul Browne noted that three victims were under the age of 16. Mayor Michael Bloomberg said that warmer weather often leads to a rise in crime. Law enforcement is monitoring gangs for any signs of retaliation connected to the recent shootings. Camera-equipped surveillance towers are also being deployed at the locations of the latest incidents. Mayor Bloomberg pointed out that, despite the recent incidents, the city’s homicide rate has fallen by 24% compared to the previous year, with 127 murders reported so far—40 fewer than the same time last year. He also referenced a notable day in November 2012 when New York recorded no murders, stabbings, or shootings. Bloomberg credited the NYPD’s dedication and leadership for making the city one of the safest major urban centers in the country and reiterated a strong commitment to combating gun violence. With reporting from CNN’s Laura Ly.

Prošlog vikenda, dok su temperature prelazile 32 stepena Celzijusa, grad je zabeležio porast oružanog nasilja: 26 osoba je upucano u tri dana, od kojih je sedam preminulo. Zamenik komesara Pol Braun je naveo da su tri žrtve bile mlađe od 16 godina. Gradonačelnik Majkl Blumberg izjavio je da toplije vreme često dovodi do povećanja kriminala. Policija pomno prati aktivnosti bandi zbog mogućih osveta u vezi sa poslednjim pucnjavama. Kule za nadzor sa kamerama takođe se postavljaju na mestima najnovijih incidenata. Blumberg je istakao da je, uprkos poslednjim događajima, stopa ubistava u gradu smanjena za 24% u odnosu na prošlu godinu, sa 127 prijavljenih slučajeva do sada—što je za 40 manje nego u istom periodu prošle godine. On je podsetio i na značajan dan iz novembra 2012. kada u Njujorku nije bilo nijednog ubistva, ubadanja ili pucnjave. Ahmed Ododo, recently elected as Governor of Kogi State, has expressed sincere thanks to his supporters and the stakeholders who contributed to his electoral win. In a statement shared on Monday, Ododo extended gratitude to the state's residents, party loyalists, and leaders for their trust as he prepares to take office in January 2024.

He reiterated a pledge to foster unity and prosperity throughout Kogi State, emphasizing the importance of transparent, accountable, and inclusive governance. Ododo recognized that collaboration with diverse stakeholders will play a vital role in shaping effective policy.

The statement acknowledged the support of President Bola Tinubu, Vice President Kashim Shettima, APC National Chairman Abdullahi Ganduje, and outgoing Governor Yahaya Bello, describing their encouragement and involvement as crucial to his success. Tinubu’s commitment to peaceful and fair elections was praised, as was Bello’s leadership and influence on the campaign.

Ododo assured citizens that with their ongoing support, his administration would continue to move the state forward by working together toward their common goals and a more unified future.

article_content: A recent ABC News/Ipsos survey finds that 76% of Americans believe the country is on the wrong track, with only 23% expressing optimism about its direction. As the 2024 presidential election approaches, both major party frontrunners—President Joe Biden and former President Donald Trump—are broadly unpopular. Biden is seen favorably by 33% of respondents, while Trump scores even lower at 29%. Sentiment is particularly negative among Republicans (95% say the country is off course), but independents (76%) and more than half of Democrats (54%) also share this gloomy outlook. Support for Biden among key voting groups has eroded: fewer than half of Black Americans (49%) and just a third of Hispanic Americans (33%) view him favorably, despite their substantial backing in the 2020 election (87% of Black voters and 65% of Hispanic voters supported Biden then). There’s some appetite for alternatives: if either party nominates someone other than Biden or Trump, about 30% of Americans say they’d be more likely to support that nominee, although most say it wouldn’t change their vote. For the Republican ticket, 31% would be more inclined to vote GOP if someone besides Trump runs, compared to 8% less inclined; among Republicans and independents, this effect is even stronger. For Democrats, 29% would be more likely to vote for a Biden alternative, with 4% less inclined; the sentiment is more pronounced among Democrats and independents. Economic issues dominate public concerns; 74% rate the economy as very important, and 69% say the same for inflation. Republicans are trusted more on these topics (35% for the economy, 35% for inflation) compared to Democrats (25% and 21% respectively). On other fronts, most Americans view healthcare (64%) and education (61%) as vital, with Democrats favored to handle both (healthcare: 37% to 18%, education: 33% to 24%). When it comes to crime (57% see it as very important) and gun violence (56%), the public is divided: Republicans lead on crime (32% vs 20%), while Democrats are ahead on gun control (34% vs 24%). Abortion isn’t as central, with only 45% calling it very important. On that issue, Democrats are more trusted (40% vs 23%), though it's unclear how this will shape voter decisions in the upcoming cycle. Abortion debates loom large in state elections, like Ohio’s vote on a constitutional amendment for abortion rights and Virginia’s legislature races, which could affect restrictions depending on which party gains power. The ABC News/Ipsos poll was administered November 3-4, 2023, in both English and Spanish, surveying 949 randomly selected U.S. adults. It specifically oversampled young adults, Black and Hispanic people, and Born Again Christians, weighting the results to reflect the overall population. The poll’s margin of error is 3.3 percentage points, with the sample comprising 25% Democrats, 25% Republicans, and 42% independents.

Kako se približavaju predsednički izbori 2024. godine, glavni kandidati obe partije—današnji predsednik Džo Bajden i bivši predsednik Donald Tramp—imaju nisku popularnost. Bajden ima pozitivno mišljenje kod 33% ispitanika, dok Tramp beleži još nižu ocenu od 29%. Posebno negativna osećanja prisutna su među republikancima (95% smatra da zemlja ide pogrešno), ali i većina nezavisnih (76%) i više od polovine demokrata (54%) deli ovaj pesimizam. Podrška Bajdenu među ključnim glasačkim grupama je opala: manje od polovine Afroamerikanaca (49%) i samo trećina Hispanoamerikanaca (33%) imaju pozitivno mišljenje o njemu, uprkos njihovoj izrazitoj podršci na izborima 2020. godine (87% crnih i 65% hispano glasača tada je glasalo za Bajdena). Postoji određena želja za alternativama: ukoliko bilo koja partija kandiduje nekog drugog osim Bajdena ili Trampa, oko 30% Amerikanaca kaže da bi verovatnije glasali za tog kandidata, iako većina kaže da to ne bi uticalo na njihov glas. Kod demokrata, 29% bi verovatnije glasalo za nekog drugog osim Bajdena, dok 4% kaže da bi ih to odvratilo; taj stav je posebno izražen među demokratama i nezavisnima. Ekonomska pitanja dominiraju brigama građana; 74% smatra da je ekonomija vrlo važna, a 69% to isto misli za inflaciju. Republikancima se više veruje u rešavanju ovih pitanja (35% kada je ekonomija u pitanju, 35% kod inflacije) u poređenju sa demokratama (25% i 21% redom). Na drugim poljima, većina Amerikanaca smatra zdravstvo (64%) i obrazovanje (61%) ključnim pitanjima, a demokratama se više veruje u njihovom rešavanju (zdravstvo: 37% naspram 18%, obrazovanje: 33% prema 24%). Kada se radi o kriminalu (57% smatra da je veoma bitno) i oružanom nasilju (56%), mišljenja su podeljena: republikanci vode u pitanju kriminala (32% naspram 20%), dok demokrate prednjače u kontroli oružja (34% prema 24%). Abortus nije u centru zbivanja, jer ga samo 45% ispitanih smatra veoma važnim. Po tom pitanju, demokratama se više veruje (40% naspram 23%), mada nije jasno kako će se to odraziti na buduće izbore. Tema abortusa je posebno aktuelna u državnim izborima kao što su izjašnjavanje u Ohaju o amandmanu za pravo na abortus i trka za skupštinu u Virdžiniji, gde bi izbori mogli uticati na nova ograničenja, u zavisnosti od toga koja partija preuzme vlast. Anketa ABC News/Ipsos sprovedena je 3. i 4. novembra 2023. na reprezentativnom uzorku od 949 odraslih Amerikanaca, na engleskom i španskom jeziku. Posebno su prebrojani mladi od 18-29, Afroamerikanci, Hispanoamerikanci i tzv. Novorođeni hrišćani, a uzorak je ponderisan da predstavlja ukupnu populaciju. Procenjena statistička greška iznosi 3,3 procentna poena, a u uzorku ima 25% demokrata, 25% republikanaca i 42% nezavisnih.

article_content: Jane Betts, 42, from Cambridge, was shocked when she discovered a human tooth embedded in a piece of Wensleydale Jervaulx Blue cheese she bought from Sainsbury's. After biting into the cheese, she felt something hard and realized it was a tooth that had fallen out. Concerned it might be her own, she visited a dentist who confirmed the tooth was human and appeared to be dental work from someone else. Deeply disturbed, Mrs Betts handed the cheese and tooth to Cambridge City Council's environmental health team, who have begun an investigation. The council stated they will thoroughly investigate the contaminant and pursue appropriate action if a business is found responsible. Sainsbury's has reiterated their commitment to food quality and is fully supporting the ongoing investigation.

Nakon što je zagrizla sir, osetila je nešto tvrdo i shvatila da je to zub koji je ispao. Zabrinuta da možda pripada njoj, posetila je zubara koji je potvrdio da je u pitanju ljudski zub, verovatno deo tuđeg zubarskog rada. Duboko uznemirena, gospođa Bets je sir i zub predala timu za zdravlje životne sredine Gradskog veća Kembridža, koji je započeo istragu. Iz veća su saopštili da će detaljno ispitati kontaminant i preduzeti odgovarajuće mere ukoliko se utvrdi odgovornost neke firme. Sainsbury's je ponovio posvećenost kvalitetu hrane i pruža punu podršku istrazi.

article_content: WASHINGTON: The Pentagon has quietly increased military aid to Israel, supplying requested items such as more laser-guided missiles for its Apache helicopter fleet, 155mm shells, night-vision devices, bunker-buster munitions, and new military vehicles, according to an internal Defense Department list. This flow of weapons extends beyond widely reported shipments of Iron Dome interceptors and Boeing smart bombs, and continues as Biden administration officials emphasize the need to minimize civilian casualties in the Gaza Strip. The arms, requested by Israel during its conflict with Hamas—a group designated as a terrorist organization by the US and EU—are detailed in a document labeled as 'Israel Senior Leader' requests from late October, which is circulating within the Pentagon. The document reviewed by Bloomberg indicates that many of these items have already been shipped or are being sourced from US and European stockpiles. For example, by late October, all 36,000 rounds of 30mm cannon ammunition, 1,800 M141 bunker-buster munitions, and at least 3,500 night-vision devices were delivered, according to the document. A Pentagon spokesperson declined to discuss specific details, but the Department of Defense stated that it is 'leveraging several avenues—from internal stocks to US industry channels—to ensure Israel has the means to defend itself.' The statement added that 'security assistance continues to arrive on a near-daily basis,' including precision-guided munitions, small-diameter bombs, 155mm artillery shells, Iron Dome interceptors, and medical support equipment. However, the provision of artillery shells and munitions has drawn criticism from numerous nongovernmental organizations. These groups argue that US shipments have enabled Israel to pursue a bombing campaign that, according to Hamas-run health authorities in Gaza, has resulted in over 10,000 deaths. Over 30 relief organizations wrote to Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin on Monday, urging him not to send 155mm shells, calling them 'inherently indiscriminate' in densely populated areas like Gaza. They noted the shells are unguided and can land about 25 meters from their intended targets. The ammunition for AH-64 Apache helicopters includes approximately 2,000 Hellfire laser-guided missiles made by Lockheed Martin, some of which are being provided from US Army stocks in Germany and South Korea. It also includes over 36,000 rounds of 30mm ammunition for the Apache’s cannons. According to Michael Eisenstadt from the Washington Institute for Near East Policy, Israeli forces have used Apaches for years and are likely employing them to support ground troops against Hamas using their guns against fighters in the open, Hellfire missiles on vehicles, fighting positions, and bunkers, and potentially for targeting senior commanders. Israel has further requested more than 57,000 155mm high-explosive artillery shells, 20,000 M4A1 rifles, up to 5,000 PVS-14 night vision devices, 3,000 M141 hand-held bunker-buster munitions, 400 120mm mortars, and 75 Joint Light Tactical Vehicles, which are replacing the Hummer. US inventories have also provided 312 Tamir missile interceptors, with two Iron Dome batteries being transported to Israel by sea. The weapons transfers include a reverse shipment of 155mm shells: 57,000 rounds previously sent from US stocks in Israel to US European Command to replace munitions sent to Ukraine have now been shipped back to Israel for its conflict with Hamas, according to US officials. For comparison, the US has supplied Ukraine with over 2 million 155mm shells and more than 800,000 105mm rounds, per a recent State Department summary. Israel has also asked for 200 armor-piercing Switchblade 600 drones produced by AeroVironment. The US Army does not currently have Switchblade 600s in its inventory. It is unclear whether AeroVironment has them in stock or would need to produce them. AeroVironment declined to comment. According to an industry official, the US could use Foreign Military Financing grants for such purchases via the Foreign Military Sales process. The Switchblade 600 request was first reported by DefenseScoop, a Washington-based defense technology publication.

Ova doprema oružja prevazilazi poznate pošiljke Iron Dome presretača i pametnih bombi kompanije Boeing, i traje dok zvaničnici Bajdenove administracije naglašavaju potrebu smanjenja civilnih žrtava u Pojasu Gaze. Oružje koje je Izrael tražio tokom sukoba sa Hamasom—organizacijom koju SAD i EU smatraju terorističkom—detaljno je navedeno u dokumentu 'Zahtevi viših izraelskih lidera' sa kraja oktobra, koji cirkuliše Pentagonom. Dokument koji je pregledao Bloomberg pokazuje da su mnoge stavke već poslate ili ih Pentagon nabavlja iz američkih i evropskih zaliha. Na primer, do kraja oktobra, svih 36.000 komada 30mm municije, 1.800 M141 municije za probijanje bunkera i najmanje 3.500 uređaja za noćni vid su isporučeni. Portparol Pentagona nije iznosio konkretne detalje, ali Ministarstvo odbrane je saopštilo da 'koristi više izvora — od sopstvenih zaliha do američke industrije — da bi Izrael imao sredstva za odbranu.' U saopštenju se navodi da 'bezbednosna pomoć stiže skoro svakodnevno', uključujući precizno vođenu municiju, bombe malog prečnika, granate 155mm, Iron Dome presretače i medicinsku opremu. Ipak, isporuka granata i municije izaziva kritike brojnih nevladinih organizacija, koje tvrde da su američke zalihe omogućile Izraelu bombardersku kampanju koja je, prema zdravstvenim vlastima pod Hamasovom upravom u Gazi, dovela do preko 10.000 žrtava. Više od 30 humanitarnih organizacija obratilo se sekretaru odbrane Lojdu Ostinu u ponedeljak, tražeći da ne šalje granate 155mm, nazivajući ih 'po prirodi neselektivnim' u gusto naseljenim područjima kao što je Gaza. Navode da su granate nevođene i da često padnu do 25 metara od ciljanog mesta. Municija za AH-64 Apache uključuje oko 2.000 Hellfire laserski vođenih raketa iz kompanije Lockheed Martin, od kojih deo dolazi iz američkih zaliha u Nemačkoj i Južnoj Koreji. Takođe uključuje više od 36.000 komada 30mm municije za top Apacha. Prema Majklu Ajzenštatu iz Washingtonskog instituta za bliskoistočnu politiku, izraelske snage Apache koriste godinama, a trenutno ih koriste za podršku kopnenim trupama protiv Hamas boraca — koristeći 30mm topove protiv boraca na otvorenom, Hellfire rakete protiv vozila i bunkera, a moguće i za ciljanje viših zapovednika. Izrael je dodatno tražio više od 57.000 granata kalibra 155mm, 20.000 pušaka M4A1, do 5.000 PVS-14 uređaja za noćni vid, 3.000 ručnih bunker-buster municija, 400 minobacača 120mm i 75 novih vozila Joint Light Tactical Vehicle koja zamenjuju Hamere. Američke zalihe su takođe obezbedile 312 Tamir presretača, a dva sistema Iron Dome stižu u Izrael brodom. Isporuke uključuju i povratnu pošiljku 155mm granata: 57.000 komada, koje su prethodno poslate iz američkih zaliha u Izraelu američkoj Evropskoj komandi za popunu municije koja je otišla Ukrajini, sada su vraćene u Izrael za sukob sa Hamasom, po navodima američkih zvaničnika. Za poređenje, SAD su Ukrajini isporučile preko 2 miliona granata 155mm i više od 800.000 granata 105mm, prema izveštaju Stejt departmenta. Izrael je takođe tražio 200 Switchblade 600 dronova za probijanje oklopa, proizvedenih u AeroVironment-u. Američka vojska nema ove dronove u zalihama. Nije poznato da li AeroVironment ima dronove ili treba da ih proizvede. Kompanija nije želela da komentariše. Prema rečima iz industrije, izvoz bi mogao biti realizovan kroz američku vojnu pomoć i proces Međunarodne vojne prodaje. Zahtjev za Switchblade 600 prvi je izvestio DefenseScoop iz Vašingtona.

Burnley departed from their familiar claret and blue, wearing a silver third kit that made them appear wrapped in tin foil during their match against Manchester United at Old Trafford. Having debuted at Sunderland last month, this kit was chosen again over Burnley’s all-black away strip. The silver look drew comparisons to the tin men from The Wizard of Oz, but Burnley quickly proved their mettle, taking the game to Manchester United and delivering an impressive performance.

Burnley set aside their black kit as George Boyd reflected on a missed opportunity for the visitors. The scene brought to mind United’s own challenges with kit colors, notably in 1996 when Sir Alex Ferguson famously ordered a grey kit to be changed at halftime during a Southampton defeat—likely ensuring United won’t revisit that color.

For much of this season, United’s technical area has been quiet, with manager Louis van Gaal observing from the dugout and taking notes, in contrast to Sir Alex Ferguson’s animated presence. In this fixture, however, assistant manager Ryan Giggs was more prominent, regularly seen beside Burnley manager Sean Dyche on the touchline.

Burnley fans jeered former Blackburn player Phil Jones as he went off injured after five minutes, but substitute Chris Smalling answered immediately by scoring with his first touch, quieting the away support. Smalling later restored United’s lead just before halftime.

Dyche’s Burnley side included three former United players—David Jones, Michael Keane, and Tom Heaton—but he couldn’t field an unchanged XI for an 11th league game due to Dean Marney’s injury from the previous weekend.

Manchester United had injury problems as well, forced into two first-half changes. Daley Blind left after suffering a cut over his left eye from a collision with Jonny Evans; he briefly returned after receiving stitches but couldn’t continue for long.

Discussion leading up to the match focused on claims, spurred by Sam Allardyce, that United had become a long-ball team. Van Gaal rebutted this at his press conference with statistical evidence. Marouane Fellaini, often central to such tactics, commented: “I’m a midfielder and prefer to play more defensively, but it’s the manager’s decision where I play. If I play up front, there’s a reason for it.”
