article_content: Tehran: Iranian authorities have released on bail Toomaj Salehi, a popular rapper who was jailed for over a year for supporting nationwide protests sparked by Mahsa Amini’s death in custody, according to local media. Salehi, 32, was arrested in October 2022 after publicly supporting demonstrations that began a month earlier, following the death of 22-year-old Mahsa Amini, an Iranian Kurd, who died in police custody after being detained for allegedly violating strict dress rules for women. In July, Salehi was sentenced to six years in prison on charges of 'corruption on earth,' a serious offense in Iran that can carry the death penalty. His lawyer, Amir Raisian, told Iran’s reformist newspaper Shargh on Saturday night that, on appeal, the Supreme Court found flaws in the initial sentence and ordered Salehi be released on bail. A photo posted overnight on Salehi’s official Instagram account showed him outside of jail, holding a bouquet of white flowers. Salehi was accused of spreading 'lies on the internet,' 'propaganda against the state,' inciting violence, and 'forming and managing illegal groups with the aim of disrupting security in cooperation with a hostile government.' Iranian officials have described last year’s protests as 'riots' and accused foreign adversaries of stoking unrest. Meanwhile, prominent actor Hanieh Tavassoli—among several actors recently banned for not following Iran’s dress code for women—has also been sentenced to jail time, her lawyer said on Sunday. According to lawyer Maryam Kianersi, an Iranian court gave Tavassoli, 44, a six-month prison sentence and a 150 million rial ($300) fine for 'publishing false content with the intention of disturbing the public,' as reported by Shargh. Months of unrest after Amini’s death in September 2022 resulted in hundreds of deaths, including dozens of security personnel, and thousands of arrests. Seven men have been executed in protest-related cases involving violence against security forces. On Monday, Iran’s Supreme Court upheld a death sentence for the killing of a Revolutionary Guards officer during the protests, according to the judiciary, which did not identify the condemned man.

article_content: James Marcus Howe, 42, a reality TV director known for working on shows like 'America's Next Top Model' and 'Tila Tequila,' was shot and killed at his Los Angeles home on the morning before Thanksgiving. His wife was also shot and remains in the hospital. The incident occurred at around 10:51 a.m. on Wednesday, November 27, when the couple's home on the 4400 block of West Avenue 42 was entered by intruders posing as solicitors. According to the Los Angeles Police Department, Howe answered the door after hearing a knock, and two intruders forced their way inside. During a struggle, one of them fired a gun, fatally wounding Howe. Police say three suspects were involved: two black males, one believed to be between 16 and 22 years old, the other between 20 and 25, and a black female. The older male is considered the likely shooter. The suspects fled in a dark-colored, early-2000s Ford Mustang after the crime. Howe and his wife had recently moved to the neighborhood with their 6-year-old son, who was not at home during the incident and is now being cared for by his aunt. Neither victim had any criminal record. Police continue to search for the suspects and urge anyone with information to contact Northeast Homicide Detectives at 323-344-5731. Anonymous tips are welcomed.

article_content: A recent study has highlighted how global virtual teams (GVTs), made up of members from a wide range of cultures and locations, can boost information flow and teamwork through specific communication methods. Published in the International Journal of Cross Cultural Management, the research outlines three essential strategies to enhance understanding and close cultural gaps, especially as remote work becomes more common. Over the past several years, notably following the COVID-19 pandemic, remote collaboration has become the norm for many organizations. This shift prompted researchers, including Dr. Zakaria from the University of Sharjah, to investigate how international teams effectively share knowledge and overcome communication challenges. The study spotlights the importance of 'cross-cultural code-switching'—the practice of adapting language and behavior to suit various cultural settings. This adaptability helps teams navigate differences in communication styles, such as the nuanced, context-rich methods of high-context cultures versus the straightforward approach of low-context cultures. Findings from the research emphasize the importance of three key behaviors in promoting healthy teamwork across cultures: being direct in conversations, being open during knowledge exchanges, and focusing team discussions on tasks. GVT members reported modifying their communication style, such as using clearer English and more explicit verbal cues, to reduce misunderstandings and build trust. Researchers recommend that organizations adapt their training to educate employees on recognizing when to switch communication styles and how to engage more transparently. These techniques help global virtual teams improve collaboration, enhance decision-making, and maintain resilience in rapidly changing work environments. Ultimately, the study concludes that as cross-cultural teamwork continues to grow, particularly in a post-pandemic world, the workplace will increasingly rely on employees skilled in code-switching—people who can embrace and bridge cultural differences to ensure diversity, equity, and inclusivity in everyday operations.

Objavljeno u časopisu International Journal of Cross Cultural Management, ovo istraživanje izdvaja tri ključne strategije za bolje razumevanje i prevazilaženje kulturnih razlika, posebno kako rad na daljinu postaje sve češći. Tokom poslednjih nekoliko godina, naročito nakon pandemije COVID-19, rad na daljinu postao je standard u mnogim organizacijama. Ova promena je podstakla istraživače, među kojima je i dr Zakaria sa Univerziteta u Šardži, da ispitaju kako međunarodni timovi uspešno dele znanje i prevazilaze komunikacijske izazove. Studija posebno ističe značaj 'kulturnog kod-prebacivanja'—prilagođavanja jezika i ponašanja različitim kulturnim kontekstima. Ova veština omogućava timovima da prevaziđu razlike u stilovima komunikacije, kao što su suptilni i kontekstom bogati pristupi visoko-kontekstnih kultura u odnosu na direktan stil nisko-kontekstnih kultura. Rezultati istraživanja naglašavaju važnost tri ponašanja za dobru saradnju u multikulturnim timovima: direktnost u komunikaciji, otvorenost u razmeni znanja i usmerenost na zadatke. Članovi GVT-ova su izveštavali da su prilagodili svoj stil komunikacije, koristeći jasniji engleski i eksplicitnije izražavanje, kako bi smanjili nesporazume i izgradili poverenje. Autori preporučuju da organizacije prilagode obuke zaposlanih kako bi ih naučile da prepoznaju kada da promene stil komunikacije i kako da budu što transparentniji. Ove tehnike pomažu globalnim virtuelnim timovima da poboljšaju saradnju, unaprede donošenje odluka i ostanu otporni u dinamičnom radnom okruženju. article_content: David Letterman returned to Manhattan’s Ed Sullivan Theater last night for the first time since his retirement from CBS’s The Late Show eight years ago, joining his successor, Stephen Colbert, for an engaging conversation. The two late-night veterans discussed their relationships with iconic hosts, including Dick Cavett and Johnny Carson. Colbert shared that he had sought advice from Cavett, and asked Letterman if he ever reached out to his own late-night idol, Johnny Carson. Letterman explained that Carson was such a legendary figure that reaching out for advice seemed unthinkable. "Johnny is, was, the Mount Olympus," Letterman said, adding, "So you didn’t just call Johnny and say, 'Hey, Johnny, what do you think?' I was pretty much alone. I was orphaned in the talk show world." When the audience responded sympathetically, Letterman jokingly responded, "I don’t appreciate the sarcasm." Asked whether he missed anything about late-night television, Letterman replied earnestly, "I miss everything. Mostly, it’s fun. Very few things in life give you the chance that, if you mess something up, 24 hours later you get to try again. That’s a pretty good deal." David Letterman hosted The Late Show on CBS from 1993 until his retirement in 2015.

article_content: Juno Films has acquired all U.S. and Canadian rights to 'The Caravan', the first documentary feature from directors Núria Clavero and Aitor Palacios. The film will have its North American premiere in International Competition at DOC NYC, ahead of a theatrical release in late spring. Co-produced by Cabal Films and Trueday Films, 'The Caravan' presents a human perspective on the political debate surrounding border control, telling the story of one family's search for a better life in the United States. The documentary follows pregnant Yuri, her partner Mike, and their young son, Santi, as they flee Honduras, capturing the complexities behind their decision to undertake this dangerous journey. While the film documents only a few weeks of their trek, it sheds light on why many others dream of migrating to the U.S. for a better future. The deal was negotiated by Laura Collado for Trueday Films and Juno Films CEO Elizabeth Sheldon. Sheldon stated, 'Núria and Aitor's film reminds viewers that for many crossing the southern border, their main motivation is to provide a better life for their children. The film gives names and faces to stories that many viewers will recognize from their own family histories of seeking political stability and economic opportunity in America.' In a joint statement, Clavero, Palacios, and Collado emphasized that, while migration is a choice, it is never an easy one. They noted that migrants often trade intangible things, such as culture and belonging, for more urgent needs: physical safety and better prospects for future generations. They continued, 'Migration always has and always will exist. What is unique about organized migration, like the caravans, is that it transforms personal stories and dreams into a political act.' The filmmakers linked the ongoing migration from Central America to historical inequalities in the region, where a small elite controls most resources and government, while the majority lives in subsistence conditions. This status quo, they claim, has been supported by U.S. policies that have viewed social reforms in those countries as threats to American interests. Most recently, boutique distributor Juno Films announced its acquisition of 'Liv Ullmann: A Road Less Traveled', another film screened at the upcoming DOC NYC. The company is known for releasing critically acclaimed titles such as 'The Most Beautiful Boy in the World', 'What She Said: The Art of Pauline Kael', Lasse Hallström’s 'Hilma', and the Gaelic comedy 'Róise & Frank'.
translated_content: Juno Films je otkupio sva prava za SAD i Kanadu na dokumentarni film 'Karavan', prvi dugometražni dokumentarac rediteljke Nurije Klavero i reditelja Aitora Palasiosa. Film će imati svoju severnoameričku premijeru u međunarodnoj konkurenciji na festivalu DOC NYC, pre bioskopske distribucije krajem proleća. Su-producenti su Cabal Films i Trueday Films, a 'Karavan' pruža ljudsku perspektivu političkoj debati o kontroli granica, prateći priču o jednoj porodici u potrazi za boljim životom u Sjedinjenim Državama. Dokumentarac prati trudnu Jurí, njenog partnera Majka i njihovog sina Santija dok beže iz Hondurasa, otkrivajući razloge i složenost njihove odluke da krenu na ovo opasno putovanje. Iako film beleži samo nekoliko nedelja njihove rute, osvetljava snove mnogih o preseljenju u SAD radi bolje budućnosti. Ugovor je dogovorila Laura Kolado ispred Trueday Films i Izvršna direktorka Juno Filmsa, Elizabet Šeldon. Šeldon je izjavila: 'Film Nurije i Aitora podseća gledaoce da je za mnoge koji prelaze južnu granicu osnovni motiv obezbeđenje boljeg života za svoju decu. Film daje ime i lice pričama koje mnogi prepoznaju kroz porodične istorije potrage za političkom stabilnošću i ekonomskim prilikama u Americi.' U zajedničkoj izjavi, Klavero, Palasios i Kolado naglašavaju da, iako je migracija izbor, to nikada nije lak izbor. Ističu da migranti često žrtvuju nematerijalno, poput kulture i pripadnosti, zarad fizičke sigurnosti i boljih prilika za buduće generacije. Dodaju: 'Migracija je oduvek postojala i uvek će postojati. Ono što organizovane migracije, poput karavana, čini posebnom jeste to što lične priče i snove pretvara u politički čin.' Autori povezuju stalne migracije iz Centralne Amerike sa istorijskim nejednakostima u tom regionu, gde mala elita kontroliše većinu resursa i vlasti, dok većina stanovništva živi na egzistencijalnom minimumu. Ovakvo stanje, tvrde, često je podržano američkom politikom koja je društvene reforme u tim državama viđala kao pretnju sopstvenim političkim i ekonomskim interesima. Nedavno je Juno Films najavio akviziciju još jednog filma, 'Liv Ulman: Manje utaban put', koji će takođe biti prikazan na DOC NYC. Kompanija je poznata po naslovima kao što su 'Najlepši dečko na svetu', 'Šta je rekla: Umetnost Polin Kejl', 'Hilma' Lasea Halstroma i galska komedija 'Rozi i Frenk'.

article_content: A luxurious beach hut, valued at £40,000, was recently transported by boat to Mudeford Spit in Dorset, a sought-after sandy peninsula known for hosting some of Britain’s most expensive beach huts. The timber chalet, measuring 13ft by 13ft, was too large for road transport, so it was floated on water to its destination. Mudeford Spit is home to approximately 350 beach huts, with some selling for around £150,000 due to their prime location and extraordinary views of the Solent. The remote sandbank is accessible only by boat or via a narrow road shared with a novelty land train. The new hut was lifted onto a small barge, towed down the River Stour across Christchurch Harbour, and craned into place nestled between two other huts. Built from cedar wood, the hut features a modern kitchen with a full-size fridge-freezer, four-ring hob, gas oven, and sink, as well as a lounge area, dining table, surround sound system, electrical outlets, and a fixture for a TV. Lacking mains electricity or water, the building is powered by two solar panels connected to a 12-volt battery, supplying both power and hot water through a pump. It can accommodate up to six people: a double bed and two singles on a mezzanine level, and two sofa beds in the lounge. A local bylaw limits overnight stays from Easter through to Autumn, while a communal shower block on the sandbank provides toilet and washing facilities. Constructed by Ecologic Developments for an anonymous couple in their 40s with two young children, the project required the unusual transport method because of the hut’s larger size compared to typical beach huts. High demand continues to drive up prices; last summer a hut at Mudeford Spit sold for £180,000, and in 2006, a West Bexington beach hut achieved a then-record £235,000 sale price.
translated_content: Luksuzna kućica na plaži, vredna 40.000 funti, nedavno je brodom prevezena do Mudeford Spita u Dorsetu, traženog peščanog poluostrva poznatog po nekim od najskupljih kućica na plaži u Britaniji. Drvena vikendica, dimenzija 4x4 metra, bila je prevelika za drumski transport, pa je do odredišta stigla vodenim putem. Mudeford Spit ima oko 350 kućica na plaži, od kojih se neke prodaju za oko 150.000 funti zbog ekskluzivne lokacije i izuzetnog pogleda na Solent. Do udaljenog spruda može se stići samo čamcem ili uskim putem kojim saobraća i turistički vozić. Nova kućica je podignuta na malu baržu, vučena niz reku Stour, preko luke Christchurch i postavljena kranom između dve druge kućice. Napravljen od kedrovine, objekat ima savremenu kuhinju sa velikim frižiderom-zamrzivačem, šporetom sa četiri ringle, plinskom rernom i sudoperom, kao i dnevnu sobu, trpezarijski sto, ozvučenje, utičnice i priključak za TV. Pošto nema struje ni vode iz mreže, napajanje obezbeđuju dve solarne ploče povezane na 12-voltnu bateriju, što omogućava upotrebu uređaja i toplu vodu pomoću pumpe. Kućica može da primi do šest osoba: bračni krevet i dva pojedinačna na galeriji, plus dve sofe na razvlačenje u dnevnoj sobi. Lokalni propisi ograničavaju noćenje od Uskrsa do jeseni, dok zajednički blok sa tuševima omogućava korišćenje toaleta i pranje. Objekat je izgradila firma Ecologic Developments za anonimni bračni par u četrdesetim sa dvoje male dece, a zbog većih dimenzija kućice bilo je potrebno neuobičajeno rešenje za transport. Velika potražnja nastavlja da podiže cene – prošlog leta jedna kućica na Mudeford Spitu prodata je za 180.000 funti, dok je 2006. godine u West Bexingtonu prodata kućica za tada rekordnih 235.000 funti.

article_content: Senator John Fetterman has stayed true to his unconventional style since arriving in the Senate, sticking with the down-to-earth image that helped win him support in Pennsylvania. Rather than embracing the formalities of Capitol Hill, the Democrat remains an outsider—often spotted in casual clothes like hoodies and shorts, eating takeout meals alone, and skipping out on D.C.’s elite social events. Recently, Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer’s attempt to loosen the chamber's dress code triggered criticism from most Republican senators, resulting in a quick reversal. Fetterman, unfazed, poked fun at the GOP’s reaction. Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren shared with The Washington Post that Fetterman’s distinctive demeanor brings much-needed energy into the Senate. 'John Fetterman brings his own vibe to the Senate. There's no one like him and that's a good thing to shake this stuffy place up a little bit,' she said. Fetterman has also been loud in his demands for Senator Bob Menendez of New Jersey to resign, becoming the first Senate Democrat to publicly do so after Menendez and his wife were indicted on bribery charges related to dealings with Egyptian businessmen. Menendez has pleaded not guilty and refuses to step down. When asked if Fetterman’s outspoken criticism of Menendez created tension, Warren pointed out that her own relationship with Fetterman remains friendly.
translated_content: Senator Džon Feterman ostao je dosledan svom nekonvencionalnom stilu otkako je došao u Senat, zadržavajući prizemni imidž koji mu je doneo podršku u Pensilvaniji. Umesto da prihvati formalnosti Kapitol Hila, ovaj demokrata i dalje ostaje autsajder—često ga viđaju u opuštenoj odeći poput dukseva i šortseva, kako jede naručenu hranu sam i izbegava elitne društvene događaje u Vašingtonu. Nedavno je pokušaj lidera većine u Senatu Čaka Šumera da olabavi pravila oblačenja izazvao kritike većine republikanskih senatora, što je dovelo do brze promene odluke. Feterman se nije obazirao i šaljivo je reagovao na reakciju republikanaca. Senatorka iz Masačusetsa Elizabet Voren izjavila je za The Washington Post da Fetermanova posebna energija unosi neophodnu živost u Senat. 'Džon Feterman donosi svoj fazon u Senat. Nema nikog kao što je on i dobro je što malo protrese ovu ukočenu instituciju', rekla je. Feterman je takođe bio glasan u zahtevima da senator iz Nju Džerzija, Bob Menendez, podnese ostavku, postavši prvi demokrata u Senatu koji je to javno zatražio nakon što su Menendez i njegova supruga optuženi za mito u vezi sa poslovima sa egipatskim biznismenima. Menendez je izjavio da nije kriv i odbija da podnese ostavku. Na pitanje da li Fetermanove oštre kritike Menendeza izazivaju tenzije, Voren je naglasila da je njen odnos s Fetermanom i dalje prijateljski.

Paul Mason, a Briton once known as the world’s heaviest man at 70 stone, says meeting his American fiancée is the best thing to have happened in his life. The 53-year-old from Ipswich, Suffolk, has slimmed down to 22 stone and is preparing to leave the UK to start a new chapter in the U.S. Mason accepted a marriage proposal from Rebecca Mountain, 40, of Orange, Massachusetts, during a live appearance on U.S. television.

Reflecting on his new relationship, Mason described feeling emotions he had never before experienced, stating, "Meeting Rebecca is the best thing that has ever happened in my life." The couple were seen choosing an engagement ring together in a New York jewelry store and celebrating in Times Square.

Mason told the Daily Mirror that after turning 50, he wondered if marriage would ever happen for him, and he was speechless when Mountain proposed. Mountain, who explained that their connection grew from many small things, emphasized the strong chemistry between them. She mentioned they spoke daily via Skype for several hours, and while their engagement might seem spontaneous, both are practical and level-headed.

On ABC's "The View," Mountain proposed to Mason, and the show’s hosts surprised the couple by pledging to contribute towards the cost of Mason’s surgery to remove excess skin after his weight loss. Dr. Jennifer Capla, a New York-based plastic surgeon, volunteered to perform the operation. With her services donated, the couple needs only to cover Mason’s hospital stay and medication, with “The View” offering $17,000 to meet these medical expenses.

Mountain said their wedding will wait until Mason’s further medical needs are addressed, as another surgery for his legs is expected in six to eight months. Their relationship began when Mountain, inspired by a documentary on Mason’s struggle with obesity, contacted him on Facebook. Their connection deepened through ongoing support and communication, eventually developing into love.

Mason’s difficulties with weight began in his 20s after family loss and health problems, leading to severe immobility and reliance on carers. At one point, emergency responders had to remove a wall from his home to evacuate him for medical treatment. Adapted housing and care reportedly cost British taxpayers more than £1 million.

After undergoing gastric bypass surgery with the NHS, Mason lost 48 stone, but now requires further medical procedures to recover fully. Mason and Mountain hope that sharing their story will help raise the additional funds needed for his surgery and their future together.

Pol Mejson, Britanac koji je nekada bio najteži čovek na svetu sa 445 kilograma, kaže da mu je upoznavanje američke verenice najbolje što mu se dogodilo u životu. Pedesetrogodišnjak iz Ipsviča, Safolk, smršao je na 140 kilograma i sprema se da napusti Veliku Britaniju kako bi započeo novi život u SAD. Mejson je prihvatio bračnu ponudu Rebeke Mauntin (40) iz Orindža, Masačusets, tokom direktnog prenosa na američkoj televiziji.

Mejson je rekao da nikada ranije nije imao ovakva osećanja i izjavio: „Upoznavanje Rebeke je najbolje što mi se ikad desilo." Par je viđen kako zajedno bira verenički prsten u njujorškoj juvelirnici i slavi na Tajms Skveru.

Za Daily Mirror je Mejson rekao da se nakon što je napunio 50 godina pitao da li će se ikada oženiti i bio je bez reči kada mu je Rebeka zaprosila. Mauntin je objasnila da je njihova veza izrasla iz mnogo sitnica i istakla snažnu hemiju između njih. Rekla je da su svakodnevno razgovarali preko Skype-a po nekoliko sati, iako veridba možda izgleda spontano, oboje su veoma prizemni.

Na ABC-ovoj emisiji "The View" Mauntin je zaprosila Mejsona, a domaćini su ih iznenadili obećanjem da će pomoći u plaćanju Mejsonove operacije uklanjanja viška kože nakon mršavljenja. Dr Dženifer Kapla, plastični hirurg iz Njujorka, volontiraće da obavi operaciju. Pošto su njene usluge donirane, paru je preostalo da pokrije Mejsonovo bolničko lečenje i lekove, pri čemu je "The View" ponudio 17.000 dolara za te troškove.

Mauntin je rekla da će venčanje sačekati dok se Mejsonove medicinske potrebe ne reše, jer ga još jedna operacija nogu očekuje za šest do osam meseci. Njihova veza je započela kada je Mauntin, inspirisana dokumentarcem o Mejsonovoj borbi sa gojaznošću, stupila s njim u kontakt preko Facebook-a. Veza se produbljivala kroz podršku i svakodnevnu komunikaciju, a kasnije je prerasla u ljubav.

Mejsonovi problemi sa težinom počeli su u dvadesetim, nakon porodičnih gubitaka i zdravstvenih problema, što je dovelo do nepokretnosti i potpune zavisnosti od negovatelja. U jednom trenutku, hitna pomoć je morala da razbije zid njegove kuće da ga izmeste na lečenje. Adaptacija stana i nega navodno su poreske obveznike u Britaniji koštali više od milion funti.

Nakon što je uradio operaciju smanjenja želuca kroz NHS, Mejson je izgubio 305 kilograma, ali mu je sada potrebna dalja medicinska pomoć za potpuni oporavak. On i Mauntin se nadaju da će kroz svoju priču prikupiti dodatna sredstva za operaciju i budućnost zajedno.

article_content: A five-month-old male orangutan named Kecil has been relocated to the Milwaukee County Zoo to find a suitable surrogate mother after failing to bond with his biological mother at the Toledo Zoo in Ohio. Kecil, born in January at the Toledo Zoo, did not form a bond with his mother, Yasmin, who has previously raised offspring but showed little interest in caring for him after a difficult delivery. Zoo officials tried placing Kecil and Yasmin in private quarters to encourage bonding, but these efforts were unsuccessful, leading to the decision to move Kecil to Milwaukee. The Milwaukee County Zoo, known for a strong history of successful orangutan births, is now introducing Kecil to M.J., a female orangutan with proven experience as a surrogate mother, having previously cared for another infant, Mahal, who died last December. Kecil arrived at the Milwaukee Zoo on May 19 in good health. He was accompanied by a keeper from Toledo, who is assisting the transition alongside Milwaukee's zookeepers. Jeff Sailer, the Milwaukee Zoo’s executive director, stressed the priority of Kecil’s well-being, emphasizing the importance of each orangutan, especially as the species is endangered and faces the risk of extinction in the wild during Kecil’s lifetime. Kecil is the second baby ape at the Milwaukee County Zoo this year. The first was Kassiu, a female gorilla born in March who died a month later. Kassiu was the first gorilla born at the zoo in 22 years. Kecil, whose name means 'little man' in Indonesian, is being gradually introduced to M.J. to help him adjust to his new environment.
translated_content: Petomesečni mužjak orangutana po imenu Kecil premešten je u Zoološki vrt okruga Milwaukee da bi pronašao odgovarajuću zamensku majku, nakon što nije uspeo da se zbliži sa svojom biologičkom majkom u zoološkom vrtu Toledo u Ohaju. Kecil, rođen u januaru u zoološkom vrtu Toledo, nije ostvario vezu sa majkom Jasmin, koja je ranije odgajila potomstvo, ali je nakon teškog porođaja pokazala malo interesovanja za njega. Zvaničnici zoološkog vrta pokušali su da smeste Kecila i Jasmin u privatni prostor kako bi podstakli njihovu međusobnu vezu, ali ti pokušaji nisu uspeli, pa je odlučeno da se Kecil preseli u Milwaukee. Zoološki vrt okruga Milwaukee, poznat po uspešnoj istoriji odgoja orangutana, sada upoznaje Kecila sa M.J, ženkom orangutana sa dokazanim iskustvom kao zamenska majka, koja je ranije negovala mladunče Mahala, preminulog prošlog decembra. Kecil je stigao u zoološki vrt Milwaukee 19. maja, u dobrom zdravstvenom stanju. Pratio ga je čuvar iz Toleda, koji pomaže u tranziciji zajedno sa čuvarima iz Milwaukeeja. Jeff Sailer, izvršni direktor zoološkog vrta Milwaukee, naglasio je da je dobrobit Kecila prioritet, ističući važnost svakog orangutana, posebno jer je ova vrsta ugrožena i suočava se sa rizikom od istrebljenja u divljini tokom Kecilovog života. Kecil je drugo mladunče čovekolikog majmuna u zoološkom vrtu Milwaukee ove godine. Prvo je bila Kassiu, ženka gorile rođena u martu, koja je uginula mesec dana kasnije. Kassiu je bila prva gorila rođena u tom zoološkom vrtu za 22 godine. Kecil, čije ime na indonežanskom znači 'mali čovek', postepeno se upoznaje sa M.J. kako bi se prilagodio svojoj novoj sredini.

article_content: Brazilian graphic designer Carol Rossetti began a series of illustrations in April to merge her passion for art with positive advocacy for women. Working from her office in Belo Horizonte, she crafted drawings of women and girls, each paired with supportive messages that promote self-acceptance and challenge societal expectations. Her project, started as a personal exercise, quickly found a global audience. With over 83,000 followers on Facebook, activity on Tumblr, and translations into numerous languages by dedicated volunteers, Rossetti's work resonates internationally. Rossetti spends about two hours on each illustration, tackling sensitive issues like body image, sexual assault, and gender stereotypes. Her artwork reassures survivors that they are more than their trauma and encourages individuals to embrace their choices regardless of societal norms. Her inbox is filled with thankful messages from around the world—many write to share how her art brought them comfort or inspired newfound confidence. The most memorable feedback comes from those helped by her sensitive treatment of difficult subjects. Although Rossetti initially concentrated on feminist topics, suggestions from her diverse audience inspired her to address racism, ableism, homophobia, and more, broadening the project's impact. She sees her work as a contribution to better representation and inclusion in media. Rossetti is exploring the possibility of selling prints online but, for now, continues to focus on creating new artwork and coordinating translations with her volunteers.
translated_content: Brazilska grafička dizajnerka Karol Roseti započela je seriju ilustracija u aprilu kako bi spojila svoju strast prema umetnosti sa pozitivnim zalaganjem za žene. Iz svog biroa u Belo Horizonteu, crtala je žene i devojke, svaku sa porukama podrške koje promovišu samoprihvatanje i izazivaju društvena očekivanja. Njen projekat, započet kao lični izazov, brzo je pronašao globalnu publiku. Više od 83.000 pratilaca na Fejsbuku, aktivnosti na Tumblru i prevodi na brojne jezike koje rade posvećeni volonteri pokazuju da se Ro­setina dela dopadaju širom sveta. Roseti na svakoj ilustraciji radi oko dva sata, obrađujući osetljive teme kao što su slika tela, seksualno nasilje i rodni stereotipi. Njena umetnost pruža podršku žrtvama, poručujući da su više od svoje traume, ali i podstiče ljude da prigrle svoje izbore bez obzira na društvene norme. Njeno sanduče puno je zahvalnih poruka iz celog sveta. Mnogi joj pišu kako im je njena umetnost donela utehu ili ih inspirisala da steknu novo samopouzdanje. Najdraže su joj reakcije onih kojima je pažljivošću pomogla u teškim trenucima. Iako se Roseti u početku fokusirala na feminističke teme, predlozi raznolike publike inspirisali su je da obrađuje i teme rasizma, ableizma, homofobije i drugih društvenih pitanja, proširujući uticaj svog projekta. Ona svoj rad vidi kao doprinos boljoj zastupljenosti i inkluziji u medijima. Roseti razmatra mogućnost prodaje printova online, ali za sada nastavlja da stvara nova dela i organizuje prevode sa svojim volonterima.

article_content: A high-speed police chase in South-East London resulted in the tragic death of a 13-year-old girl. The incident began when a Peugeot 308 triggered an automatic number plate recognition system used to identify wanted criminals or vehicles. During the pursuit, the Peugeot collided with the rear of a family's Volkswagen Polo on Ilderton Road in New Cross, causing catastrophic injuries to the teenager, who died at the scene. Her mother, father, and four-year-old brother—who was seated beside her in the back seat—were also injured. The Metropolitan Police charged Devon Newell, 32, with causing death by dangerous driving, causing serious injury by dangerous driving, failing to stop for police, failing to stop at the scene of an accident, and driving without a license or insurance. Newell is scheduled to appear before magistrates in Camberwell. The crash took place near a primary school and close to Millwall's football ground shortly before 6:30 pm Sunday. Witnesses reported that the Peugeot, chased by a marked police car with lights and sirens, struck the Polo at a junction in a 30mph zone, pushing it into a wall. The Peugeot was not reported as stolen. A woman passenger suffered minor injuries and another man was arrested at the scene. The girl's father remains in the hospital, while her mother and brother have been discharged. The collision left the community in shock. The case is now being investigated by the Directorate of Professional Standards. Commander Tony Eastaugh stated, “An innocent family are now dealing with the tragic loss of a loved one.”

On Wednesday morning, a section of Oslo's central train station (Oslo S) was evacuated after an abandoned suitcase was discovered on a bus bound for the airport. Authorities quickly suspended all train and bus services, blocked access to the station, and called in the police bomb squad to assess the situation. After investigation, the luggage was deemed harmless.

Bus driver Jack Vaadahl had noticed the suitcase left by a man who departed hurriedly, prompting him to notify security right away. Reports indicate that the man left the area promptly after leaving the bag, causing law enforcement to bolster their vigilance.

This event unfolds while Oslo is still on heightened alert, following deadly bombing and shooting incidents the previous Friday that took at least 68 lives. The main suspect, 32-year-old Norwegian Anders Behring Breivik, has confessed to involvement in the attacks but pleads not guilty to the killings. Despite claiming he acted alone, his manifesto suggests ties to other terror groups.

Police are also searching for a recently released individual deemed dangerous, who has expressed identifying with Breivik. Security precautions remain strong, especially as ministers such as Rigmor Aasrud return to offices damaged by the earlier bombing. Prime Minister Jens Stoltenberg is operating from the defense ministry for now, as decisions about the government's main offices are pending.

Additionally, authorities recently detonated explosives found at a farm rented by Breivik, where he is believed to have assembled bombs with fertilizer under the pretense of being a farmer.

Apple’s new Journal app is strikingly simple—just one screen displaying a reverse-chronological timeline of your entries, with a large plus button to add more. When you tap the button, you can choose to start a new entry or respond to one of Apple's 'reflection' prompts, such as, “What could you do to make someone’s day better this week?” or “Write about a time you found an unexpected solution to a hard problem.” Entries can include photos, videos, voice memos, and location data. The timeline view allows basic filtering by photo entries or bookmarked favorites. Daily reminders to journal are also available.

While the app offers a smooth, beginner-friendly experience, its features are fairly basic—there are no tags or folders to organize content beyond bookmarks and filters. The Journal app’s purpose is twofold: reflecting Apple’s emphasis on health and wellness, and capitalizing on your phone’s ability to recognize and suggest memorable 'Moments'. Using on-device machine learning, Journal identifies notable events (such as calls, activities, and photos) and prompts you to capture or reflect on them. Privacy is central; all data is processed on-device, with only iCloud-encrypted backups leaving the phone. The 'suggestions API' is open to third-party apps, though the specifics of the Moment-detection algorithm remain unclear.

However, automatic memory-surfacing features carry emotional risks, as seen with social media platforms unintentionally resurfacing painful moments. While Journal lets you choose which data sources it uses and even turn off suggestions, there’s little granular control—primarily on/off switches. For now, after a few days of use, the app hasn’t prompted me with any Moments, despite proactive journaling. It remains to be seen how effective and considerate the suggestion engine will be, and whether third-party apps will integrate with the Journal API. Apps using SiriKit, CallKit, or HealthKit may contribute data to suggestions, but can’t directly add Moments. The algorithm behind Moment discovery still feels opaque.

You can also use the share sheet to add links and media from other apps; Journal will save rich links back to the original source. This works well in some cases (like playing music tracks directly within your timeline), but experiences can be inconsistent if, for example, you aren’t recognized as a paying subscriber to a linked service. Journal is not designed to replace bookmarking or read-later apps—its sole focus is making journaling accessible and straightforward.

Overall, Journal is likely to appeal most to first-time journalers or those seeking a minimalist approach. Advanced users may find it too basic to switch from more robust apps like Day One. Ultimately, while Apple’s approach underscores privacy and well-intentioned design, questions remain about user control and the nuanced understanding of meaningful moments. Are we ready to let our phones decide what matters most? It's a thought-provoking step into digital self-reflection.

Novi Apple Journal je izuzetno jednostavan—samo jedan ekran koji prikazuje zapise obrnutim hronološkim redosledom, sa velikim plus dugmetom za dodavanje novih. Osnovna ideja Journal-a je dvostruka: promovisanje zdravlja i dobrobiti, i korišćenje sposobnosti telefona da prepozna i predloži značajne „Trenutke“. Kroz mašinsko učenje na samom uređaju, Journal identifikuje važna dešavanja (kao što su pozivi, aktivnosti ili slike) i sugeriše da ih zabeležite ili reflektujete o njima. Privatnost je prioritet; svi podaci se obrađuju na telefonu, a jedino bekap kopije na iCloudu napuštaju uređaj i i one su šifrovane. Apple-ov Suggestions API je dostupan i drugim aplikacijama, ali proces detekcije „Trenutaka” i dalje nije potpuno transparentan.

Međutim, automatsko prikazivanje uspomena može biti emotivno rizično, kao što se dešavalo sa društvenim mrežama koje nenamerno prikazuju bolna sećanja. Journal omogućava izbor izvora podataka i uključivanje/isključivanje predloga, ali ne postoje detaljnije kontrole. Posle nekoliko dana korišćenja, meni aplikacija još nije predložila nijedan „Trenutak”, uprkos redovnom pisanju. Ostaje da se vidi koliko će predlozi biti korisni i obazrivi, te kako će druge aplikacije koristiti Journal API. Aplikacije sa SiriKit-om, CallKit-om ili HealthKit-om mogu slati podatke za predloge, ali ne mogu direktno dodavati „Trenutke”. Detalji algoritma ostaju nejasni.

Preko share sheet opcije možete dodavati linkove i medije iz drugih aplikacija; Journal čuva bogate linkove do originalnog sadržaja. Ovo ponekad radi odlično (poput puštanja muzike direktno iz dnevnika), ali može biti nekonzistentno ako, recimo, nemate pretplatu na određenu uslugu. Journal nije namenjen kao zamena za aplikacije za obeležavanje sadržaja ili naknadno čitanje—fokusiran je na jednostavno vođenje dnevnika.

Generalno, Journal će najviše odgovarati početnicima i ljubiteljima minimalističkih rešenja. Napredni korisnici će ga verovatno smatrati suviše osnovnim u poređenju sa aplikacijama kao što je Day One. I dok Apple stavlja privatnost i dobre namere u prvi plan, ostaju pitanja o kontroli i suptilnosti određivanja važnih trenutaka. Jesmo li spremni da prepustimo telefonu odluku o tome šta nam je važno? Ovo je zanimljiv korak ka digitalnoj samorefleksiji.

article_content: Maruti Suzuki India announced on Friday that its board has approved the allotment of over 12.3 million shares to its parent company, Suzuki Motor Corporation (SMC), on a preferential basis. This decision is part of SMC's acquisition of 100% stake in Suzuki Motor Gujarat (SMG). The board has approved the allotment of 12,322,514 shares to SMC, each with a face value of Rs 5 at a price of Rs 10,420.85 per share, according to a regulatory filing by the company. Based on the valuation report by RBSA Valuation Advisors LLP, this translates to a total value of Rs 12,841.1 crore. Following this share allotment, SMC's stake in Maruti Suzuki India will rise to 58.19% from the previous 56.48%. Last week, Maruti Suzuki shareholders approved the plan to issue shares on a preferential basis to SMC as part of a related party transaction for acquiring SMG. On July 31, 2023, the MSI board approved the termination of its contract manufacturing agreement with SMG, as well as SMC's acquisition of all SMG shares at a price determined in accordance with applicable laws. MSI Chairman R C Bhargava stated that the share-swap method used for the acquisition benefits shareholders and aims to align all production operations under a single management. The company envisions achieving an annual output of four million units by 2030-31. Since 2014, SMC has invested Rs 18,000 crore in SMG. SMG, which is a wholly owned subsidiary of SMC, supplies its entire production to MSI. The company, incorporated in 2014, operates a production facility in Gujarat with an annual capacity of 750,000 units. As of the latest update, MSI shares were trading 0.08% higher at Rs 10,501.95 on the BSE. In related business news, more women are taking up senior leadership roles in India Inc, Tesla is considering a $2 billion investment in India contingent on lower import duties, and the government may factor in human development and sustainability in its next Finance Commission resource allocation formula.

article_content: Donna Fallon was a 40-year-old housewife and mother of three when she discovered her psychic abilities. While receiving a reading from another medium, she was told she possessed this gift and soon began to explore it herself. Now 49 and living in Cambridgeshire, Donna has spent the past nine years building a loyal client base, offering spiritual meetings to connect with departed loved ones, tarot card readings, and soul healing sessions. Her clients include celebrities such as former TOWIE star Amy Childs, former WAG Lizzie Cundy, former EastEnder Cheryl Fergison, Tamara Ecclestone, and Colleen Rooney. Donna said, 'Everyone comes to see me for different reasons, and every session is unique depending on why they are there. I usually start by asking their loved ones in the spirit world why they have come, as that's often the best way.' She emphasizes client confidentiality and will not speak publicly about sessions or reveal details about her clients. 'People may come for guidance about work, relationships, or to contact loved ones who have passed away. Most people want some direction in their lives. I never tell anyone what to do or predict death. Life is difficult enough—I want to give people hope.' Donna considers herself a 'spiritual supermarket,' providing spiritual messages, tarot readings, and soul healing in one place. She recounts helping clients with a variety of situations, such as supporting a woman after a miscarriage, assisting a mother grieving her son who died in the Hillsborough disaster, and helping someone forgive herself for not being present at a loved one’s passing. Donna prefers to offer guidance, believing that clients should retain free will. She recalls turning down direct advice, as she feels it’s not her place to make decisions for others. Donna provides readings in a separate area of her Cambridgeshire home, keeping work and personal life distinct. Initially, her children were unsure about her career, but as they've grown older, they have become supportive. She also does charity readings at Everton matches and enjoys the positive impact she can have on others. Donna seldom reads for her own family, believing emotional involvement can cloud judgment. She has occasionally done tarot readings for her eldest daughter and husband but generally maintains boundaries to respect their privacy. She is planning to organize spiritual retreats to teach others how to give readings.

Navodi da je pomagala klijentima u različitim situacijama, na primer, pružanjem podrške ženi posle spontanog pobačaja, majci koja je izgubila sina u Hillsborough katastrofi ili osobi koja je sebi oprostila što nije bila uz voljenu osobu u njegovim poslednjim trenucima. article_content: Children wade through floodwater on Nyangai Island, Sierra Leone, where most of the land has already been lost to the sea and what remains is regularly submerged at high tide. Sixty-two-year-old fisherman Kpana Charlie recalls his childhood when the island was a paradise, filled with white beaches, green forests, and vibrant community life. Today, the island’s size has been reduced to a small patch, its forests gone and its homes swept away. The soccer field where children once played spends most of the day underwater. Charlie and other residents now live in makeshift shelters of sticks and tarpaulin after their homes were destroyed. 'It's getting worse and worse,' says Charlie. 'There's nowhere to go to the toilet, nowhere to be free. Whenever the water rises, everything floods. It never used to be like this.' Nearly a third of Sierra Leone’s population lives in coastal areas, relying heavily on agriculture and fishing for survival. The nation is among the most vulnerable to climate change, despite contributing minimally to global emissions, and lacks the resources to adequately respond to these challenges. Rising global sea levels and intensifying weather patterns foreshadow similar threats to many low-lying coastal communities worldwide. Gabriel Kpaka of Sierra Leone’s Meteorological Agency attributes Nyangai’s troubles to significant sea-level rise, noting the island has little protection beyond sandbags. 'If we don't act now,' he says, 'the impacts on people are going to get worse.' Twenty years ago, Nyangai had over 500 homes with about eight people each; now, just 70 homes remain as residents flee, joining millions worldwide displaced by climate-related disasters. A 2017 USAID study found that parts of Sierra Leone's coastline are receding up to 20 feet per year. While some islanders find it hard to measure the rising sea level, they notice more violent storms and unpredictable weather, which have become major destructive forces. Shopkeeper Tene Kamara, who moved to Nyangai from Freetown 15 years ago, laments her shrinking business as most of her customers have left. 'I'd leave tomorrow if I could,' she says. 'I'm afraid, and it makes my heart worry.' Neighboring islands in the Turtle Islands archipelago have fared somewhat better, either due to protective mangrove forests or higher elevation, but all are now influx destinations for displaced Nyangai residents. Karim Anso, a former resident, rebuilt his home four times before finally relocating his family. 'I did it for my children,' he says. Constant erosion on Nyangai has forced the merging of villages and eventually split the community into two isolated settlements before one was finally abandoned. Today, everyone who remains is crammed into what’s left, with basic shelter and few prospects for the future. Attempts to restore mangroves or secure government-backed sea defenses have failed due to a lack of resources and environmental challenges. Efforts by local and national authorities, like Bonthe's construction of a seawall and USAID’s mangrove plantings, have seen limited success. According to Paul Lamin of the country's Environmental Protection Agency, Nyangai is not a government priority, and the limited resources must cover many urgent needs elsewhere. He calls for greater international support for vulnerable countries. For remaining residents, even basic necessities like fresh water and sanitation are hard to come by. Wells are contaminated, forcing residents to travel long distances by boat for drinking water. With so little land left, privacy is scarce and children make their own fun among the stumps of fallen trees. Many fear the island will disappear altogether within a few years. As the sea continues to erode what’s left of their home, a sense of resignation has descended on Nyangai’s shrinking community. 'The sea is eating our island,' says Chief Kong. 'God will decide what happens to us. We're in his hands now.'
translated_content: Deca gaze kroz poplavljenu vodu na ostrvu Nyangai u Sijera Leoneu, gde je većina zemljišta izgubljena u moru, a ono što je preostalo redovno je pod vodom tokom plime. Šezdesetdvogodišnji ribar Kpana Charlie priseca se detinjstva kada je ostrvo bilo raj sa belim plažama, zelenim šumama i živom zajednicom. Danas je ostrvo svedeno na mali komad kopna, šume su nestale, a kuće su odnele vode. Fudbalsko igralište gde su se deca igrala veći deo dana je pod vodom. Charlie i ostali stanovnici sada žive u skloništima od drvenih štapova i cerade nakon što su im kuće uništene. 'Sve je gore i gore,' kaže Charlie. 'Nema gde ni da se ode u toalet, nigde nema slobode. Kad voda naraste, sve bude pod vodom. Nikada nije bilo ovako.' Skoro trećina stanovništva Sijera Leonea živi u obalnim regionima i u velikoj meri se oslanja na poljoprivredu i ribolov. Zemlja je jedna od najugroženijih od klimatskih promena, iako minimalno doprinosi globalnom zagađenju i nema dovoljno resursa da se izbori s tim izazovima. Porast nivoa mora i jači vremenski uslovi predstavljaju pretnju mnogim niskim obalskim zajednicama širom sveta. Gabriel Kpaka iz Meteorološke agencije Sijera Leonea kaže da su problemi ostrva Nyangai zbog znatnog porasta nivoa mora i napominje da ostrvo nema zaštitu osim vreća s peskom. 'Ako sada ne preduzmemo ništa, posledice po ljude biće još gore,' kaže. Pre dvadeset godina Nyangai je imao više od 500 kuća sa po oko osam ljudi; danas je ostalo svega 70 domova, dok su se ostali iselili, pridružujući se milionima ljudi širom sveta raseljenih klimatskim katastrofama. Prema USAID studiji iz 2017, obala Sijera Leonea erodira i do šest metara godišnje. Iako stanovnici teško procenjuju rast nivoa mora, primećuju jače oluje i nepredvidivo vreme koje nanose velike štete. Prodavačica Tene Kamara, koja se iz Fritauna preselila na Nyangai pre 15 godina, žali zbog slabe prodaje jer su većina njenih mušterija otišli. 'Otišla bih sutra kad bih mogla', kaže. 'Plašim se, srce mi je teško.' Susedna ostrva u arhipelagu Turtle Islands stoje nešto bolje, zbog mangrova ili veće nadmorske visine, ali su sada utočište za raseljene sa Nyangaija. Karim Anso, bivši stanovnik, obnavljao je kuću četiri puta pre nego što je preselio porodicu. 'Uradio sam to zbog svoje dece', rekao je. Neprekidna erozija na Nyangaiju je spojila sela, a potom i podelila zajednicu na dva izolovana dela pre nego što je jedno potpuno napušteno. Danas su svi preostali skupljeni na malom prostoru, sa privremenim skloništima i malo nade za budućnost. Pokušaji s mangrovama i zaštitom od mora nisu dali rezultat zbog nedostatka resursa i okolinskih problema. Lokalne i državne vlasti, poput izgradnje zaštitnog zida u Bontheu i sadnje mangrova uz pomoć USAID-a, nisu imale veći uspeh. Paul Lamin iz Agencije za zaštitu životne sredine kaže da Nyangai nije prioritet vlade i da ograničeni resursi moraju ići na hitnije potrebe. On apeluje na veću međunarodnu pomoć ugroženim zemljama. Stanovnici teško dolaze do osnovnih potreba poput pijaće vode i sanitacije. Bunari su poplavljeni, pa moraju putovati čamcem do drugih ostrva po vodu za piće. Zbog malo preostale zemlje, nema privatnosti, a deca se igraju uz panjeve iščupanih stabala. Mnogi strahuju da će ostrvo nestati u narednih nekoliko godina. Dok more nastavlja da odnosi ostrvo, među preostalim stanovnicima vlada osećanje beznađa. 'More jede naše ostrvo,' kaže poglavica Kong. 'Bog će odlučiti šta će biti s nama. U njegovim smo rukama.'

article_content: Nicole Scherzinger, the glamorous Pussycat Dolls singer and X Factor judge whose act James Arthur won this year's show, has revealed her Christmas Day outfit will include a pair of Spanx and a push-up bra. Spanx control pants have become popular among celebrities and the public for smoothing their silhouette and preventing visible panty lines, and Nicole, 34, is joining the trend. Even slim celebrities like Katy Perry, Tulisa Contostavlos, and Kristen Stewart have admitted to wearing Spanx, with stars such as Princess Beatrice, Kim Kardashian, and Jennifer Lopez occasionally seen sporting them as well. Nicole told Closer magazine she would pair the control pants with a great bra, humorously commenting that it will ‘lift up those puppies’. Excited to celebrate Christmas with her family, Nicole plans to indulge in festive favorites like chicken, dumplings, and pecan pie, saying she doesn't diet during the holidays but likes to work off the treats in January by running in Hyde Park and attending Bikram yoga classes. She typically eats a boiled egg with toast for breakfast, a chicken and salad wrap for lunch, and wholewheat pasta or sushi for dinner, and chooses healthy snacks such as raw nuts, bananas, and sugar-free hot chocolate, limiting alcohol to an occasional glass of wine. Nicole admits to having a weakness for crumpets, chocolate, sweets, cheese, and cakes, but enjoys them in moderation, believing that denying yourself only increases cravings. On Christmas Eve, she plans to wear a funny Christmas jumper and jeans, comfy clothes on Christmas Day, and something smart for church, joking, ‘It’s not a time for latex!’ Nicole, who has previously spoken about battling bulimia during her time touring with the Pussycat Dolls in 2003, says she tries to maintain a healthy diet overall.

article_content: Adani Ports & SEZ Ltd. is expanding its presence in Sri Lanka with a record investment in the Colombo West International Terminal (CWIT). The project gained momentum after the US International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) announced a $553 million loan for the terminal. The CWIT consortium includes Adani Ports (holding 51% stake), John Keells Holdings of Sri Lanka, and the Sri Lanka Ports Authority. The loan is backed by the project and has a 20-year tenure. The first phase of the project is estimated to cost $650 million, with completion targeted for December 2024. The overall investment, including a second phase, is projected at $1 billion, making it the largest foreign direct investment ever seen in Sri Lanka. In a public statement, DFC described itself as the US government’s development finance institution that partners with the private sector to address significant development challenges globally, investing in various sectors like energy, healthcare, infrastructure, agriculture, and finance. This DFC loan marks the first time a US government agency is financing an Adani project, signaling international confidence in the Adani Group’s ability to build a world-class container facility in Colombo. The investment comes after Adani’s market value saw substantial losses earlier in the year following allegations from short seller Hindenburg. Additionally, the move highlights US efforts to balance China’s growing investments in Sri Lanka. Karan Adani, CEO of Adani Ports, welcomed the DFC’s association as validation of the company’s capabilities and governance. He emphasized that the CWIT project would transform Sri Lanka’s socio-economic landscape through thousands of job opportunities and an improved trade ecosystem. The Port of Colombo is currently the largest and busiest transshipment port in the Indian Ocean and has been operating at over 90% capacity since 2021, indicating high demand for expanded facilities. The new terminal will serve growing economies in the Bay of Bengal, leveraging Sri Lanka’s strategic location. According to DFC CEO Scott Nathan, the partnership aims to strengthen economic growth and the strategic positions of partner countries. CWIT will be developed on a build, operate, and transfer basis for 35 years. Upon completion, it will have a quay length of 1,400 meters and a depth of 20 meters, capable of handling ultra-large container vessels of up to 24,000 TEUs. The terminal’s annual cargo capacity is expected to exceed 3.2 million TEUs. Karan Adani has previously stated that international operations may make up 10-12% of Adani Ports’ business in the coming years. The company also plans to develop a 500-megawatt wind farm in Northern Sri Lanka and build a cross-country transmission line to export renewable energy to India. The first phase of this clean energy project is budgeted at $750 million and is expected to be completed by the end of next year, according to Sri Lanka’s Energy Minister Kanchana Wijesekara. In other news, Tata Group will acquire Wistron's iPhone manufacturing facility for $750 million (including debt), becoming the first Indian firm to assemble iPhones. India has also surpassed China in the QS World University Rankings: Asia 2024, reflecting the country's advancements in higher education. Separately, the independent directors of Religare Enterprises Ltd. (REL) have raised concerns with regulators over the Burman family’s bid to acquire the company, alleging irregularities.

Konzorcijum CWIT čine Adani Ports (sa 51% udela), John Keells Holdings iz Šri Lanke i Uprava luka Šri Lanke. Kredit je obezbeđen projektom i ima rok otplate od 20 godina. Prva faza projekta procenjena je na 650 miliona dolara, a završetak se očekuje do decembra 2024. Ukupna investicija, uključujući drugu fazu, procenjuje se na milijardu dolara, što je najveća direktna strana investicija ikada uložena na Šri Lanki. U javnom saopštenju, DFC se predstavio kao razvojna finansijska institucija američke vlade koja sarađuje sa privatnim sektorom radi rešavanja ključnih razvojnih izazova širom sveta, ulažući u energetiku, zdravstvo, infrastrukturu, poljoprivredu i finansije. Ovaj kredit DFC-a predstavlja prvi put da neka američka vladina agencija finansira Adani projekat, što signalizira međunarodno poverenje u sposobnosti Adani Grupe da izgradi vrhunski kontejnerski terminal u Kolombu. Investicija dolazi nakon značajnog pada tržišne vrednosti Adani Grupe ranije ove godine zbog navoda short sellera Hindenburga. Ovaj potez takođe osvetljava napore SAD da izbalansiraju rastući uticaj kineskih investicija na Šri Lanki. Karan Adani, izvršni direktor Adani Ports, pozdravio je partnerstvo sa DFC-om kao potvrdu sposobnosti i korporativnog upravljanja kompanije. Naglasio je da će projekat CWIT transformisati socio-ekonomsku sliku Šri Lanke kroz više hiljada direktnih i indirektnih radnih mesta i unapređenje trgovinskog ekosistema. Novi terminal će služiti ekonomijama u razvoju u Bengalskom zalivu, koristeći strateški položaj Šri Lanke. Direktor DFC-a, Skot Nejtan, izjavio je da partnerstvo ima za cilj unapređenje privrednog razvoja i strateške pozicije partnerskih zemalja. CWIT će se razvijati po modelu izgradnje, upravljanja i prenosa (BOT) tokom 35 godina. Po završetku, imaće pristanište od 1.400 metara i dubinu od 20 metara, što omogućava obrađivanje ogromnih kontejnerskih brodova do kapaciteta 24.000 TEU. Očekuje se da će godišnji obim tereta biti preko 3,2 miliona TEU. Karan Adani je ranije rekao da će međunarodne operacije činiti 10-12% poslovanja Adani Ports-a u narednim godinama. Kompanija takođe planira izgradnju vetroparka od 500 megavata na severu Šri Lanke i izgradnju prenosne linije za izvoz obnovljive energije u Indiju. Prva faza ovog projekta procenjena je na 750 miliona dolara i očekuje se da bude završena do kraja sledeće godine, rekao je ministar energetike Šri Lanke Kančana Vižesekara. article_content: Mount Everest, Nepal (CNN) -- Even at over 21,000 feet on the world's tallest mountain, 13-year-old Jordan Romero used a live television broadcast Monday to greet his mother. 'Hi, Mom,' Romero said, waving during a CNN interview from Everest's advance base camp in Nepal. The interview followed the first day of serious climbing in Romero's quest to become the youngest person to reach Everest's summit, which stands at 29,028 feet (8,847 meters). Romero is accompanied by his father, Paul Romero, and Paul's girlfriend, Karen Lundgren. They are supported by a team of sherpas and yaks, which help transport their 2,000 kilograms (4,400 pounds) of gear. It took 13 days for them to reach the start of the real climbing. Paul Romero explained that Monday's initial ascent involved technical climbing in challenging weather, including ice and snow. For Jordan, it's just part of the journey. 'It could take a couple of weeks or even a couple of years,' he said, sitting in a tent wearing a parka and fluorescent yellow hat, his legs covered by a blue sleeping bag. 'This is the first of many attempts.' His first impressions: the trip is both tough and rewarding. 'It's Mount Everest—it's a difficult mountain. The altitude is tough,' Jordan said. 'It's physically and technically hard. I'm learning a lot of new things.' At the same time, he enjoys the views. 'I've been able to see Everest from everywhere I go. I'm already happy with that.' He also mentioned learning about the culture, politics, religion, and people of Nepal and China. 'This has been a great trip, and I've learned so much from it.' Paul Romero praised Jordan's effort, noting they spent 10 hours on ice and snow that day. 'Knock on wood, everyone is healthy,' he added. 'Jordan had a stellar day today.' Before the climb, Jordan said he wanted to inspire more young people to get outdoors, noting concerns about childhood obesity in America. 'I'm hoping to change that by climbing and motivational speaking. I want to motivate and inspire children to be outside.' He added with a smile, 'I'm doing this a bit for myself too, to accomplish something big.' Jordan has now climbed five of the Seven Summits—the highest peaks on each continent. The family started this challenge in 2005, when Jordan was 9 and they summited Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania (19,341 ft). There's some debate about the tallest mountain in Oceania, so the family climbed both Australia's Kosciuszko and Indonesia's Carstensz Pyramid. After Everest, only Vinson Massif in Antarctica remains, with a trip there planned for December. Jordan was inspired to start this journey after seeing a mural of the Seven Summits at school. He researched independently, then two weeks later shared his dream with his father, who was surprised by Jordan's knowledge. Paul Romero and Karen Lundgren traveled to Kathmandu last year to assess whether Jordan could summit Everest from the south in Nepal, but they chose to climb from the north in China instead. Paul acknowledges concerns about Jordan's age, but notes his son's strength and skill, as well as the strong support and safety systems in place. Jordan's highest peak so far has been Aconcagua in Argentina (22,841 ft). He spent weeks preparing for Everest, focusing on cardio and endurance training, and even slept in an altitude simulation tent for a month. Jordan has always loved the outdoors and often takes other kids to climb mountains in California's Big Bear region. Despite his achievements, Jordan wants to be seen as a regular kid. 'I try to seem like an average kid who happens to be climbing,' he said, 'but I'm not really fitting in.'
translated_content: Mont Everest, Nepal (CNN) -- Čak i na visini većoj od 6.400 metara na najvišoj planini na svetu, trinaestogodišnji Džordan Romero iskoristio je priliku da u ponedeljak putem TV prenosa uživo pozdravi svoju majku. 'Zdravo, mama', rekao je Romero mahnuvši tokom intervjua za CNN iz naprednog baznog kampa na Everestu u Nepalu. Ovaj intervju je usledio posle prvog dana ozbiljnog penjanja u Romerovom pokušaju da postane najmlađa osoba koja je dostigla vrh Everesta, koji se nalazi na 8.847 metara. Romera prate njegov otac, Pol Romero, i devojka njegovog oca, Karen Lundgren. Podršku im pruža tim šerpasa i jaka, koji pomažu u prenosu njihove opreme teške 2.000 kilograma. Do mesta odakle počinje ozbiljno penjanje trebalo im je 13 dana. Pol Romero je objasnio da je prvi uspon u ponedeljak uključivao tehničko penjanje u izazovnim vremenskim uslovima, sa mnogo leda i snega. Za Džordana je to samo deo putovanja. 'Može da traje nekoliko nedelja ili čak nekoliko godina', rekao je, sedeći u šatoru obučen u park u i fluorescentno žutu kapu, sa plavom vrećom za spavanje preko nogu. 'Ovo je prvo od mnogih pokušaja.' Njegovi prvi utisci: putovanje je i naporno i ispunjavajuće. 'To je Mont Everest—teška planina. Visina je izazovna', rekao je Džordan. 'Fizički i tehnički je zahtevno. Učim mnogo novih stvari.' U isto vreme, uživa u pogledima. 'Mogu da vidim Everest gde god da idem. Već sam zbog toga srećan.' Takođe je spomenuo da uči o kulturi, politici, religiji i ljudima Nepala i Kine. 'Ovo je sjajno putovanje i mnogo sam iz toga naučio.' Pol Romero je pohvalio Džordanov trud, napomenuvši da su toga dana proveli 10 sati na ledu i snegu. 'Da kucnem u drvo, svi su zdravi', dodao je. 'Džordan je danas imao sjajan dan.' Pre uspona, Džordan je rekao da želi da inspiriše više mladih da budu aktivni napolju, naglašavajući problem dečje gojaznosti u Americi. 'Nadam se da ću to promeniti planinarenjem i motivacionim govorima. Želim da motivišem i inspirišem decu da budu napolju.' Sa osmehom je dodao: 'Ovo radim i za sebe, da ostvarim nešto veliko.' Džordan je do sada popeo pet od Sedam vrhova—najviših planina na svakom kontinentu. Porodica je ovaj izazov započela 2005. godine, kada je Džordan imao 9 godina i zajedno su osvojili Kilimandžaro u Tanzaniji (5.895 metara). Postoji debata oko najvišeg vrha Okeanije, pa su se porodica penjala i na australski Kosciusko i indonežanski Karstensz Pyramid. Posle Everesta, preostao je samo Vinson Massif na Antarktiku, a putovanje tamo planirano je za decembar. Džordan je inspiraciju za ovaj izazov dobio kada je u školi video mural Sedam vrhova. Samostalno je istraživao, a tek dve nedelje kasnije saopštio svoju želju ocu, koji je bio iznenađen njegovim znanjem. Pol Romero i Karen Lundgren su prošle godine otputovali u Katmandu kako bi procenili može li se Džordan popeti na Everest sa južne strane u Nepalu, ali su se ipak odlučili da krenu sa severne strane iz Kine. Pol priznaje da postoje zabrinutosti zbog Džordanovih godina, ali ističe sinovu snagu i veštine, kao i snažan sistem podrške i bezbednosti. Najviši vrh koji je Džordan do sada osvojio je Akonkagva u Argentini (6.962 metra). Nedeljama se spremao za Everest, fokusirajući se na kardio i izdržljivost, spavajući mesec dana u šatoru sa simulacijom visine. Džordan je ceo život voleo boravak u prirodi i često vodi drugu decu na planinarenje u regionu Big Bear u Kaliforniji. Uprkos svojim dostignućima, Džordan želi da ga vide kao običnog dečka. 'Trudim se da izgledam kao prosečan klinac koji slučajno planinari,' rekao je, 'ali se baš i ne uklapam.'

article_content: Separating delicate items from everyday clothes and washing them at different times may soon be unnecessary. LG has introduced a washing machine featuring two washers, allowing users to save time and energy by cleaning two loads simultaneously. Homeowners can also control temperature, cycle length, and even start the machine remotely using an app. LG’s latest washing machine uses the Twin Wash system, which includes a main washer above a compact mini washer in the pedestal. LG says the mini washer is ideal for items requiring special care and can be paired with any of LG’s front-loading machines. The Twin Wash system was announced at LG's press conference during CES in Las Vegas. The mini washer, described by LG as the world's first compact washer in a concealed pedestal, provides new laundry options. For example, users can separate muddy sports gear from whites, or wash delicate silk underwear alongside towels at higher temperatures. When not in use, the mini washer acts as a pedestal but can be combined with all compatible LG front-loading washers. The system features Wi-Fi and NFC and includes LG’s SmartThinQ technology, enabling users to set washing cycles—including temperature and duration—through an app while away from home. Additionally, users can download pre-programmed wash cycles to their smartphones and begin them by touching the phone to the machine. The Smart Diagnosis feature assists users in identifying issues and faults. LG also presented its latest 'Door-In-Door' refrigerator at the event, with shelves built into an additional outer set of doors that open independently from the main compartment. LG claims this design helps prevent up to 47% of cold air from escaping each time the fridge is accessed, resulting in energy savings and keeping food fresher. Model LPXS346C provides 34 cubic feet of space. In addition, the Twin Wash machines incorporate LG’s TurboWash technology, featuring twin nozzles that spray concentrated detergent onto clothes, while a high-pressure nozzle above the drum circulates water during high spin cycles for faster and more effective rinsing. Pricing and release dates for the Twin Wash system and appliances have not yet been announced. Seong-jin Jo, President of LG Electronics Home Appliance and Air Solution Company, stated: 'The addition of a mini washer under the main washer brings greater flexibility, convenience, and efficiency. This is another step forward in our commitment to innovative technology that improves life for consumers worldwide.' During CES, LG also unveiled the G Flex 2, its next-generation flexible smartphone. The device features a Qualcomm Snapdragon 810 64-bit octa-core processor, 2GB of RAM, a 5.5-inch Full HD curved display with 1080 x 1920 pixel resolution and 403 pixels per inch, running Android Lollipop. The G Flex 2 is claimed to be 30% more durable than the original model. Rob Kerr, a mobile expert at uSwitch.com, commented that while the curved design is comfortable and ergonomic, it remains more of a visual novelty, but the upgraded specifications provide significant value.

Vlasnici mogu da kontrolišu temperaturu, trajanje ciklusa pa čak i da pokrenu mašinu na daljinu pomoću aplikacije. Najnovija LG veš mašina koristi Twin Wash sistem, koji uključuje glavni bubanj i kompaktni mini bubanj u postolju. LG navodi da je mini bubanj idealan za stvari koje zahtevaju posebnu negu i može se kombinovati sa bilo kojom LG mašinom za prednje punjenje. Twin Wash sistem predstavljen je na LG konferenciji za štampu tokom CES sajma u Las Vegasu. Mini bubanj, koji LG opisuje kao prvi kompaktni bubanj skriven u postolju, donosi nove opcije za pranje veša. Na primer, korisnici mogu da odvoje blatnjavu sportsku opremu od bele odeće ili da peru svileni veš i peškire zajedno na višoj temperaturi. Kada se ne koristi, mini bubanj služi kao postolje, ali može se uklopiti sa svim kompatibilnim LG mašinama za prednje punjenje. Sistem ima Wi-Fi i NFC, a uključuje LG-ovu SmartThinQ tehnologiju, što korisnicima omogućava da preko aplikacije podešavaju cikluse pranja – uključujući temperaturu i trajanje – dok su van kuće. Dodatno, mogu preuzeti unapred programirane cikluse na svoj telefon i pokrenuti ih dodirom telefona na mašinu. Smart Diagnosis funkcija pomaže korisnicima da brzo otkriju probleme i kvarove. LG je na sajmu predstavio i najnoviji frižider sa 'vrata-u-vratima', sa policama ugrađenim u dodatna spoljna vrata koja se otvaraju nezavisno od glavnog dela frižidera. LG tvrdi da ovaj dizajn sprečava do 47% izlaska hladnog vazduha svaki put kada se frižider otvara, što štedi energiju i duže čuva svežinu hrane. Model LPXS346C raspolaže sa 34 kubna metra prostora. Twin Wash mašine takođe imaju LG-ovu TurboWash tehnologiju, sa dvostrukim mlaznicama koje prskaju koncentrisan deterdžent direktno na odeću i visokopritisnom mlaznicom iznad bubnja koja tokom brze centrifuge raspršuje vodu za brže i efikasnije ispiranje. Cena i datum izlaska Twin Wash sistema i novih uređaja još nisu najavljeni. Seong-jin Jo, predsednik LG Electronics Home Appliance and Air Solution Company, izjavio je: 'Dodatak mini bubnja ispod glavnog bubnja donosi veću fleksibilnost, praktičnost i efikasnost. Ovo je još jedan iskorak u našoj posvećenosti inovativnoj tehnologiji koja poboljšava život potrošača širom sveta.' Tokom CES sajma, LG je predstavio i G Flex 2, svoju novu generaciju fleksibilnog pametnog telefona. Ovaj uređaj ima Qualcomm Snapdragon 810 64-bit octa-core procesor, 2GB RAM-a, zakrivljeni Full HD ekran od 5,5 inča sa rezolucijom 1080 x 1920 piksela i gustinom od 403 piksela po inču i pokreće ga Android Lollipop. Za G Flex 2 se tvrdi da je 30% izdržljiviji od originala. Rob Kerr, mobilni ekspert sa sajta uSwitch.com, prokomentarisao je da je zakrivljen dizajn udoban i ergonomski, ali više vizuelna zanimljivost nego presudna funkcija, dok unapređena specifikacija daje ovom telefonu pravu vrednost.

Recent football rumors claimed that Radamel Falcao was not present at Old Trafford for Manchester United’s loss to Southampton after Louis van Gaal left him out of the squad. In fact, Falcao watched the game with Marcos Rojo from a private box and was seen in the players’ tunnel after the match.

With these rumors settled, focus has turned to Falcao’s future at United. On loan from Monaco with weekly wages of £280,000, the Colombian striker has found it difficult to make a strong impact. He’s scored just three goals in eight starts, making a permanent transfer (which would cost United over £40 million) seem unlikely at present.

Manager Louis van Gaal has had lingering doubts about Falcao’s fitness, especially after the forward suffered a severe ligament injury last season. Even after returning to training following muscle problems, questions about his physical durability remain. Falcao trained ahead of United’s 1-0 defeat to Southampton but wasn’t selected for the squad.

Falcao’s statistics are modest: eight starts, three goals, and three assists so far—averaging over 200 minutes per goal. His high cost per goal draws attention compared to other Premier League forwards.

Reportedly, Falcao feels he must work especially hard to meet Van Gaal’s expectations. While he avoids public complaints, sources close to Falcao say he often puts in extra training to adapt to the English game and impress his manager. Inspired by players like Wayne Rooney, Falcao has sought to broaden his game beyond just scoring.

However, gaining confidence and momentum is difficult without consistent playing time. Friends suggest Falcao is frustrated when left out of the squad and believes he needs more regular minutes to show his best.

Van Gaal’s strict standards with underperformers are well known—he famously shifted major stars like Rivaldo at Barcelona. For Van Gaal, assists, shots on target, and overall contribution matter as much as goals, and these are areas where Falcao needs improvement.

With United looking for a dependable striker—Rooney now playing deeper and Van Persie aging—Falcao is under pressure. Unless his performances quickly improve, it appears unlikely he’ll remain at the club beyond his loan spell.

Nedavne fudbalske glasine tvrdile su da Radamel Falkao nije bio prisutan na Old Trafordu tokom poraza Mančester junajteda od Sautemptona, nakon što ga je Luj van Gal izostavio iz tima. Zapravo, Falkao je utakmicu gledao sa Markosom Rojoom iz privatne lože, a kasnije je viđen u tunelu kod igrača nakon meča.

Nakon što su ove glasine razjašnjene, pažnja se preusmerila na Falkaovu budućnost u Junajtedu. Kao pozajmljen igrač iz Monaka sa nedeljnom platom od 280.000 funti, kolumbijski napadač se teško nametnuo. Postigao je samo tri gola u osam startova, zbog čega trajni transfer (koji bi Junajted koštao preko 40 miliona funti) trenutno izgleda malo verovatno.

Menadžer Luj van Gal imao je dugotrajne sumnje u Falkaovu fizičku spremnost, posebno nakon teške povrede ligamenta prošle sezone. Čak i nakon povratka na trening posle problema sa mišićima, pitanja o njegovoj izdržljivosti su ostala. Falkao je trenirao pred poraz Junajteda od Sautemptona 1:0, ali nije bio izabran za tim.

Falkaove trenutne statistike su skromne: osam startova, tri gola i tri asistencije, u proseku preko 200 minuta po golu. Njegova visoka cena po golu dodatno privlači pažnju u poređenju sa drugim napadačima Premijer lige.

Pretpostavlja se da Falkao oseća da mora posebno naporno da radi kako bi ispunio Van Galova očekivanja. Iako se javno ne žali, izvori bliski Falkaou kažu da često ostaje na dodatnim treninzima kako bi se prilagodio engleskoj igri i impresionirao trenera. Inspirisan igračima kao što je Vejn Runi, Falkao pokušava da proširi svoju igru na više od pukog postizanja golova.

Međutim, teško je steći samopouzdanje i kontinuitet bez redovnog igranja. Prijatelji sugerišu da je Falkao frustriran kada nije među prvih 11 i veruje da su mu potrebni stalni minuti da pokaže svoj maksimum.

Van Gal je poznat po strogim standardima prema igračima koji nisu u formi — poznato je da je velike zvezde, poput Rivalda u Barseloni, postavljao na neobične pozicije. Za Van Gala su pored golova važne i asistencije, udarci u okvir gola i celokupni doprinos, a to su oblasti u kojima Falkao mora da se unapredi.

Junajted traži pouzdanog napadača — Runi sada igra povučenije, a Van Persi je u poznim igračkim godinama — pa je pritisak na Falkaoa veliki. Ako se njegov učinak brzo ne poboljša, malo je verovatno da će ostati u klubu nakon isteka pozajmice.

Jake Drage, a 23-year-old man from Geraldton, Western Australia, has been sentenced to nine months in jail after being found guilty of causing a fatal motorbike crash in West Java, Indonesia. The crash occurred on June 30 and resulted in the death of Kokom, a local woman who was riding as a passenger on her teenage daughter Mela's motorcycle. Drage, who has been in custody since the incident, was also fined Rp1 million ($93) and faced charges of reckless driving causing death.

Prosecutors had initially sought an 18-month sentence, but the court considered Drage's three months already served, so he will spend another six months in jail. While the prosecution argued that Drage was overtaking a small truck at excessive speed, Kokom's husband, Iim, expressed compassion, stating that he does not blame Drage and even views him as a son. Iim has attended all six of Drage's court appearances and values that Drage did not try to avoid responsibility.

After the accident, local relative Andika Hidayat assisted Drage due to the language barrier. Drage’s mother, Tiena, traveled from Australia and was offered support by Kokom’s family and the local community. The families have developed a supportive bond while attending the trial together.

Although Drage could have faced up to six years in jail and a fine of $1,100, the court issued a lighter sentence, reflecting the victim’s family’s forgiveness and the community’s compassionate response.

Iim je prisustvovao svim šest ročišta i ceni što Drejdž nije pokušao da izbegne odgovornost.

Nakon nesreće, lokalni rođak Andika Hidayat pomogao je Drejdžu zbog jezičke barijere. Drejdžova majka Tiena doputovala je iz Australije i dobila podršku od Kokomine porodice i lokalne zajednice. Porodice su razvile blisku vezu i zajedno prisustvuju suđenju.

Iako je Drejdž mogao da dobije do šest godina zatvora i kaznu od 1.100 dolara, sud je izrekao blažu kaznu, odražavajući oproštaj porodice žrtve i saosećanje zajednice.
