article_content: World Cup winger Max Gradel has emerged as a strong transfer target for Bournemouth as the club looks to build on an impressive first season back in the Championship. The former Leeds United player recently competed in Brazil with Didier Drogba’s Ivory Coast team, but his future at French side Saint-Etienne remains uncertain, with only a year left on his contract. Gradel featured in 23 Ligue 1 matches last season. During the World Cup, Gradel was among Ivory Coast's standout performers, despite their elimination in the group stage. Previously, he was a fan favourite at Bournemouth during a 2007 loan spell in League One, scoring nine goals. The Cherries, led by Eddie Howe, finished 10th in the Championship last season, exceeding expectations and coming close to a playoff spot. Bournemouth has already strengthened their squad by signing highly-rated Callum Wilson from Coventry City. Gradel's proven track record and prior connection to Bournemouth make him an appealing option as the club seeks to further bolster their squad.

article_content: White Dee, whose real name is Deirdre Kelly, became widely known after appearing on the Channel 4 reality show Benefits Street. She believes she could become a millionaire by next year, with plans like publishing an autobiography and making further television appearances. After her recent earnings from her growing celebrity status, the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) has reportedly frozen her £101 a week sickness benefit. The Birmingham mother-of-two is preparing for a second trip to Majorca, this time accompanied by a new boyfriend. The trip is reportedly being funded by the organizers of the Carnage Magaluf pub crawl and pool party, who also intend to cover expenses for her boyfriend. Alan Collinson, representing Carnage, remarked that people on benefits should be able to go on holiday, especially if it’s free. There are also rumours that Kelly might appear on Celebrity Big Brother. Her agent, Barry Tomes, told The Daily Star she could become a millionaire if she copes well with her depression. He estimated that she might earn about £100,000 by Christmas and potentially up to £500,000 by 2015, and possibly reach a million pounds if she stays well. Tomes added that Kelly’s benefits had possibly been paused because her media-related income rose, but they could resume if her earnings fall again. He declined to confirm whether her benefits had been permanently cut, and criticised the DWP’s handling of her changing circumstances, threatening legal action if her personal information was made public. Previously, Kelly received £214 a week from a combination of Employment and Support Allowance, Child Tax Credit, and Child Benefit, plus £500 a month in Housing Benefit—amounting to the take-home pay of someone earning £20,000 a year. She was recently photographed in Magaluf, where she enjoyed a holiday, which led to some public criticism. Kelly’s last full-time job was working for Birmingham council, from which she was dismissed in 2007 for stealing £13,000. Since her television appearance, she has received offers for at least six new TV programs—including a cookery show in France—and has worked abroad and as a DJ at Birmingham nightclubs. Other Benefits Street cast members have had less success. 'Smoggy,' who was well regarded for selling household goods for 50p each, recently missed out on a business deal after reportedly requesting a £50,000 fee for participation. Charlie Mullins, founder of Pimlico Plumbers, who was interested in supporting Smoggy's venture, expressed disappointment over the deal falling through.

Veruje da bi do sledeće godine mogla da postane milionerka, sa planovima kao što su objavljivanje autobiografije i nastupi na televiziji. Nakon što je počela da zarađuje na osnovu svog statusa poznate ličnosti, Ministarstvo za rad i penzije (DWP) navodno je zamrzlo njenu nedeljnu pomoć od £101. Majka dvoje dece iz Birmingema planira drugo putovanje na Majorku, ovog puta sa novim dečkom. Putovanje navodno finansiraju organizatori Carnage Magaluf pub crawla i pool partyja, koji takođe planiraju da plate troškove za njenog dečka. Alan Collinson, ispred Carnage-a, izjavio je da ljudi na socijalnoj pomoći treba da mogu da idu na odmor, posebno ako je besplatan. Takođe se priča da bi Kelly mogla da učestvuje u emisiji Celebrity Big Brother. Njen agent, Barry Tomes, rekao je za Daily Star da bi mogla da postane milionerka ako se uspešno nosi sa depresijom. Procijenio je da bi do Božića mogla da zaradi oko £100,000, a do 2015. potencijalno i do £500,000, pa čak i milion ako ostane dobro. On nije želeo da potvrdi da li je pomoć trajno ukinuta i kritikovao je kako je DWP postupio u njenom slučaju, preteći pravnim koracima ako se njeni lični podaci objave. article_content: Tim Sherwood is considering an offer to become the new Queens Park Rangers (QPR) manager following Harry Redknapp’s resignation earlier this week. Sherwood, who previously worked under Redknapp at Tottenham Hotspur, is concerned that accepting the role could strain his friendship with Redknapp. Redknapp stepped down citing the need for two knee operations, after QPR failed to secure any points in their 11 away matches this Premier League season—a record for the competition. The club’s home form has been more encouraging, but QPR have yet to score in the first 15 minutes of any league match and have conceded more shots on target than any other team. Les Ferdinand, newly promoted to QPR’s director of football, has recommended Sherwood for the manager’s role. However, since Sherwood is still under contract with Tottenham until May, financial negotiations between QPR and Tottenham chairman Daniel Levy are anticipated. QPR chairman Tony Fernandes has stressed his commitment to a long-term strategy focused on developing youth players and building a sustainable club philosophy, acknowledging past errors in transfer policy. In the interim, Chris Ramsey and Kevin Bond are in temporary charge as the club prepares for their next fixture against Southampton.

Les Ferdinand, koji je nedavno postavljen za sportskog direktora QPR-a, preporučio je Šervuda za ulogu trenera. Ipak, s obzirom da je Šervud i dalje pod ugovorom sa Totenhemom do maja, očekuju se finansijski pregovori sa predsednikom Totenhema Danijelom Levijem. Predsednik QPR-a Toni Fernandes istakao je posvećenost dugoročnoj strategiji razvoja mladih igrača i izgradnji održive klupske filozofije, uz priznanje ranijih grešaka u transfer politici. article_content: Atlanta police have launched a search for a heavily pregnant woman suspected in four armed robberies across the city. The unidentified woman was seen wearing a floor-length, bright pink shawl or cape during each incident. According to police, she entered a Walgreens, threatened the cashier by claiming she had a gun, and demanded money. She fled with $200 in a gold Nissan Maxima, as reported by the Atlanta Journal-Constitution. Two weeks later, a similar robbery took place at a nearby CVS, where a worker reported the same woman. She allegedly instructed the clerk to stay calm and showed a gun wrapped in muslin cloth before taking $180 in cash. Authorities are also investigating claims that the same suspect attempted to rob a hair braiding salon, where a beauty assistant reportedly managed to wrestle a .32-caliber pistol away from her. This week, the woman reportedly appeared again at a grocery store targeting a cashier while wearing the pink shawl. Police believe the suspect is connected to several similar incidents and have released her image to the public in hopes of identifying her.

article_content: Chelsea may allow Romelu Lukaku to join Tottenham Hotspur this summer, provided they sign Diego Costa from Atletico Madrid for £31.5 million. Jose Mourinho aims to overhaul Chelsea’s attack and has identified Costa as his main target. Although Lukaku, currently on loan at Everton, has performed well, Mourinho wants at least two new strikers before approving a permanent departure for the Belgian forward. Lukaku joined Chelsea from Anderlecht for £18 million in 2011, but has had limited opportunities, starting just one league game. Instead, he has enjoyed productive loans, netting 17 goals in 35 games for West Brom and 13 in 26 matches for Everton. Chelsea hopes to start bids for him at about £20 million, banking on his successful loan record. Recognizing his restricted role at Chelsea under Mourinho, Lukaku is open to a transfer. Tottenham have shown interest amid ongoing uncertainty over their managerial position. Chelsea are also considering Michy Batshuayi from Standard Liege, who shares Lukaku’s agent. Everton would prefer to secure Lukaku permanently but can only afford a deal if they qualify for the Champions League. Meanwhile, Chelsea’s frontline currently features Samuel Eto’o and Fernando Torres. Tottenham’s Roberto Soldado, signed last summer, has fallen short of expectations. The landscape for striker transfers could rapidly change if Chelsea succeed in signing Diego Costa, potentially triggering related moves across several clubs.

Charlotte Richards, a 42-year-old woman with no fixed address, has received a ten-year ban from keeping animals after authorities found that she was caring for as many as fifteen dogs in unsanitary conditions inside a cramped caravan and a garage near Huddersfield, West Yorkshire. According to the RSPCA, the environment was filthy, with strong odors and cages littered with dirt and excrement. The dogs, mostly terrier-chihuahua mixes and dachshunds, suffered from neglected hygiene, flea infestations, and dehydration; their claws had also grown excessively long due to lack of proper care.

At Kirklees Magistrates Court, Richards pleaded guilty to failing to ensure the animals' welfare and exposing them to unnecessary suffering. The court was told she was allowed by her relative, Andrew Roberts, to reside on his property because she had nowhere else to go. While the original arrangement permitted only a few dogs, the number rapidly increased to fifteen, causing Roberts to worry about their well-being. He added that Richards often left the caravan for hours, sometimes overnight, leaving most of the dogs locked inside, and because he didn't have a key, he could not check on them.

RSPCA Inspector Gemma Fowler visited the property on July 14 last year following a report of poor conditions. Due to the severity of the situation, police forced entry and the animals were removed for treatment. Richards’ defense attorney, Clive Rees, pointed out that she suffers from depression and struggles to say no to people who ask her to take in additional dogs.

Magistrate Kashmir Khangura sentenced Richards to a 12-month community order involving 30 activity sessions and imposed a ten-year disqualification from owning animals. She was also told to pay £260 towards boarding costs for the rescued animals, which will be deducted from her benefits in weekly installments.

Prema navodima RSPCA, prostor je bio prljav, sa jakim neprijatnim mirisima i kavezima punim prljavštine i izmeta. Psi, uglavnom mešanci terijera i čivava i jazavičari, patili su zbog zapuštene higijene, najezde buva i dehidracije; njihove kandže su preterano porasle zbog neadekvatne nege.

Na Sudu za prekršaje u Kirklesu, Ričards je priznala krivicu za nebrigu o dobrobiti životinja i izlaganje istih nepotrebnoj patnji. Sudu je rečeno da joj je rođak Endru Roberts dozvolio boravak na svojoj imovini jer nije imala gde da ode. Iako je prvobitni dogovor bio da povede samo nekoliko pasa, njihov broj je brzo narastao na petnaest, zbog čega se Roberts zabrinuo za njihovo stanje. Dodao je i da je Ričards često odsustvovala iz prikolice na više sati, ponekad i celu noć, ostavljajući većinu pasa zatvorenim, a da on, budući da nije imao ključ, nije mogao da proveri njihovo stanje.

Inspektorka RSPCA, Džema Fauler, posetila je imanje 14. jula prošle godine posle prijave o lošim uslovima. Sudija Kašmir Kangura osudio je Ričardsovu na jednogodišnju društvenu kaznu sa obaveznim prisustvom na 30 aktivnosti i izrekao joj desetogodišnju zabranu držanja životinja. Takođe je naloženo da plati 260 funti za troškove smeštaja spasavanih životinja, što će se odbijati sa njenih socijalnih davanja u nedeljnim ratama.

article_content: A recent Swedish study shows that adolescent boys with greater muscle strength are likely to enjoy longer lifespans than those who are physically weaker. Researchers followed over a million male Swedish teenagers, aged 16 to 19, for 24 years and found a strong connection between muscular strength and reduced risk of early death. Muscle power was tested through grip strength, leg curls, and push-ups. The results revealed that those with less strength faced higher chances of premature death and were more susceptible to mental health diagnoses. Teenagers displaying above-average strength had a 20–35% lower risk of dying early from any cause, as well as reduced risk from cardiovascular diseases and suicide. Additionally, their risk of being diagnosed with mental health conditions like schizophrenia or depression was up to 65% lower. Interestingly, higher muscle strength benefited both thin and overweight individuals, suggesting its independent importance for longevity. Among the participants, 26,145 died during the study period; accidental injuries were the most common cause, followed by suicide, cancer, heart disease, and stroke. The researchers advise that while muscle strength is beneficial, general fitness is what matters, and simply engaging in excessive muscle-building does not necessarily extend life.

article_content: Hamas and Israel have agreed to a Qatar-mediated pause in fighting—the first since October 7. Both sides have stated they are ready to resume hostilities after the pause. The deal involves Israel releasing 150 Palestinian prisoners in exchange for 50 hostages (women and children) held by Hamas in Gaza since the October 7 attacks. Under the agreement, Israel will suspend all military actions in Gaza for four days, allowing hundreds of trucks with humanitarian, medical, and fuel aid to enter the territory. The State of Qatar announced the success of its joint mediation efforts with Egypt and the United States, leading to an agreement for a humanitarian pause between Israel and Hamas. The pause, set to last four days (with possible extension), will commence within 24 hours of the announcement. The agreement specifies the release of 50 civilian women and children hostages from Gaza in exchange for a number of Palestinian women and children detained in Israeli prisons, with the number to increase during later stages. The pause will also enable more humanitarian convoys and fuel to enter Gaza. Qatar affirmed its commitment to ongoing diplomatic efforts and thanked Egypt and the US for their roles in reaching the agreement. Hamas stated that, motivated by their commitment to the Palestinian people and the sacrifices made in Gaza, they reached a four-day humanitarian truce agreement through persistent Qatari and Egyptian mediation. The agreement stipulates a pause in fighting, suspension of Israeli military actions, the release of 50 hostages in exchange for 150 Palestinian detainees under 19, cessation of airstrikes in southern Gaza for four days, and six hours daily in northern Gaza. Humanitarian aid will be allowed into all areas without exception, and freedom of movement along Salah al-Din Road will be ensured. Hamas emphasized its continued readiness to defend the Palestinian people and reaffirmed its goal of Palestinian liberation and establishing an independent state with Jerusalem as its capital. The Israeli government affirmed its commitment to returning all hostages, noting that the first stage of an agreement will see at least 50 women and children hostages released over four days, coinciding with a pause in fighting. Each additional ten hostages released would extend the pause by one day. Israel declared its determination to continue military operations until all hostages are returned, Hamas is subdued, and threats from Gaza are eliminated.
translated_content: Hamas i Izrael su pristali na prekid vatre posredstvom Katara — prvi od 7. oktobra. Oba aktera su izjavila da su spremna da nastave sukobe nakon isteka pauze. Sporazum predviđa da Izrael oslobodi 150 palestinskih zatvorenika u zamenu za 50 talaca (žena i dece) koje Hamas drži u Gazi od napada 7. oktobra. Prema dogovoru, Izrael će obustaviti sve vojne akcije u Gazi na četiri dana i dozvoliti stotinama kamiona sa humanitarnom, medicinskom pomoći i gorivom da uđu u teritoriju. Država Katar je objavila uspeh zajedničkih napora u posredovanju sa Egiptom i Sjedinjenim Državama, koji su doveli do dogovora o humanitarnoj pauzi između Izraela i Hamasa. Pauza, koja treba da traje četiri dana (uz mogućnost produžetka), počeće u roku od 24 sata od objave. Dogovorom je predviđeno oslobađanje 50 civilnih žena i dece iz pojasa Gaze u zamenu za određeni broj palestinskih žena i dece iz izraelskih zatvora, sa mogućnošću povećanja tog broja tokom narednih faza sporazuma. Pauza će omogućiti i ulazak većeg broja humanitarnih konvoja i goriva u Gazu. Katar je potvrdio svoju posvećenost diplomatskim naporima i zahvalio Egiptu i SAD-u na njihovoj ulozi u postizanju sporazuma. Hamas je izjavio da je, motivisan posvećenošću palestinskom narodu i žrtvama iz Gaze, postignut četvorodnevni humanitarni prekid vatre zahvaljujući upornom posredovanju Katara i Egipta. Sporazum predviđa prekid borbi, obustavu izraelskih vojnih akcija, oslobađanje 50 talaca u zamenu za 150 palestinskih zatvorenika mlađih od 19 godina, prestanak vazdušnih napada na jug Gaze tokom četiri dana i na severu Gaze šest sati dnevno. Humanitarna pomoć biće dozvoljena za sve oblasti bez izuzetka, kao i sloboda kretanja duž puta Salah al-Din. Hamas je naglasio svoju spremnost da i dalje brani palestinski narod i potvrdio cilj oslobođenja Palestine i osnivanja nezavisne države sa Jerusalimom kao glavnim gradom. Izraelska vlada je potvrdila posvećenost vraćanju svih talaca, navodeći da će prva faza sporazuma rezultirati oslobađanjem najmanje 50 žena i dece talaca tokom četiri dana, uz privremeni prekid borbi. Svako dodatno oslobađanje deset talaca produžava pauzu za jedan dan. Izrael je izjavio odlučnost da nastavi vojne operacije dok se svi taoci ne vrate, Hamas ne bude poražen i dok ne bude otklonjena opasnost iz Gaze.

Spain's Socialist Party, under acting Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, has successfully negotiated agreements with several smaller parties to secure enough parliamentary backing for Sánchez’s anticipated re-election, which could occur as early as next week. After placing second in the July 23 national elections with 121 out of 350 seats, the Socialists conducted extensive talks and have now assembled the support needed for a majority, totaling 179 seats—surpassing the 176 required—through fresh pacts with the Basque Nationalist Party and a coalition from the Canary Islands.

A particularly consequential—and divisive—agreement was made with a Catalan separatist group led by former Catalan president Carles Puigdemont, who is living in Belgium. The pact grants support from the separatists’ seven lawmakers in exchange for a promised amnesty law that could shield Puigdemont and many others involved in Catalonia’s unsuccessful secession attempt six years ago. While final details of the amnesty bill have not been published, it is expected to apply broadly, benefiting a spectrum of people from officials to ordinary citizens linked to the 2017 events that brought Spain to the edge of a national crisis.

The amnesty proposal has sparked strong objections from the Popular Party and far-right Vox, in addition to criticism from judicial and police associations. Recent weeks have seen mass protests in Madrid and Barcelona, with a demonstration outside the Socialist Party’s headquarters turning violent on Thursday—resulting in police intervention and arrests after some protesters threw objects. Additional rallies are planned for the coming days.

Though Sánchez had previously opposed the idea of an amnesty, he now contends that it is vital for restoring normal political life in Catalonia and promoting national unity. Supported by the leftist Sumar party and six other smaller groups, the Socialists appear ready to secure the upcoming investiture vote. However, questions remain about the coalition’s long-term stability over the next four-year parliamentary term. The Popular Party, headed by Alberto Núñez Feijóo, emerged from July’s election with the highest seat count but failed to form a government, largely due to its alliance with Vox, which alienated potential support from other parties.

Posle drugog mesta na izborima 23. jula sa 121 od ukupno 350 poslanika, socijalisti su vodili intenzivne pregovore i sada imaju potrebnu većinu od 179 poslanika—tri više od minimuma—zahvaljujući novim sporazumima sa Baskijskom nacionalističkom partijom i koalicijom sa Kanarskih ostrva.

Posebno je važan i sporan sporazum sa katalonskom separatističkom grupom koju predvodi bivši predsednik Katalonije, Carles Puigdemont, koji živi u Belgiji. Ovim dogovorom, podrška sedam poslanika separatista dolazi u zamenu za obećani zakon o amnestiji koji bi mogao obuhvatiti Puigdemonta i mnoge druge povezane sa neuspešnim pokušajem secesije Katalonije pre šest godina. Detalji ovog zakona još nisu objavljeni, ali se očekuje da će amnestija obuhvatiti širok spektar – od političara do građana koji su bili uključeni u događaje iz 2017. koji su Španiju doveli na ivicu krize.

Predlog amnestije izazvao je snažno protivljenje Narodne partije i krajnje desničarskog Voksa, kao i nezadovoljstvo pravosudnih i policijskih udruženja. U proteklim nedeljama, hiljade su protestovale u Madridu i Barseloni, a tokom jednih demonstracija ispred sedišta Socijalističke partije u četvrtak izbili su sukobi kada su neki demonstranti bacali predmete na policiju, koja je intervenisala i privela nekoliko osoba. Dodatni protesti su zakazani za naredne dane.

Iako je ranije bio protiv amnestije, Sánchez sada tvrdi da je potrebna za povratak političke normalnosti u Kataloniji i jačanje nacionalnog jedinstva. Sa podrškom levičarskog Sumara i još šest manjih stranaka, socijalisti su spremni za glasanje o poverenju, dok se i dalje postavlja pitanje stabilnosti ove široke koalicije tokom narednog četvorogodišnjeg mandata. Narodna partija, na čelu sa Albertom Núñezom Feijóoom, pobedila je na julski izborima po broju poslaničkih mesta, ali nije uspela da formira vladu, pre svega zbog bliske saradnje sa Voksom, što je odbilo potencijalne koalicione partnere.

Siemens AG has announced plans to complete the demerger of its Indian subsidiary, Siemens Ltd, by 2025, earlier than initially scheduled. To facilitate this, Siemens AG will buy an 18% stake in Siemens Ltd India from Siemens Energy for €2.1 billion.

At present, Siemens India includes the energy segment (gas and power), which, while globally separated and listed, remains part of Siemens Ltd in India. Siemens Energy currently holds a 24% stake, and Siemens AG holds 51% in the listed Indian company. Faced with global financial difficulties, Siemens Energy is selling part of its stake in Siemens Ltd India to Siemens AG. This transaction is primarily between group companies, with shares sold at a 15% discount.

Following this, Siemens plans a legal demerger that will separate the gas and power (energy) business from the rest of Siemens India, mirroring its global structure. Over the next five years, Siemens Energy aims to regain a majority stake in the separated gas and power business, but it remains unclear if this business will be independently listed on the stock exchange, as was the case with ABB and Hitachi Energy.

The demerger mainly serves to isolate the risks and liabilities of the energy business from Siemens India's other operations, which could be positive for shareholders. However, unless the separated entity is listed, there may be limited immediate value creation for minority shareholders. Clarity regarding listing or potential strategic sale should become clearer as Siemens Energy increases its stake in the coming years.

After the announcement, Siemens Ltd's share price initially rose by 4%, before settling at about 2.5%. This positive market response was largely due to the modest 15% discount on the share transfer, compared to earlier fears of a deeper discount.

There is no immediate operational impact anticipated for Siemens India at this stage. However, longer-term effects could depend on Siemens Energy’s financial condition in Germany and the outcome of any potential bailout. Investors should stay tuned for updates about the demerger and possible listing of the energy business.

article_content: Binny Bansal, billionaire and co-founder of Flipkart, is launching an AI-as-a-service startup aimed at global clients, entering the fast-growing artificial intelligence sector after his success in Indian e-commerce. Bansal has hired 15 experts so far, mainly artificial intelligence scientists, and plans to expand the team soon, according to people familiar with the matter. The startup's goal is to offer AI talent, products, and services to corporate clients, following a business model similar to Tata Consultancy Services and Infosys. The company is headquartered in Singapore, with main operations based in Bengaluru, and is currently operating in stealth mode. It expects to launch its services within a few months and also plans to expand to the US. Global companies are increasingly seeking to leverage AI, with tools like OpenAI's ChatGPT spurring demand. Bansal aims to utilize India's large, young, English-speaking workforce by training talent from smaller cities where the cost of living is lower. While specific products have not been revealed, the startup will initially target legal and e-commerce sectors, later expanding into financial services, data science, and analytics. The company expects to roll out products and start marketing in the second half of 2024. Bansal, 40, declined to comment. After selling Flipkart to Walmart in 2018 for $16 billion, Bansal moved to Singapore but continues to travel between there and Bengaluru. He invests in tech startups and serves on the boards of companies such as PhonePe. Both Bansal and Flipkart co-founder Sachin Bansal (no relation) graduated from IIT Delhi and worked at Amazon before founding Flipkart as a localized online retailer for India. This AI venture represents Bansal’s ongoing commitment to innovation in technology by developing new AI solutions and nurturing talent across India.

Kompanija ima sedište u Singapuru, glavne operacije su u Bengaluruu, i trenutno radi u 'stealth' režimu. Očekuje se lansiranje usluga za nekoliko meseci, a planira se i širenje na američko tržište. Očekuje se plasman proizvoda i početak marketinga u drugoj polovini 2024. godine. Bansal (40) odbio je da komentariše. article_content: President Barack Obama intends to nominate Jeh Johnson, the former top lawyer at the Pentagon, as the next Secretary of Homeland Security, according to sources reported by CNN. The formal nomination is expected to take place on Friday and will require confirmation by the Senate. If confirmed, Johnson will succeed Janet Napolitano, who left earlier this year to become president of California's public university system. Johnson would be the fourth person to lead the Department of Homeland Security, created following the 9/11 attacks. Johnson was appointed as General Counsel of the Defense Department in 2009, after serving on Obama's transition team. Overseeing 10,000 attorneys, both military and civilian, he was responsible for the legal review and approval of every military operation authorized by the President and Secretary of Defense. He stepped down from the Pentagon earlier this year and returned to private legal practice. Johnson would assume the role as Homeland Security Secretary shortly after President Obama called for a reassessment of the 'war on terror,' emphasizing that it should not be an endless conflict but one that concludes like all wars. The Department of Homeland Security coordinates domestic security measures in the U.S., including the FBI, Border Patrol, immigration enforcement, cybersecurity, transportation security, and disaster response. Johnson's nomination comes about three months after Napolitano announced her plan to resign in July. Other names considered for the position included New York City Police Commissioner Ray Kelly and Boston Police Commissioner Ed Davis. CNN journalists Jake Tapper and Brianna Keilar contributed to this report.

Ako bude potvrđen, Džonson će naslediti Dženet Napolitano, koja je ranije ove godine napustila funkciju da bi postala predsednica sistema javnih univerziteta Kalifornije. Džonson bi bio četvrta osoba na čelu Ministarstva za unutrašnju bezbednost, koje je osnovano posle napada 11. septembra. Ministarstvo za unutrašnju bezbednost koordinira mere domaće bezbednosti u SAD, uključujući FBI, pograničnu patrolu, sprovođenje imigracije, sajber bezbednost, bezbednost transporta i reagovanje na katastrofe. George Saliba was puzzled when his electric vehicle dealership in Ewing, New Jersey, was suddenly inundated with customers from the Bronx, all seeking Tesla's black-on-black Model Y. Other EV dealerships in the tri-state region noticed the same surge in demand. The cause was a recent rule change by New York City’s Taxi and Limousine Commission (TLC). In mid-October, the TLC made its first update in five years, allowing anyone who owns an electric vehicle to apply for a license to drive in New York for services like Uber and Lyft. This new policy is part of the city’s broader Green Rides initiative, which aims to convert the entire taxi and ride-hail fleet to electric vehicles by 2030.

The strategy is clear: by increasing the number of EVs on the road, the city hopes charging infrastructure will quickly expand to keep up. For years, New York imposed strict limits on the number of Uber and Lyft vehicles, but the new rules have lifted those restrictions for electric vehicles. While this seems like a win-win, there have been complications. Just three weeks after the new program launched, a group representing taxi and ride-hail workers petitioned a court to intervene, arguing that officials failed to follow the proper process and that the influx of drivers would reduce existing drivers’ earnings and worsen traffic congestion. In early November, a state court judge temporarily paused the new policy.

This development highlights the political complexity of realizing ambitious EV goals, especially when they could profoundly reshape city transportation. Other places, such as London and California, view electrification of highly used ride-hailing vehicles as a key opportunity for EV adoption. However, depending on lower- and middle-income ride-hail drivers—many of whom own or lease their vehicles—also presents significant challenges. The future of New York City's Green Rides program now rests with the courts.

Strategija je jasna: povećanjem broja električnih vozila na ulicama, grad očekuje ubrzani razvoj infrastrukture za punjenje. Međutim, oslanjanje na radnike iz nižih i srednjih slojeva, od kojih mnogi poseduju ili iznajmljuju svoja vozila, donosi i brojne izazove. Sud će sada odlučiti o budućnosti programa Green Rides u Njujorku.

article_content: Nigerian police are facing heavy scrutiny after allegations emerged that they detained and beat Joe Ajaero, leader of the Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC), the nation's biggest labour union. Union representatives say Ajaero suffered head injuries during a demonstration in Owerri, Imo state's capital, on Wednesday. The police deny the accusations, insisting they intervened to protect Ajaero from an angry crowd. Local media reported Ajaero was released and immediately sought medical attention for injuries to his face. Footage of the wounded union leader shared on social media led to widespread criticism of the police, including from human rights lawyer Inibehe Effiong, who condemned the treatment as 'brutal and degrading.' Effiong also warned that this could severely impact civic freedoms nationwide. The NLC and Imo state government have been locked in a long dispute over unpaid salaries, with the NLC claiming workers have gone over 20 months without payment. In a statement, the NLC and Trade Union Congress (TUC) alleged police with accompanying thugs attacked Ajaero, causing serious injuries while dragging him on the ground. NLC spokesperson Benson Upah said assaults continued after Ajaero was taken away, resulting in significant facial injuries. The police countered that Ajaero was assaulted by union members opposed to a planned blockade of critical infrastructure, and maintained that taking him into custody prevented him from being lynched. Last month, Nigeria's labour unions suspended plans for a national strike over rising living costs after President Bola Tinubu's government agreed to boost wages temporarily and halt a diesel tax. At the time, Ajaero stated that walkouts could resume if workers' concerns were not resolved within a month.

Predstavnici sindikata tvrde da je Ajaero zadobio povrede glave tokom protesta u Oweru, glavnom gradu države Imo, u sredu. Policija negira ove optužbe, tvrdeći da su intervenisali kako bi ga zaštitili od razjarene mase. Lokalni mediji preneli su da je Ajaero pušten i odmah potražio medicinsku pomoć zbog povreda na licu. Tada je Ajaero izjavio da će štrajk biti nastavljen ukoliko se problemi radnika ne reše u roku od mesec dana.

article_content: At the recent Forbes Global CEO Conference, panelists including Antoine Blondeau, Meng Ru Kuok, Rohan Narayana Murty, Eduardo Saverin, and Rich Karlgaard discussed whether Generative AI is the next evolutionary step in a 70-year journey, starting from Alan Turing’s era, or represents a transformative phase shift. Their answers may shape how companies, investors, educational systems, governments, and societies organize themselves over the next two decades. The discussion highlighted the concept of phase change — comparing how monkeys and humans both excel at perception and optimization, but differ in cognition. While monkeys adapt quickly and perceive threats, humans excel at constructing mental models of the world. Generative AI is now moving artificial intelligence from mere perception and optimization toward a form of cognition, enabling machines to develop their own models without learning exactly as humans do. This leap was described as both remarkable and unexpected. The rapid advance of this technology is forcing a reassessment of current opportunities. One anecdote compared changes in music tastes to shifts in human attention spans and needs, influenced by technology and mobile phones. This underlined how our relationship with information, and what we consider as knowledge, has fundamentally changed. Some experts argued that Generative AI simulates human cognition but does not truly possess it. Specifically, they noted that generative models modify how machines process language and influence workplace dynamics by identifying work patterns described through words. This suggests that tasks traditionally handled by consultants could, in theory, be completed by AI. Looking at the evolution of AI through chess, the panel recalled how Deep Blue defeated Garry Kasparov in the late 1990s by relying on exhaustive knowledge of historical chess strategies. In contrast, Google’s AlphaZero later learned to play chess by observing games and developing its own playing style. Generative AI represents another major acceleration of these technological trends. The panel concluded that a true 'phase change' would occur when computers are able to effectively program themselves—a milestone that may not be far off.
translated_content: Na nedavnom Forbes Global CEO konferenciji, panelisti, među kojima su Antoine Blondeau, Meng Ru Kuok, Rohan Narayana Murty, Eduardo Saverin i Rich Karlgaard, raspravljali su o tome da li generativna veštačka inteligencija (AI) predstavlja sledeći evolutivni korak u sedam decenija dugom razvoju, započetom u eri Alana Turinga, ili transformativnu prekretnicu. Njihovi odgovori mogli bi da oblikuju način na koji kompanije, investitori, obrazovni sistemi, vlade i društva funkcionišu u narednim decenijama. U diskusiji je istaknut koncept „fazne promene”—upoređujući kako majmuni i ljudi odlično opažaju i optimizuju, ali se razlikuju u kogniciji. Dok se majmuni brzo prilagođavaju i prepoznaju pretnje, ljudi su izuzetni u građenju mentalnih modela sveta. Generativna AI sada pomera granice od samog opažanja i optimizacije ka kogniciji, omogućavajući mašinama da razvijaju sopstvene modele bez učenja na isti način kao ljudi. Ovaj skok ocenjen je kao izuzetan i neočekivan. Brz razvoj ove tehnologije podstiče ponovno sagledavanje aktuelnih mogućnosti. Jedan primer povezao je promene u muzičkom ukusu sa promenama u pažnji i potrebama ljudi, pod uticajem tehnologije i mobilnih telefona. To naglašava koliko se naš odnos prema informacijama i onome što smatramo znanjem suštinski promenio. Neki stručnjaci smatraju da generativna AI simulira ljudsku kogniciju, ali je zapravo ne poseduje. Posebno su ukazali da generativni modeli menjaju način na koji mašine procesuiraju jezik i utiču na radnu dinamiku prepoznajući radne obrasce opisane rečima. To znači da bi zadatke koje tradicionalno obavljaju konsultanti, u teoriji, sada mogao da radi AI. Kroz evoluciju AI prikazanu na primeru šaha, panelisti su se prisetili kako je Deep Blue pobedio Garija Kasparova krajem devedesetih koristeći obimno znanje o istorijskim šahovskim strategijama. Nasuprot tome, Google-ov AlphaZero kasnije je učio šah posmatranjem partija i razvio sopstveni stil igre. Generativna AI predstavlja još jedno veliko ubrzanje ovih tehnoloških pravaca. Panel je zaključio da bi prava „fazna promena” nastupila kada bi računari mogli efektivno sami sebe da programiraju—prekretnica koja možda i nije tako daleko.

article_content: A 1,000-year-old Anglo-Saxon limestone relief sculpture of St Peter, which was once used as a gravestone for a cat, has been acquired by the Museum of Somerset for £150,000. The artwork was originally discovered by stonemason Johnny Beeston in a Somerset quarry; he unknowingly used it to mark his adopted cat Winkle's resting place in his garden. Its historical significance was later identified by historian Chris Brewchorne, who realized it was a rare Anglo-Saxon artifact from the 10th or 11th century. After Beeston’s death, the carving was auctioned at Sotheby's and bought by collector Stanley J. Seeger. When Seeger passed away, the museum managed to purchase the sculpture thanks to a lottery grant. Scholars suggest the relief could have come from a nearby church such as Muchelney Abbey and might have been part of its architectural decoration, possibly near the altar. The piece was originally painted, and the eyes likely featured blue glass or another material. Its exceptional preservation and detailed craftsmanship make it a rare find among Anglo-Saxon carvings, especially in Somerset and the South-West. Dr Victoria Whitworth from the University of the Highlands and Islands noted the uniquely English portrayal of St Peter, who is beardless and tonsured, with a book instead of a key. Dr Helen Gittos of the University of Kent pointed out its remarkable quality and the rarity of such works in the region. Public display of the sculpture will begin at the Museum of Somerset in Taunton Castle. The story echoes other remarkable archaeological discoveries made in British gardens, demonstrating the hidden potential of common places.

Klesar Džoni Biston pronašao ga je u kamenolomu u Somersetu i, nesvestan značaja, postavio na grob svoje usvojene mačke Vinkl u vrtu. Njegov istorijski značaj kasnije je otkrio istoričar Kris Bručorn, koji je prepoznao da je u pitanju redak anglosaksonski artefakt iz 10. ili 11. veka. Nakon Bistonove smrti, reljef je prodat na Sodebijevoj aukciji i kupio ga je kolekcionar Stenli Dž. Siger. Kada je preminuo, muzej je zahvaljujući lutrijskoj donaciji uspeo da skulpturu otkupi. Stručnjaci veruju da reljef potiče iz neke lokalne crkve, kao što je Mičelni Abei, i da je možda bio deo arhitekture, moguće uz oltar. Originalno je bio oslikan, a oči su najverovatnije bile ukrašene plavim staklom ili sličnim materijalom. Izuzetna očuvanost i detaljna izrada izdvajaju ga među anglosaksonskim skulpturama, pogotovo u Somersetu i jugozapadnoj Engleskoj. Doktorka Viktorija Vitvort sa Univerziteta Hajlands i Ostrva ističe autentično engleski prikaz Svetog Petra — bez brade i sa tonzurom, sa knjigom umesto ključa. Dr Helena Gitos sa Univerziteta u Kentu posebno naglašava retkost i vrhunski kvalitet ovog umetničkog dela. Ova skulptura biće izložena u Muzeju Somerseta u zamku Taunton od subote. Priča je još jedan podsetnik na to kakva čudesna arheološka otkrića mogu da isplivaju iz običnih britanskih vrtova.

article_content:
A Hong Kong court on Friday (Nov 3) sentenced 23-year-old student Mika Yuen to two months in prison for sedition after she published pro-independence social media posts while studying in Japan. This marks the first known conviction of a Hong Konger under the colonial-era sedition law for online speech made outside Hong Kong. Scholars and overseas activists consider this case to be a significant escalation in the suppression of individuals involved with Hong Kong affairs.

Chief Magistrate Victor So explained the two-month sentence was intended as a deterrent, stating that 'ignorant people would be incited subtly.' Yuen pleaded guilty in late October to 13 social media posts made on Facebook and Instagram between September 2018 and March 2023, supporting Hong Kong independence. Most of the posts were published while Yuen was in Japan, including statements such as, 'I am a Hongkonger; I advocate for Hong Kong independence,' and 'Hong Kong independence, the only way out.' Of the 13 posts, only two were made in Hong Kong.

Yuen was arrested in March after returning to Hong Kong to renew her identity card. During the trial, the defense had initially questioned the court's jurisdiction over posts made abroad but abandoned the challenge, as the content remained online.

Ovo je prva poznata presuda građanki Hongkonga po kolonijalnom zakonu o pobuni za onlajn govor izvan Hongkonga. Stručnjaci i aktivisti iz inostranstva smatraju ovaj slučaj značajnim pojačanjem pritiska na one koji se bave pitanjima Hongkonga.

Od tih 13 objava, samo dve su napisane dok je bila u Hongkongu.

article_content: After its opening in New York City, the National September 11 Memorial Museum removed a commemorative cheese platter from its gift shop due to criticism from families of 9/11 victims. The item was a ceramic platter shaped like the United States, with hearts marking the locations of the 9/11 attacks—lower Manhattan, the Pentagon, and Shanksville, Pennsylvania. Memorial Foundation President Joe Daniels informed the Wall Street Journal that the museum will seek additional input from 9/11 family members serving on the foundation's board for future merchandise decisions. Many survivors and victims' relatives were upset by the presence of a souvenir shop within such a hallowed site. The shop includes various keepsakes like mugs, keychains, apparel, jewelry, and plush toys, and helps financially support the museum’s operations. Daniels noted that many visitors want to take something home, and shop revenue contributes to sustaining the memorial. Even so, opponents argue that selling 9/11-themed souvenirs—many made internationally—is insensitive given the proximity to where many people died and where unidentified remains are held. Rosaleen Tallon, who lost her firefighter brother on 9/11, said it was difficult to accept commercial activities so close to the resting place of victims. According to the museum, proceeds from the gift shop support operational costs, executive salaries (which are privately funded), and the $63 million annual budget, which also relies on donations and visitor admission fees. The shop’s establishment included a $5 million donation from lawyers Paul Napoli and Marc Bern, known for representing Ground Zero workers. Some available merchandise includes sweatshirts with the phrase 'In Darkness We Shine Brightest,' commemorative T-shirts, Twin Towers charms, 'Survivor Tree' jewelry, tote bags, bookmarks, ornaments, water bottles, rescue dog plushies, silk scarves depicting vintage WTC scenes, FDNY and memorial caps, and themed journals.
translated_content: Nakon otvaranja u Njujorku, Nacionalni muzej memorijala 11. septembra povukao je ukrasnu keramičku dasku za sir iz svoje prodavnice suvenira zbog kritika porodica žrtava. Ova daska bila je u obliku Sjedinjenih Država, sa srcima koja označavaju lokacije napada 11. septembra—donji Menhetn, Pentagon i Šanksvil u Pensilvaniji. Predsednik fondacije memorijala Džo Danijels izjavio je za Wall Street Journal da će muzej ubuduće više uključivati članove upravnog odbora koji su porodice žrtava 11. septembra pri odabiru suvenira. Mnoge porodice i preživele povredila je prodavnica suvenira na tako svetom mestu. Prodavnica nudi različite suvenire poput šolja, priveza, odeće, nakita i plišanih igračaka, a prihod pomaže finansiranju rada muzeja. Danijels je naveo da mnogi posetioci žele da ponesu uspomenu, a prihod iz prodavnice doprinosi održavanju memorijala. Ipak, protivnici smatraju da prodaja suvenira sa temom 11. septembra—od kojih su mnogi proizvedeni u inostranstvu—nije primerena, s obzirom na blizinu mesta gde su mnogi izgubili živote i gde su smešteni posmrtni ostaci neidentifikovanih žrtava. Rozalin Talon, koja je izgubila brata vatrogasca 11. septembra, rekla je da joj je teško da prihvati komercijalne aktivnosti tako blizu mesta počinka žrtava. Iz muzeja navode da prihodi prodavnice suvenira pomažu pokrivanju operativnih troškova, plata rukovodstva (koje se finansiraju privatno) i godišnjeg budžeta od 63 miliona dolara, a uz to se oslanjaju i na donacije i ulaznice. Prodavnica je otvorena zahvaljujući donaciji od 5 miliona dolara advokata Pola Napolija i Marka Berna, poznatih po zastupanju radnika sa lokacije Ground Zero. Neka od ponuđenih roba uključuje dukseve sa natpisom 'U tami sijamo najsvetlije', majice, priveske sa Kuli bliznakinjama, nakit 'Survivor Tree', torbe, obeleživače za knjige, ukrase, flašice za vodu, plišane spasilačke pse, svilene šalove sa motivima starog WTC-a, kape FDNY i memorijalne dnevnike.

article_content: Mexican authorities have apprehended a suspected leader of the Gulf cartel, officials reported Tuesday. The individual, believed to be Mario Cardenas Guillen, was taken into custody Monday in Tamaulipas, a northern Mexican state, according to a navy spokesperson. Mario is the brother of Osiel Cardenas Guillen, the cartel’s founder and former leader, who was sentenced by a U.S. federal judge in 2010 to 25 years in prison after pleading guilty to several felonies, including drug trafficking, money laundering, and threatening federal agents. After another brother was killed during a military operation, Mario, also known by the aliases 'M1' and 'The Fat One,' became one of the leading figures in the cartel, authorities said. Previously, he had been accused of overseeing segments of the cartel’s business from within a Mexican prison on organized crime charges. Officials allege that, while incarcerated, Mario operated an auto workshop that modified vehicles with hidden compartments for transporting cocaine and marijuana to the United States. He was released in 2007. On Tuesday, Vice Adm. Jose Luis Vergara Ibarra, spokesperson for Mexico’s navy, stated that Mario Cardenas Guillen remains connected to several ongoing cocaine trafficking investigations. The Gulf cartel, headquartered in Matamoros across the border from Brownsville, Texas, is one of Mexico’s most significant drug-trafficking organizations. The cartel split into two factions after its former leader, Antonio Cardenas Guillen—'Tony the Storm'—was killed in a 2010 military operation, Vergara noted. The arrest was announced a day after President Felipe Calderon defended his strategy against the drug cartels in his final state of the union address. Since Calderon deployed federal troops to fight the cartels after taking office in December 2006, more than 47,500 people have been killed in drug-related violence, although actual figures may be higher. The government has not published updated numbers since January. Calderon emphasized that federal intervention was a necessary part of the solution, attributing the violence primarily to battles between rival cartels. Calderon, whose term ends in December, urged the incoming administration to continue the fight against organized crime.

Osoba za koju se veruje da je Mario Cardenas Guillen uhapšena je u ponedeljak u Tamaulipasu, severnoj meksičkoj saveznoj državi, prema navodima portparola mornarice. Mario je brat Osiela Cardenasa Guillen-a, osnivača i bivšeg vođe kartela, koji je 2010. godine osuđen u SAD na 25 godina zatvora pošto je priznao krivicu za nekoliko krivičnih dela, uključujući trgovinu drogom, pranje novca i pretnje federalnim agentima. Nakon što je još jedan njegov brat ubijen tokom vojne operacije, Mario, poznat i pod nadimcima 'M1' i 'Debeli', postao je jedan od vodećih ljudi kartela, navode vlasti. Pre toga, optužen je da je iz meksičkog zatvora, gde je bio zbog organizovanog kriminala, rukovodio delom kartelovih aktivnosti. Zvaničnici tvrde da je dok je bio u zatvoru Mario upravljao automehaničarskom radionicom u kojoj su automobili prepravljani sa skrivenim pregradama za krijumčarenje kokaina i marihuane u Sjedinjene Države. Pušten je iz zatvora 2007. godine. U utorak je kontraadmiral Hose Luis Vergara Ibarra, portparol meksičke mornarice, rekao da se Mario Cardenas Guillen i dalje povezuje sa nekoliko aktuelnih istraga o krijumčarenju kokaina. Zalivski kartel, sa sedištem u Matamorosu, preko puta Braunsvila u Teksasu, jedan je od najznačajnijih meksičkih narko-kartela. Kartel se podelio na dve frakcije nakon što je bivši vođa, Antonio Cardenas Guillen – 'Toni Oluja' – ubijen u vojnoj operaciji 2010. godine, naveo je Vergara. Hapšenje je objavljeno dan nakon što je predsednik Felipe Kalderon branio svoju strategiju protiv narko-kartela u svom poslednjem obraćanju naciji. Od kada je Kalderon rasporedio saveznu vojsku protiv kartela nakon dolaska na vlast u decembru 2006. godine, u nasilju povezanim s drogom ubijeno je više od 47.500 ljudi, iako stvarne brojke mogu biti i veće. Vlada nije objavljivala nove podatke od januara. Kalderon je naglasio da je savezna intervencija bila ključni deo rešenja, pripisujući nasilje uglavnom borbama među rivalskim kartelima. Kalderon, kojem mandat ističe u decembru, pozvao je novu administraciju da nastavi borbu protiv organizovanog kriminala.

article_content: A team of daring skiers donned custom-made LED light suits to film a visually spectacular nighttime ski video. The 11-minute film, called 'Afterglow,' is considered one of the most cinematically impressive ski movies ever made. Shot over several weeks in Alaska and British Columbia, Canada, 'Afterglow' features top athletes skiing down dark, snowy mountains, illuminated solely by their glowing suits. Described as a unique blend of creativity, branded content, and remarkable effort, the film pushes visual boundaries. The skiers serve as moving beacons of light across winter landscapes, overcoming notable logistical challenges. Pep Fujas appears as if he's engulfed in flames while soaring through the air in British Columbia. The film is a collaboration between Sweetgrass Productions, Philips TV, and Swedish agency Ahlstrand & Wållgren. It follows skiers Pep Fujas, Eric Hjorleifson, Daron Rahlves, and Chris Benchetler as they perform stunts in the Alaskan wilderness, leaving vibrant trails of light behind. Creating these mesmerizing shots required 14 crew members and 9,000 pounds of equipment, with filming taking place at night in temperatures as low as -15°C. Special camera gear and lighting systems were designed to endure the challenging environment. The end result is a dazzling showcase of creative vision and technical achievement. In Alaska, Chris Benchetler demonstrates his skills on a colorful mountainside, while Pep Fujas lights up an alpine forest at the Golden Alpine Holidays facility in British Columbia.

Sniman tokom nekoliko nedelja na Aljasci i u Britanskoj Kolumbiji u Kanadi, 'Afterglow' prikazuje vrhunske sportiste kako skijaju niz tamne, snežne planine, osvetljeni samo svojim svetlećim odelima. Film se opisuje kao jedinstveni spoj kreativnosti, brendiranog sadržaja i izuzetnog truda, pomerajući vizuelne granice. Skijaši su pokretni svetionici na zimskim pejzažima, savladavajući značajne logističke izazove. Pep Fujas izgleda kao da je u plamenu dok leti kroz vazduh u Britanskoj Kolumbiji. Stvaranje ovih očaravajućih scena zahtevalo je 14 članova ekipe i 4.000 kilograma opreme, a snimanje je trajalo noću na temperaturama i do -15°C. Na Aljasci, Chris Benchetler pokazuje svoje veštine na šarenoj padini, dok Pep Fujas osvetljava alpsku šumu u objektu Golden Alpine Holidays u Britanskoj Kolumbiji.

article_content: The Edo State government is strengthening its efforts to give young people key technology skills, aiming to inspire them to solve global problems using digital innovation. Governor Godwin Obaseki stated that Edo is working with investors to build tech parks where youth can meet, collaborate, and use technology to create solutions. He emphasized that tech initiatives have already stimulated Edo’s economy, and that future infrastructure projects will continue to prioritize technology according to new master plans. Obaseki also mentioned the partnership with Decagon, which has led to training about 7,000 engineers so far. In the next five years, the goal is to develop 10,000 to 15,000 tech professionals, positioning Edo as a technology leader in Nigeria. On healthcare, the governor referenced the modernization and reaccreditation of the state’s School of Nursing—claimed to be the best in the country—and the rebuilding of the School of Medical Health Technology. These projects aim to develop the necessary workforce for Edo’s healthcare sector. Obaseki highlighted the success of the Edojobs initiative, which, with partner support, has resulted in over 308,000 jobs created across the state, both directly and indirectly.

Guverner Godwin Obaseki je izjavio da država Edo sarađuje sa investitorima na izgradnji tehnoloških parkova, gde mladi mogu da se okupljaju, sarađuju i koriste tehnologiju za razvoj rešenja. Naglasio je da su tehnološke inicijative već dale značajan podsticaj ekonomiji Edosa, a budući infrastrukturni projekti će, prema novim master planovima, i dalje stavljati akcenat na tehnologiju. Obaseki je takođe pomenuo partnerstvo sa kompanijom Decagon, zahvaljujući kojem je do sada obučeno oko 7.000 inženjera. Ovi projekti imaju za cilj jačanje stručnog kadra za zdravstveni sistem Edosa. Obaseki je istakao i uspeh inicijative Edojobs, koja je uz podršku partnera doprinela otvaranju više od 308.000 radnih mesta širom države, direktno i indirektno.

article_content: Indonesia’s lead investigator revealed that the co-pilot was at the controls of AirAsia flight QZ8501 just before it crashed. The Airbus A320 disappeared from radar in bad weather on December 28, less than halfway into its two-hour journey from Surabaya to Singapore. All 162 people aboard died. According to Mardjono Siswosuwarno of the National Transport Safety Committee (NTSC), First Officer Remi Plesel was flying the plane prior to the crash, rather than Captain Iriyanto, a seasoned former military pilot. Officials said that Captain Iriyanto, 53, likely took over as the aircraft began to climb and then descend sharply. Black box flight data has provided investigators with a clear picture of the aircraft’s final moments, though few details have been publicly released. Siswosuwarno explained the co-pilot was flying, with the captain monitoring at the time. Remi Plesel, once an engineer for Total, pursued his passion for aviation by becoming a pilot and joining AirAsia. At the time of the accident, he had 2,275 hours of flight experience. His sister Renee recalled that Plesel was enthusiastic about his career and had enjoyed his Christmas before returning to work in inclement weather. Indonesian authorities have examined wreckage lifted from the Java Sea. The crash, about 40 minutes after take-off, remains unexplained. Investigators confirmed the plane was cruising stably, considered airworthy, and crew certifications were valid. Siswosuwarno noted that the aircraft’s weight and balance were within limits, and licenses and medical certificates were up-to-date. Previously, officials suggested the plane climbed rapidly from cruising altitude, then stalled before plunging into the sea. NTSC chief Tatang Kurniadi said in Jakarta that Indonesia submitted a preliminary factual report to the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) as required. The report is not yet public and contains no analysis; a full report is expected in six to seven months. Seventy bodies have been recovered, with searches ongoing for more victims. Poor weather and visibility have complicated recovery efforts, even with the fuselage located. Captain Iriyanto, a former Air Force pilot, logged over 20,000 flight hours, including 6,100 hours with AirAsia on the Airbus 320, before moving to commercial aviation.

Prema rečima Mardjona Siswosuwarna iz Nacionalnog odbora za bezbednost saobraćaja (NTSC), prvi oficir Remi Plesel upravljao je avionom pre nesreće, a ne kapetan Irijanto, iskusni bivši vojni pilot. Izveštaj još nije javan i sadrži samo činjenice; konačan izveštaj se očekuje za šest do sedam meseci. Do sada je pronađeno 70 tela, dok potraga za preostalim žrtvama još traje. Loše vreme i slaba podvodna vidljivost otežali su napore spasilačkih timova, iako je pronađen trup aviona. Kapetan Irijanto, nekadašnji pilot ratnog vazduhoplovstva, imao je više od 20.000 sati leta, od toga 6.100 sati na Airbusu 320 u AirAsia, pre nego što je prešao u komercijalnu avijaciju.

Last week, a cash shipment worth about half a billion dollars was delayed at Argentina’s main international airport due to a 72-hour cargo terminal shutdown, according to Bloomberg. The shipment, brought in by local banks — including Banco Macro SA, Banco de Galicia, and Banco Santander Rio — in collaboration with Bank of America, was intended to help banks cope with a sharp increase in dollar withdrawals ahead of Argentina’s presidential election. The cash was flown in on cargo planes, transported in batches of $1.6 million each.

With inflation reaching 138% in September, Argentinians have been withdrawing dollars from banks to shield their savings from the weakening peso, especially in advance of the October 22 election. The country’s tax authority, AFIP, ordered the temporary shutdown at the airport on October 10, following a sharp selloff in the peso and black market exchange rates exceeding 1,000 pesos per US dollar. One shipment was also held up in Miami because of these issues, Bloomberg reported.

Fortunately, the cargo restriction was lifted after just 24 hours, meaning the cash delay caused minimal disruption to the banks. Since February, Argentinians have withdrawn nearly $2 billion (€1.89 billion) in cash from banks. The persistent high demand for US dollars is likely to continue, especially as outsider presidential candidate Javier Milei — a libertarian economist who advocates for dollarizing Argentina’s economy — emerged as a surprise winner in the August primary.

Pošiljku su doneli domaće banke — uključujući Banco Macro SA, Banco de Galicia i Banco Santander Rio — u saradnji sa Bank of America, kako bi banke mogle da se izbore sa naglim porastom podizanja dolara pred predsedničke izbore u Argentini. Counting deaths in warzones is a formidable challenge—and Gaza is no exception. As fighting escalates, the situation is made even more chaotic by Israeli bombardments, ground combat, communications outages, fuel shortages, and crumbling infrastructure. These conditions make it extremely difficult to get accurate information about casualties. Palestinian officials have acknowledged 'significant difficulties' in gathering updated figures because of ongoing communication blackouts in Gaza.

In Gaza, the Hamas-run health ministry is the official source for death tolls, which it updates regularly. As of Monday evening, it reported that 11,240 people—including 4,630 children—had been killed since the 7 October Hamas attacks on Israel that triggered the current conflict. These figures are doubted by Israel, which recently revised its own death toll down from 1,400 to around 1,200. US President Joe Biden has said he has 'no confidence' in the Gaza statistics, while international organizations, such as the UN's World Health Organization, say they have no reason to doubt them.

The BBC examined how Gaza's casualty numbers are calculated. The health ministry releases daily totals on social media, including breakdowns by gender, age, and whether the victims are women, children, or elderly. While these reports do not specify causes of death, the victims are described as casualties of 'Israeli aggression.' The ministry also provides figures for the injured and the missing. According to the Palestinian Red Crescent, some bodies remain trapped under rubble. Health officials note that death figures are based on medical reports and only include those declared dead in hospitals; the tally does not distinguish between civilians and combatants. Bodies lost in blasts and those buried immediately without being found may not be included, meaning the real death toll could be higher.

This point was echoed by US officials last week. Barbara Leaf, Assistant Secretary of State for Near Eastern Affairs, told Congress that the actual toll 'could be even higher' than reported. This contrasts sharply with President Biden's earlier skepticism about the numbers, for which he provided no evidence. After Biden voiced his doubts on 25 October, the Gaza health ministry published a detailed list naming all known victims between 7 and 26 October—including over 6,000 names, with ages, sex, and ID numbers.

BBC investigators cross-referenced this list with their own reporting, confirming cases such as Dr. Midhat Mahmoud Saidam, killed on 14 October. Satellite imagery supported reports of attacks in his area, and his name was shown on a body bag. Organizations like Airwars and academics such as Professor Michael Spagat (Royal Holloway, University of London and head of Every Casualty Counts), as well as international groups like the UN and Human Rights Watch, have reviewed the data and found it mostly consistent and reliable, with only minor discrepancies such as a single duplicate entry. Airwars, for example, matched names from the health ministry list with those confirmed in bombed areas.

A particular point of contention is the death toll from the 17 October explosion at al-Ahli hospital in Gaza City. The health ministry initially said 500 were killed, later revising the number to 471. US intelligence gave a lower estimate, 'likely at the low end of the 100-to-300 range.' Israel pointed to these discrepancies as evidence that the Gaza health ministry inflates civilian casualty numbers.

Historically, assessments from previous conflicts in Gaza (such as the 2014 war) have shown that the health ministry’s death tolls align closely with independent records from Israeli human rights organization B’Tselem and the UN. For example, in 2014, the ministry reported 2,310 deaths, B’Tselem counted 2,185, the UN counted 2,251, and Israel reported 2,125 deaths. Professor Spagat describes such differences as 'fairly normal' due to the complexities of war.

There are unique complexities in documenting deaths: for instance, Israel controls the ID numbers used for newborn babies in Gaza. Israeli authorities argue that the Gaza ministry is a branch of Hamas and that its data should be viewed with caution, but they have not provided evidence of inconsistencies. Israel’s own casualty tracking has also seen revisions, with the government reducing the number of deaths in the 7 October attack after identifying some bodies as those of attackers rather than Israeli civilians. Israel has yet to release an official detailed list of civilian casualties, though the identification of Israeli soldiers killed in the conflict is publicly available.

Additional reporting by Kayleen Devlin.

Brojanje žrtava u ratnim zonama izuzetno je izazovno – Gaza nije izuzetak. Sa eskalacijom sukoba, situacija je dodatno haotična zbog izraelskog bombardovanja, borbi na terenu, prekida komunikacija, nestašice goriva i urušene infrastrukture. Ovi uslovi veoma otežavaju prikupljanje tačnih informacija o žrtvama. Palestinski zvaničnici su priznali 'značajne poteškoće' u pribavljanju ažuriranih podataka zbog prekida komunikacija u Gazi.

U Gazi je ministarstvo zdravlja pod upravom Hamasa zvanični izvor broja poginulih i redovno ažurira podatke. Do ponedeljka uveče, izveštavaju da je 11.240 ljudi – uključujući 4.630 dece – izgubilo život od napada Hamasa na Izrael 7. oktobra, koji su pokrenuli trenutni sukob. Izrael osporava ove brojke i nedavno je svoj broj žrtava smanjio sa 1.400 na oko 1.200. Predsednik SAD Džo Bajden izjavio je da 'nema poverenja' u statistiku iz Gaze, dok međunarodne organizacije, poput SZO-a i UN-a, smatraju da nema razloga za sumnju u podatke.

BBC je istraživao kako se broje žrtve u Gazi. Ministarstvo zdravlja svakodnevno objavljuje broj poginulih na društvenim mrežama, sa prikazom po polu, starosti i kategorijama žrtava – žene, deca, stariji. Ovi izveštaji ne navode uzrok smrti, a preminuli se opisuju kao žrtve 'izraelske agresije'. Ministarstvo takođe objavljuje broj povređenih i nestalih. Prema Palestinskom Crvenom polumesecu, neka tela ostaju ispod ruševina. Zdravstveni zvaničnici kažu da su u broj ušli samo oni koje su lekari proglasili mrtvim u bolnicama; brojke ne prave razliku između civila i boraca. Tela nestala u napadima ili odmah sahranjena možda nisu popisana – što znači da stvarni broj poginulih može biti i veći.

Na to su ukazale i američke vlasti prošle nedelje. Barbara Leaf, pomoćnica američkog državnog sekretara za bliskoistočna pitanja, rekla je Kongresu da bi realan broj mogao biti i veći nego što je prijavljeno. To je u oštrom kontrastu s ranijim skepticizmom predsednika Bajdena, koji za svoje tvrdnje nije dao dokaze. Posle njegovih izjava 25. oktobra, ministarstvo zdravlja Gaze objavilo je detaljan spisak svih poznatih žrtava između 7. i 26. oktobra – preko 6.000 imena sa godinama, polom i identifikacionim brojevima.

Istraživači BBC-a su proverili ovu listu poređenjem sa svojim izveštajima, potvrdivši slučajeve poput dr Midata Mahmouda Saidama, ubijenog 14. oktobra. Satelitski snimci potvrđuju napade u njegovom kraju, a njegovo ime je na vreći sa telom. Organizacije kao što su Airwars, akademici poput profesora Majkla Spagata (Royal Holloway, Univerzitet u Londonu i vođa Every Casualty Counts), kao i međunarodne grupe kao što su UN i Human Rights Watch, proveravali su podatke i ocenili ih uglavnom pouzdanim, sa manjim neslaganjima poput jednog duplikata. Airwars je, na primer, povezivao imena sa spiska ministarstva sa žrtvama iz pogođenih područja.

Sporan je broj poginulih u eksploziji u bolnici al-Ahli 17. oktobra. Ministarstvo zdravlja je prvo navelo 500 stradalih, pa smanjilo broj na 471. Američka obaveštajna procena bila je niža, 'verovatno prema donjoj granici između 100 i 300.' Izrael smatra da ovo pokazuje da ministarstvo zdravlja Gaze preuveličava broj civilnih žrtava.

Analize prethodnih sukoba (npr. 2014) pokazuju da su podaci ministarstva uglavnom u skladu sa nezavisnim izveštajima izraelske organizacije B’Tselem i UN-a. Na primer, 2014. ministarstvo je prijavilo 2.310 mrtvih, B’Tselem 2.185, UN 2.251, a Izrael 2.125. Profesor Spagat kaže da su ovakva odstupanja 'prilično normalna' zbog kompleksnosti rata.

Posebne komplikacije u vođenju evidencije nastaju, na primer, zato što Izrael kontroliše ID brojeve za novorođenčad u Gazi. Izraelske vlasti tvrde da je ministarstvo deo Hamasa i da njihove podatke treba gledati s rezervom, ali nisu dali dokaze o nepravilnostima. I izraelsko praćenje žrtava je revidirano – broj poginulih 7. oktobra smanjen je kad su neka tela identifikovana kao napadači, a ne civili. Izrael još nije objavio zvaničan detaljan spisak civilnih žrtava, dok je lista poginulih izraelskih vojnika dostupna javnosti.

article_content: Bird populations native to many regions across the world are in decline, with some species nearing extinction, according to a comprehensive new report released Thursday. The Western meadowlark has been identified as an endangered species. However, the 'State of the Birds' report notes that some bird species are thriving because of conservation programs and waterfowl management, which could serve as models elsewhere. The report, published by the Cornell Lab of Ornithology in partnership with federal agencies and other organizations, states that 'every U.S. habitat contains bird species in need of conservation.' It highlights that Hawaiian and ocean birds are particularly at risk and could face collapse without immediate intervention. Of over 800 bird species in the U.S., 67 are officially listed as endangered or threatened, while another 184 are classified as 'species of conservation concern' due to limited ranges, significant threats, or declining populations. Hawaiian birds are especially vulnerable. Although more than one-third of all American bird species are found in Hawaii, 71 species have become extinct since human arrival around 300 A.D., and 10 more have not been observed in the past 40 years, raising fears of further extinctions. Grassland and arid-land birds are experiencing the steepest declines over the past four decades, with forest birds also in decline. Interior Secretary Ken Salazar described birds as indicators of the health of the environment, water, and ecosystems, echoing Rachel Carson's warnings from 'Silent Spring.' He called for urgent action to prevent significant losses in bird populations. The report attributes these declines to various factors, mainly agriculture, climate change, urban development, energy expansion, and invasive species. Rapidly growing cities such as Las Vegas, Phoenix, and San Diego, located in arid regions, face significant threats from unplanned urban development. Invasive non-native plants also contribute to ecosystem disruption by fueling wildfires and displacing native vegetation. Birds of concern in arid lands include the elf owl, Bendire’s thrasher, LeConte’s thrasher, and gilded flicker. The California condor remains endangered. Grassland bird populations are negatively affected by intensive agriculture practices like overgrazing, frequent or poorly timed burning, and excessive mowing in public lands and parks, leaving insufficient cover for nesting and survival. Species showing significant declines in grasslands include the mountain plover, Eastern and Western meadowlark, short-eared owl, and Northern bobwhite. Although some forest bird species are doing well, approximately one-third of forest-breeding birds are in decline. Similarly, 38 percent of arctic and alpine bird species are of conservation concern. Game birds are also at risk; 47 percent of 19 resident species are species of conservation concern, and two are federally endangered. The report identifies Farm Bill programs that retire heavily farmed land as a promising approach for long-term management. Coastal and oceanic bird populations are harmed by overfishing, pollution, and climate change. Despite these challenges, the report offers reasons for hope. The reintroduction of the California condor has led to population growth, and several urban bird species — including American robins, hummingbirds, sparrows, and woodpeckers — have shown steady increases over the past four decades. The adaptability of many native birds to urban environments demonstrates the value of these habitats for bird survival. Wetland bird populations remain below historical levels, but conservation measures and favorable policies since the late 1970s have resulted in increases for many wetland species, including hunted waterfowl. Kenneth Rosenberg of the Cornell Lab of Ornithology emphasized the success of investments in wetland conservation and called for similar commitments in other habitats facing rapid bird declines. The report stresses that immediate action, especially to address habitat loss, can help reverse negative trends. Recommended strategies include increased population monitoring, stricter protection laws, more incentives for conservation, sustainable fishing, and broad educational outreach. Greg Butcher, conservation director for the National Audubon Society, highlighted the essential role of citizen science in monitoring and addressing threats to birds, stating that real progress is only possible with active public involvement in habitat restoration and protection.
translated_content: Populacije ptica koje su autohtone za mnoga područja sveta opadaju, a neke vrste su na ivici istrebljenja, prema sveobuhvatnom novom izveštaju objavljenom u četvrtak. Zapadni livadski ševa je identifikovana kao ugrožena vrsta. Ipak, izveštaj „Stanje ptica“ navodi da su neke vrste ptica u procvatu zahvaljujući programima zaštite i upravljanja vodoplavnim područjima, koji bi mogli poslužiti i kao modeli na drugim mestima. Izveštaj, koji je objavila laboratorija za ornitologiju na Kornel univerzitetu u saradnji sa državnim agencijama i drugim organizacijama, ističe da „svako stanište u SAD ima ptice kojima je potrebna zaštita“. Posebno su ugrožene havajske i okeanske ptice koje se mogu suočiti s kolapsom ako se odmah ne preduzmu mere. Od preko 800 vrsta ptica u SAD, 67 je zvanično na spisku ugroženih ili zaštićenih, dok se još 184 vrste smatraju 'vrstama od konzervacijskog značaja' zbog ograničenog rasprostranjenja, ozbiljnih pretnji ili opadajuće populacije. Havajske ptice su naročito ranjive. Iako se više od trećine svih američkih ptica nalazi na Havajima, 71 vrsta je izumrla od dolaska ljudi oko 300. godine nove ere, a 10 vrsta nije viđeno poslednjih 40 godina, što izaziva strah od daljeg izumiranja. Ptice travnjaka i sušnih područja doživljavaju najbrži pad poslednje četiri decenije, a ni šumske vrste ne zaostaju. Sekretar unutrašnjih poslova Ken Salazar opisao je ptice kao pokazatelje zdravlja životne sredine, vode i ekosistema, podsećajući na upozorenja Rejčel Karson iz knjige „Tiho proleće“. On je pozvao na hitnu akciju kako bi se sprečili ozbiljni gubici populacije ptica. Izveštaj ove padove pripisuje raznim faktorima, uglavnom poljoprivredi, klimatskim promenama, urbanizaciji, širenju energetskog sektora i invazivnim vrstama. Brzo rastući gradovi poput Las Vegasa, Feniksa i San Dijega, koji se nalaze u sušnim regijama, suočavaju se sa značajnim pretnjama zbog neplanske urbanizacije. Invazivne biljke iz drugih područja takođe doprinose narušavanju ekosistema podsticanjem požara i izbacivanjem autohtonog rastinja. Ptice pod pretnjom u sušnim područjima uključuju patuljastu sovu, Bendireovog i LeConteovog drozda i zlatnu žunu. Kalifornijski kondor i dalje ostaje ugrožena vrsta. Populacije ptica travnjaka negativno su pogođene intenzivnim poljoprivrednim praksama kao što su prekomerna ispaša, često ili nepravilno paljenje trave i previše redovno košenje javnih površina i parkova, što ne ostavlja dovoljno skloništa za gnežđenje i opstanak. Vrste koje beleže značajan pad u travnatim staništima su planinski plover, istočni i zapadni livadski ševa, kratkouha sova i severni bobvajt. Iako su neke šumske vrste ptica u dobrom stanju, otprilike trećina ptica koje se gnezde u šumama beleži pad broja. Slično, 38 odsto arktičkih i alpskih vrsta ptica se smatra konzervacijskim prioritetom. I lovne ptice su u riziku; 47 odsto od 19 domaćih vrsta su vrste od konzervacijskog značaja, a dve su zvanično ugrožene. Izveštaj ističe programe iz Farm Bill-a koji povlače zemljište iz intenzivne poljoprivrede kao obećavajući pristup za dugoročnu upravu. Populacije ptica na obalama i u okeanima ugrožava prelov, zagađenje i klimatske promene. Uprkos tim izazovima, izveštaj daje razloge za nadu. Ponovno uvođenje kalifornijskog kondora dovelo je do rasta populacije, a nekoliko urbanih vrsta — uključujući američkog drozda, kolibrija, vrapca i detlića — pokazuje stalni rast tokom poslednje četiri decenije. Prilagodljivost mnogih autohtonih ptica na gradska staništa pokazuje vrednost ovih prostora za njihov opstanak. Populacije močvarnih ptica su i dalje ispod istorijskih nivoa, ali su mere zaštite i povoljne politike od kasnih 1970-ih rezultirale porastom brojnosti za mnoge vrste močvarnih ptica, uključujući i lovne vrste vodoplavnih ptica. Kenet Rozenberg iz Kornelove laboratorije za ornitologiju naglasio je uspeh ulaganja u zaštitu močvara i pozvao na slične napore u drugim staništima gde su ptice u naglom opadanju. Izveštaj naglašava da hitna akcija, posebno u oblasti gubitka staništa, može pomoći u preokretanju negativnih trendova. Preporučene strategije uključuju pojačano praćenje populacija, strože zakone o zaštiti, više podsticaja za očuvanje, održive ribolovne prakse i širu edukaciju. Greg Bučer, direktor za zaštitu u Nacionalnom ornitološkom društvu Audubon, istakao je ključnu ulogu građanske nauke u praćenju i rešavanju pretnji za ptice, navodeći da su stvarni napredak i zaštita mogući samo uz aktivno učešće javnosti u obnovi i zaštiti staništa.
