article_content: Germany’s President Joachim Gauck has proposed that English should become the common language of Europe, referring to it as the 'lingua franca' of the continent. Speaking in Berlin, Gauck highlighted the importance of effective communication in fostering European integration and urged Britain not to leave the European Union. Gauck recognized that young Europeans are increasingly communicating in English, but insisted that diversity of languages must also be protected. He stated, 'More Europe means multilingualism,' adding that Europe's native languages and English can thrive together. Referring to British Prime Minister David Cameron's proposal for an EU membership referendum, Gauck addressed citizens of England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, and new British citizens: 'We would like to keep you! We need your experience as a country with the oldest parliamentary democracy—your traditions, your moderation, your courage. You helped to save Europe during World War II; it is your Europe, too. More Europe should not mean Europe without you.' Gauck, in his primarily ceremonial role, acknowledged that the European Union has a structural flaw leading to imbalances, which have so far only been managed with emergency measures like the European Stability Mechanism and the fiscal compact. He noted that much of what people hear about the EU lately relates to the eurozone crisis, leading to a broader crisis of confidence in Europe as a political project. 'This is not only a struggle for our currency—it's also an internal struggle for our future direction.' Addressing a mainly youthful audience, Gauck recalled the achievements of the EU, especially its success in maintaining peace in Europe since its beginnings as a post-war trading bloc. He reflected on Germany's past and thanked the Allies for supporting and reintegrating Germany after World War II. The president stressed that, despite Germany's economic strength, the country does not seek to dominate Europe. Citing his background as a pastor and activist from East Germany, Gauck emphasized how much Germany owes to Europe and the western Allies for their support after the devastation of WWII.
translated_content: Predsednik Nemačke Joahim Gauk predložio je da engleski postane zajednički jezik Evrope, nazivajući ga „lingua franca“ kontinenta. Govoreći u Berlinu, Gauk je naglasio važnost efikasne komunikacije za jaču evropsku integraciju i apelovao na Veliku Britaniju da ne napušta Evropsku uniju. Gauk je priznao da mladi Evropljani sve više komuniciraju na engleskom jeziku, ali je istakao da se mora sačuvati jezička raznolikost. Rekao je: „Više Evrope znači višejezičnost“, dodajući da maternji jezici i engleski mogu zajedno napredovati u Evropi. Pozivajući se na predlog britanskog premijera Dejvida Kamerona o referendumu o članstvu u EU, Gauk se obratio građanima Engleske, Škotske, Velsa, Severne Irske i novim britanskim građanima: „Želimo da ostanete! Potrebno nam je vaše iskustvo kao zemlje sa najstarijom parlamentarnom demokratijom—vaše tradicije, umerenost i hrabrost. Pomogli ste da spasite Evropu tokom Drugog svetskog rata; to je i vaša Evropa. Više Evrope ne treba da znači Evropa bez vas.“ Gauk, čija je predsednička uloga uglavnom ceremonijalna, priznao je da Evropska unija ima strukturnu manu koja dovodi do neravnoteže, a koja je do sada rešavana samo hitnim merama poput Evropskog stabilizacionog mehanizma i fiskalnog pakta. Napomenuo je da većina onoga što ljudi u poslednje vreme čuju o EU ima veze sa krizom evrozone, što je dovelo do šire krize poverenja u Evropu kao politički projekat. „Ovo nije samo borba za našu valutu—ovo je i unutrašnja borba za naš budući put.“ Obraćajući se uglavnom mlađoj publici, Gauk je podsetio na uspehe EU, posebno na očuvanje mira u Evropi od osnivanja kao posleratnog trgovinskog bloka. Prisjetio se nemačke prošlosti i zahvalio saveznicima što su podržali i ponovo prihvatili Nemačku nakon Drugog svetskog rata. Predsednik je naglasio da, uprkos ekonomskoj moći Nemačke, zemlja ne želi da dominira Evropom. Pozivajući se na svoje iskustvo pastora i aktiviste iz istočne Nemačke, Gauk je istakao koliko Nemačka duguje Evropi i zapadnim saveznicima za pomoć posle razaranja Drugog svetskog rata.

article_content: During an intense snowstorm in Churchill, Canada, wildlife photographer Jules Cox captured a heartwarming scene: an arctic fox curled up tightly, using its thick tail for warmth and finding shelter behind a rock against fierce winds. The adult male fox instinctively reduced his exposure to the elements, blending in with the snowy landscape. Cox, from Bermondsey in London, called witnessing these elusive animals in their natural habitat one of his most memorable experiences. He and several friends spent ten days exploring the tundra, renting a jeep in hopes of seeing the rare creatures. Spotting the fox was no easy feat—as snow flew and visibility dropped, the group managed to find more than twenty arctic foxes during their trip. This unusual abundance was due to a spike in lemming populations, providing the foxes with plenty of food and resulting in a strong breeding season. Although arctic foxes are often timid and rare to see, this trip offered remarkably close encounters. Sometimes, the animals came within meters of the group and even ran nearby, providing excellent photo opportunities. Well-adapted for the extreme cold, arctic foxes (also known as polar or snow foxes) have thick fur and extra body fat, helping them survive in harsh climates. As the seasons change, they shed their white winter coats for brown fur in the spring, aiding in both evasion from predators and stealth when hunting prey.

Odrasli mužjak instinktivno je smanjio izloženost hladnoći, stapajući se sa snežnim pejzažom. Koks, iz Bermondzija u Londonu, opisao je susret sa ovim neuhvatljivim životinjama u prirodi kao jedno od svojih najposebnijih iskustava. Ova neuobičajena brojnost posledica je rasta populacije lemmiinga, što je lisicama obezbedilo dosta hrane i dobru sezonu parenja. Iako su arktičke lisice obično stidljive i teško ih je videti, ova ekspedicija omogućila je izuzetno bliska susretanja. Nekad su životinje prišle na svega nekoliko metara i trčale pored grupe, pružajući odlične prilike za fotografisanje. Izvanredno prilagođene ekstremnoj hladnoći, arktičke lisice (poznate i kao polarne ili snežne lisice) imaju gust krzneni sloj i veći procenat telesnih masti, što im pomaže da opstanu u surovim uslovima. Kada dođe proleće, zamenjuju belu zimsku dlaku smeđom, čime se lakše sakrivaju od predatora i neprimetno prilaze plenu.

article_content: An eight-month-old child has died after her family's SUV broke through thin ice on Lake Minnetonka in Minnesota last Friday. According to the Star Tribune, Tabitha Markle was pronounced dead early Monday morning following the accident, which took place near the Halstead Bay Bridge in Minnetrista around 5 p.m. She had been strapped into her car seat when the SUV, driven by her father Jonathan Markle, 41, fell through the ice. The vehicle's lights could be seen under the ice after it went through at a spot known for thin ice, especially above a channel, according to local reports. Tabitha's mother, Amanda Markle, 31, a speech clinician at Richfield STEM school, and her two-year-old sister Isabelle managed to escape the submerged vehicle with help and were brought to shore. Jonathan Markle made multiple attempts to rescue his youngest daughter by diving into the freezing water before being pulled out himself. A retired volunteer firefighter who lives nearby also tried to assist, but the baby could not be freed immediately. Firefighters were able to cut Tabitha from her car seat about 15 minutes after the vehicle went under, but she could not be saved. Mound firefighter Paul Jolicoeur described the rescue as a long struggle, saying, 'It felt like we were fighting it for hours, just finally getting her out of there.' Authorities have reiterated that driving over channels on Lake Minnetonka remains very dangerous despite cold weather, and the local sheriff’s office reported that seven vehicles fell through thin ice on the lake over the same weekend. The Hennepin County Sheriff's Office and Orono Police Department are investigating the incident, and the SUV's driver, Jonathan Markle, underwent blood alcohol testing, as the family was returning from a restaurant prior to the accident. Jonathan, Amanda, and Isabelle were all treated for hypothermia and have since been released from the hospital. The Hennepin County Medical Examiner confirmed Tabitha's death as an accidental drowning. Although Tabitha is the first fatality this season attributed to thin ice in the area, several other vehicles suffered similar accidents that weekend. The Sheriff's Office emphasized that channels remain hazardous and advised the public to avoid them.

Bila je vezana u auto-sedištu kada je automobil, kojim je upravljao njen otac Džonatan Markle (41), upao kroz led. Svetla vozila mogla su se videti pod ledom nakon incidenta na mestu poznatom po slabom ledu, naročito iznad kanala, prema lokalnim izveštajima. Tabithina majka, Amanda Markle (31), logoped u školi Richfield STEM, i njena dvogodišnja sestra Izabel, uspele su da pobegnu iz potopljenog vozila uz pomoć i izvučene su na obalu. Džonatan Markle je više puta pokušavao da spasi mlađu ćerku zaronom u ledenu vodu pre nego što je i on izvučen. Penzionisani dobrovoljni vatrogasac iz komšiluka takođe je pokušao da pomogne, ali beba nije mogla odmah da se oslobodi. Vatrogasci su uspeli da izvuku Tabithu iz auto-sedišta oko 15 minuta nakon što je vozilo potonulo, ali nije mogla biti spasena. Vatrogasac iz Mounda, Pol Žolikoer, opisao je spasavanje kao dugotrajnu borbu: 'Delovalo nam je kao da smo se satima borili, tek smo je na kraju uspeli izvući.' Vlasti su ponovo upozorile da je vožnja iznad kanala na jezeru Minnetonka veoma opasna, uprkos hladnom vremenu, a lokalna kancelarija šerifa saopštila je da je sedam vozila tog vikenda propalo kroz led. Šerifska kancelarija okruga Hennepin i Policijska uprava Orono istražuju ovaj incident, a vozač SUV-a, Džonatan Markle, testiran je na alkohol jer se porodica vraćala iz restorana pre nesreće. Džonatan, Amanda i Izabel su lečeni od hipotermije i otpušteni iz bolnice. Sudski patolog okruga Hennepin potvrdio je da se Tabitha udavila slučajnim utapanjem. Iako je Tabitha prva žrtva tankog leda ove sezone u tom području, nekoliko drugih vozila je takođe upalo kroz led tog vikenda. Kancelarija šerifa naglašava da su kanali posebno rizični i građanima savetuje da ih izbegavaju.

article_content: The global economic crisis has driven a surge in world hunger, leaving more than one billion people undernourished, according to a new report from United Nations agencies. The report states that efforts to stabilize financial markets have led to reduced investment in agriculture and food distribution. "It is unacceptable in the 21st century that nearly one in six people globally are going hungry," said Josette Sheeran, executive director of the World Food Programme. "At a time when we are seeing record numbers of hungry people, food aid is at its lowest in recent memory." The report, released by the World Food Programme (WFP) and the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) on Wednesday, comes ahead of World Food Day on Friday. Most of the world's undernourished live in developing countries, the report notes. An estimated 642 million people in Asia and the Pacific are affected by chronic hunger, with another 265 million in sub-Saharan Africa. Latin America, the Caribbean, the Near East, and North Africa account for 95 million, while 15 million live in developed countries. The number of people going hungry increased as the global economic crisis unfolded and governments prioritized stabilizing financial markets, resulting in decreased agricultural and food sector investments. "World leaders took swift and decisive action to address the financial and economic crisis, mobilizing billions of dollars in a short period. The same determination is now needed to combat hunger and poverty," said Jacques Diouf, FAO director-general. "The rising number of hungry people cannot be tolerated." The report urges greater investment in agriculture to address both immediate and long-term hunger by supporting farmers and building resilience to future crises. "We know what needs to be done to address urgent hunger – we just need sufficient resources and consistent international commitment," Sheeran added.

Izveštaj navodi da su napori na stabilizaciji finansijskih tržišta doveli do smanjenih ulaganja u poljoprivredu i distribuciju hrane. "Neprihvatljivo je da u 21. veku skoro svaki šesti čovek na svetu gladuje," izjavila je Josette Sheeran, izvršna direktorka Svetskog programa za hranu. "U trenutku kada ima najviše gladnih ljudi do sada, humanitarna pomoć u hrani je na najnižem nivou u novijoj istoriji." Izveštaj, koji su zajednički objavili Svetski program za hranu (WFP) i Organizacija za hranu i poljoprivredu (FAO) u sredu, izlazi pred Svetski dan hrane u petak. Većina neuhranjenih ljudi živi u zemljama u razvoju, navodi se u izveštaju. Procene pokazuju da 642 miliona ljudi u Aziji i Pacifiku pati od hronične gladi, dok ih je još 265 miliona u podsaharskoj Africi. Latinska Amerika, Karibi, Bliski istok i Severna Afrika broje 95 miliona, dok u razvijenim zemljama živi 15 miliona. Broj ljudi koji gladuju porastao je kako se globalna ekonomska kriza razvijala, a vlade su davale prioritet stabilizaciji finansijskih tržišta, što je dovelo do smanjenih ulaganja u poljoprivredni sektor i sektor isporuke hrane. "Svetski lideri su brzo i odlučno reagovali na finansijsku i ekonomsku krizu, mobilizujući milijarde dolara u kratkom roku. Sada je potrebna ista odlučnost u borbi protiv gladi i siromaštva," rekao je Jacques Diouf, generalni direktor FAO. "Rastući broj gladnih ljudi je neprihvatljiv." Izveštaj poziva na veća ulaganja u poljoprivredu kako bi se rešila i trenutna i dugoročna glad, podržao rad poljoprivrednika i povećala otpornost na buduće krize. "Znamo šta treba da radimo da bismo odgovorili na hitne potrebe gladi – potrebno nam je samo dovoljno resursa i dosledna međunarodna posvećenost," dodala je Sheeran.

A recent study has found that Granny Smith apples contain high levels of compounds that promote healthy gut bacteria, helping individuals feel fuller for longer and potentially aiding in weight management. The research, published in Food Chemistry, highlights that the non-digestible fibres and polyphenols in Granny Smith apples are not broken down by stomach acid. Instead, when these compounds reach the colon, they are fermented by gut bacteria, supporting the growth of beneficial microbes.

Scientists at Washington State University tested several varieties of apples on mice— including both obese and lean groups— to see which would best promote friendly gut bacteria. The findings showed that Granny Smith apples were more effective than other popular varieties such as Golden Delicious, Gala, and Braeburn. The variety’s high fibre content and unique mix of polyphenols appeared to have the most pronounced effect in their experiments with mice.

After feeding the mice different apple types, researchers analyzed their droppings and observed that obese mice fed Granny Smith apples developed a gut bacteria balance more similar to that of lean mice. Disruptions in gut bacteria have been linked to metabolic issues and increased hunger, suggesting that Granny Smith apples might help address obesity-related problems, including low-grade inflammation. However, these results are based on animal studies, and further research would be needed to confirm effects in humans.

Professor Giuliana Noratto, who led the research at Washington State University, stated that while many apple varieties contain beneficial compounds, there are important differences between them. The findings suggest that choosing varieties like Granny Smith could help manage obesity by positively influencing gut bacteria. The study points to a potential direction for future treatments targeting obesity and related disorders.

Istraživanje objavljeno u časopisu Food Chemistry ističe da se neprobavljiva vlakna i polifenoli iz Granny Smith jabuka ne razgrađuju u želucu. Umesto toga, kada stignu do debelog creva, fermentišu ih bakterije, čime se pospešuje rast korisnih mikroorganizama.

Naučnici sa Državnog univerziteta Vašington testirali su nekoliko sorti jabuka na miševima — uključujući i gojazne i mršave — kako bi utvrdili koja sorta najviše potpomaže korisne crevne bakterije. Rezultati su pokazali da su Granny Smith jabuke efikasnije od drugih popularnih sorti poput Golden Delicious, Gala i Braeburn. Visoka količina vlakana i specifična kombinacija polifenola dali su najizraženije efekte tokom eksperimenata na miševima.

Nakon hranjenja miševa različitim vrstama jabuka, istraživači su analizirali njihov izmet i primetili da su gojazni miševi hranjeni Granny Smith jabukama razvili crevnu floru sličniju onoj kod mršavih miševa. article_content: Emily Warner, a two-year-old from Royston, Hertfordshire, lost her life after accidentally getting entangled in a window blind cord in her bedroom. Her father, Jamie Warner, found her unconscious, and despite medical efforts, Emily sustained severe brain damage and later died due to complications. The tragic accident happened on August 27, after Emily climbed onto her bed and reached the window. Moments later, her father discovered the accident and called for help, but Emily never fully recovered from her injuries. The Warner family—parents Jamie and Tracey, and their son James—were devastated. They described Emily as full of light, emphasizing that her death was a tragic accident nobody could have anticipated. In a similar case, two-year-old Arthur Winfield from Markyate, Hertfordshire, died after getting caught in a blind cord in his room. His family, like the Warners, was shocked and grief-stricken. Both families have since launched a campaign to raise awareness about the dangers of window blind cords. They are supporting the 'Make It Safe' initiative by the Royal Society for the Prevention of Accidents and the British Blind and Shutter Association, advocating for safer blinds with features like chain-break connectors. At least 19 children in the UK have died in similar accidents since 1999. Following Emily’s accident, the Warners replaced all their blinds with net curtains. An inquest found Emily’s death to be accidental, and the coroner commended the Warners for turning their loss into advocacy. The families are urging other parents to ensure the safety of blinds in their homes to prevent future tragedies.

article_content: More than 200 defendants in one of Italy's largest mafia trials in generations have been sentenced to a combined total of over 2,200 years in prison. The three-year trial involved individuals allegedly linked to the 'Ndrangheta and saw convictions for crimes ranging from extortion to drug trafficking. Those sentenced included a former Italian senator, although all verdicts are subject to appeal. The 'Ndrangheta is considered one of Europe's most powerful criminal organizations. The case demonstrated the group's far-reaching impact on politics and society in southern Italy. Experts noted that the convictions of white-collar workers, including local officials, businesspeople, and politicians, highlighted organized crime's deep penetration into Italian institutions. Among the notable individuals sentenced was Giancarlo Pittelli, a lawyer and former senator for former Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi's party, Forza Italia. Pittelli received an 11-year sentence for collusion with a mafia-type organization. Others convicted included civil servants, professionals from diverse fields, and high-ranking officials, who played key roles in helping the 'Ndrangheta infiltrate the legitimate economy and state institutions. Over 100 defendants were acquitted. The judges presiding over the case were placed under police protection due to concerns for their safety. Originating in the Calabria region, the 'Ndrangheta is considered one of the world's most dangerous criminal organizations, with estimated control of up to 80% of Europe's cocaine market and a reported annual turnover of approximately $60 billion. The trial took place in a call center on the outskirts of Lamezia Terme, which was transformed into a high-security courtroom capable of accommodating around 600 lawyers and 900 witnesses, and equipped with secure cages for the defendants. Charges included murder, extortion, drug trafficking, loan sharking, abuse of office, and money laundering. Over three years, the proceedings showed how the syndicate's reach extended across continents — including operations as far as South America and Australia. The group infiltrated the local economy, public institutions, and even the health sector, manipulating public tenders and bribing officials. This was the largest mafia trial in Italy since the 1980s, with judges hearing thousands of hours of testimony. Former mafia members who collaborated with authorities provided insight into the activities of the Mancuso family and their associates, who maintain significant control over the province of Vibo Valentia. The Mancuso family, based in Limbadi, is one of about 150 clans comprising the 'Ndrangheta. Anna Sergi, criminology professor at the University of Exeter, remarked, 'This trial confirms the convictions of classic mafiosi for offenses traditionally linked to organized crime, such as extortion and drug trafficking. However, it's important to note the diverse backgrounds of those involved, including white-collar workers, which provides a broader view of the network and connections among various mafia clans.' Most defendants were arrested in December 2019, following a wide-ranging investigation across at least 11 Italian regions that began in 2016. Around 2,500 officers participated in raids centered on Vibo Valentia, an area under the Mancuso clan's influence within the 'Ndrangheta. More than 50 former mafia members agreed to cooperate with prosecutors, including Luigi Mancuso's nephew, Emanuele. Their testimonies shed light on the organization's internal operations. The trial revealed that members of the 'Ndrangheta allegedly hid weapons in cemetery chapels, transported drugs in ambulances, and redirected public water supplies to grow marijuana. Opponents of the group often faced intimidation and threats, such as dead animals left at their homes, property damage, and other forms of violence. Antonio Nicaso, organized crime expert and author, commented, 'This initial round of sentences highlights the difficulty in combating the 'Ndrangheta given its political, economic, and financial connections.'

Tro-godišnje suđenje obuhvatilo je osobe navodno povezane sa 'Ndranghetom, a presude su donete za zločine od iznude do trgovine drogom. Više od 100 optuženih je oslobođeno. Sudije koje su predsedavale suđenjem bile su pod policijskom zaštitom zbog zabrinutosti za svoju bezbednost. 'Ndrangheta, koja potiče iz regije Kalabrija, smatra se jednom od najopasnijih kriminalnih organizacija na svetu, sa procenjenom kontrolom do 80% tržišta kokaina u Evropi i godišnjim prometom od oko 60 milijardi dolara. Suđenje je održano u pozivnom centru na periferiji Lamezia Terme, koji je pretvoren u visokobezbednosnu sudnicu, sposobnu da primi oko 600 advokata i 900 svedoka, sa sigurnosnim kavezima za optužene. Grupa je prodrla u lokalnu ekonomiju, javne institucije, pa čak i u zdravstveni sektor, manipulišući javnim tenderima i podmićujući zvaničnike. Ovo je bilo najveće mafijaško suđenje u Italiji od 1980-ih, a sudije su saslušale hiljade sati svedočenja. Bivši članovi mafije koji su sarađivali sa vlastima doneli su uvid u aktivnosti porodice Mancuso i njihovih saradnika koji imaju značajnu kontrolu nad provincijom Vibo Valentia. Porodica Mancuso, iz Limbadija, jedna je od oko 150 klanova koji čine 'Ndranghetu. Ana Serđi, profesorka kriminologije na Univerzitetu u Ekseteru, izjavila je: 'Ovo suđenje potvrđuje osude klasičnih mafijaša za dela tradicionalno povezana sa kriminalom, kao što su iznuda ili trgovina drogom. Međutim, važno je istaći raznovrsnost ljudi uključenih u slučaj, uključujući i „bele okovratnike“, što daje širu sliku mreže i povezanosti među različitim klanovima.' Većina okrivljenih uhapšena je u decembru 2019, nakon opsežne istrage započete 2016. godine koja je obuhvatila najmanje 11 italijanskih regija. Oko 2.500 policajaca učestvovalo je u pretresima fokusiranim na Vibo Valentiju, oblast pod uticajem klana Mancuso unutar 'Ndranghete. Više od 50 bivših mafijaša odlučilo je da sarađuje sa tužilaštvom, među njima i Emanuele, nećak Luigija Mancusa. Njihova svedočenja rasvetlila su unutrašnje funkcionisanje organizacije. Suđenje je otkrilo da su članovi 'Ndranghete navodno skrivali oružje u kapelama na grobljima, prevozili drogu u ambulantama i preusmeravali javnu vodu za uzgoj marihuane. Protivnici grupe često su se suočavali sa pretnjama i zastrašivanjima, kao što su uginule životinje na pragu kuće, uništena imovina i drugi oblici nasilja. Antonio Nikaso, stručnjak za organizovani kriminal i autor, rekao je: 'Ova prva runda presuda ističe koliko je teško boriti se protiv 'Ndranghete zbog njenih političkih, ekonomskih i finansijskih veza.'

article_content: Interacting with negative individuals often feels as challenging as dealing with porcupines—you can rarely escape unscathed. Anthony Iannarino, who authored 'The Negativity Fast: Proven Techniques to Increase Positivity, Reduce Fear, and Boost Success,' is well-versed in this idea. Drawing from over twenty years in sales and staffing, Iannarino understands how crucial mindset is for professional and organizational success. According to Iannarino, unchecked problems in a workplace often trap organizations in negativity. He explains that just one toxic person can shift an entire team’s atmosphere if leadership fails to intervene. Ambiguity about expectations can also drive workplace negativity, since people need clear direction to perform well. Iannarino points out that negativity is highly contagious. 'It spreads when one person’s complaints trigger others to highlight workplace issues,' he says, noting how easy it is for negativity to gain momentum. However, he clarifies that not every complaint is harmful; sometimes raising concerns is necessary for improvement. Iannarino refers to research connecting prolonged negativity to increased levels of stress, anxiety, and sometimes depression. He suggests that gratitude can be an effective antidote. He recommends psychologist Martin Seligman’s 'Three Blessings' exercise: each night, write down three positive things from your day. According to Seligman, just two weeks of this habit can help ward off depression for up to six months. To tackle negativity, Iannarino advocates a 'negativity audit'—a strategy for identifying negative influences in our environments, especially in the workplace. Recognizing these sources allows individuals to make targeted plans to minimize negativity. Citing Friedrich Nietzsche’s famous phrase, 'That which does not kill you makes you stronger,' Iannarino points out that personal hardships can sometimes result in increased gratitude and reduced negativity. He emphasizes that The Negativity Fast isn’t about denying tough emotions, but about choosing positivity more often. It’s important to experience appropriate negative feelings, but also to intentionally surround yourself with optimistic people. As the saying goes: negative people need drama like oxygen, so staying positive, in turn, can be invigorating and protective.

Entoni Janarino, autor knjige „Brzi post protiv negativnosti: Dokazane tehnike za povećanje pozitivnosti, smanjenje straha i postizanje uspeha“, dobro poznaje ovu temu. Sa više od dvadeset godina iskustva u prodaji i regrutaciji, Janarino naglašava koliko je način razmišljanja ključan za profesionalni i organizacioni napredak. Prema Janarinu, nerešeni problemi na radnom mestu često odvode organizaciju u zamku negativnosti. On objašnjava da samo jedna toksična osoba može narušiti atmosferu celog tima ako rukovodstvo ne reaguje na vreme. Nejasnoće oko očekivanja takođe doprinose negativnom okruženju, jer ljudima treba jasnoća da bi uspešno radili. Janarino napominje da je negativnost veoma zarazna. „Širi se kada nečije žalbe podstaknu druge da istaknu probleme na poslu“, kaže on, naglašavajući koliko se negativnost lako širi. Ipak, ističe da svaka pritužba nije nužno loša; ponekad je podizanje problema neophodno za poboljšanje. Janarino se poziva na istraživanja koja povezuju dugotrajnu negativnost sa povećanim nivoom stresa, anksioznosti, pa čak i depresije. Kao efikasan protivotrov, predlaže zahvalnost. Preporučuje vežbu psihologa Martina Seligmana „Tri blagoslova“: svake večeri zapišite tri pozitivne stvari koje su vam se dogodile tog dana. Prema Seligmanu, ova praksa tokom dve nedelje može sprečiti depresiju i do šest meseci. Kako bi se izborili sa negativnošću, Janarino savetuje 'reviziju negativnosti'—strategiju za identifikaciju izvora negativnih uticaja, posebno na radnom mestu. Prepoznavanje ovih izvora omogućava pojedincima da prave konkretne planove za smanjenje negativnosti. Citirajući poznatu frazu Fridriha Ničea „Što te ne ubije, to te ojača“, Janarino navodi da lične teškoće ponekad mogu povećati zahvalnost i smanjiti negativnost. On naglašava da 'Brzi post protiv negativnosti' nije o potiskivanju teških emocija, već o izboru pozitivnog stava što češće. Važno je da sebi dozvolimo negativna osećanja kada su primerena, ali i da se okružimo optimističnim ljudima. Kao što izreka kaže: negativnim ljudima treba drama kao kiseonik—ostanite pozitivni i time ih razoružajte.

article_content: Mumbai officials responded quickly after a 17-year-old posted a threat on X (formerly Twitter) about a potential incident during the World Cup semi-final between India and New Zealand. Tagging the Mumbai police, he uploaded images of a gun, grenade, and cartridges, leading authorities to ramp up security at Wankhede Stadium, the venue for the match. The investigation traced the IP address to Latur, identifying the minor behind the message. As he is underage, Latur police were asked to take his statement and relay it to Mumbai authorities for next steps. Police officials said further action will be decided after reviewing the statement. Elsewhere, the Indian cricket team touched down at Wankhede to gear up for their high-pressure semi-final, having maintained an unbeaten streak with nine straight victories. The face-off with New Zealand is drawing substantial attention from fans and commentators. In other news, a Mumbai police officer is recovering after being hit by a drunk scooterist in Andheri – the driver and one passenger have been detained, while another suspect fled. Also, football legend David Beckham, currently in India as a UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador, is expected at the semi-final. The second semi-final will feature Australia against South Africa in Kolkata’s Eden Gardens.

Artificial intelligence (AI) continues to experience rapid and transformative growth, directly influencing how we communicate, collaborate, and create in the workplace. Deepa Nagraj, Global Head of Communications & Sparkle Innovation Ecosystem at Mphasis, highlights that as the world changes, AI remains a driving constant behind innovation.

The global AI market is projected to reach $1.8 trillion by 2030, expanding at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 37.3% from 2023 to 2030. PwC estimates that AI could contribute up to $15.7 trillion to the global economy by 2030, exceeding the current outputs of China and India combined. Of this, $6.6 trillion may result from increased productivity, while $9.1 trillion could originate from new consumption patterns. AI’s impact extends to brand storytelling as organizations leverage it to redefine their identities and customer engagement.

AI encompasses computer systems capable of sensing, thinking, learning, and acting. Its applications span nearly every aspect of human experience—from boosting productivity and economic output to transforming collaboration and workplace effectiveness. A 2021 survey of employees in the U.S. and U.K. found that 81% believed AI improved their job performance, and 89% thought AI could support them in up to half of their responsibilities. Top benefits reported included more productive workdays, better decision-making, enhanced creativity, and stronger team collaboration.

Companies are applying AI in innovative ways to market themselves. For instance, Heinz invited customers to share AI-generated images of tomato ketchup, most of which resembled Heinz’s own iconic bottle, demonstrating AI’s role in creative branding.

Generative AI tools such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT have quickly gained traction for their versatility and user-friendly interfaces, reaching 100 million monthly users within two months of launch. These platforms can generate a diverse range of content, from articles to jokes. An MIT study involving 444 professionals found that using ChatGPT for business documents boosted productivity by 59%, allowing for higher output and improved quality.

Beyond content creation, AI-powered collaborative tools now enhance virtual meetings, automate workflows, and facilitate communication among distributed teams. Microsoft’s Copilot for IT, for example, is an AI assistant that creates a unified experience for enterprise users, analyzing, summarizing, creating, and automating content tailored to their needs in real time.

Hybrid work environments also benefit from AI-powered virtual assistants, which gather information across multiple systems and deliver solutions instantly. These smart assistants can answer common questions and proactively resolve issues, reducing feelings of disconnection for remote employees.

AI continues to automate routine office tasks like meeting transcription and note-taking, allowing employees to focus on more innovative and meaningful work. Freed from repetitive duties, teams can explore new ways to collaborate and drive progress, marking a significant shift from previous workplace norms.

Forbes Communications Council is an invitation-only community for executives in public relations, media strategy, creative, and advertising agencies.

Deepa Nagraj, globalna direktorka za komunikacije i Sparkle Innovation Ecosystem u kompaniji Mphasis, ističe da VI ostaje konstanta inovacija u svetu koji se stalno menja.

Očekuje se da će globalno tržište VI dostići 1,8 biliona dolara do 2030. godine, uz godišnju stopu rasta od 37,3% između 2023. i 2030. PwC procenjuje da bi VI mogla dodati do 15,7 biliona dolara globalnoj ekonomiji do 2030, što nadmašuje trenutne rezultate Kine i Indije zajedno. Od toga, 6,6 biliona dolara moglo bi biti rezultat veće produktivnosti, dok bi 9,1 bilion dolara mogao doći iz novih obrazaca potrošnje. Uticaj VI proširuje se i na priču brenda – organizacije koriste VI da redefinišu svoj identitet i angažovanje sa korisnicima.

VI podrazumeva kompjuterske sisteme sposobne da opažaju, razmišljaju, uče i deluju. Njena primena pokriva gotovo svaki aspekt ljudskog iskustva—od povećanja produktivnosti i ekonomskog učinka do transformacije saradnje i efikasnosti na radnom mestu. Istraživanje iz 2021. godine među zaposlenima u SAD i Velikoj Britaniji pokazalo je da 81% smatra da VI poboljšava njihov radni učinak, a 89% veruje da VI može podržati do polovinu njihovih zadataka. Najveće prednosti su produktivniji radni dani, bolje odlučivanje, veća kreativnost i jača timska saradnja.

Kompanije inovativno primenjuju VI u marketingu. Na primer, Heinz je pozvao korisnike da podele slike kečapa koje je generisala VI; većina je podsećala na prepoznatljivu Heinz flašu, pokazujući uticaj VI na kreativni brending.

Ove platforme mogu generisati raznovrstan sadržaj, od članaka do šala. Studija MIT-a u kojoj je učestvovalo 444 profesionalca pokazala je da je korišćenje ChatGPT-a za izradu poslovnih dokumenata povećalo produktivnost za 59%, omogućavajući veću produkciju i bolji kvalitet rada.

Pored kreiranja sadržaja, alati za saradnju pokretani VI unapređuju virtuelne sastanke, automatizuju radne tokove i olakšavaju komunikaciju među timovima na daljinu. Microsoft Copilot za IT, na primer, je AI asistent koji stvara objedinjeno iskustvo korisnicima u preduzeću analiziranjem, sažimanjem, kreiranjem i automatizacijom sadržaja prilagođenog njihovim potrebama u realnom vremenu.

Hibridni rad takođe mnogo dobija zahvaljujući AI virtuelnim asistentima koji prikupljaju podatke iz različitih sistema i brzo pružaju rešenja. Ovi pametni asistenti mogu odgovarati na česta pitanja i proaktivno rešavati probleme, čime pomažu zaposlenima na daljinu da se osećaju povezano.

AI nastavlja da automatizuje rutinske kancelarijske zadatke kao što su transkripcija sastanaka i vođenje beležaka, oslobađajući zaposlene da se usmere na inovativniji i smisleniji rad. Oslobođeni od ponavljajućih zadataka, timovi mogu istraživati nove načine za saradnju i napredak, što je velika promena u odnosu na ranije standarde na radnom mestu.

article_content: Maoz Inon finds it hard to sleep since losing his parents in the October 7 attack near Gaza. He swims in the Mediterranean each morning, seeking a brief escape from his grief. After the attack by Hamas destroyed his parents’ home in Netiv HaAsara, Inon was left devastated but says he doesn’t seek revenge—he mourns for all innocent victims and longs for peace, even when hope feels distant. Oded Adomi Leshem, a psychologist, notes that immediate empathy is difficult during ongoing conflict. Surveys confirm growing pessimism among Israelis and Palestinians regarding a two-state solution, with many underestimating how much the opposite side desires peace. Still, large numbers on both sides express a wish to live safely and peacefully together; support for peace exists, even if overshadowed by mistrust and pain. Dr. Lina Qasem Hassan, a Palestinian citizen of Israel, works as a family physician for Jewish patients and volunteers with medical teams. Despite losing a relative—a Gaza ambulance driver killed in the war—she continues to help Israeli evacuees and emphasizes the shared humanity of suffering. She recalls seeing both hardship and resilience during past visits to Gaza, and wishes to return to provide aid to those now trapped by war. Robi Damelin lost her son to a Palestinian sniper during the Second Intifada, but instead of hatred, she sought reconciliation and joined the Parents Circle—Families Forum, uniting bereaved Israeli and Palestinian families. Even after contacting her son’s killer, she held fast to forgiveness, believing that only understanding and dialogue can end the cycle of violence. Yousef Bashir, a Palestinian from Gaza, was shot as a teenager by Israeli soldiers. His father taught him the importance of forgiveness and peace; even after being injured, Bashir refused to embrace hate. He regained his mobility and now advocates for coexistence from Washington, D.C., reminding the world that both peoples deserve safety and dignity. Efforts to build bridges—like shared guesthouses, bereavement groups, and youth camps—continue despite recurring violence. Leaders and participants admit progress is slow and uncertain. Yet they believe ordinary acts of compassion, shared mourning, and open conversations sow seeds of peace and offer hope that the long cycle of retribution might one day end.

Nakon što je Hamas uništio kuću njegovih roditelja u Netiv HaAsara, Inon je bio slomljen, ali kaže da ne traži osvetu—žali sve nevine žrtve i čezne za mirom, čak i kad se nada čini dalekom. Oded Adomi Leshem, psiholog, ističe da je saosećanje teško tokom aktivnog sukoba. Ankete potvrđuju sve veći pesimizam među Izraelcima i Palestincima u vezi sa rešenjem o dve države, a mnogi potcenjuju želju suprotne strane za mirom. Ipak, veliki broj ljudi na obe strane želi da živi zajedno u miru i sigurnosti; podrška miru postoji, iako je potisnuta nepoverenjem i bolom. Doktorka Lina Qasem Hassan, Palestinka iz Izraela, radi kao porodična lekarka za jevrejske pacijente i volontira u medicinskim timovima. Iako je izgubila rođaka—vozača hitne pomoći iz Gaze, stradalog tokom rata—nastavlja da pomaže izraelskim evakuisanim licima i naglašava zajedničku ljudsku patnju. Seća se teških i lepih trenutaka sa prethodnih poseta Gazi i nada se da će se vratiti kako bi pomogla ljudima zarobljenim ratom. Robi Damelin je izgubila sina u napadu palestinskog snajperiste tokom Druge intifade, ali se umesto mržnje okrenula pomirenju i pridružila organizaciji Parents Circle—Families Forum, koja okuplja ožalošćene izraelske i palestinske porodice. Čak i nakon što je kontaktirala ubicu svog sina, odabrala je oproštaj, verujući da samo razumevanje i dijalog mogu prekinuti krug nasilja. Jousef Bašir, Palestinac iz Gaze, ranjen je kao tinejdžer od strane izraelskih vojnika. Njegov otac ga je naučio važnosti oproštaja i mira; i nakon povrede odbio je da širi mržnju. Ponovo je prohodao i sada iz Vašingtona zagovara suživot, podsećajući svet da oba naroda zaslužuju bezbednost i dostojanstvo. Napori za izgradnju mostova—poput zajedničkih gostinjskih kuća, grupa za žaljenje i kampova za mlade—nastavljaju se uprkos stalnom nasilju. Lideri i učesnici priznaju da je napredak spor i neizvestan. Ipak, veruju da obični činovi saosećanja, zajednička žalost i otvoreni razgovori mogu da sačuvaju nadu i pomognu da ciklus osvete jednog dana prestane.

article_content: A new study suggests that as US congressional representatives vote more frequently for Democratic policies, alcohol consumption increases in the states they represent, particularly regarding beer and spirits. Researchers propose several explanations, such as a greater propensity among liberals for rebellious behaviors and a belief that public healthcare and social systems could help with negative outcomes from drinking. The study, conducted by economists who examined data from all 50 states between 1952 and 2010, found similar patterns to previous research in Russia, where socialists showed higher levels of drinking than conservatives. Researchers estimated that if Michigan's congressional delegation, which is just over half Democrat, shifted to match Vermont's more liberal profile (where two-thirds supported Barack Obama), residents could consume an additional two gallons of beer per year on average. Dr. Pavel Yakovlev, an economics professor at Duquesne University in Pittsburgh, noted that their analysis accounted for economic, demographic, and religious factors. A separate consumer habits study by Hunch.com found that liberals were 28% more likely to drink both beer and wine compared with conservatives, who preferred milk and soft drinks. Another study published in Psychological Science indicated that when both liberals and conservatives drank alcohol, Democrats were more likely to choose new, inexpensive beer brands, while conservatives preferred more established and expensive options. In the UK, this pattern may also hold. Despite the public image of figures like UKIP leader Nigel Farage, data indicates that right-wing voters are less likely to drink than liberals. According to 2013 data from the Health and Social Care Information Centre, problem drinking was most prevalent in the North of England, a traditional Labour (liberal) stronghold, while heavy drinking was less common in London, where the Conservative (Tory) party has greater support.

Istraživači nude nekoliko objašnjenja, poput veće sklonosti liberala ka buntovnom ponašanju i uverenja da bi javni zdravstveni sistem i socijalne službe mogli pomoći u slučaju negativnih posledica prekomernog pijenja. Studija ekonomista, koja je obuhvatila svih 50 saveznih država od 1952. do 2010. godine, otkrila je slične obrasce kao i prethodna istraživanja u Rusiji, gde su socijalisti više pili od konzervativaca. Procena istraživača pokazuje da bi stanovnici Mičigena, ukoliko bi njihova kongresna delegacija, koja je malo više od polovine demokratska, postala liberalna kao u Vermontu (gde su dve trećine podržale Baraka Obamu), mogli prosečno da popiju još dve galone piva godišnje. Dr Pavel Jakovljev, profesor ekonomije na Univerzitetu Dukesne u Pitsburgu, naglasio je da njihova analiza uključuje ekonomske, demografske i verske faktore. Izdvojeno istraživanje navika potrošača koje je sproveo Hunch.com pokazalo je da su liberali 28% skloniji ispijanju i piva i vina od konzervativaca, koji više preferiraju mleko i gazirane napitke. Još jedno istraživanje objavljeno u časopisu Psychological Science pokazalo je da su demokrate češće birale nove, jeftinije marke piva, dok su konzervativci preferirali poznate i skuplje brendove. Sličan obrazac moguć je i u Velikoj Britaniji. Uprkos javnom imidžu lidera UKIP-a Najdžela Faradža, podaci pokazuju da su desničarski birači ređe konzumenti alkohola od liberala. article_content: Casen Buswell, a seven-month-old from Puyallup, Washington, is living with an extremely rare genetic disorder called Glomuvenous malformations plaque type. Affecting only 14 people worldwide, this progressive condition causes his blood vessels, skin, and muscles to gradually harden because of a missing glomulin gene. If left untreated, it can eventually threaten his life by leading to heart failure. His mother Jenna must be extremely careful when handling him, since even gentle contact can increase Casen’s pain and skin sensitivity. When Casen was born, he had lesions all over his body, and his condition was so unusual that it took weeks for doctors to determine the cause. Ultimately, specialists in Belgium—Dr. Miikka Vikkula and Dr. Laurence Boon—identified the disorder and traced it to the absent gene. Casen is now receiving monthly laser treatments in Belgium, the only available way to slow down the hardening process. These treatments are planned to continue until he turns three, in hopes of enabling him to enjoy normal activities with his older sister, Cora. The Buswell family has started a significant fundraising campaign to pay for the expensive treatments and regular trips to Belgium. Jenna’s wish is for Casen to someday experience the ordinary joys of childhood.

Ova progresivna bolest, koja pogađa samo 14 ljudi na svetu, dovodi do postepenog otvrdnjavanja krvnih sudova, kože i mišića, zbog nedostatka glomulin gena. Ako se ne leči, na kraju može ugroziti njegov život izazivajući srčanu insuficijenciju. Njegova majka Džena mora da bude izuzetno pažljiva dok ga dodiruje, jer čak i blag kontakt može dodatno pojačati bol i osetljivost Kasenove kože. Kada se rodio, imao je promene na koži po celom telu, a stanje je bilo toliko neobično da su lekari nedeljama pokušavali da utvrde uzrok. Na kraju su belgijski specijalisti, dr Miika Vikkula i dr Lorns Bun, identifikovali poremećaj i povezali ga sa nedostajućim genom. Kasen sada svakog meseca ide na laserske tretmane u Belgiji, što je jedini poznat način da se uspori napredovanje bolesti. Ove terapije će trajati do njegovog trećeg rođendana, uz nadu da će jednog dana moći da vodi normalan život i igra se sa svojom starijom sestrom Korom. Porodica Basvel pokrenula je veliku humanitarnu akciju kako bi sakupili novac za skupe tretmane i česta putovanja u Belgiju. Dženina želja je da Kasen jednog dana oseti sve radosti detinjstva.

article_content: Actress Jaime King revealed that her close friend, TV star Lena Dunham, was instrumental in giving her the confidence to open up about her own struggles with fertility. Jaime discussed her experience ahead of the release of her music video for Grace MMXIII, in which she collaborates with Academy Award-nominated composer J. Ralph. King credits reading about Lena’s fight with endometriosis in the book 'Not That Kind of Girl' as the turning point that inspired her to speak out about her own journey. “Lena’s openness helped me find my own voice,” Jaime shared, acknowledging that it can be intimidating to talk about personal health struggles, but stressing the importance of raising awareness about conditions like endometriosis and PCOS. Jaime, who experienced five miscarriages before having her son James, recently announced she is expecting her second child with husband Kyle Newman. She hopes that being transparent about her experiences will challenge the perception of a perfect Hollywood life. “It bothers me when I see my life depicted as flawless, because that isn’t reality. While glamour is part of the entertainment world, I think it’s vital to also show the real side and support others dealing with similar issues,” King said. She aims to use her platform to educate and break taboos surrounding reproductive health conditions. Alongside family life and her role as Lemon Breeland on 'Hart of Dixie,' Jaime is deeply engaged in creative work and says staying active makes her feel good, even while pregnant. Her new endeavors include a video for Grace MMXIII and work on an album with J. Ralph. Jaime says that her friendship with Taylor Swift gave her the push she needed to share her own music, explaining that Taylor’s talent and courage were a significant influence. Jaime calls herself a ‘cheerleader’ for friends like Lena Dunham and Taylor Swift, supporting them as they use their talents to make a difference. In Grace MMXIII’s new video, Jaime takes center stage, performing with live vocals—without auto-tune—showing off her authentic, emotive singing style. For Jaime, creative expression is about making others feel less isolated. “I always want to create a sense of connection for my audience,” she said, emphasizing her mission to combine honesty, artistry, and encouragement for others facing their own battles.

article_content: On Monday, US Ambassador to India Eric Garcetti advocated for deeper discussions between India and the United States to develop a regulatory framework for artificial intelligence (AI). He suggested this collaboration could serve as a prime example of a ‘multiplicative relationship’ between the two democracies. Speaking at an Observer Research Foundation event, Garcetti emphasized the importance of proactive action on AI to avoid potential catastrophic outcomes. "If we don’t get ahead of AI," he warned, "even a small chance of something catastrophic happening could occur sooner than we expect." Garcetti noted that although India and the US have had significant discussions on AI, neither country has yet made a formal proposal regarding regulation. He highlighted that US President Joe Biden has strongly addressed AI risks and last month issued an executive order. The order requires AI developers to provide the US government with assessments on their technologies’ vulnerability to cyberattacks, details about training and testing data, and performance measurement results. At the recent India-US 2+2 dialogue, Garcetti said both countries made progress in strengthening their defense partnership and promoting cooperation in industrial sectors through initiatives like the US-India industrial cooperation and defense roadmap. Promoting India-US collaboration in emerging fields, Garcetti added: "We sometimes focus only on equipment—what is sold or co-developed—but the operational coordination of our militaries is just as important." He also stressed the importance of expanding science and technology partnerships, aiming to use technology for global benefit rather than division.
translated_content: U ponedeljak je američki ambasador u Indiji, Erik Garseti, pozvao na dublje razgovore između Indije i Sjedinjenih Država kako bi se razvila regulatorna osnova za veštačku inteligenciju (AI). Naglasio je da bi ova saradnja mogla biti odličan primer 'multiplikativnog odnosa' između dve demokratije. Govoreći na događaju Fondacije za istraživanje (Observer Research Foundation), Garseti je istakao važnost proaktivnog pristupa AI-u kako bi se izbegle potencijalne katastrofalne posledice. "Ako se ne pozabavimo AI-jem na vreme," upozorio je, "čak i mala šansa za katastrofu može se desiti ranije nego što očekujemo." Garseti je naveo da, iako su Indija i SAD vodile značajne razgovore o AI-u, nijedna strana još nije iznela formalni predlog o regulaciji. Posebno je istakao da je predsednik SAD, Džo Bajden, ozbiljno pristupio rizicima AI-ja i prošlog meseca izdao izvršnu naredbu. Naredba zahteva od razvijača AI-ja da američkoj vladi dostave procene ranjivosti svojih tehnologija na sajber napade, detalje o podacima korišćenim za obuku i testiranje, kao i rezultate performansi. Na nedavnom dijalogu Indija-SAD 2+2, Garseti je rekao da su obe zemlje napredovale u jačanju odbrambenog partnerstva i promociji industrijske saradnje preko inicijativa poput Mape puta o industrijskoj i odbrambenoj saradnji između Indije i SAD. Ističući potrebu za saradnjom Indije i SAD u novim oblastima, Garseti je dodao: "Ponekad se fokusiramo samo na opremu—šta se prodaje ili zajednički razvija—ali operativna saradnja naših vojski je isto toliko važna." Takođe je naglasio važnost širenja partnerstava u nauci i tehnologiji, s ciljem da se tehnologija koristi za opšte dobro, a ne za stvaranje podela.

article_content: Louis van Gaal declined to comment on whether Wayne Rooney has the right temperament to captain Manchester United after the England striker was sent off for a reckless challenge at Old Trafford. Rooney received the sixth red card of his career after lunging at West Ham’s Stewart Downing, leaving United to defend their 2-1 lead with 10 men for more than half an hour. Van Gaal dismissed suggestions that he had erred in making Rooney captain and insisted the incident was a professional foul, though he acknowledged the referee made the correct decision. Rooney was sent off by referee Lee Mason in the 59th minute, forcing his teammates to fight hard for the victory. Van Gaal avoided questions about Rooney's suitability as captain, stating he had the right not to answer. Rooney will now serve a three-match ban for violent conduct, missing games against Everton, West Brom, and Chelsea. The match had started positively for Rooney, who scored in the fifth minute, while Robin van Persie added another in the 23rd. Diafra Sakho pulled a goal back for West Ham, while Kevin Nolan had an equalizer disallowed for offside. Commentary from Phil Neville and Ruud Gullit highlighted that the tackle was unnecessary and fits a pattern in Rooney's career. This latest red card brings Rooney’s Premier League tally to 175 goals, moving him ahead of Thierry Henry into third place on the all-time list, behind Alan Shearer and Andy Cole. Van Gaal added, 'It was the right card for Wayne. I could imagine why he did it, but he has to do it more carefully. I call that a professional foul. In professional football, you make professional fouls.' West Ham manager Sam Allardyce commented that the challenge appeared cynical and that Rooney deserved to be sent off according to the rules.

article_content: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has announced that a cyclone is expected to develop over the Bay of Bengal early this week. When it strengthens, it will be named Cyclone Hamoon, with the name contributed by Iran. Currently, there are no alerts for heavy rain or strong winds on India's east coast. As of Monday morning, the system was called a deep depression and was located about 400 kilometers south of Paradip (Odisha), 550 kilometers south-southwest of Digha (West Bengal), and 690 kilometers south-southwest of Khepupara (Bangladesh). According to IMD forecasts, Cyclone Hamoon will likely weaken as it approaches Bangladesh and is set to cross between Khepupara and Chittagong on Wednesday. For the past week, the North Indian Ocean, which includes the Bay of Bengal and the Arabian Sea, has been unusually active with cyclones. This region commonly sees such storms after the monsoon, especially from October to December, with November being the peak month. Separately, Cyclone Tej has gained strength over the west-central Arabian Sea and is on a path toward Yemen. The IMD bulletin from Monday morning projects that Tej will make landfall near Al-Ghaidah in Yemen early Tuesday as a very severe cyclonic storm, with winds of 125 to 135 km/h and gusts reaching up to 150 km/h. According to a 5:30 am satellite report by the IMD, Cyclone Tej was positioned 200 kilometers north-northwest of Socotra (Yemen), 300 kilometers south of Salalah (Oman), and 240 kilometers southeast of Al-Ghaidah (Yemen).

U ponedeljak ujutro, sistem je označen kao duboka depresija i bio je lociran oko 400 kilometara južno od Paradipa (Odisha), 550 kilometara južno-jugozapadno od Dighe (Zapadni Bengal) i 690 kilometara južno-jugozapadno od Khepupara (Bangladeš). Po IMD prognozi, očekuje se da će Ciklon Hamoon oslabiti približavajući se Bangladešu i trebalo bi da pređe između Khepupara i Chittagonga u sredu. Protekle nedelje, Severnoindijski okean, koji obuhvata Bengalski zaliv i Arabsko more, bio je posebno aktivan glede ciklona. Ova oblast inače ima više oluja posle monsuna, naročito od oktobra do decembra, dok je novembar najčešći za njihov razvoj. U međuvremenu, Ciklon Tej je značajno ojačao iznad zapadno-centralnog Arabskog mora i kreće se ka Jemenu. Po IMD biltenu od ponedeljka ujutro, očekuje se da će Tej stići do obale Jemena kod Al-Ghaidaha rano u utorak kao veoma jak ciklon, sa brzinama vetra od 125 do 135 km/h i udarima do 150 km/h. Po IMD satelitskim podacima u 5:30 ujutru, Ciklon Tej se nalazio 200 kilometara severozapadno od Socotre (Jemen), 300 kilometara južno od Salale (Oman) i 240 kilometara jugoistočno od Al-Ghaidaha (Jemen).

article_content: Delhi saw its air quality worsen significantly on Wednesday, as it moved into the 'severe' pollution category, according to the Central Pollution Control Board. At 7 AM, the Air Quality Index (AQI) readings were above 400 in several areas: Anand Vihar (405), Jahangirpuri (428), Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium (404), and Dwarka Sector 8 (403), all indicating dangerous levels of pollution. By comparison, Tuesday's AQI was 323, falling in the 'very poor' range, as reported by SAFAR-India. The AQI scale helps the public by translating data about different pollutants into one easy-to-read number: 0-100 is 'good,' 100-200 'moderate,' 200-300 'poor,' 300-400 'very poor,' and 400-500 or above is regarded as 'severe.' Recently, after a short period of improvement, the Commission for Air Quality Management removed GRAP 4 restrictions. This allowed trucks and buses, except for older BS-3 and BS-4 petrol and diesel models, to enter the city again, and permitted construction activities to resume.

U 7 časova ujutru, indeks kvaliteta vazduha (AQI) bio je iznad 400 na nekoliko lokacija: Anand Vihar (405), Jahangirpuri (428), Nacionalni stadion Major Dhyan Chand (404) i Dwarka Sektor 8 (403), što označava opasan nivo zagađenja. Za poređenje, AQI je u utorak iznosio 323, što spada u 'veoma lošu' kategoriju, prema izveštaju SAFAR-India. AQI skala javnosti olakšava razumevanje složenih podataka o zagađenju kroz jedinstvenu vrednost: 0-100 je 'dobar', 100-200 'umeren', 200-300 'loš', 300-400 'veoma loš', a 400-500 ili više - 'ozbiljan'. Nedavno, nakon kratkog poboljšanja, Komisija za upravljanje kvalitetom vazduha ukinula je GRAP 4 ograničenja. article_content: Hemang Jani, an independent market expert, notes that TVS Motor has handled the challenge from electric vehicles (EVs) impressively by launching various products. As a result, TVS has become the best-performing stock in the sector over the past 12 months. However, he considers TVS Motor's stock expensive based on valuations compared to Bajaj Auto or Hero MotoCorp, as TVS shares have seen significant gains. Currently, TVS Motor's stock price has climbed from around Rs 1,450 to nearly Rs 1,700. Ahead of the Ola Electric IPO, there is renewed focus on TVS Motor’s substantial EV segment, which is said to be 65–70% the size of Ola Electric’s operations. The two-wheeler sector is experiencing a revival. Earlier concerns about weak growth, especially in rural areas, are being addressed by improved recent numbers and strong festive season sales. New premium two-wheeler launches have also been well-received. TVS had previously faced risk, with 40% of its portfolio potentially susceptible to EV disruption, but the company’s introduction of new products has strengthened its position. This response has contributed to TVS being the sector’s top-performing stock in the last year. Regarding financial regulations, the RBI recently asked NBFCs to stop lending via certain channels, such as e-commerce and Insta EMI cards, resulting in a temporary decline in Bajaj Finance shares. However, Jani views this as an operational issue with minimal lasting impact on the broader NBFC sector. Further, the RBI’s notification on increasing risk weight for categories such as personal and unsecured loans may slightly raise borrowing costs, but the banking sector is expected to remain relatively stable, with only minor short-term reactions expected in the market. Jani states that recent underperformance of Bank Nifty versus Nifty may present buying opportunities in private banks or SBI. He also notes that specific companies like SBI Card could experience larger price movements due to recent developments. In international and broader business news, OpenAI has removed its CEO Sam Altman due to disagreements over AI safety and profitability, and the Indian government has approved hardware manufacturing investments from 27 companies including Dell, HP, and Lenovo, as part of its PLI initiative.

article_content: Dawn Walker, a distinguished Indigenous author from Saskatchewan, has pleaded guilty after being accused of abducting her son and faking their deaths. Walker, 49, was reported missing in the summer of 2022, leading to a high-profile search. Two weeks later, she and her son were found safe in Oregon, United States. Walker has stated that she fled due to domestic violence. She faced nine charges in total, including parental abduction, identity fraud, and passport forgery, after initially pleading not guilty. On Thursday, Walker pleaded guilty in a Saskatoon court to three charges: parental abduction contrary to a custody order, possession of a forged document, and passport forgery. Both her defense team and prosecutors are recommending a 12-month conditional sentence to be served in the community, followed by 18 months of probation. Judge Brad Mitchell will determine the final sentence. Walker's disappearance was first reported by Saskatoon Police on July 24, 2022, after she was last seen on July 22. Her vehicle and belongings were found at Chief White Park in Saskatchewan, raising concerns for her and her son’s safety. After an extensive two-week search, including efforts along the South Saskatchewan River, police announced on August 5, 2022, that Walker and her son had been located over 1,000 miles away in Oregon City. Authorities tracked her via bank records for gas, food, and various rentals. US officials arrested Walker and charged her with two counts of identity theft. She was later transferred back to Canadian custody while her American legal proceedings were paused. During this period, Walker was jailed and her child was placed in care. In a court filing and public statements, Walker alleged she experienced domestic violence and insufficient protection from Saskatchewan authorities. Through a friend, she expressed regret for her actions but stated she felt left without choice, highlighting systemic failures to protect Indigenous women. Saskatoon police said Walker’s previous allegations were investigated but resulted in no charges. She was released on bail with a trial scheduled for late 2023, but her guilty plea preempted the trial. Walker’s case has drawn significant support from the literary community and Indigenous advocates, who argue it illustrates broader issues within the Canadian legal system for women of color. She is represented by renowned lawyer Marie Henein, who echoed concerns of systemic failure. Known professionally as Dawn Dumont, Walker has built a decade-long career as an author and advocate. Her novel, The Prairie Chicken Dance Tour, was recently shortlisted for the Stephen Leacock Memorial Medal for Humour. Walker also holds a law degree from Queen’s University and previously ran for federal office with the Liberal Party. In written responses to the BBC, Walker detailed how her work is influenced by her experiences as an Indigenous woman facing racism and colonialism. Walker shared observations about overrepresentation and mistreatment of Indigenous women in prison, citing Statistics Canada data that Indigenous women are incarcerated at dramatically higher rates than non-Indigenous women. Walker concluded that national attention is needed to address racism and colonialism, particularly in Saskatchewan, and stated that official statistics do not fully convey the personal pain experienced by those involved.
translated_content: Dawn Walker, istaknuta autorka i pripadnica starosedelačkih naroda iz Saskačevana, priznala je krivicu nakon što je optužena da je otela svog sina i lažirala njihovu smrt. Walker (49) je bila prijavljena kao nestala tokom leta 2022, što je pokrenulo opsežnu potragu. Dve nedelje kasnije, ona i njen sin su pronađeni živi i zdravi u Oregonu, SAD. Walker je izjavila da je pobegla zbog porodičnog nasilja. Suočila se sa devet optužbi, uključujući otmicu deteta, prevaru identiteta i falsifikovanje pasoša, iako je isprva tvrdila da nije kriva. U četvrtak je u sudu u Saskatunu priznala krivicu po tri tačke: otmica deteta suprotno odluci o starateljstvu, posedovanje falsifikovanih dokumenata i falsifikovanje pasoša. Odbrana i tužilaštvo preporučili su uslovnu kaznu od 12 meseci koju bi služila u zajednici, a nakon toga 18 meseci uslovnog nadzora. Sudija Bred Mičel će doneti konačnu presudu. Nestanak Walker je policiji u Saskatunu prijavljen 24. jula 2022, nakon što je poslednji put viđena 22. jula. Njeno vozilo i lične stvari su pronađeni u parku Čif Vajt u Saskačevanu, što je izazvalo zabrinutost za nju i dete. Nakon opsežne dvonedeljne potrage, koja je obuhvatila i oblast reke Južni Saskačevan, policija je 5. avgusta 2022. saopštila da su Walker i njen sin pronađeni više od 1.600 kilometara dalje, u Oregon Sitiju. Vlasti su je pronašle prateći bankovne transakcije za gorivo, hranu i razne iznajmljivanja. Američki zvaničnici su uhapsili Walker i podneli dve optužbe za krađu identiteta. Kasnije je predana kanadskim vlastima, dok je postupak u SAD-u stavljen na čekanje. U tom periodu je bila u pritvoru, a dete joj je oduzeto. U sudskim podnescima i javnim izjavama Walker je tvrdila da je bila žrtva porodičnog nasilja i da joj institucije Saskačevana nisu pružile adekvatnu zaštitu. Kroz prijatelja je izrazila žaljenje zbog svojih postupaka, ali je navela da nije imala izbora, ukazujući na sistemske propuste u zaštiti starosedelačkih žena. Policija u Saskatunu saopštila je da su Walkerine prethodne prijave istražene, ali nisu dovele do podizanja optužnica. Puštena je uz kauciju, a suđenje je bilo zakazano za kraj 2023, ali je priznanje krivice prekinulo proces. Slučaj Walker dobio je značajnu podršku književne zajednice i starosedelačkih aktivista, koji tvrde da ova priča osvetljava šire probleme u kanadskom pravnom sistemu za žene druge boje kože. Zastupa je poznata advokatica Mari Henajn, koja je takođe ukazala na sistemske propuste. Pod imenom Dawn Dumont, Walker je izgradila uspešnu karijeru autorke i aktivistkinje duže od decenije. Njen roman "The Prairie Chicken Dance Tour" bio je u užem izboru za nagradu Stephen Leacock Memorial Medal za humor. Takođe ima diplomu prava sa univerziteta Queen's i kandidovala se na federalnim izborima za Liberalnu partiju. U odgovorima BBC-ju, Walker je objasnila kako njen rad oblikuju lična iskustva starosedelačke žene suočene sa rasizmom i kolonijalizmom. Podelila je zapažanja o prekomernoj zastupljenosti i lošem postupanju prema starosedelačkim ženama u zatvorima, pozivajući se na podatke Statistics Canada da su one u višestruko većem riziku od zatvaranja u odnosu na ostale žene. Walker smatra da je neophodno nacionalno i međunarodno skrenuti pažnju na rasizam i kolonijalizam, posebno u Saskačevanu, naglašavajući da zvanična statistika ne pokazuje punu sliku lične boli onih koji su pogođeni.

article_content: Gulf Binance, a joint venture between Gulf Energy Development—led by founder and CEO Sarath Ratanavadi—and Binance Holdings, plans to launch a cryptocurrency exchange in Thailand after receiving regulatory approval earlier this month. On November 10, Thailand’s Securities and Exchange Commission approved Gulf Binance’s application to operate a digital asset exchange and brokerage for cryptocurrencies and digital tokens, Gulf Energy announced in a regulatory filing. Currently, the crypto platform is open by invitation only, with public access expected in early 2024. According to Yupapin Wangviwat, deputy CEO and CFO of Gulf Energy, Gulf Binance aims to enhance blockchain services in Thailand and promote advancements in the country’s digital asset infrastructure. Gulf Energy, one of Thailand’s largest power producers, entered a partnership with Binance—led by billionaire Changpeng Zhao, the world's largest crypto exchange by volume—in January 2022. The initiative is part of Sarath’s broader efforts to diversify Gulf Energy’s business portfolio. Recent investments include stakes in Singtel-backed InTouch and its wireless unit AIS in 2021, and the acquisition of satellite operator Thaicom last year. Founded in 2007, Gulf Energy is led by Sarath, who, with a net worth of $11.3 billion, ranked fifth on Thailand’s 50 Richest list published in June.
translated_content: Gulf Binance, zajedničko preduzeće Gulf Energy Development-a—na čijem je čelu osnivač i izvršni direktor Sarath Ratanavadi—i Binance Holdings-a, planira da pokrene kripto berzu u Tajlandu nakon što je prošlog meseca dobila regulatorno odobrenje. Dana 10. novembra, Komisija za hartije od vrednosti Tajlanda odobrila je zahtev Gulf Binance-a za rad kao digitalna berza i broker za kriptovalute i digitalne tokene, saopštila je Gulf Energy u zvaničnom izveštaju. Trenutno je kripto platforma dostupna samo putem pozivnica, a javno pokretanje se očekuje početkom 2024. godine. article_content: The Call of Duty franchise, having explored nearly every possible setting, has entered a reboot phase with renewed takes on the Modern Warfare trilogy. While these updated versions haven't matched the acclaim of their originals, they have been enjoyable enough for both long-time and new fans. Unfortunately, this progress stalls with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. Modern Warfare 3’s campaign offers open-ended missions and a timely, yet shallow, story about terrorism. The campaign doesn't capture the excitement of the original trilogy’s final chapter. While multiplayer continues to deliver top-tier gunplay, issues like a confusing user interface, a lack of original maps, and frustrating design decisions significantly impact the overall experience. The story picks up after Modern Warfare 2, featuring Task Force 141's ongoing battle with Vladimir Makarov, the franchise’s most infamous villain. Despite Makarov's notoriety from the original Modern Warfare 3 (2009) and the infamous 'No Russian' mission, the short campaign fails to develop its characters or plot meaningfully. Players remain disconnected from the cast, who mostly communicate military jargon or reiterate Makarov’s antagonism in brief cutscenes. Despite strong acting performances, the weak script restricts emotional engagement. While a complex narrative isn't required for a great game—seen in Mario’s enduring popularity—Modern Warfare 3 fails to offer impactful commentary or meaningful storytelling, even though it addresses serious themes. For those more interested in gameplay than narrative, Modern Warfare 3 upholds the series’ tradition of tight, responsive gunplay and a diverse arsenal. Visuals and cutscenes are particularly impressive, but superb production quality doesn't compensate for uninspired gameplay. Nearly half of the campaign consists of Open Combat Missions, using a Warzone-style sandbox approach. These missions offer flexibility in completing objectives but slow the game’s pacing and reduce urgency. While completionists might enjoy searching for hidden stashes, most players will find the objectives repetitive and lacking impact. Scripted missions deliver brief excitement, but overall, the campaign is forgettable. Attempts at controversy lack depth and come across as hollow. Multiplayer features smooth movement and satisfying gunplay, with modes like the new Cutthroat 3v3v3 adding excitement. However, this installment is the first in the series to launch without any new 6v6 maps, instead reusing enhanced versions of older maps. Although visually impressive, these maps feature more clutter and altered sightlines, which can challenge even experienced players. The multiplayer experience suffers from an unintuitive UI and aggressive microtransaction promotion, making players feel more like customers than gamers. Lingering issues, like unfavorable spawn points, inconsistent time-to-kill, and problematic sound design, further detract from enjoyment. Overall, Modern Warfare 3 is a significant setback for the franchise. The brief and unremarkable campaign and a multiplayer mode lacking identity struggle to compete with more innovative shooters, and its core gameplay is overshadowed by pervasive monetization. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 was reviewed on PlayStation 5.
translated_content: Franšiza Call of Duty, nakon što je istražila gotovo svaku moguću postavku, ušla je u fazu reboota sa novim verzijama Modern Warfare trilogije. Iako ove osvežene verzije nisu dostigle priznanje originala, bile su dovoljno zabavne za dugogodišnje i nove fanove. Nažalost, taj napredak se zaustavlja sa Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. Kampanja Modern Warfare 3 nudi otvorene misije i aktuelnu, ali površnu priču o terorizmu. Kampanja ne uspeva da dočara uzbuđenje završnog poglavlja originalne trilogije. Dok multiplayer i dalje pruža vrhunsku pucnjavu, problemi poput zbunjujućeg korisničkog interfejsa, nedostatka originalnih mapa i frustrirajućih dizajnerskih odluka značajno utiču na celokupno iskustvo. Priča se nastavlja posle Modern Warfare 2, uz povratak Task Force 141 u sukob sa najpoznatijim negativcem franšize, Vladimirom Makarovim. Uprkos Makarovljevoj zloglasnosti iz originalnog Modern Warfare 3 (2009) i čuvene 'No Russian' misije, kratka kampanja ne uspeva da smisleno razvije likove ni zaplet. Igrači ostaju distancirani od likova, koji većinom izgovaraju vojni žargon ili ponavljaju Makarovljevu zlobu u kratkim scenama. I pored dobrih glumačkih nastupa, slab scenario ograničava emotivno povezivanje. Iako kompleksna naracija nije neophodna za dobru igru—što potvrđuje Marijeva popularnost—Modern Warfare 3 ne nudi značajan društveni komentar niti kvalitetnu priču uprkos ozbiljnoj temi. Za one kojima je gejmplej važniji od priče, Modern Warfare 3 nastavlja tradiciju serijala preciznim pucanjem i raznovrsnim arsenalom. Grafika i scene su vrlo impresivne, ali sama produkcija ne može da nadomesti nedostatak inspiracije u igranju. Skoro polovina kampanje sadrži Open Combat Mission zadatke, sa sandbox pristupom kao u Warzone-u. Ove misije daju slobodu u ispunjavanju ciljeva, ali usporavaju tempo igre i smanjuju tenziju. Iako će igrači koji vole da istražuju uživati u pronalaženju skrivenih stvari, većina će ove zadatke doživeti kao ponavljajuće i nevažne. Skriptovane misije donose trenutke uzbuđenja, ali u celini je kampanja zaboravna. Pokušaji šokiranja igrača deluju šuplje i bez stvarne dubine. Multiplayer pruža brzo kretanje i zadovoljavajući osećaj pucanja, dok modovi poput novog Cutthroat 3v3v3 donose dodatnu dinamiku. Ipak, ovo je prvi nastavak bez novih 6v6 mapa, koristeći unapređene verzije starih. Iako su vizuelno sjajne, mape su sada prenatrpane i izmenjenih linija vatre, što može zbuniti i iskusne igrače. Multiplayer pati zbog neintuitivnog interfejsa i agresivnog reklamiranja mikrotransakcija, pa se igrači pre osećaju kao potrošači nego kao gejmeri. Dugotrajni problemi poput loših spawn tačaka, nekonzistentnog vremena za eliminaciju i slabe zvučne dizajna dodatno kvare iskustvo. Sve u svemu, Modern Warfare 3 predstavlja značajan korak unazad za franšizu. Kratka i neupadljiva kampanja i multiplayer bez identiteta teško mogu da pariraju inovativnijim pucačinama, dok osnovna igra pati pod teretom agresivne monetizacije. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 je testiran na PlayStation 5.

article_content: Nigeria is preparing to introduce a dedicated mortgage scheme for its citizens living in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada, as revealed by Housing and Urban Development Minister Ahmed Dangiwa. Speaking at the 6th Nigeria Diaspora Investment Summit in Abuja, Dangiwa explained that this initiative aims to help Nigerians abroad purchase affordable homes in their country of origin. Dangiwa, who conceived the Diaspora Mortgage Scheme while serving as Managing Director/Chief Executive of the Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria, expressed enthusiasm for advancing the project as minister. The program is expected to launch soon in the US, UK, and Canada, and Dangiwa urged Nigerians abroad to take advantage of the new opportunity. Summit participants included Sports Development Minister John Enoh, who commended the patriotism of diaspora Nigerians and recognized their significant role in national development, especially in sports. The summit host, Abike Dabiri-Erewa, Chair of the Nigerians in Diaspora Commission, underscored the importance of strong partnerships between the government and diaspora communities for strengthening the economy. She also noted that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s recent engagements, such as attending the Saudi-Africa Summit, signal Nigeria’s commitment to attracting more direct investments from the diaspora and enhancing business collaborations through ongoing reforms. Overall, officials at the summit highlighted the essential contribution of Nigerians abroad to the country's progress and development.

Domaćin samita, Abike Dabiri-Erewa, predsednica Komisije za Nigerijce u dijaspori, istakla je važnost snažnog partnerstva između vlade i dijasporskih zajednica za jačanje ekonomije.
