article_content: NEW YORK – Retailers are launching the holiday shopping season on Friday with a range of discounts and promotions. However, business leaders are increasingly concerned about a potential slowdown in consumer spending, which could affect sales on Black Friday and throughout the holidays. Despite a strong job market and steady wage growth, many shoppers had defied expectations by continuing to spend, even as inflation and higher borrowing costs made purchases more expensive. Recently, though, consumers are facing more financial pressure, with reduced savings, rising credit card debt, and persistent inflation. In October, shoppers cut back on spending, ending a six-month stretch of gains. Although some relief has come from easing inflation, prices for many goods and services – such as meat and rent – remain much higher than three years ago. Major retailers including Walmart and Best Buy have noted signs of a weakening consumer. Walmart reported shoppers began cutting back in October and gave a cautious sales outlook. Best Buy pointed out customers are now opting for more affordable TVs, while Target observed that people are waiting longer to make purchases, delaying buying items like sweatshirts or jeans until colder weather arrived. "Consumers have shown remarkable resilience," Target CEO Brian Cornell recently told analysts, "but in our research, uncertainty, caution, and budgeting are key concerns." Even luxury retailers such as Saks Fifth Avenue have noticed more cautious behavior. "We're taking a careful approach as we've seen some softening," said Marc Metrick, CEO of Saks’ online business. He does not expect an exceptional or dismal holiday season, but rather a measured one. According to the National Retail Federation, shoppers are expected to spend more than last year, but at a slower pace due to economic uncertainty. The group predicts U.S. holiday sales will grow by 3% to 4% for November and December, compared to a 5.4% increase a year ago. This projection aligns with the pre-pandemic average yearly increase of 3.6% from 2010 to 2019. During the pandemic, Americans increased spending, helped by federal relief checks, with holiday sales in 2021 jumping 12.7% over two months. This year, many retailers have ordered fewer products and started holiday sales earlier to help shoppers spread out their spending. Early shopping became more common during the pandemic, especially when supply chain snarls in 2021 prompted consumers to buy early to secure desired items. Retailers expect many shoppers to be motivated by deals, with some likely to wait until the last minute. Best Buy is promoting more items at entry-level prices, while Kohl’s is spotlighting products under certain price points, such as $25. Barbara Lindquist, 85, of Hawthorne Woods, Illinois, said she and her husband plan to spend the same $1,000 as last year on gifts. Working as a preschool teacher at her local church, Lindquist is even more focused on bargains due to high prices for staples. She expects to buy more gift cards to stick to her budget, opting for value and recently buying discounted sheets and towels for holiday guests. Online deals should exceed those from last year, according to Adobe Analytics, particularly for toys, electronics, and clothing. The firm predicts average toy discounts of 35% (vs. 22% a year ago), electronics at 30% (vs. 27%), and clothing at 25% (vs. 19%). The five-day Black Friday weekend, culminating in Cyber Monday, is widely viewed by analysts as a key indicator of Americans' willingness to spend. Black Friday is expected to once again be the busiest shopping day of the year, says Sensormatic Solutions, a firm tracking store traffic. Roughly 40% of all holiday retail traffic is expected to occur on the top 10 busiest U.S. shopping days. Retailers have been offering Black Friday-style deals all month to boost sales. Adobe Analytics reports consumers spent $63.2 billion online from November 1 through Monday, up 5% compared to last year and ahead of the firm's estimate. Marshal Cohen, chief retail adviser at market research firm Circana, believes most shoppers will stick to their lists and avoid impulse purchases, taking their time throughout the season. "There's no sense of urgency," Cohen said. "Shoppers are saying, ‘I’ll shop when it’s convenient for me.’" Follow Anne D’Innocenzio on Twitter: http://twitter.com/ADInnocenzio

article_content: There are growing concerns at Manchester United's Carrington training ground after several players suffered injuries. Radamel Falcao picked up a thigh injury in Friday's session, ruling him out of Sunday's match. Phil Jones and Ashley Young also sustained injuries on Saturday. Falcao received treatment on Sunday morning but was deemed unfit to play. Phil Jones had trained on Friday ahead of United's upcoming match against Chelsea. A key moment in the Chelsea match came when Rafael da Silva, despite being shorter, was assigned to mark Didier Drogba. Drogba capitalized on this mismatch to give Chelsea the lead with a header. Robin van Persie could have intercepted the goal if he had maintained his assigned position but was drawn toward the ball. Fortunately, van Persie redeemed himself later in the match. The United match programme promoted Sir Alex Ferguson’s reissued autobiography, drawing attention as well to the absence of mention of Roy Keane’s new book. An item from the George Best era added nostalgia, featuring a postcard from a 17-year-old Best on a tour of Zurich, where he wrote about the good weather, average food, and impressive local women. Despite travel disruptions on the west coast line from London, Old Trafford was filled for the match, undermining Manchester City fans’ taunts about United’s fan base. Though Didier Drogba has scored just four goals in 22 matches against United, his goals have often been decisive, including winning the FA Cup final and contributing to Chelsea’s 2010 Premier League title. United demonstrated resilience, securing a late equalizer against Chelsea. This impressed Gary Lineker, who predicted United would qualify for the next season's Champions League. The result leaves United eighth in the Premier League, mirroring their place at this time last year, though with one fewer point.

article_content: Samsung’s Android 14-based One UI 6 update is now rolling out of beta for Galaxy S23 devices in Europe, according to user reports. Across platforms such as X (formerly Twitter) and Reddit, people in countries including the UK, France, Germany, Poland, Spain, and Portugal are noticing the update. Many users are updating from the beta version, while others are downloading a larger, 3GB patch to upgrade from the stable One UI 5.1. OpenAI is facing significant internal turmoil after its board of directors removed co-founder and CEO Sam Altman, surprising both employees and major investors such as Microsoft. According to Bloomberg and The Wall Street Journal, investors are actively pushing for Altman's reinstatement. The Verge reports that negotiations regarding Altman's possible return are nearing completion, with a deadline of 5 p.m. PT, as Microsoft wants the matter resolved before the stock market opens. Some investors, including Thrive Capital, have also contacted Microsoft to advocate for Altman’s return.

On Friday, OpenAI’s board stated it “no longer has confidence in [Altman's] ability to continue leading” the company, citing inconsistent communication. In response, Altman has reportedly set conditions for his return, such as requesting a new board. Key OpenAI executives including interim CEO Mira Murati, Chief Strategy Officer Jason Kwon, and Chief Operating Officer Brad Lightcap, are said to support the current board’s replacement and Altman's reinstatement.

Negotiations have encountered difficulties regarding the selection of new board members. Bloomberg reported that former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor is likely to join the board, and Microsoft executives are being considered as well. Meanwhile, Altman is reportedly considering forming a new AI company with former OpenAI employees if negotiations fail, as stated by The Information.

Following Altman's removal, Murati, OpenAI’s chief technology officer and a former Tesla employee, was named interim CEO. Greg Brockman, OpenAI's president and co-founder, resigned shortly after, expressing shock and sadness over the board’s decision. Other employees have since resigned, while Brockman is reportedly in discussions to possibly return. No official comments have been given by OpenAI, Microsoft, or Thrive Capital.

article_content: Shukria Barakzai, a prominent women’s rights advocate and Afghan parliamentarian, survived an assassination attempt in Kabul that left three civilians dead, including a young girl. Previously a journalist who ran a clandestine school for girls under Taliban rule, Barakzai escaped with minor injuries after a suicide bomber targeted her car as she headed to Parliament. Authorities stated the attacker tried to ram her vehicle before detonating explosives, causing an explosion heard across Kabul. More than a dozen people were wounded, among them her driver. Speaking from her hospital bed, Barakzai attributed her survival to the prayers of her supporters. After the explosion, video footage showed Barakzai visibly shaken but alert, walking away from her severely damaged, blackened car. The scene was chaotic, with crowds gathering as emergency services responded and a nearby car reduced to wreckage. Barakzai, who founded Women’s Mirror magazine and has served in Parliament for ten years, is recognized for her close alliance with President Ashraf Ghani and was named BBC Woman of the Year in 2005. Although no group has claimed responsibility, the attack reflects mounting Taliban violence amid the ongoing withdrawal of US and UK forces after more than a decade of conflict. Afghanistan’s Parliament now includes 28% women, a proportion higher than that of the UK. However, increasing violence threatens this progress, echoing the repressive era of Taliban rule. Recent attacks have targeted other high-profile figures, such as Kabul’s police chief, and last year MP Fariba Ahmadi Kakar was abducted. Barakzai’s survival is regarded as a testament to the resilience shown by women’s rights advocates in Afghanistan, despite ongoing threats.

A recent survey has revealed that Beyoncé is the top celebrity women across the UK want to emulate when preparing for a night out. The ‘Crazy in Love’ singer emerged as the clear favorite in almost every major city, including London, Manchester, Liverpool, Bristol, and Cardiff.

The results show that women aspire to look like celebrities such as Beyoncé, Cheryl Cole, Kim Kardashian, and Rihanna. These stars are known for embracing curvier, more natural body types while still radiating glamour and sex appeal—qualities that many British women seek for their Saturday nights.

Interestingly, the findings suggest that achieving this 'natural' look often requires more time. The survey, conducted by fast fashion online retailer fusefashion.com, gathered responses from over 500,000 participants. It aimed to explore the rituals and priorities of British women as they prepare for a night out, as well as their beauty ideals and favorite celebrities.

When it comes to fashion, women of all ages—both those aged 16-20 and those 40 and above—agree on what to wear. Figure-hugging, bodycon dresses, including the classic little black dress (LBD), are the preferred choice, with looking sexy and glamorous remaining a key priority.

Regionally, unique trends emerged. In Norwich, 67% of women prefer six-inch heels—two inches higher than the UK average. Women here are also the most devoted planners, with 67% spending the entire week preparing their Saturday night outfit.

Other regional findings include York women favoring darker fake tans, Aberdeen’s lively party culture, and Plymouth’s penchant for new outfits—where 90% always buy a new outfit for a night out, and half spend over £91. Plymouth women also get ready the fastest, with 50% spending between 30 minutes and an hour. In contrast, dressing up can take much longer in cities like Edinburgh, where 80% of women spend two to three hours getting ready.

The survey also highlighted that the use of artificial beauty enhancements increases further north. In York, over 40% use dark fake tan, and Newcastle claimed the title of the UK’s 'most fake city,' with the highest reported usage of fake lips, breasts, hair, nails, eyelashes, and tan. Nottingham and London also reported notable rates of cosmetic enhancements.

article_content: Lima, Peru – Peruvians are heading to the polls this Sunday in a closely contested presidential election focused on how best to manage the country’s robust economic growth. According to the World Bank, Peru’s economy is expected to grow by 7% this year, making it one of the fastest-growing economies in Latin America. The country weathered the global financial crisis with minimal impact, maintaining GDP growth, creating jobs, and reducing poverty, the Ministry of Economics and Finance reports. Despite the positive economic indicators, many Peruvians have yet to see the benefits reflected in higher salaries. As a result, the main question at the polls is which candidate will best capitalize on strong macroeconomic management and high commodity prices to improve daily life for Peruvians. Voters face a choice among five leading candidates so closely matched that most experts predict a second round of voting will be necessary. However, it remains uncertain which two candidates will make it to the runoff, as Peruvian law prohibits publishing poll numbers during the week before the election. Prior to the blackout, polls showed Ollanta Humala gaining momentum. Humala, a former army officer and the most nationalist among the candidates, lost to current President Alan Garcia in the last presidential runoff. Critics previously accused him of aligning with Venezuelan President Hugo Chavez, though Humala now insists he models himself after Brazil’s more moderate former President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva. Analyst Giovanna Penaflor observes, 'I think Humala has attempted to appear more moderate and centrist in this campaign.' Close behind is Keiko Fujimori, daughter of former President Alberto Fujimori. At 36, she is the youngest candidate. She first became known nationally at 19, when she served as first lady during her father's presidency. Analyst Penaflor notes, 'Her youth is both an advantage and a drawback—it appeals to some voters but may reflect a lack of experience.' Fujimori faces criticism for allegedly running to help free her father, who is serving multiple 25-year sentences, but she maintains his case should be decided by the courts. Former president Alejandro Toledo, known for his market-oriented policies and opposition to Fujimori, is also a contender, riding a wave of renewed popularity despite lackluster poll results during his previous term (2001–2006). Pedro Pablo Kuczynski, an economist with experience as a minister and prime minister, is another prominent candidate. Criticized for holding U.S. as well as Peruvian citizenship, Kuczynski emphasizes his ties to Peru, even adopting the traditional guinea pig, cuy, as his campaign mascot. The final leading candidate is Luis Castañeda, former mayor of Lima. Analyst Luis Benavente says, 'He has been an efficient and successful public official, recognized in Lima for his achievements, but could not turn that local recognition into a national image.' The top two finishers will move on to a runoff scheduled for June 5. Reporting contributed by journalist Maria Elena Belaunde.

Prema podacima Svetske banke, očekuje se rast peruanske ekonomije od 7% ove godine, što je svrstava među najbrže rastuće u Latinskoj Americi. Zemlja je prošla kroz globalnu finansijsku krizu s minimalnim posledicama, zadržavajući rast BDP-a, otvarajući radna mesta i smanjujući siromaštvo, navodi Ministarstvo ekonomije i finansija. Uprkos dobrim ekonomskim pokazateljima, mnogi Peruanci još uvek nisu osetili korist kroz veće plate. Zato je ključno pitanje na izborima koji će kandidat najbolje iskoristiti dobru makroekonomsku politiku i visoke cene sirovina da poboljša svakodnevni život građana. Birači biraju između pet vodećih kandidata koji su toliko izjednačeni da stručnjaci predviđaju drugi krug izbora. I dalje je neizvesno koja će dva kandidata proći dalje jer je po peruanskom zakonu zabranjeno objavljivanje rezultata anketa nedelju dana pred izbore. Pre zabrane, ankete su pokazivale porast podrške za Ollantu Humalu. Humala, bivši vojni oficir i najizraženiji nacionalista među kandidatima, izgubio je od sadašnjeg predsednika Alana Garsije u prošlom predsedničkom balotažu. Kritičari su ga ranije povezivali s venecuelanskim predsednikom Hugom Čavezom, ali sada tvrdi da se ugleda na umerenijeg bivšeg brazilskog predsednika Luiza Inasija Lulu da Silvu. Analitičarka Đovana Penaflor kaže: 'Mislim da se Humala sada trudi da deluje umerenije i centristički.' Njegova glavna protivnica je Keiko Fuđimori, ćerka bivšeg predsednika Alberta Fuđimorija. Sa 36 godina, najmlađa je među kandidatima. Poznata je postala još s 19 kada je bila prva dama tokom očevog mandata. Analitičarka Penaflor napominje da je 'njen mladost prednost, ali i mana — približava je delu birača, ali može ukazivati na nedovoljno iskustvo.' Kritičari je optužuju da kandidaturom zapravo želi pomoći svom ocu, osuđenom na više kazni do 25 godina, dok ona tvrdi da sud treba donositi odluke. Alejandro Toledo, bivši predsednik poznat po tržišnim reformama i protivljenju Fuđimoriju, takođe je ozbiljan kandidat, koristeći povratak popularnosti uprkos slabijoj podršci tokom mandata (2001–2006). Pedro Pablo Kusčinski, ekonomista i bivši ministar i premijer, još je jedan od vodećih. Kritikuju ga što ima i američko državljanstvo, ali on ističe svoje peruansko poreklo i kao maskotu koristi tradicionalnog zamorca cuy. Poslednji među vodećima je Luis Kastañeda, bivši gradonačelnik Lime. Analitičar Luis Benavente napominje: 'Efikasan je i uspešan javni službenik, zbog čega je u Limi imao visok rejting, ali to nije uspeo da prenese na nacionalni nivo.' Dvoje najbolje plasiranih kandidata idu u drugi krug, zakazan za 5. jun. Na izveštaju je radila i novinarka Marija Elena Belaunde.

article_content: Scott Strode, after overcoming his addiction to drugs and alcohol through sports and community support, founded Phoenix Multisport in 2007. The nonprofit provides free athletic activities and a sober support community, having served more than 6,000 participants in Colorado. Phoenix Multisport offers a variety of weekly programs, from casual walks and yoga to mountain biking and ice climbing. Strode, named one of CNN's top 10 Heroes of 2012, hopes that national recognition will bring in donors to sustain and expand Phoenix Multisport nationwide. In the U.S., more than 23 million people over the age of 12 struggle with addiction, and only about 10% receive treatment. Strode emphasizes the importance of community and finding hope in sobriety, aiming to support others facing addiction. He expressed deep gratitude and emotion in response to CNN's recognition, highlighting the dedication of staff and supporters. Strode believes sharing Phoenix Multisport’s story can inspire more support for people in recovery. The $50,000 award from CNN Heroes will help Phoenix Multisport pursue its goal of opening chapters in other cities. Strode believes recovery heals individuals and families. He points out that Phoenix Multisport helps people in recovery rebuild self-esteem and regain lost dreams, as seen through achievements like finishing races and climbing mountains. Wearing Phoenix apparel represents pride in sobriety and shows support for others who are struggling. Strode encourages those struggling with addiction to seek hope and community, emphasizing that recovery is possible and no one has to face it alone.

Arizona Sheriff Joe Arpaio is now the subject of a federal lawsuit, with the U.S. Justice Department accusing him and his department of violating the civil rights of Latino residents through discriminatory policing practices in Maricopa County. Arpaio, famous for his strict and highly publicized approach to law enforcement, has long attracted both fervent supporters—especially those who back tough immigration enforcement—and vocal critics, particularly from Arizona’s growing Latino community. The Latino community’s political clout has recently been demonstrated with the successful recall of state Senator Russell Pearce, the lawmaker behind Arizona’s controversial immigration law.

This case marks the first time the Justice Department has filed a lawsuit specifically to end what it labels as systemic, unconstitutional law enforcement procedures at the county level. Supporters like Arizona Republican spokesman Shane Wikfors argue that Arpaio has survived similar controversies before and still commands strong backing. Meanwhile, some analysts, including Jon Feere of the Center for Immigration Studies, suggest that the lawsuit may have political motivations, pointing to what they see as selective enforcement of federal policy.

During his lengthy time in office—since 1993—Arpaio has introduced a range of controversial jail tactics, such as making inmates wear pink underwear and housing them in outdoor tents. He also reintroduced chain gangs, including for women and juveniles, and banned comforts like coffee and unrestricted television. According to Arpaio’s office, these measures helped cut costs and established discipline, as well as generated publicity. The sheriff’s department, with more than 3,400 employees, regularly publishes mugshots of detainees online as part of its transparency practices.

Federal authorities, however, claim that these policies came at the expense of the rights of Latino residents and critics of the sheriff. The Justice Department also alleges retaliation against those who spoke out against Arpaio through unwarranted investigations or lawsuits. Attempts to negotiate reforms ended in failure after Arpaio’s refusal to accept outside monitoring, prompting the DOJ to file suit. Despite the legal challenge, Arpaio and his supporters assert that he remains determined to continue his tenure as “America’s Toughest Sheriff.”

Arpaio’s background includes military service, roles as a police officer and federal narcotics agent, and more than five terms as sheriff, all contributing to his national reputation for controversial law enforcement methods.

Arpajo je poznat po svom strogom i medijski propraćenom načinu sprovođenja zakona, što mu je donelo kako snažne pristalice—posebno među onima koji podržavaju strogu kontrolu imigracije—tako i brojne kritičare, naročito iz sve uticajnije latino zajednice u Arizoni. Ova tužba je prvi slučaj da Ministarstvo pravde pokreće postupak kako bi sprečilo, prema njihovim rečima, sistematsku i neustavnu praksu sprovođenja zakona na lokalnom nivou. Pregovori za postizanje reformi završeni su bezuspešno jer je Arpajo odbio nezavisni nadzor, pa je DOJ pokrenuo tužbu. article_content: For years, football teams have followed a protocol for suspected concussions: after a player sustains a hard hit to the head, a coach or trainer evaluates him to determine the impact’s severity and whether he can return to play. However, a visual check only reveals so much. What if data could help detect concussions in real time? Now, emerging technology embedded in football helmets measures the force of collisions, sending alerts when a player's health may be at risk. "We want to protect players as best we can," said Thad Ide, head of product development at Riddell, a leading U.S. football helmet maker that has adopted new head-impact monitoring systems. "It’s about keeping players healthy and allowing them to stay in the game." Head injuries have become an urgent concern in football at all levels, from youth leagues to the NFL. Thousands of former players—many with dementia, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and other brain disorders—have sued the NFL, claiming the league was aware of long-term risks associated with head trauma. Riddell, whose helmets were worn by two-thirds of NFL players last season, has also been named in several lawsuits. Additionally, more parents are becoming concerned about their children playing football after studies found high school athletes may be more vulnerable to concussions than older players. “Ten or 15 years ago, concussions weren’t taken as seriously as they are now,” Ide noted. “Now, they’re recognized as more than just ‘getting shaken up’ on the field.” Manufacturers have responded by creating so-called 'head impact sensors'—small devices fitted inside helmets that trigger a warning if a player experiences a significant blow. Products like Shockbox, Battle Sports’ Impact Indicator, and Reebok’s CheckLight are marketed as extra eyes for coaches. Riddell is now integrating such sensors directly into its latest helmet, the SpeedFlex, which is designed from the ground up to include a polymer-film lining that develops a charge upon impact. The helmet’s crown has a flexible panel that compresses to help reduce collision forces. The helmet can be equipped with InSite sensors, which send wireless alerts to the sidelines if a player sustains a particularly hard hit or multiple impacts. According to Ide, when fitted this way, the helmet becomes an “information-gathering tool.” Riddell's spokeswoman said the SpeedFlex would be available in time for the 2014 football season. However, not everyone is convinced. Testing last year showed some helmets failed to register alerts even after severe impacts. Some doctors worry inaccurate sensors might give a false sense of security. “These technologies can be useful if used cautiously and not overinterpreted,” said Dr. Jeffrey Kutcher, director of Michigan NeuroSport clinic. "It could be dangerous to rely on this too much." Riddell and other manufacturers clarify that their products are not designed to diagnose or treat concussions. Rather, they give staff additional insights for deciding when to remove a player from play. Ide believes the SpeedFlex has additional safety benefits. “It could identify players who are striking their heads too often. Multiple alerts might mean a player needs coaching to avoid using their head so much, potentially making the game safer.”
translated_content: Godinama fudbalski timovi slede protokol za sumnje na potres mozga: nakon jakog udarca u glavu, trener ili medicinski stručnjak procenjuje igrača kako bi utvrdio ozbiljnost povrede i da li može da nastavi igru. Međutim, vizuelna procena je ograničena. Šta ako bi podaci mogli pomoći da se potres mozga prepozna odmah? Sada nova tehnologija u kacigama meri jačinu sudara i šalje upozorenje kad je zdravlje igrača ugroženo. "Želimo da zaštitimo igrače najbolje što možemo," rekao je Tad Ajd, direktor razvoja proizvoda u kompaniji Riddell, vodećem američkom proizvođaču fudbalskih kaciga, koji koristi nove sisteme za praćenje udaraca. "Cilj je održati igrače zdravim i omogućiti im da igraju duže." Povrede glave su postale ozbiljan problem u fudbalu, od omladinskih liga do NFL-a. Hiljade bivših igrača—mnogi sa demencijom, Alchajmerom, Parkinsonovom bolešću i drugim poremećajima mozga—tužili su NFL tvrdeći da su znali za dugoročne rizike od povreda glave. Riddell, čije su kacige prošle sezone nosile dve trećine NFL igrača, naveden je u više tužbi. Takođe, sve više roditelja brine zbog bezbednosti dece u fudbalu, jer studije ukazuju da su srednjoškolci podložniji potresima mozga nego stariji sportisti. “Pre 10 ili 15 godina, potresi mozga nisu se shvatali tako ozbiljno kao danas,” rekao je Ajd. “Sada se shvataju mnogo ozbiljnije i ne smatraju se više samo ‘lakšim podrhtavanjem’ na terenu.” Proizvođači su odgovorili razvojem ‘senzora za udarce u glavu’—malih uređaja u kacigama koji šalju upozorenja ako igrač primi jak udarac. Shockbox, Battle Sports’ Impact Indicator i Reebok’s CheckLight nude se kao dodatna podrška trenerima. Riddell sada ove senzore ugrađuje direktno u novi model kacige, SpeedFlex, koja je od početka dizajnirana sa polimernim slojem koji reaguje na udarac. Deo na vrhu kacige ima fleksibilnu ploču koja se sabija i tako umanjuje silu sudara. U kacigu mogu biti ugrađeni InSite senzori koji šalju bežična upozorenja ukoliko igrač doživi posebno jak udarac ili više njih u nizu. Ajd kaže da kaciga ovako postaje „alat za prikupljanje informacija“. Portparolka Riddella navodi da će SpeedFlex izaći na tržište pred početak fudbalske sezone 2014. Nisu svi uvereni u učinkovitost. Prošlogodišnja testiranja pokazala su da neke kacige nisu slale upozorenja čak ni nakon ozbiljnih udaraca. Lekari upozoravaju da pogrešni senzori mogu dati lažni osećaj sigurnosti. “Ove tehnologije mogu biti korisne ako se koriste oprezno i ne preuveličavaju značenje,” rekao je dr Džefri Kačer, direktor Michigan NeuroSport klinike. „Može biti opasno oslanjati se samo na to." Riddell i drugi proizvođači naglašavaju da proizvodi nisu namenjeni dijagnostikovanju ili lečenju potresa. Namenjeni su da pruže dodatne informacije pri odlučivanju kada povući igrača iz igre. Ajd smatra da SpeedFlex donosi dodatne bezbednosne koristi. “Može pomoći da se prepoznaju igrači koji često udaraju glavom. Višestruka upozorenja mogu značiti da igrač treba da promeni stil igre, što može dodatno poboljšati bezbednost.”

article_content: The recent addition of metal studs to the entrance alcove of a high-end apartment complex on Southwark Bridge Road in South London has triggered significant backlash from religious leaders and homeless advocacy organizations. Intended to prevent homeless individuals from sleeping near the building’s front door, these one-inch-high studs were installed after residents voiced concerns about people sleeping rough in the area. Not everyone welcomed this intervention. Reverend Sally Hitchiner, who drew attention to the studs with a photo on social media, condemned them for sending a 'negative message' and likened the treatment of vulnerable people to that of nuisance animals. ‘It’s deeply upsetting and even makes me feel physically sick,’ she said. Katharine Sacks-Jones from the homelessness charity Crisis echoed this criticism, arguing that simply displacing rough sleepers fails to address the deeper challenges they face, such as mental health struggles and addiction. Conversely, some residents expressed support for the measure. Estefania Moreno, a resident, explained that the move helped keep the entrance cleaner, as the area had previously been occupied by people sleeping there. Flats in the building sell for around £400,000 per one-bedroom unit.

Ovi šiljci, visoki oko jedan inč, postavljeni su nakon što su stanari izrazili zabrinutost zbog osoba koje su spavale ispred glavnog ulaza. Međutim, nisu svi podržali ovu odluku. Sveštenica Sali Hičiner, koja je putem društvenih mreža objavila fotografiju spornih šiljaka, osudila je potez uz komentar da šalje negativnu poruku i da tretman ranjivih ljudi podseća na odnos prema štetočinama. 'To me duboko uznemirava i fizički mi je loše zbog toga,' rekla je. Katarina Saks-Džons iz dobrotvorne organizacije Crisis složila se sa kritikom, navodeći da proterivanje beskućnika ne rešava dublje probleme, kao što su mentalno zdravlje i zavisnosti. Sa druge strane, neki stanari podržali su ovu meru. Estefanija Moreno, stanovnica zgrade, objasnila je da je potez doprineo čistoći ulaza, jer su ranije ljudi spavali na tom mestu. Stanovi u ovom objektu koštaju oko 400.000 funti za jednosoban stan.

article_content: A ground invasion and a longer, more sustained war are likely, and an Israeli attempt to forcibly remove Palestinians from Gaza is possible. However, there remains a possibility for diplomacy. A boy, Muhammed Abu Louli, is shown convulsing, wide-eyed and covered in ash and debris after surviving an Israeli air strike on the Gaza Strip. Comforted by a doctor, Muhammed breaks down in tears. On another night in Gaza, veteran Al Jazeera journalist Wael Dahdouh learns live on air that an Israeli strike has killed his wife, son, daughter, and grandchild. Throughout the blockaded enclave, overworked doctors struggle to treat the wounded, sometimes recognizing their own relatives among the victims. Tents have appeared in southern Gaza to shelter those fleeing Israeli bombings. Displaced Palestinians say the scenes are reminiscent of the Nakba in 1948, when many were forced to flee their homes. These scenes have unfolded in Gaza for weeks, as Israel’s retaliatory assault continues following Hamas’s incursion into Israeli territory on October 7. Casualties are rising, with the death toll in Gaza surpassing 7,000 people, including many children. Israel has been amassing military hardware and troops, and conducting limited ground operations as preparation for a larger offensive. The most likely scenarios include a prolonged, devastating war or possible diplomatic mediation—though the latter faces many challenges, particularly relating to Western influence. An extreme outcome would be the reoccupation of Gaza, or expulsion of all Palestinians from the territory, comparable to notorious urban sieges such as Stalingrad, Grozny, or Mariupol, according to strategic analyst Zoran Kusovac. Such urban warfare in Gaza would likely result in substantial civilian casualties, with fighting potentially beginning at night, when Israeli forces have an advantage, Kusovac added. Gaza’s network of tunnels, controlled by Hamas, could hinder an Israeli offensive but Israel possesses advanced technology to target these tunnels. This conflict differs from previous Israeli operations due to increased military force and higher casualties, says Loreley Hahn-Herrera, a SOAS lecturer. She describes Israel’s response as one of vengeance, primarily involving widespread bombings. Historian Zachary Foster notes that the scale of violence exceeds previous conflicts such as those in 2008 and 2014. For example, Israel dropped over 6,000 bombs in five days after October 7—more than during the entire 2014 conflict. Israel now destroys entire neighborhoods, with little attempt to distinguish between military and civilian targets, Foster said. The current siege—including extended cuts to food, water, and electricity—is unprecedented, Foster added. He is also documenting statements by Israeli politicians and commentators suggesting aggressive intentions, noting 24 names as of October 20. If Israel delays a ground invasion, the likelihood of one decreases, Foster argues, since such a conflict would likely result in heavy losses and could escalate tensions with Hezbollah in Lebanon. Hamas is likely prepared for protracted guerrilla warfare using fortified tunnels—posing a major challenge for Israel. Foster maintains that a diplomatic solution is ultimately necessary, though it requires major concessions from both sides, such as Hamas releasing hostages and Israel relaxing the blockade. Diplomacy faces major obstacles, notably Arab states’ normalization with Israel, which has limited criticism and hindered agreement for de-escalation, analysts said. Arab leaders are criticized for failing to support the Palestinian cause, Hahn-Herrera noted. The United Nations Security Council has failed to pass ceasefire resolutions due to vetoes. Analysts blame the US administration under President Biden for prioritizing military approaches. Biden’s administration is seen as aligned with an ‘American agenda’ and as regarding the war as an opportunity to sell weapons. Countries advocating for peace have inadequate influence at the UN, said Haim Bresheeth. Western leaders have visited Israel, voicing support for its ‘right to defend itself’. A third scenario could see Israel reoccupying the Gaza Strip or expelling its Palestinian population. Hahn-Herrera contends this aligns with long-standing Israeli goals of maximizing land with minimal Palestinian presence. She argues that Israeli evacuation orders and ongoing strikes in southern Gaza suggest an intent to encourage further displacement of Palestinians. Despite this, many Palestinians have chosen to return to their homes in the north rather than evacuate. Anis Mohsen hears from friends in Gaza who returned north after attacks on southern shelters, echoing the sentiment that Palestinians should remain on their land. Egypt has refused to allow a mass influx of Palestinians into Sinai, citing concerns about permanent displacement. Kusovac observes that calls to clear Gaza entirely remain on the political fringes in Israel but have gained traction recently. If enacted, such policies would result in the end of Hamas presence in Gaza and potentially allow additional Israeli settlements, Kusovac said. Historian Foster warns that, regardless of the outcome, ordinary Palestinians in Gaza are likely to continue suffering worsening conditions, with no real improvement or easing of the blockade expected. He describes Gaza as resembling an open-air prison, forgotten by the international community. Despite grave circumstances, there are signs of a shift in global discourse as more people witness the conflict’s impact online, noted Hahn-Herrera. Bresheeth emphasizes that there are no winners in this crisis, attributing responsibility both to Israeli leadership and to Western governments supporting Israel. Follow Al Jazeera English.
translated_content: Kopnena invazija i duži, intenzivniji rat su verovatni, a izraelski pokušaj prinudnog proterivanja Palestinaca iz Gaze je moguć. Ipak, mogućnost za diplomatiju i dalje postoji. Dečak, Muhamed Abu Louli, prikazan je kako se trese, širom otvorenih očiju i prekriven pepelom i ruševinama nakon što je preživeo izraelski vazdušni napad na Pojas Gaze. Posle utehe od strane lekara, Muhamed brizne u plač. Jedne večeri u Gazi, novinar Al Jazeere, Vail Dahdu, saznaje uživo u programu da je izraelski napad ubio njegovu ženu, sina, ćerku i unuče. U blokiranoj enklavi iscrpljeni lekari pokušavaju da pruže pomoć ranjenima, ponekad prepoznajući svoje rođake među žrtvama. U južnoj Gazi pojavili su se šatori za one koji beže od izraelskog bombardovanja. Raseljeni Palestinci kažu da su ove scene podsećanje na Nakbu iz 1948. godine, kada su mnogi bili primorani da napuste svoje domove. Ove slike viđaju se nedeljama u Gazi, dok izraelski napadi traju kao odgovor na upad Hamasa na izraelsku teritoriju 7. oktobra. Broj žrtava raste, a broj poginulih u Gazi premašio je 7.000, među kojima je mnogo dece. Izrael gomila vojnu opremu i trupe, i sprovodi ograničene kopnene operacije kao pripremu za širu ofanzivu. Najizgledniji scenariji uključuju produženi, razorni rat ili moguće diplomatsko posredovanje — iako ono nosi brojne izazove, posebno vezane za zapadni uticaj. Ekstreman ishod bio bi ponovna okupacija Gaze ili proterivanje svih Palestinaca, što se poredi sa opsadama kao što su Staljingrad, Grozni ili Mariupolj, prema rečima Zorana Kusovca. Takvo urbano ratovanje u Gazi verovatno bi proizvelo velike civilne žrtve, a borbe bi mogle početi noću, kada izraelske snage imaju prednost, dodaje Kusovac. Mreža tunela u Gazi, koju kontroliše Hamas, može otežati izraelsku ofanzivu, ali Izrael poseduje naprednu tehnologiju za napad na te tunele. Ovaj sukob razlikuje se od prethodnih izraelskih operacija zbog povećane vojne sile i većeg broja žrtava, kaže Loreli Han-Erera sa SOAS-a. Ona izraelski odgovor opisuje kao osvetnički, sa širokim bombardovanjem. Istoričar Zakarija Foster zapaža da nivo nasilja prevazilazi ranije sukobe iz 2008. i 2014. Izrael je, na primer, ispustio više od 6.000 bombi u pet dana nakon 7. oktobra — više nego tokom celog sukoba 2014. Izrael sada uništava čitave četvrti, sa malo razlike između vojnih i civilnih ciljeva, kaže Foster. Sadašnja opsada — sa dugim prekidima u snabdevanju hranom, vodom i strujom — bez presedana je, dodaje Foster. On takođe beleži izjave izraelskih političara i komentatora o agresivnim namerama, navodeći 24 imena do 20. oktobra. Ako Izrael odloži kopnenu invaziju, verovatnoća za njen početak opada, smatra Foster, jer bi takav sukob doveo do velikih gubitaka i moguće eskalacije s Hezbolahom. Hamas je verovatno spreman za dugotrajan gerilski rat koristeći utvrđene tunele — što je ozbiljan izazov za Izrael. Foster smatra da je diplomatsko rešenje nužno, ali zahteva značajne ustupke obe strane: oslobađanje talaca od strane Hamasa i ublažavanje blokade od strane Izraela. Diplomatija je suočena s ozbiljnim preprekama, uključujući normalizaciju odnosa arapskih država s Izraelom, što je ograničilo kritiku i otežalo dogovore, kažu analitičari. Arapski lideri kritikovani su zbog izostanka podrške palestinskoj stvari, ističe Han-Erera. Savet bezbednosti UN nije uspeo da donese rezoluciju protiv sukoba zbog prava veta. Analitičari okrivljuju američku administraciju pod predsednikom Bajdenom za prioritizovanje vojnih rešenja. Bajdenova administracija posmatra konflikt kao priliku za prodaju oružja, navode neki analitičari. Zemlje koje zagovaraju mir nemaju dovoljno uticaja u UN, kaže Haim Brešit. Zapadni lideri su posećivali Izrael i izražavali podršku njegovom 'pravu na odbranu'. Treći scenario može biti ponovna okupacija Gaze ili proterivanje Palestinaca sa te teritorije. Han-Erera smatra da to odražava dugogodišnje izraelske težnje za maksimalnom teritorijom uz što manje palestinsko stanovništvo. Ona tvrdi da izraelske naredbe za evakuaciju i napadi na jug Gaze sugerišu nameru da se podstakne dalje raseljavanje. Ipak, mnogi Palestinci odlučuju da se vrate na sever umesto da izbegnu. Anis Mohsen iznosi iskustva prijatelja iz Gaze koji su se vratili nakon napada na skloništa na jugu, uz osećaj da Palestinci treba da ostanu na svojoj zemlji. Egipat je odbio masovni prijem Palestinaca u Sinaj, zabrinut oko trajnog raseljavanja. Kusovac navodi da su pozivi na potpuno 'čišćenje' Gaze još uvek na političkim marginama u Izraelu, ali dobijaju sve više pristaša. Ako bi takva politika bila sprovedena, to bi značilo kraj Hamasovog prisustva i otvaranje prostora za nova izraelska naselja, navodi Kusovac. Foster upozorava da će, bez obzira na ishod, obični Palestinci u Gazi nastaviti da pate, bez izglednog poboljšanja ili ublažavanja blokade. On opisuje Gazu kao otvoreni zatvor, zaboravljen od međunarodne zajednice. Uprkos ozbiljnoj situaciji, postoje znaci promene javnog diskursa na Zapadu jer se više ljudi na internetu upoznaje s posledicama sukoba, ističe Han-Erera. Brešit naglašava da u ovoj krizi nema pravih pobednika, kriveći izraelsko rukovodstvo i zapadne vlade koje podržavaju Izrael. Pratite Al Jazeera English.

article_content: Seamus Heaney, the renowned Irish poet whose evocative portrayals of rural life captured the complexities of Ireland's sectarian divide, died on Friday at the age of 74, according to his publisher Faber & Faber. Heaney passed away in Dublin after a brief illness. Heaney was one of the most widely read poets of the last century, bringing the tradition of Irish authorship into an era marked by violence in late twentieth-century Ireland. Irish Prime Minister Enda Kenny said, 'We are blessed to call Seamus Heaney our own and thankful for the gift of him in our national life. He belongs with Joyce, Yeats, Shaw, and Beckett among our greatest literary figures.' Like Yeats, Shaw, and Beckett, Heaney won the Nobel Prize in Literature. The prize committee cited his 'works of lyrical beauty and ethical depth, which exalt everyday miracles and the living past.' Born in 1939 on a farm in County Londonderry, Northern Ireland, Heaney drew upon personal experiences and rural heritage in his poetry. The eldest of nine children in a Catholic family, Heaney described his father as 'a creature of the archaic world' who would have felt at home in a Gaelic hill-fort. In his poem 'Follower' from 'Death of a Naturalist,' Heaney reflected on his father's farming life, idealizing him while also acknowledging generational shifts. Although Heaney's family spoke English and had few books at home, he attended boarding school in Derry at age 12 and later studied English literature at Queen's University, Belfast. Derry, with its Protestant rule over a mostly Catholic population, became a focal point of Northern Ireland's sectarian conflict. Heaney moved to Dublin in 1972, where he wrote poetry reflecting his navigation between support for the Irish nationalist movement and his roots in the British-ruled North. After 'Death of a Naturalist,' Heaney achieved both critical and popular acclaim. His poetry encompassed a variety of themes, from love to meditations on Ireland's Troubles. His collection 'North,' published in 1975 during a period of intense conflict, explored Ireland’s divisions. Despite his work engaging with political themes, Heaney insisted he was inspired more by personal experience than political motive. He said, 'What matters is the shape-making impulse, the emergence and convergence of an excitement into a wholeness. I don't think I'm a political poet with political themes and a specifically political understanding of the world.' Heaney’s personal perspective on Ireland’s struggles for peace earned him a prominent role in the country’s modern history. Bill and Hillary Clinton, the former U.S. president and first lady, wrote, 'His mind, heart, and uniquely Irish gift for language made him our finest poet of the rhythms of ordinary lives and a powerful voice for peace. And he was a good and true friend.' Bill Clinton helped broker the 1999 Good Friday Agreement in Northern Ireland. Later, Heaney produced translations of major works, including a highly regarded version of 'Beowulf.' He served as Professor of Poetry at Oxford University from 1989 and held academic posts at Harvard University for over 20 years. Heaney is survived by his wife, Marie, and three children.
translated_content: Šejmus Hini, poznati irski pesnik čije je slikovito prikazivanje seoskog života obuhvatilo i složenosti verskih podela u Irskoj, preminuo je u petak u 74. godini, saopštila je njegova izdavačka kuća Faber & Faber. Hini je preminuo u Dablinu posle kratke bolesti. Hini je bio jedan od najčitanijih pesnika prošlog veka, unoseći tradiciju irske književnosti u doba obeleženo nasiljem u kasnom dvadesetom veku. Irski premijer Enda Keni kazao je: 'Blagosloveni smo što možemo Šejmusa Hinija zvati našim i zahvalni smo na njegovom daru za naš nacionalni život. On pripada Džojsu, Jejtsu, Šou i Beketu među našim najvećim književnicima.' Poput Jejtsa, Šoa i Beketa, Hini je osvojio Nobelovu nagradu za književnost. Odbor za nagradu naveo je njegova 'dela lirske lepote i etičke dubine, koja uzdižu svakodnevna čuda i živu prošlost.' Rođen 1939. na farmi u okrugu Londonderi u Severnoj Irskoj, Hini je u svojoj poeziji često koristio lična iskustva i seosku tradiciju. Kao najstariji od devetoro dece u katoličkoj porodici, Hini je svog oca opisao kao 'stvorenje arhaičnog sveta' koje bi se, kako sam kaže, snalazilo u galskoj utvrdi. U pesmi 'Pratilac' iz zbirke 'Smrt prirodnjaka', Hini razmišlja o očevom farmerskom životu, idealizujući ga ali i primećujući generacijske promene. Iako su u njegovoj porodici govorili engleski i imali malo knjiga, Hini je sa 12 godina pohađao internat u Deriju, a potom studirao englesku književnost na Kraljičinom univerzitetu u Belfastu. DERI, u kojem su protestanti upravljali većinskim katoličkim stanovništvom, kasnije je postao središte sukoba u Severnoj Irskoj. Hini se 1972. preselio u Dablin, gde je pisao pesme koje su prikazivale njegov položaj između podrške irskom nacionalističkom pokretu i veze sa rodnim britanskim Severom. Nakon 'Smrti prirodnjaka', Hini je stekao i kritičku i narodnu naklonost. Njegova poezija obrađivala je razne teme, od ljubavi do meditacija o irskim problemima. Njegova zbirka 'Sever', objavljena 1975. tokom perioda intenzivnih sukoba, istraživala je podele u Irskoj. Iako su njegova dela često imala političke teme, Hini je tvrdio da je više inspirisan ličnim iskustvom nego politikom. Rekao je: 'Bitno je stvaralačko nagnuće, iznenadni nastanak i upotpunjavanje uzbuđenja. Ne smatram da sam politički pesnik sa posebno političkim pogledom na svet.' Hini je svojim ličnim pogledom na irsku borbu za mir stekao značajno mesto u savremenoj istoriji zemlje. Bil i Hilari Klinton, bivši američki predsednik i prva dama, napisali su: 'Njegov um, srce i jedinstveni irski dar za jezik učinili su ga našim najboljim pesnikom svakodnevnog života i snažnim glasom za mir. Bio je i pravi prijatelj.' Bil Klinton je pomogao u postizanju Sporazuma na Veliki petak 1999. u Severnoj Irskoj. Kasnije se Hini bavio prevodima velikih dela, uključujući veoma cenjenu verziju 'Beovulfa'. Bio je profesor poezije na Oksford univerzitetu od 1989. godine i više od 20 godina je radio na Harvardu. Hini je iza sebe ostavio suprugu Mariju i troje dece.

article_content: Many diners prefer to keep their chicken and soda separate, but Lay's—part of the U.S. snack giant PepsiCo—is betting that Chinese consumers are more willing to experiment. The Chinese division of Lay's has introduced a variety of unusual potato chip flavors, including a Pepsi and chicken combination, aiming to capture the attention of China's increasingly adventurous and affluent snackers. This unique flavor is just one among several creative options offered by the global brand, which also owns Pepsi. Other Lay's flavors designed for the Chinese market include Numb and Spicy Hot Pot, Cheese Lobster, Hot and Sour Fish Soup, and Braised Pork. Competitors have also joined the trend, releasing products like Kimchi (inspired by the Korean fermented vegetable dish), Tomato Seafood, and even a combination of Chicken Wing and Pizza on a single chip. China, with its rapid economic growth—averaging 10 percent over the past three decades—has become a key market for companies seeking future expansion, and Western snack brands are adapting their products to appeal to local tastes. Though these flavors may seem unusual from a Western perspective, their popularity in China highlights different cultural preferences. The Shanghaiist blog reviewed some of these chips, describing certain flavors as an 'overload of sodium, corn syrup, and chemicals' with textures comparable to 'stale McDonald's fries'. Shanghaiist's food editor highlighted eight of the most unusual finds. The Pepsi and Chicken chips were noted for blending the cinnamon sweetness of Pepsi with a flavor reminiscent of roast chicken, while Cheese and Lobster received mixed reviews, compared to a toddler playing a piano—occasionally a recognizable note, but often ambiguous.
translated_content: Većina ljudi voli da drži pileće meso i gazirane napitke odvojeno, ali Lay's—deo američkog giganta za grickalice PepsiCo—veruje da su kineski potrošači spremniji na eksperimente. Kineski ogranak Lay's-a predstavio je niz neobičnih ukusa čipsa, uključujući i kombinaciju Pepsi-ja i piletine, sa ciljem da privuče pažnju sve avanturističkijih i imućnijih uživalaca grickalica u Kini. Ovaj jedinstveni ukus je samo jedan od mnogo kreativnih izbora koje nudi ovaj globalni brend, koji je ujedno i vlasnik Pepsi-ja. Ostali Lay’s ukusi, namenjeni kineskom tržištu, uključuju: 'Numb and Spicy Hot Pot', 'Cheese Lobster', 'Hot and Sour Fish Soup' i 'Braised Pork'. Konkurentske firme su takođe uhvatile trend, lansirajući proizvode kao što su kimči (inspirisan korejskim jelom od fermentisanog povrća), Tomato Seafood i čak kombinaciju Chicken Wing & Pizza na jednom čipsu. Kina, sa svojim brzim ekonomskim razvojem—prosečan rast od 10 odsto tokom poslednje tri decenije—postala je ključno tržište za kompanije koje traže nove prilike, a zapadni brendovi grickalica prilagođavaju svoje proizvode lokalnim ukusima. Iako se ovi ukusi mogu činiti neobičnim iz zapadne perspektive, njihova popularnost u Kini odražava različite kulturne preferencije. Blog Shanghaiist je testirao neke od ovih čipseva i opisao ih kao 'eksploziju natrijuma, kukuruznog sirupa i hemikalija', sa teksturom sličnom 'ustajalim pomfritima iz McDonaldsa'. Urednik hrane sa Shanghaiist-a izdvojio je osam najneobičnijih ukusa. Čips sa ukusom Pepsi-ja i piletine je pohvaljen kao uspešan spoj cimeta iz Pepsi-ja i arome pečenog mesa, dok je 'Cheese and Lobster' dobio podeljene ocene—upoređen je sa detetom koje svira klavir; povremeno prepoznate note, ali često nejasne.

On the technical front, the 200-day moving average (DMA) for SRF Ltd. stood at Rs 2,050.00 as of November 21, and the 50-day moving average was Rs 2,283.43. Trading above both averages often signals an uptrend; below both signals a downtrend; between averages leaves direction uncertain. The department has issued notices to 45 brands and expects to send more. article_content: The Bank of England's chief economist, Andy Haldane, has indicated that interest rates are likely to stay 'lower for longer' as the UK’s recovery from the Great Recession slows. Haldane described the current economic outlook as 'jobs-rich, pay-poor,' expressing concern over weak global growth, minimal wage increases, and ongoing political and financial risks. Haldane's outlook contrasts with that of fellow Bank of England Monetary Policy Committee member Martin Weale, who has consistently advocated for raising interest rates, positioning himself against the majority. Speaking to business leaders in Kenilworth, Warwickshire, Haldane stated, 'Put in rather plainer English, I am gloomier.' He suggested that rates could remain low for longer than he anticipated three months ago, noting a shift in economic indicators that now support a more cautious approach. Three months prior, Haldane had argued for an earlier increase in rates, but now he sees the evidence favoring delayed action, possibly until after the General Election in May. He emphasized the complex state of the economy, highlighting strong employment and output gains offset by weak wage and productivity growth—a 'jobs-rich but pay-poor' scenario. Interest rates have not increased since July 2007 and have been at 0.5% since March 2009. While this has allowed mortgage borrowers to benefit from record-low rates, savers have seen minimal returns. The recent economic recovery, marked by a 6% unemployment rate—the lowest in nearly six years—previously sparked speculation about imminent rate hikes. However, the ongoing crisis in the Eurozone and concerns about global economic growth have shifted expectations. Official data shows inflation fell to 1.2% in September, its lowest in five years and well below the Bank’s target of 2%, giving policymakers room to maintain low rates. Within the MPC, two of nine members have called for a rate increase, but have been outvoted. Martin Weale, one of the dissenters, believes current conditions warrant tightening monetary policy. He notes that falling oil prices and a strong pound—factors outside the Bank's control—are contributing to low inflation, and warns that waiting too long to raise rates could necessitate sharper increases later. Economist Dr Howard Archer from IHS Global Insight forecasts a gradual rise in interest rates: to 1% by the end of 2015, 2% by the end of 2016, and 3% by the end of 2017, as earnings growth remains weak, inflation stays subdued, and global uncertainties persist.

Haldane je aktuelnu ekonomsku situaciju opisao kao 'bogatu zaposlenjem, siromašnu platama', izražavajući zabrinutost zbog slabog globalnog rasta, niskog rasta plata i političkih i finansijskih rizika. Haldaneovo mišljenje razlikuje se od stava Martina Vilea, člana Monetarnog odbora Banke Engleske, koji dosledno zagovara povećanje kamatnih stopa i time se suprotstavlja većini. Pre tri meseca, Haldane je zagovarao ranije povećanje stopa, ali sada smatra da dokazi ukazuju na odlaganje te odluke, verovatno do nakon Opštih izbora u maju. Naglasio je kompleksnost ekonomije, ističući snažan rast zaposlenosti i proizvodnje, ali i slabu dinamiku plata i produktivnosti – situacija 'zaposlenost bogata, plate siromašne'. Kamatne stope nisu povećavane od jula 2007. i na nivou su od 0,5% od marta 2009. Ovo je omogućilo korisnicima hipotekarnih kredita da imaju rekordno niske kamate, dok su štediše imale minimalne prinose. Oporavak ekonomije, sa stopom nezaposlenosti od 6% – najnižom u skoro šest godina – ranije je podstakao nagađanja o skorom povećanju kamata. Međutim, kontinuirana kriza u evrozoni i zabrinutost zbog globalnog ekonomskog rasta promenili su ta očekivanja. Zvanični podaci pokazuju da je inflacija pala na 1,2% u septembru, što je najniži nivo u poslednjih pet godina i znatno ispod cilja Banke od 2%, zbog čega kreatori politike imaju prostora da zadrže niske kamate. U Monetarnom odboru, dvoje od devet članova zalaže se za povećanje kamata, ali su preglasani. Martin Vile, jedan od tih članova, smatra da trenutni uslovi zahtevaju pooštravanje monetarne politike. On navodi da su na nisku inflaciju uticali pad cena nafte i jačanje funte – faktori izvan kontrole Banke – i upozorava da odlaganje povećanja može dovesti do naglog rasta kamata kasnije. Ekonomista dr Hauard Arčer iz IHS Global Insight-a predviđa postepeni rast kamata: na 1% do kraja 2015, 2% do kraja 2016. i 3% do kraja 2017, kako rast zarada ostaje slab, inflacija niska, a globalna neizvesnost traje.

article_content: Chinese mining company MMG Ltd's shares soared on Tuesday, reaching their highest level in nearly eight weeks, after the firm agreed to acquire Canada-based Cuprous Capital—the parent company of Botswana's Khoemacau copper mine—in a deal valuing the enterprise at $1.88 billion. MMG has spent over a year seeking copper assets as global demand for the metal, crucial to the green energy transition, continues to rise. MMG's shares climbed as much as 7.5% to HK$2.45 during morning trading, marking their most significant single-day gain since April and their highest level since September 29. In a statement, MMG Chairman Jiqing Xu called the Khoemacau acquisition 'an important step in achieving our vision of creating a leading international mining company for a low carbon future,' adding that it would generate significant long-term value for shareholders. China—the world's largest consumer of refined copper—has recently increased its copper smelting capacity, but faces challenges in securing sufficient copper concentrate amid slower growth in mining output. In September, Reuters reported at least three South African miners competed to buy Khoemacau, which hosts one of Africa's largest copper deposits, as strong demand for copper drives fierce competition for the prized asset. Khoemacau is located in the Kalahari Copper Belt, which extends from northeast Botswana to western Namibia. The mine currently produces about 60,000 tons of copper and 2 million ounces of silver annually, with the potential to boost output to approximately 130,000 tons of copper and 5 million ounces of silver each year given additional investment. In its Tuesday filing, MMG said it intends to fund the Cuprous Capital acquisition using a mix of shareholder loans and third-party financing. The deal requires regulatory approval in both China and Botswana and is expected to close in the first half of 2024. Macquarie Capital and Citigroup are serving as joint financial advisors on the deal.

Khoemacau se nalazi u Kalahari Copper Beltu, području koje se prostire od severoistočne Bocvane do zapadne Namibije. article_content: England’s disappointing campaign at the 2023 Cricket World Cup has raised tough questions for the reigning champions, with few straightforward answers. Their elimination was confirmed by a 33-run defeat to Australia in Ahmedabad—England’s sixth loss in seven matches, putting them last in the ten-team standings. Even the Netherlands, the lowest-ranked side, have claimed two wins. Once boasting a formidable batting lineup, England faltered in pursuit of a 287-run target, managing only a single individual century from Dawid Malan. Key batsmen Jonny Bairstow and Joe Root have struggled to perform, and the team has lacked consistency. Early losses to New Zealand and Afghanistan prompted a shift away from an all-rounder-heavy selection policy, followed by indecision as management sought the right formula. Ambiguity extended to England’s batting tactics, with players uncertain whether to pursue all-out aggression—a strategy successful under former skipper Eoin Morgan—or build cautious foundations before accelerating. Scrutiny now focuses on captain Jos Buttler and coach Matthew Mott, though changes seem unlikely with the T20 World Cup looming in the US and West Indies. Only four players from the original 15-man squad are under 30, making the prospect of rebuilding more complex. During the tournament, the ECB unveiled new central contracts, including multi-year deals, for most of the squad—excluding David Willey, who subsequently announced his international retirement. Fast bowler Mark Wood, despite injury concerns and modest tournament results, secured a three-year contract. Ex-captain Michael Vaughan criticized the ECB, suggesting they overreacted to fears of losing players to franchise cricket, and insisted England should select only those with strong national commitment. The decline in domestic one-day cricket, due to the rise of The Hundred, and a reduced schedule of ODIs—42 this cycle versus 88 ahead of 2019—have hampered the emergence of new limited-overs talent. Many matches featured weakened lineups, reflecting the challenge of balancing England’s international commitments. Resulting complacency has been exposed in India. Harry Brook may be recalled for the final matches, but England must finish in the top eight to qualify for the 2025 Champions Trophy. Further defeats to the Netherlands or Pakistan could see them miss a major ICC men’s event for the first time ever. This situation presents the biggest challenge of Rob Key’s tenure as managing director, which until now has enjoyed positive results, especially with the Test side. Captain Buttler reflected: 'We've let ourselves down. We've let down people at home, who support us through thick and thin, and we wear that on our own shoulders.' --- Other business news: Saab secured India’s first 100% FDI defense project; SBI reported an 8% profit increase due to strong loan demand; and Byju’s posted substantial revenue growth alongside continued losses.

article_content: Mumbai has seen a worrying rise in the number of minor girls dying by suicide, according to recent police data. In one case, a 15-year-old girl from the western suburbs died by suicide in April after repeated conflicts with her parents over phone use and previous attempts at self-harm. In another suburb, a ninth-grade student ended her life after being blackmailed with photographs. These incidents highlight a broader trend. Data obtained from Mumbai Police under the RTI Act shows that from 2019 to 2022, 231 underage girls died by suicide—a number 23% higher than that of boys, which was 188. Conversely, among adults, men are three times likelier than women to die by suicide: 3,765 men and 1,260 women over the four-year period. Suicide is among the world’s top ten causes of death according to the World Health Organization. In Mumbai, suicide deaths increased by 22%—from 1,229 in 2019 to 1,499 in 2022. Experts say that the main causes among adults include family and financial stress. For minors, the reasons may differ. Dr. Samya Shinde, head of the sociology department at LS Raheja College, points to stress, relationship gaslighting, reluctance to confide in family, and stricter parental restrictions for girls. She also notes that body-shaming can be a significant trigger. Cyber psychologist Nirali Bhatia agrees, adding that bullying and body image issues are increasingly reported by girls, especially due to social media influences. Her cyberbullying prevention app now includes outreach to young people expressing suicidal thoughts. Dr. Bharat Shah, former psychiatry professor at Somaiya Hospital, also attributes rising suicide rates among girls to social media pressures and Western influences. Suryakant Yadav, assistant professor at the International Institute for Population Sciences, observes that the trend of higher teenage girl suicide rates is visible nationwide, citing both Mumbai police and National Crime Records Bureau data. However, he notes that while the increase is visible in Mumbai, the national rise isn't statistically significant in absolute numbers. Mumbai police data also shows that most adult suicide victims are men aged 18-29. According to Dr. Yadav, men are more affected by unemployment and economic hardship, whereas women often have stronger social support networks to cope with stress. An NGO, the MPower Foundation, lists social isolation, the death of a spouse, divorce, and unemployment as major risk factors for suicide among adults aged 18–45. Warning signs include withdrawal from others, substance abuse, giving away possessions, or changes in personality. The largest year-on-year increase in suicides (12%) came between 2020 and 2021, during the onset of the Covid-19 pandemic. Lockdowns led to job insecurity, impacted incomes, disrupted family relationships, and harmed mental health. Experts emphasize that effective suicide prevention requires addressing social, psychological, and economic factors together. While suicide has been decriminalized, destigmatization remains a serious challenge.

U drugom predgrađu, učenica devetog razreda oduzela je sebi život nakon što je bila ucenjivana slikama. Ovi slučajevi ukazuju na širi problem. Podaci dobijeni od policije u Mumbaju prema Zakonu o pravu na informisanje pokazuju da je od 2019. do 2022. godine 231 maloletna devojčica izvršila samoubistvo—što je za 23% više nego dečaka, kojih je bilo 188. Kod odraslih, muškarci su tri puta češće izvršavali samoubistvo od žena: u istom periodu, 3.765 muškaraca i 1.260 žena. Prema Svetskoj zdravstvenoj organizaciji, samoubistvo je među deset vodećih uzroka smrti u svetu. U Mumbaju je broj samoubistava porastao za 22%—sa 1.229 u 2019. godini na 1.499 u 2022. Stručnjaci navode da su glavni uzroci kod odraslih porodični i finansijski problemi. Kod maloletnika razlozi mogu biti drugačiji. Dr Samya Shinde, šefica odseka za sociologiju na LS Raheja koledžu, ukazuje na stres, gaslajting u vezama, nevoljnost da se poveri porodici i stroža roditeljska ograničenja za devojčice. Ona takođe navodi da ismevanje izgleda može biti značajan okidač. Sajber psihološkinja Nirali Bhatia se slaže i dodaje da devojčice sve češće prijavljuju maltretiranje i probleme sa sopstvenim izgledom, posebno zbog uticaja društvenih mreža. Njena aplikacija za prevenciju sajber-nasilja sada uključuje podršku mladima koji izražavaju suicidne misli. Dr Bharat Shah, bivši profesor psihijatrije na bolnici Somaiya, porast samoubistava među devojčicama pripisuje pritisku društvenih mreža i zapadnim uticajima. Suryakant Yadav, docent Međunarodnog instituta za populacione nauke, navodi da je trend više samoubistava među adolescentkinjama primetan širom zemlje, pozivajući se na podatke policije iz Mumbaja i Nacionalnog biroa za evidenciju zločina. Ipak, on dodaje da povećanje na nacionalnom nivou nije statistički značajno u apsolutnim brojevima. Podaci policije iz Mumbaja takođe pokazuju da su većina odraslih žrtava samoubistva muškarci uzrasta od 18 do 29 godina. Prema rečima dr Yadava, muškarci trpe više zbog nezaposlenosti i ekonomskih problema, dok žene često imaju jaču društvenu podršku za prevazilaženje stresa. NVO MPower Foundation ističe da su socijalna izolacija, smrt supružnika, razvod i nezaposlenost glavni faktori rizika za samoubistvo kod odraslih starosti 18–45 godina. Znakovi upozorenja uključuju povlačenje iz društva, zloupotrebu supstanci, poklanjanje stvari ili promene u ličnosti. Najveći godišnji rast broja samoubistava (12%) zabeležen je između 2020. i 2021. godine, tokom izbijanja pandemije Covid-19. Zatvaranja su dovela do nesigurnosti posla, pada prihoda, narušenih porodičnih odnosa i pogoršanja mentalnog zdravlja. Stručnjaci naglašavaju da je za efikasnu prevenciju samoubistava potrebno istovremeno sagledati društvene, psihološke i ekonomske faktore. Iako je samoubistvo dekriminalizovano, destigmatizacija ostaje ozbiljan izazov.

article_content: Europe secured a decisive victory over the USA in the 2014 Ryder Cup at Gleneagles, winning 16½-11½. Celebrations erupted Sunday night, with Rory McIlroy sporting a red tartan kilt and wig as he shared lighthearted moments on social media. McIlroy later remarked it was disappointing that Phil Mickelson and USA captain Tom Watson didn't stay for the closing festivities, especially in light of Mickelson's public criticism of Watson's leadership. McIlroy also praised European captain Paul McGinley for his exceptional guidance during the tournament. Both European and American players joined the post-match revelry, with Rickie Fowler and Bubba Watson participating in Scottish-themed outfits. The evening featured friendly competitions, like table tennis, and celebrations that lasted into the early morning. Players such as Lee Westwood and Jamie Donaldson documented the celebrations online; Donaldson humorously admitted the magnitude of Europe’s win hadn’t fully sunk in as celebrations continued. Donaldson was credited with delivering the decisive stroke to clinch the win for Europe, prompting jubilant celebrations led by McGinley. Responding to criticism, Watson acknowledged he and Mickelson had different philosophies on leadership but expressed pride in how hard his team fought, conceding Europe faced a formidable opponent. Mickelson suggested that returning to a more collaborative team approach, as championed by Paul Azinger in 2008, could benefit future US squads. Throughout the celebrations and post-match analysis, European captain McGinley received widespread acclaim from his team, while camaraderie and good spirits marked the Ryder Cup’s conclusion.

McIlroy je takođe pohvalio kapitena Evrope Paula McGinleyja za izuzetno vođstvo tokom turnira. I evropski i američki igrači pridružili su se slavlju nakon meča, a Rickie Fowler i Bubba Watson su učestvovali u škotskim kostimima. Veče je uključivalo i prijateljska takmičenja, poput stonog tenisa, a slavlje je trajalo do ranih jutarnjih sati. Upravo je Donaldson zabeležio presudni udarac koji je osigurao trijumf Evropi, što je izazvalo euforiju predvođenu McGinleyjem. Odgovarajući na kritiku, Watson je priznao da on i Mickelson imaju različite filozofije vođstva, ali je izrazio ponos zbog borbe svoje ekipe i priznao da je Evropa bila snažan protivnik. Mickelson je predložio povratak na kooperativniji timski pristup, kakav je uspešno primenjivan pod vođstvom Paula Azingera 2008. godine. article_content: The Federal Government, through the Nigeria Civil Aviation Authority (NCAA), has advised pilots and airline operators to exercise caution during the dry season due to hazardous weather conditions. According to the NCAA, flights may be delayed, diverted, or cancelled if visibility at airports falls below the prescribed safety minimum. This warning follows an alert from the Nigerian Meteorological Agency (NiMET), which indicates that dust haze from neighboring regions, particularly Chad, is likely to reduce visibility across parts of Nigeria. The agency specifies that air-to-ground visibility may decrease due to haze, dust, or fog, and that severe dust haze can obscure runways and airport lighting, making visual navigation extremely difficult or impossible. The NCAA emphasizes the importance of all pilots, airline operators, and air traffic controllers adhering strictly to established safety protocols. These include closing airspace when necessary, ensuring strict compliance with published airport weather minima, and obtaining up-to-date weather briefings from NiMET's meteorological offices before every flight. Operators must take measures to mitigate the impact of delays or cancellations on passengers. The NCAA, in a statement signed by Director-General Musa Nuhu, also urges passengers to remain patient and understanding during this period, stressing that their safety is the top priority. NiMET’s latest report notes that strong winds favor the spread of dust haze into the northern regions of Nigeria, especially affecting areas such as Katsina, Kano, Nguru, Jigawa, Potiskum, and Maiduguri over the next 24 hours. Citizens are encouraged to plan their trips carefully during this period to avoid unexpected delays. Violations of these safety requirements will be taken seriously by the authorities. All stakeholders are advised to consult regular weather updates from NiMET to plan their operations effectively.
translated_content: Savezna vlada Nigerije, preko Nigerijske uprave za civilno vazduhoplovstvo (NCAA), savetovala je pilote i avioprevoznike da budu oprezni tokom sušne sezone zbog opasnih vremenskih uslova. Po rečima NCAA, letovi mogu biti odloženi, preusmereni ili otkazani ako vidljivost na aerodromima padne ispod propisanog bezbednosnog minimuma. Ovo upozorenje dolazi nakon najave Nigerijske meteorološke agencije (NiMET), koja navodi da će prašnjavi vazduh iz susednih regiona, posebno Čada, verovatno smanjiti vidljivost u pojedinim delovima Nigerije. Agencija navodi da može doći do smanjenja vidljivosti zbog izmaglice, prašine ili magle, i da u ozbiljnim slučajevima prašina može prekriti piste i svetla aerodroma, što čini vizuelnu navigaciju veoma otežanom ili nemogućom. NCAA naglašava važnost strogog poštovanja uspostavljenih bezbednosnih protokola od strane pilota, avioprevoznika i kontrolora letenja. Ovo uključuje zatvaranje vazdušnog prostora po potrebi, pridržavanje objavljenih meteoroloških minimuma za aerodrome i redovno dobijanje najnovijih vremenskih izveštaja od NiMET-ovih meteoroloških službi pre svakog leta. Prevoznici moraju preduzeti mere kako bi ublažili uticaj kašnjenja ili otkaza letova na putnike. NCAA, u saopštenju koje je potpisao generalni direktor Musa Nuhu, apeluje na putnike da budu strpljivi i razumevajući tokom ovog perioda, naglašavajući da je njihova bezbednost najvažnija. Najnoviji izveštaj NiMET-a navodi da jaki vetrovi pogoduju širenju prašnjavog vazduha ka severnim regionima Nigerije, posebno utičući na oblasti kao što su Katsina, Kano, Nguru, Jigawa, Potiskum i Maiduguri u naredna 24 sata. Građanima se savetuje da pažljivo planiraju svoja putovanja kako bi izbegli nepotrebna kašnjenja. Kršenje ovih bezbednosnih zahteva biće ozbiljno shvaćeno od strane vlasti. Svim zainteresovanim stranama preporučuje se redovno praćenje vremenskih izveštaja NiMET-a radi efikasnog planiranja svojih aktivnosti.

article_content:
In professional settings, introducing yourself is often necessary—whether it's giving an elevator pitch at a conference, answering “Tell me about yourself” in a job interview, or meeting new colleagues on a team project. The most effective self-introduction blends professional information, which establishes your credibility, with personal details that build rapport. Solely focusing on business can make you seem distant or self-promotional, while too much personal sharing may be inappropriate. Instead, share enjoyable and relevant facts about yourself that also hint at skills, experience, or attributes valued at work.

Four areas can help craft a memorable introduction:

1. Professional Motivation: What inspired your career? For example, a COO candidate once shared that a family health issue led him to biotech—a motivation that impressed the hiring team with his dedication. Explaining what drives you or how you chose your career path is both interesting and professionally relevant.

2. Personal Mission: What motivates you beyond work? A marketing candidate discussed her love for running and volunteering with an organization supporting blind runners. Although unrelated to marketing, her commitment shone through, building trust with interviewers. Sharing personal missions can highlight commitment and integrity, showing a well-rounded character.

3. Passionate Hobby: What brings you joy? Another candidate, a biotech leader and avid musician, connected with the hiring team over music. Hobbies outside work demonstrate passion, dedication, and provide new ways to relate to colleagues or interviewers.

4. Energy Source: How do you sustain your stamina? At an investment firm, a sales candidate stood out by remaining energetic after a demanding day of interviews—showcasing endurance and enthusiasm valued by the employer. Sharing your involvement in challenging activities, like sports, can emphasize your energy and drive.

To find fun facts for your introduction, list activities, recent achievements outside work, and volunteer commitments. These details can reveal your enthusiasm, passions, and both professional and personal drive.
translated_content:
U profesionalnim okruženjima, predstavljanje je često neophodno—bilo da dajete kratak govor na konferenciji, odgovarate na pitanje „Recite mi nešto o sebi“ na intervjuu za posao ili upoznajete nove kolege na timskom projektu. Najefikasnije predstavljanje kombinuje profesionalne informacije, koje potvrđuju vašu kredibilnost, sa ličnim detaljima koji grade poverenje. Ako se fokusirate samo na posao, možete delovati distancirano ili previše samopromotivno, dok previše ličnih informacija može biti neprimereno. Umesto toga, delite zanimljive i relevantne informacije o sebi koje otkrivaju veštine, iskustva ili osobine koji su cenjeni na poslu.

Četiri oblasti mogu vam pomoći da osmislite upečatljivo predstavljanje:

1. Profesionalna motivacija: Šta vas je inspirisalo za karijeru? Na primer, jedan kandidat za izvršnog direktora podelio je da ga je zdravstveni problem u porodici naveo na biotehnologiju—ta motivacija je impresionirala komisiju zbog njegove posvećenosti. Objašnjavanje šta vas pokreće ili kako ste izabrali svoj karijerni put interesantno je i profesionalno relevantno.

2. Lična misija: Šta vas pokreće osim posla? Kandidatkinja za marketing podelila je ljubav prema trčanju i volontiranju u organizaciji koja podržava slepe trkače. Iako to nije vezano za marketing, njena posvećenost se jasno videla i izgradila je poverenje sa ispitivačima. Deljenje lične misije može istaknuti vašu posvećenost i integritet i pokazati vas kao zaokruženu ličnost.

3. Strastveni hobi: Šta vas ispunjava? Drugi kandidat, lider u biotehnologiji i zaljubljenik u muziku, povezao se sa komisijom preko interesovanja za muziku. Hobiji van posla pokazuju vašu strast, posvećenost i nude nove načine za povezivanje sa kolegama ili ispitivačima.

4. Izvor energije: Kako održavate svoju izdržljivost? U investicionoj firmi, kandidatkinja za prodaju izdvojila se tako što je ostala energična i nakon napornog dana intervjua—pokazala je izdržljivost i entuzijazam koji se cene kod poslodavaca. Deljenje vašeg učešća u zahtevnim aktivnostima, poput sporta, može naglasiti vašu energiju i pokretačku snagu.

Da biste pronašli zanimljive činjenice za predstavljanje, napravite listu aktivnosti, nedavnih dostignuća van posla i volonterskih angažovanja. Ovi detalji mogu otkriti vaš entuzijazam, strasti, kao i profesionalni i lični elan.
