Ovaj događaj, koji je osmislio ekonomista Klaus Schwab 1971. godine, već decenijama važi za ključnu priliku za visoki nivo umrežavanja i diskusija. Tema ovogodišnje konferencije je „Preoblikovanje sveta: posledice po društvo, politiku i biznis“. U fokusu su globalne promene izazvane brzim napretkom tehnologije i nauke, ubrzanim društvenim tranzicijama i promenljivim ekonomskim dinamikama. Prema WEF-u, ti poremećaji traže nova rešenja za globalne probleme. CNN-ov Richard Quest primećuje da se svet kreće kroz neistražen teren posle godina krize, naglašavajući nesigurnost i u pravilima i u rešenjima. On postavlja pitanje da li Davos zaista može da podstakne jedinstvo i pruži pravac u ovakvim promenama. Događaj 2014. godine izuzetno je ekskluzivan, okuplja preko 2.500 lidera, mislilaca i poznatih ličnosti iz više od 100 zemalja—mnogi dolaze po pozivu, dok poslovna ulaznica košta oko 20.000 dolara. Prisustvuju državnici, verski lideri, akademici, aktivisti, predstavnici nevladinih organizacija i izabrane zvezde, a tokom četiri dana održava se više od 250 sesija tematski vezanih za centralnu temu. Među poznatim učesnicima su predsednik Evropske komisije Manuel Barroso, šefica MMF-a Kristin Lagard, generalni sekretar UN Ban Ki Mun, osnivač Microsofta Bil Gejts i glumci Met Dejmon i Goldie Hawn. Forum se dešava dok u regionima poput Južnog Sudana, Sirije i Centralnoafričke Republike traju sukobi. Lider sirijske opozicije Džordž Sabra će prisustvovati, dok su mirovni pregovori istovremeno u toku u Ženevi. Nestabilnost na Bliskom istoku i u Severnoj Africi i dalje usporava oporavak godinama posle Arapskog proleća, navodi Svetska banka, ističući stalne nemire u Siriji i ekonomski zastoj u brojnim zemljama. Sankcije i dalje utiču na Iran, iako bi nedavni međunarodni sporazumi mogli da ih olakšaju. Predsednik Irana Hasan Rohani, koji je nedavno zamenio Mahmuda Ahmadinedžada, održaće govor o ulozi Irana u svetu, dok će premijer Izraela Benjamin Netanjahu, inače kritičan prema Rohaniju, predstaviti politički i ekonomski pogled Izraela. Ipak, postoji oprezan optimizam jer globalna ekonomija beleži postepen oporavak od prošle godine. Kinesko rukovodstvo sprovodi ekonomske reforme sa ciljem smanjenja državnog uticaja i uspostavljanja ravnopravnije konkurencije, što će biti tema na nekoliko panela u Davosu. Japanski premijer Šinzo Abe govoriće o ‘Abenomicsu’, ekonomskim merama svoje zemlje. U Evropi se beleži povratak rasta, ali nezaposlenost, naročito među mladima u Španiji i Grčkoj, ostaje veoma visoka. Američke prioritete takođe su u fokusu; državni sekretar Džon Keri dolazi kako bi govorio o angažmanu SAD na Bliskom istoku. Tema kao što su otkrića o nadzoru NSA i dalje su značajne, posebno među evropskim partnerima poput Nemačke, čija kancelarka Angela Merkel neće prisustvovati zbog drugog državnog sastanka. Istorijski gledano, velika vrednost Davosa su neformalne diskusije, koje se često vode van zvaničnog programa—što upućuje na to da ključni dogovori mogu nastati u opuštenijem okruženju.

article_content: Bengaluru-based aerospace components manufacturer Aequs has secured a ten-year contract with Airbus to supply critical parts for the A320, A330neo, and A350 aircraft. This agreement represents a significant milestone for Aequs and supports Airbus’s Make-in-India initiative. The contract’s value has not been disclosed. Under the agreement, Aequs will produce bench assemblies for the wings, fuselage, and pylons of Airbus’s single-aisle aircraft family over the next decade. This partnership elevates Aequs to the status of a strategic partner for Airbus. Aravind Melligeri, chairman and CEO of Aequs, described the contract as a pivotal moment in the company’s relationship with Airbus, highlighting the trust global original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) place in Aequs, especially amidst ongoing global supply chain changes. Aequs operates an integrated aerospace manufacturing facility in Belagavi, Karnataka, offering over 1.2 million machining hours annually. Both Airbus and Boeing are among its key clients. Recently, Aequs raised Rs 448 crore in funding, led by Singapore-based Amansa Capital, with participation from Steadview Capital, Catamaran (NR Narayana Murthy’s family office), Sparta Group, Desh Deshpande’s investment office, and other investors. Separately, Airbus is exploring innovative concepts such as 'fellofly,' which involves aircraft flying in closer formations to leverage wake energy and reduce CO2 emissions. Airbus’s Bengaluru innovation center plays a significant role in digital platform development to support these initiatives. The center includes specialized engineering teams and the Airbus ProtoSpace, focused on rapid prototyping of digital engineering solutions. Airbus is also partnering with Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) to enhance India’s Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) industry for the A320 aircraft. HAL intends to establish an integrated MRO hub, while Airbus will provide consulting and access to its AirbusWorld digital platform, further supporting the government’s Make-in-India mission.

Ovaj dogovor predstavlja značajnu prekretnicu za Aequs i podržava Airbusovu inicijativu 'Proizvedeno u Indiji'. Vrednost ugovora nije objavljena. Prema uslovima ugovora, Aequs će narednih deset godina proizvoditi montažne sklopove za krila, trup i pylon-e za Airbusovu porodicu aviona sa jednim prolazom. Ovo partnerstvo podiže status Aequs-a na strateškog partnera za Airbus. Aravind Melligeri, predsednik i izvršni direktor Aequs-a, opisao je ovaj ugovor kao ključni trenutak u saradnji sa Airbus-om, ističući poverenje koje globalni OEM-ovi imaju u Aequs, posebno u vreme promena globalnog lanca snabdevanja. Aequs upravlja integrisanim proizvodnim centrom za vazduhoplovstvo u Belagaviju, Karnataka, sa kapacitetom od preko 1,2 miliona sati mašinske obrade godišnje. I Airbus i Boeing se nalaze među glavnim klijentima ove kompanije. Nedavno je Aequs prikupio 448 miliona rupija investicija, predvođenih kompanijom Amansa Capital iz Singapura, uz učešće Steadview Capital-a, Catamaran-a (porodična kancelarija NR Narayana Murthy-ja), Sparta Group-e, investicione kancelarije Desh Deshpande-a i drugih investitora. Pored toga, Airbus istražuje inovativne koncepte poput 'fellofly', gde avioni lete bliže jedni drugima kako bi iskoristili energiju iz uzburkanog vazduha i smanjili emisiju CO2. Inovacioni centar Airbus-a u Bengaluruu ima ključnu ulogu u razvoju digitalnih platformi za ove inicijative. Centar uključuje specijalizovane inženjerske timove i Airbus ProtoSpace, koji je fokusiran na brzo prototipisanje digitalnih inženjerskih rešenja. HAL ima za cilj da uspostavi integrisani MRO centar, dok će Airbus pružiti konsultantske usluge i pristup svojoj digitalnoj platformi AirbusWorld, dodatno podržavajući vladinu inicijativu 'Proizvedeno u Indiji'.

BBC broadcaster Andrew Marr acknowledged that his wife, Jackie Ashley, was upset with him after photos surfaced of him in an intimate moment with another woman. Marr, holding a suitcase, left the family home that he shares with Ashley and their three children, but insisted his departure was for a work trip to America to film a program about President Obama, not because he was asked to leave. The 53-year-old, who last year admitted to an affair with another journalist, described the recent incident as a 'drunken clinch' and apologized for his behavior, calling it poor judgment and expressing embarrassment.

The event took place in the early hours of Saturday following drinks with colleagues at The Bar in Fitzrovia, London, celebrating the completion of his latest BBC series, 'History of The World.' A witness reported seeing Marr and a female colleague hugging and kissing outside the bar. Marr denied any ongoing romantic involvement, stating it was simply a farewell after intense work together; he emphasized there was no romantic connection, past or future.

Previously, Marr had obtained a legal order to suppress news of an affair he believed had resulted in a child, though a DNA test later disproved his paternity. Marr has been married to Guardian columnist Jackie Ashley, daughter of Lord Ashley of Stoke, since 1986. Ashley declined to comment on the situation. Despite the personal controversy, Marr continued to fulfill his professional responsibilities, hosting 'The Andrew Marr Show' as usual.

Mar je, noseći kofer, napustio porodični dom koji deli sa Ešli i njihovo troje dece, ali je istakao da je otišao zbog poslovnog puta u Ameriku gde snima program o predsedniku Obami, a ne zato što mu je rečeno da ode. Pedesettrogodišnji Mar, koji je prošle godine priznao aferu sa drugom novinarkom, nedavni incident opisao je kao „pijani zagrljaj“ i izvinio se zbog svog ponašanja, nazivajući to lošom procenom i izražavajući stid.

Dogadjaj se desio rano u subotu nakon što je sa kolegama pio u baru The Bar u Ficroviji u Londonu, slaveći završetak njegove poslednje BBC serije „History of The World“. article_content: Barcelona coach Luis Enrique has confirmed that striker Luis Suarez will make his debut in Monday night’s friendly match against Mexican side Leon. Suarez, who joined Barcelona in July for £75 million, had initially trained separately from the team due to a four-month ban from football-related activities after biting Italy’s Giorgio Chiellini during the World Cup. Following a ruling by the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS), which eased some conditions of the suspension, Suarez has now participated in two group training sessions. Luis Enrique expressed confidence in Suarez’s abilities, mentioning in a Sunday press conference his intention to give the 27-year-old some playing time in Monday’s match for the Joan Gamper Cup. Although Suarez’s appeal to completely overturn his suspension was unsuccessful, CAS’s decision allows him to train with Barcelona and play in friendly games for both club and country, though he remains barred from competitive matches until late October. His official competitive debut for Barcelona could come during the highly anticipated Clasico fixture against Real Madrid at the Bernabeu. Before the match against Leon, Suarez will be presented to Barcelona fans at the Nou Camp, potentially joining Lionel Messi and Neymar on the field. Neymar, who suffered a vertebra injury during the World Cup, has been medically cleared to play. Barcelona’s league campaign begins at home against Elche next Sunday. Suarez, who won the European Golden Boot last season despite missing several games due to suspension, expressed his excitement at being able to train again. Meanwhile, Alexis Sanchez, whom Suarez effectively replaced, has since joined Arsenal, and Javier Mascherano, like Suarez, also arrived at Barcelona from Liverpool.

article_content: Barack Obama began his presidency with strong approval ratings and immediately faced challenges like the economic downturn and international conflicts. In his first week, he prioritized a major $825 billion stimulus package to revive the economy and made notable efforts to secure support from both Democrats and Republicans. He aimed for cooperation across party lines, meeting with Republican legislators and expressing hope for unity despite inevitable disagreements. On foreign policy, Obama quickly set plans to send up to 30,000 more troops to Afghanistan and reinforced a commitment to counter terrorism in Pakistan. High-ranking officials in his administration, such as Secretary of State Hillary Clinton and Defense Secretary Robert Gates, underscored actions against al Qaeda and engagement with Afghan leadership. Obama’s early diplomacy included appointing special envoys to the Middle East and South Asia and reaching out to the Muslim world with an interview on Al-Arabiya, stressing the message that the U.S. seeks partnership, not confrontation. He acknowledged that the country had made errors in the past. Setting a new course, Obama signed executive orders to close Guantanamo Bay within a year and banned torture in interrogations by mandating the use of the Army Field Manual, distancing his policies from those of the previous administration. He also lifted the ban on U.S. funding for international family-planning groups offering abortion counseling, criticizing previous restrictions as divisive. Polls showed that most Americans approved of Obama’s first moves, but figures like former President Carter cautioned that high public expectations would require patience for results. The article also contrasts Obama’s first week with those of Bush and Clinton, illustrating different challenges and public reactions faced by incoming presidents.

article_content: Germany announced on Sunday it has agreed to lend 100 million euros ($144 million) to the Libyan rebels for civilian and humanitarian purposes, despite not participating in NATO's military campaign against Libyan government forces. Previously, Germany had provided a $10 million (7 million euros) loan for humanitarian aid to the Transitional National Council, the main opposition group fighting to remove longtime Libyan leader Moammar Gadhafi. German Foreign Minister Guido Westerwelle stated, 'Because of Colonel Gadhafi's war against his own people, the situation in Libya is very difficult.' He highlighted serious shortages of infrastructure, medical supplies, and food. Germany has not taken part in the NATO-led military campaign in Libya and abstained from the U.N. Security Council vote that authorized the use of force to protect civilians from Gadhafi's troops. However, Chancellor Angela Merkel has emphasized that Germany hopes the NATO mission succeeds. She also said Germany is contributing by increasing resources to the U.S.-led mission in Afghanistan, enabling other nations to focus more on Libya. Germany recognizes the Transitional National Council as the legitimate representative of the Libyan people and opened a liaison office with the rebels in Benghazi in May. Berlin indicated the loan will eventually be repaid by the Transitional National Council after the U.N. Security Council unfreezes Libyan assets for a legitimate government. By providing the loan, Germany joins a growing list of nations, including Turkey and Qatar, which are also making plans to channel frozen Gadhafi regime funds to the rebel council in Benghazi. Libya's finance minister in Tripoli, Abdulhafid Zlitni, warned in a CNN interview last week that reallocating frozen assets could violate international law. 'If you are freezing, through United Nations Security Council action, funds for any country, then you can't confiscate it. There are legal obligations of the banks,' he said. Meanwhile, rebel forces fought to maintain control of Qawalish, a key village along a major north-south route. Rebel fighter Talha Jwaili told CNN that Gadhafi's forces advanced with heavy machinery from nearby Al-Asaba. Reinforcements arrived from Zintan, located about 40 kilometers away, and after nearly four hours of fighting, the rebels repelled the attack. According to Jwaili, one person died—a 16-year-old cousin named Youssef Jwaili, son of the Zintan military commander—and several others were injured. Libyan state television, however, reported a different story, claiming 'armed gangs and the colonialist crusader alliance' attacked a march by Libyan tribes at Qawalish's entrance. The broadcast included footage of civilian vehicles waving green government flags and people receiving hospital treatment. Last week, Gadhafi called on supporters to march unarmed to retake cities and towns held by the rebels. 'A million should march to Benghazi and liberate it from the traitors without any weapons,' Gadhafi said. 'Even without weapons, we can cleanse the western mountains by mass marches.' Reporting contributed by CNN's Ivan Watson in Tripoli, Kareem Khadder in Tunisia, and Frederik Pleitgen in Cairo.
translated_content: Nemačka je u nedelju objavila da je pristala da pozajmi 100 miliona evra (144 miliona dolara) libijskim pobunjenicima za civilne i humanitarne svrhe, iako ne učestvuje u vojnoj kampanji NATO-a protiv snaga libijske vlade. Ranije je Nemačka obezbedila zajam od 10 miliona dolara (7 miliona evra) za humanitarnu pomoć Prelaznom nacionalnom savetu, glavnoj opozicionoj grupi koja se bori za svrgavanje dugogodišnjeg libijskog lidera Moamera Gadafija. Nemački ministar spoljnih poslova Gido Vestervele izjavio je: 'Zbog rata pukovnika Gadafija protiv sopstvenog naroda, situacija u Libiji je veoma teška.' Naglasio je ozbiljan nedostatak infrastrukture, medicinskih zaliha i hrane. Nemačka nije učestvovala u vojnoj kampanji NATO-a u Libiji i uzdržala se pri glasanju Saveta bezbednosti UN koji je odobrio upotrebu sile za zaštitu civila od Gadafijevih trupa. Ipak, kancelarka Angela Merkel istakla je da Nemačka želi da NATO misija uspe. Takođe je rekla da Nemačka doprinosi povećanjem resursa za misiju u Avganistanu pod vođstvom SAD, omogućavajući drugim državama da se više fokusiraju na Libiju. Nemačka priznaje Prelazni nacionalni savet kao legitimnog predstavnika libijskog naroda i u maju je otvorila kancelariju za vezu sa pobunjenicima u Bengaziju. Berlin je naglasio da će zajam na kraju biti vraćen od strane Prelaznog nacionalnog saveta nakon što Savet bezbednosti UN odmrzne libijsku imovinu za legitimnu vladu. Obezbeđivanjem zajma, Nemačka se pridružuje sve većem broju zemalja, uključujući Tursku i Katar, koje takođe planiraju da prebace zamrznuta sredstva režima Gadafija savetu pobunjenika u Bengaziju. Libijski ministar finansija u Tripoliju, Abdulhafid Zlitni, izjavio je prošle nedelje za CNN da bi preusmeravanje zamrznute imovine moglo predstavljati kršenje međunarodnog prava. 'Ako zamrzavate sredstva za bilo koju zemlju preko akcije Saveta bezbednosti UN, ne možete ih oduzeti. Postoje pravne obaveze banaka,' rekao je on. U međuvremenu, pobunjeničke snage su se borile da zadrže kontrolu nad Qawalishom, ključnim selom duž glavnog puta sever-jug. Borac pobunjenika Talha Jwaili rekao je za CNN da su Gadafijeve snage napredovale sa teškom mehanizacijom iz obližnjeg Al-Asabe. Pojačanja su stigla iz Zintana, udaljenog oko 40 kilometara, i posle skoro četiri sata borbe, pobunjenici su odbili napad. Prema Jwailiju, jedna osoba je poginula—njegov šesnaestogodišnji rođak Jusuf Jwaili, sin zintanskog vojnog komandanta—a nekoliko drugih je povređeno. Libijska državna televizija, međutim, iznela je drugačiju verziju događaja, tvrdeći da su 'naoružane bande i kolonijalistički krstaški savez' napali marš libijskih plemena na ulazu u Qawalish. Emitovan je snimak civilnih vozila sa zelenim zastavama vlasti i ljudi koji primaju pomoć u bolnici. Prošle nedelje, Gadafi je pozvao svoje pristalice da ne naoružani marširaju i povrate gradove i mesta pod kontrolom pobunjenika. 'Milion ljudi treba da maršira na Bengazi i oslobodi ga od izdajnika bez oružja', rekao je Gadafi. 'Čak i bez oružja, možemo očistiti zapadne planine masovnim marševima.' Izveštavanju su doprineli Ivan Watson iz Tripolija, Kareem Khadder iz Tunisa i Frederik Pleitgen iz Kaira.

article_content: With the holiday season approaching, food is top of mind. It’s a great time to focus on nutritious, tasty, and affordable food that's also sustainable for the planet. Cathy Burns, CEO of the International Fresh Produce Association (IFPA), believes that eating more fruits and vegetables, and buying more flowers, can make people happier and healthier. At the recent IFPA conference in Anaheim, California, Burns explained how the association is working to improve the health of the industry, the environment, and consumers. Using AI and other technology, food supply chains are collaborating to overcome disruptions and build a healthier, more sustainable world. Building a climate-resilient future for fresh produce Earlier this year, IFPA hosted sustainability summits in Australia and New Zealand. According to the United Nations, about 17 percent of global food production is wasted, consuming 38 percent of the total energy used in the food system. IFPA’s top priorities include environmental benchmarking, climate resilience metrics, supply chain partnerships, and diversity, equity, and inclusion commitments. Burns noted, 'For consumers, climate change is the second biggest issue after inflation that requires attention from governments, the public, and businesses. People expect companies to help solve food supply challenges, overconsumption, and waste.' She also mentioned expectations for solutions to issues like intensive farming, deforestation, and loss of biodiversity. From a regulatory perspective, sustainability topics are influencing decisions throughout the supply chain. Tech innovations, including AI, drive growth Burns highlighted advanced technologies as key drivers of agribusiness growth. One report projects that AI could bring $113 billion in efficiency and new revenue to retail grocery. Seventy-five percent of surveyed executives believe AI will be integrated into their software by 2025. Technology is offering new agribusiness opportunities. Researchers can now use AI to breed crops that are more resistant to disease and drought. Machine learning could also help ensure consistent flavor in fruits and produce. Supermarkets can provide dynamic pricing in real-time based on product freshness, making shopping more efficient. Cross-industry innovation in agribusiness Agribusiness is increasingly intersecting with other industries. Burns pointed out healthcare organizations piloting 'produce prescription' programs that offer free or discounted fruits and vegetables to people with diet-related illnesses like diabetes. A North Carolina non-profit turned a produce prescription grant into $8 million in fruit and vegetable sales in just over a year. Sven Denecken, senior vice president at SAP Industries, commented, 'The boundaries between traditional value chains are blurring to create sustainable, intelligent, and connected businesses, improving customer experience and supporting a circular economy. The future of fresh produce is data-driven. Companies are adopting best practices for resilient and eco-friendly supply chains with solutions like SAP Industry Cloud.' Overcoming barriers to healthy foods Burns emphasized that the agribusiness industry faces significant challenges in encouraging consumers to eat more fruits and vegetables, including labor shortages, rising energy prices, transportation delays, extreme weather, and inflation. 'Our biggest hurdle is increasing consumption...We can solve some of the world’s major problems,' said Burns. 'This industry is built on complexity. My concern is not resources—we have enough. My fear is leaving this task to others who may not understand our capabilities or what our products can do. We can change global health.' Economic value of fresh produce Burns also explained that fruits and vegetables are valuable economically. While they make up just 7% to 8% of global food production, they represent about $1.3 trillion in annual revenue. Adding more fruits and vegetables to our holiday meals is a small but important step towards sustainability. No matter how you celebrate this season, make healthy food choices—and don’t forget the fresh flowers! Discover more about the data-driven future of fresh produce, from farm to grocery store.
translated_content: Kako nam se praznična sezona približava, hrana je glavna tema. Ovo je pravo vreme da obratimo pažnju na zdravu, ukusnu i pristupačnu hranu koja je takođe održiva za planetu. Keti Berns, direktorka Međunarodne asocijacije za sveže proizvode (IFPA), veruje da konzumiranje više voća i povrća, kao i kupovina više cveća, može ljude učiniti srećnijima i zdravijima. Na nedavnoj IFPA konferenciji u Anaheimu, Kalifornija, Berns je objasnila kako asocijacija radi na unapređenju zdravlja industrije, okoline i potrošača. Koristeći veštačku inteligenciju i druge tehnologije, lanci snabdevanja hrane sarađuju da prevaziđu poremećaje i grade zdraviji, održiviji svet. Stvaranje otpornije budućnosti za sveže proizvode Ranije ove godine IFPA je organizovala samite o održivosti u Australiji i na Novom Zelandu. Prema Ujedinjenim nacijama, oko 17 procenata globalne proizvodnje hrane se baci, što troši 38 procenata ukupne energije u prehrambenom sistemu. Najveći prioriteti IFPA su ekološko merenje performansi, metrički pokazatelji za otpornost na klimu, partnerstva u lancu snabdevanja i posvećenost raznolikosti, jednakosti i inkluziji. Berns je navela: 'Za potrošače, klimatske promene su drugo najvažnije pitanje odmah posle inflacije, koje zahteva pažnju vlada, javnosti i kompanija. Ljudi očekuju da kompanije pomognu u rešavanju problema snabdevanja hranom, preterane potrošnje i otpada.' Takođe je pomenula očekivanja za rešenja problema poput intenzivne poljoprivrede, krčenja šuma i gubitka biodiverziteta. Iz regulatorne perspektive, teme održivosti utiču na odluke širom lanca snabdevanja. Tehničke inovacije, uključujući veštačku inteligenciju, pokreću rast Berns je istakla da su napredne tehnologije ključni pokretači rasta agrobiznisa. Prema jednom izveštaju, AI bi mogao doneti 113 milijardi dolara u efikasnosti i novim prihodima za maloprodaju prehrambenih proizvoda. Sedamdeset pet procenata ispitanih rukovodilaca veruje da će veštačka inteligencija biti integrisana u njihov softver do 2025. Tehnologija nudi nove mogućnosti za agrobiznis. Istraživači sada koriste AI za uzgoj kultura otpornijih na bolesti i sušu. Mašinsko učenje može pomoći i u obezbeđivanju konstantnog ukusa voća i povrća. Supermarketi mogu nuditi dinamičko formiranje cena u realnom vremenu prema svežini proizvoda, olakšavajući kupovinu. Inovacije u agrobiznisu kroz saradnju industrija Agrobiznis sve više sarađuje sa drugim industrijama. Berns je istakla zdravstvene organizacije koje testiraju programe 'recepta na proizvode', gde ljudi sa bolestima vezanim za ishranu, poput dijabetesa, dobijaju besplatno ili sa popustom voće i povrće. Jedna neprofitna organizacija iz Severne Karoline pretvorila je bespovratna sredstva ovog tipa u 8 miliona dolara vrednosti prodatih proizvoda za nešto više od godinu dana. Sven Denecken, potpredsednik kompanije SAP Industries, rekao je: 'Granice tradicionalnih vrednosnih lanaca se brišu da bi se stvorile održive, inteligentne i povezane kompanije, poboljšava korisničko iskustvo i podržava kružna ekonomija. Budućnost svežih proizvoda je vođena podacima. Kompanije usvajaju najbolje prakse za otpornije i ekološke lance snabdevanja uz rešenja kao što je SAP Industry Cloud.' Prevazilaženje prepreka do zdrave hrane Berns je naglasila da se agrobiznis suočava sa značajnim izazovima u podsticanju potrošača da jedu više voća i povrća, uključujući nestašicu radne snage, povećanje cena energije, kašnjenja u transportu, ekstremne vremenske prilike i inflaciju. 'Naša najveća prepreka je povećanje potrošnje...Možemo rešiti neke od najvećih problema u svetu', rekla je Berns. 'Ova industrija je izuzetno složena. Nije me strah resursa—imamo ih dovoljno. Brine me da ostavimo ovaj zadatak nekome ko ne razume naše sposobnosti i šta naši proizvodi mogu. Možemo promeniti globalno zdravlje.' Ekonomska vrednost svežih proizvoda Berns je objasnila da su voće i povrće ekonomski veoma vredni. Iako zauzimaju samo 7-8% globalne proizvodnje hrane, donose oko 1,3 triliona dolara godišnjeg prihoda. Dodavanje više voća i povrća prazničnoj trpezi je mali, ali važan korak ka održivosti. Kako god slavili praznike, birajte zdravu hranu—i ne zaboravite sveže cveće! Saznajte više o budućnosti zasnovanoj na podacima za sveže proizvode, od farme do prodavnice.

PORT-AU-PRINCE, Haiti — Haiti's government has banned all charter flights to Nicaragua, a route thousands of migrants fleeing poverty and violence had been using in hopes of reaching the United States, according to a government bulletin obtained Monday by The Associated Press. The announcement, first reported by the Miami Herald, gave no explanation for the decision, and Haiti's civil aviation authorities did not respond to requests for comment. As a result, hundreds of travelers, some with small children, were left stranded with their luggage in a parking lot outside Port-au-Prince's main international airport.

“I have to seek a better life elsewhere because Haiti doesn’t offer my generation anything," said Jean-Marc Antoine, 29, whose brother in Chile loaned him $4,000 for a ticket. Like many others, he was worried about getting his money back.

Nearby, Marie-Ange Solomon, 58, said she had paid $7,000 for tickets for herself and her son, but could not reach the charter company. “After gathering money to get me and my son out of this fragile country, now all of a sudden they stop everything,” she said. Solomon waited with her bags as her 28-year-old son checked the airport for updates.

Since early August, more than 260 flights are believed to have taken as many as 31,000 migrants from Haiti to Nicaragua, as the country’s crisis deepens and gangs now control up to 80% of Port-au-Prince. Manuel Orozco, director at the Inter-American Dialogue, estimated these migrants account for about 60% of Haitians arriving at the U.S.-Mexico border. Orozco noted charter flights to Nicaragua have cost between $3,000 and $5,000, with the country a favored destination as it does not require visas for certain migrants. He called the volume of flights unprecedented and a security concern, and questioned if foreign pressure played a role in the suspension.

Orozco added, as of January, there were no such flights, but by late July, three flights a day had increased to eleven. Nicaragua's vice president Rosario Murillo did not comment on the policy change. Some Nicaraguans have provided services to arriving migrants, guiding them to Honduras. Orozco said the flight suspension could push Haitians to seek other routes, including via the Dominican Republic. The two countries share the island of Hispaniola and are currently in conflict over a canal Haiti is building that would divert water from a border river.

Last month, Dominican President Luis Abinader announced his country would stop issuing visas to Haitians and has closed the border to Haitians seeking to cross for work, education, or other reasons. As another migration route closed, frustration among stranded Haitians grew outside the airport.

“Can you imagine that I spent all this money? I sold everything that I had,” said Jean Erode Louis-Saint, 25, who never received a boarding pass for the flight he was scheduled to board. “I cannot stay in this country because of the lack of security. Gangs are everywhere.”

Saint-Ville Etienne, a 35-year-old civil engineer, hoped to find a new life and support his 14-year-old son. “Haiti is in a state of war among its own people,” he said. “I don’t know why they are fighting. It’s only causing everybody to leave the country.”

Associated Press reporters contributed to this story from Port-au-Prince, Mexico City, and San Juan, Puerto Rico. Follow AP's global migration coverage at https://apnews.com/hub/migration

PORT-O-PRINS, Haiti — Vlada Haitija zabranila je sve čarter letove za Nikaragvu, rutu koju su hiljade migranata koristile da pobegnu od siromaštva i nasilja, nadajući se da će doći do Sjedinjenih Država, prema biltenu koji je u ponedeljak dobila agencija Associated Press. Saopštenje, koje je prvi preneo Miami Herald, ne navodi razlog za ovu odluku, a vlasti civilnog vazduhoplovstva Haitija nisu odgovorile na zahteve za komentar. Zbog toga su stotine putnika, neki i sa malom decom, ostale zaglavljene sa prtljagom na parkingu ispred glavnog međunarodnog aerodroma u Port-o-Prinsu.

"Moram da tražim bolji život negde drugde, jer Haiti mojoj generaciji ne nudi ništa," rekao je Žan-Mark Anton (29) kome je brat iz Čilea pozajmio 4.000 dolara za kartu. Poput mnogih drugih, brine se da li će uspeti da povrati svoj novac.

U blizini, Mari-Anž Solom (58) rekla je da je platila 7.000 dolara za sebe i sina, ali ne uspeva da dođe do čarter kompanije. "Nakon što sam skupila novac da izvučem sebe i sina iz ove nesigurne zemlje, sad su najednom sve zaustavili," rekla je ona. Solom je pazila na torbe dok je njen 28-godišnji sin proveravao situaciju na aerodromu.

Od početka avgusta, procenjuje se da je više od 260 letova prevezlo do 31.000 migranata iz Haitija u Nikaragvu, dok se kriza u zemlji pogoršava, a bande sada drže do 80% Port-o-Prinsa. Manuel Orozko, direktor u Inter-American Dialogue, procenjuje da ovi migranti čine oko 60% Haićana koji dolaze do američko-meksičke granice. Orozko navodi da su čarter letovi za Nikaragvu koštali između 3.000 i 5.000 dolara, a Nikaragva je popularna jer ne traži vizu za određene migrante. On kaže da je toliki broj letova neviđen i predstavlja bezbednosni rizik, te postavlja pitanje da li je zabranu letova izazvao pritisak iz inostranstva.

Orozko dodaje da početkom januara nije bilo ovih letova, a da je do kraja jula broj skočio sa tri na jedanaest letova dnevno. Potpredsednica Nikaragve Rosario Muriljo nije komentarisala promenu politike. Neki Nikaragvanci pružaju usluge migrantima vodeći ih do Hondurasa. Orozko smatra da bi suspenzija letova mogla podstaći Haićane da traže alternativne rute, uključujući i preko Dominikanske Republike. Dve zemlje dele ostrvo Hispanjola i trenutno su u sporu zbog kanala koji Haiti gradi, a koji bi preusmerio vodu iz reke na granici.

Prošlog meseca, predsednik Dominikanske Republike Luis Abinader najavio je da zemlja prestaje da izdaje vize Haićanima i potpuno je zatvorio granicu za prelazak radi posla, školovanja ili drugih razloga. Kako je još jedna migrantska ruta zatvorena, frustracija među zaglavljenim Haićanima ispred aerodroma rasla je.

"Možete li da verujete, potrošio sam sav novac? Prodao sam sve što sam imao," rekao je Žan Erod Lui-Sen (25), koji nije dobio ukrcajnicu za planirani let. "Ne mogu da ostanem ovde zbog nedostatka bezbednosti. Bande su svuda."

Sent-Vil Etijen, 35-godišnji građevinski inženjer, nadao se novom početku kako bi mogao da izdržava svog 14-godišnjeg sina. "Haiti je u stanju rata unutar svog naroda," rekao je. "Ne znam zašto se bore. To tera svakoga da napusti zemlju."

article_content: The Delta State Police Command has arrested Samsom Ibiloma for impersonating the Secretary to the State Government, Dr. Kingsley Emu, and other senior government officials. Police Public Relations Officer DSP Bright Edafe announced the arrest on Tuesday in Asaba. Edafe explained that following multiple complaints from victims about a fraudster posing as the Delta State Secretary to the State Government, police acted quickly to apprehend Ibiloma, a member of a syndicate specializing in impersonating high-ranking officials. The syndicate reportedly operated under the alias of Hon. Kingsley Emu and defrauded unsuspecting job-seekers of millions of naira. Commissioner of Police, CP Wale Abass, assigned the Command’s DECOY Squad to thoroughly investigate the matter. DECOY Squad Commander ASP Julius Robinson gathered intelligence and led officers to the Walter Odili area by Enerhen Junction in Warri, where they arrested 52-year-old Ibiloma, a native of Dekina LGA, Kogi State, residing in Warri. Edafe stated that Ibiloma confessed to impersonating government officials and defrauding victims of over N10 million. He further revealed that Ibiloma identified Stephen Odeemero as the leader and mastermind of the syndicate. Efforts are ongoing to apprehend other gang members who remain at large. The Commissioner of Police has urged anyone who has fallen victim to the fraud to report to the police headquarters or the PPRO office.
translated_content: Policijska komanda države Delta uhapsila je Samsoma Ibilomu zbog lažnog predstavljanja kao sekretar Vlade države, dr. Kingsley Emu, i drugih visokih zvaničnika. Portparol policije DSP Bright Edafe saopštio je hapšenje u utorak u Asabi. Edafe je objasnio da su, nakon više pritužbi žrtava koje je prevarant obmanuo predstavljajući se kao sekretar Vlade države Delta, pripadnici policije brzo reagovali i priveli Ibilomu, člana grupe specijalizovane za lažno predstavljanje visokih državnih funkcionera. Sindikata je koristio ime Hon. Kingsley Emu i prevario je nesuđene tražioce zaposlenja za milione naira. Komesar policije CP Wale Abass naložio je DECOY timu detaljnu istragu slučaja. Komandant DECOY tima ASP Julius Robinson prikupio je obaveštajne podatke i poveo policajce u oblast Walter Odili kod raskrsnice Enerhen u Warriu, gde su uhapsili 52-godišnjeg Ibilomu, poreklom iz Dekina LGA, država Kogi, koji živi u Warriu. Edafe je naveo da je Ibiloma priznao lažno predstavljanje državnih funkcionera i prevaru žrtava za više od 10 miliona naira. Takođe je saopštio da je Ibiloma identifikovao Stephena Odeemera kao vođu i organizatora grupe. Policija nastavlja potragu za ostalim članovima bande koji su u bekstvu. Komesar policije pozvao je sve koji su žrtve ove prevare da se jave u sedište policije ili kancelariju portparola (PPRO).

Detective David Currie, 50, became part of one of Florida’s first married gay couples after the state legalized same-sex marriage just after midnight on Tuesday. Currie wed his partner Aaron Woodard, 33, in a ceremony where Currie wore his police uniform, having received approval from the Broward County Sheriff’s Office. “It’s a really great feeling,” Currie told the Miami Herald. “I think about how I did an amazing thing last night. I’m very excited, not only for me personally, but for what it means for Florida and for people with careers like mine, where being gay isn’t always easily accepted.”

Sheriff Scott Israel fully supported Currie’s decision, stating, “If he was proud enough of the agency to wear the uniform on such an important night, I wanted him to do so.” The couple, who met a year ago in Fort Lauderdale through mutual friends, are certified foster parents and plan to raise children together.

Detektiv Dejvid Kuri (50) postao je deo jednog od prvih homoseksualnih brakova na Floridi, nakon što je država legalizovala istopolne brakove odmah posle ponoći u utorak. Kuri se venčao sa svojim partnerom, Aronom Vudardom (33), na ceremoniji na kojoj je nosio svoju policijsku uniformu, uz odobrenje Šerifove kancelarije okruga Brauard. „Zaista je sjajan osećaj“, rekao je Kuri za Miami Herald. „Razmišljam o tome kako sam sinoć uradio nešto neverovatno. Veoma sam uzbuđen, ne samo zbog sebe lično, već i zbog toga šta ovo znači za Floridu i za ljude sa karijerama poput moje, gde nije uvek lako biti gej.“

Šerif Skot Izrael je u potpunosti podržao Kurijevu odluku, rekavši: „Ako je bio dovoljno ponosan na agenciju da obuče uniformu tokom tako važnog događaja, želeo sam da to i učini.“ Par, koji se upoznao pre godinu dana u Fort Loderdejlu preko zajedničkih prijatelja, sertifikovani su kao hranitelji i planiraju zajedno da odgajaju decu.

In twentieth-century warfare, soldiers' uniforms were primarily designed for warmth, but modern advancements are transforming these garments into cutting-edge electronic systems. The U.S. Office of Naval Research (ONR) is developing 'Intelligent Uniforms' embedded with sensors to detect injuries and exposure to nuclear, biological, or chemical agents. These sensors are woven into the fabric to monitor vital signs, radiation, and chemical toxins.

Maintaining lightweight and comfortable uniforms remains a key challenge. A recent ONR proposal outlines uniforms equipped with integrated GPS and radio systems that can automatically relay health information to medical teams at base. These developments are part of a wider range of high-tech innovations pursued by the Pentagon and defense companies, including augmented-reality glasses for enhanced vision and electronic fabrics for efficient team communication.

The inclusion of medical sensors in uniforms is more than a novelty; current protocols often delay diagnosis until a medic can reach the wounded, potentially risking lives. The goal is to give medical staff a head start by providing rapid preliminary diagnostics to increase survival chances.

Wired’s Danger Room blog highlights that immediate assessment is critical in battlefield scenarios involving gunfire, explosions, or exposure to hazardous agents. 'Intelligent Uniforms' could pinpoint wounds, estimate penetration depth, and detect harmful substances by analyzing biomarkers in fluids like blood, saliva, sweat, or urine.

Technologies once found only in science fiction are rapidly becoming reality. The Pentagon has partnered with Innovega to develop augmented-reality eyewear that projects 3D battlefield data directly into soldiers’ fields of view. This enhances situational awareness without obstructing regular vision, delivering essential information from drones and satellites.

Enhanced communication systems are also being tested. Fabric-integrated antennas allow soldiers to transmit video, voice, and GPS data simultaneously, even while under cover. BAE Systems’ Body Wearable Antennas eliminate clunky external antennas, boost mobility, and ensure consistent communication. The system interfaces with commercial devices for real-time mapping, sharing visual information and hazard alerts among team members.

Jon Pinto of BAE Systems stresses that wearable antennas could reduce gear weight while enhancing battlefield communications—a significant tactical advantage. These technologies may also benefit civilians, such as firefighters and police, in search and rescue operations or patrols.
translated_content:
U ratovima dvadesetog veka uniforme su pre svega služile da zagreju vojnike, ali savremeni razvoj pretvara ovu odeću u napredne elektronske sisteme. Američka Kancelarija za pomorska istraživanja (ONR) razvija „inteligentne uniforme“ sa ugrađenim senzorima koji mogu detektovati povrede i izloženost nuklearnim, biološkim ili hemijskim agensima. Ovi senzori utkani su u tkaninu i prate vitalne znake, radijaciju i otrovne supstance.

Očuvanje laganih i udobnih uniformi ostaje glavni izazov. Nedavni predlog ONR-a predviđa uniforme sa integrisanim GPS i radio sistemima koji automatski šalju podatke o zdravlju medicinskim timovima u bazi. Ove inovacije deo su šireg spektra visokotehnoloških rešenja na kojima rade Pentagon i odbrambene kompanije, uključujući naočare za proširenu stvarnost i elektronske tkanine za efikasniju komunikaciju u timu.

Ugradnja medicinskih senzora u uniforme nije samo novotarija; trenutni protokoli često znače da dijagnoza kasni dok bolničar ne stigne do ranjenog, što može ugroziti život. Cilj je medicinarima omogućiti bržu dijagnostiku početnog stanja i tako povećati šanse za preživljavanje.

Blog Danger Room magazina Wired naglašava koliko je hitna procena važna u scenarijima na ratištu — poput vatrenih okršaja, eksplozija ili izloženosti opasnim agensima. „Inteligentne uniforme“ mogu detektovati mesto i dubinu povrede i prepoznati štetne materije analizom biomarkera iz krvi, pljuvačke, znoja ili urina.

Tehnologije koje su nekada bile rezervisane za naučnu fantastiku sada brzo postaju stvarnost. Pentagon je sklopio ugovor sa kompanijom Innovega o razvoju naočara za proširenu stvarnost koji 3D podatke sa ratišta projektuju direktno vojnicima u vidno polje. Tako vojnici bolje sagledavaju situaciju bez ometanja prirodnog vida — uz ključne informacije s dronova i satelita.

Stižu i novi komunikacioni sistemi. Antene u tkanini uniformi omogućavaju prenos videa, zvuka i GPS podataka istovremeno — i kad su vojnici pod zaklonom. Body Wearable Antennas iz kompanije BAE Systems smanjuju potrebu za glomaznim spoljnim antenama, poboljšavaju pokretljivost i obezbeđuju stabilnu vezu. Sistem može da radi sa komercijalnim uređajima radi prikaza operativnih mapa u realnom vremenu, deljenja vizuelnih informacija i upozorenja na opasnosti.

Jon Pinto iz kompanije BAE Systems naglašava da ovakve antene mogu značajno smanjiti teret opreme i unaprediti komunikaciju na terenu — što vojniku može dati taktičku prednost. Ove tehnologije bi, osim vojske, mogle koristiti i civilima — vatrogascima i policiji — pri spasilačkim operacijama i patrolama.
post_content: High-tech 'Intelligent Uniforms' with built-in sensors are the future for soldiers—tracking injuries, toxins, and even sending health data straight to medics. Plus, next-level AR glasses and smart antennas mean better team comms and less gear to lug around! #FuturisticUniforms #MilitaryTech

article_content: After Australia defeated India by six wickets in the 2023 ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup final, some Indian fans expressed their disappointment online, targeting not only the cricket players but also their families. This frustration led to a case of mistaken identity: Adam Zampa, a Slovakian ski racer with the same name as the Australian bowler, received a surge of angry messages on his Instagram, particularly under a video where he was flying a small aircraft. Many commenters confused him with the Australian cricketer who took a key catch to dismiss India's Shubman Gill. Some users tried to clarify that the account belonged to a different Adam Zampa, but the confusion persisted. In the match, the actual Australian spinner Adam Zampa played a vital role, taking one wicket for 44 runs to help hold India to 240. Australia reached the target in 43 overs, with Travis Head scoring a superb 137 and Marnus Labuschagne remaining unbeaten on 58. This victory gave Australia its record-extending sixth World Cup title.

To je dovelo do zabune zbog sličnih imena: Adam Zampa, slovački skijaš, koji ima isto ime kao i australijski kuglaš, postao je meta ljutitih komentara na svom Instagram nalogu, naročito ispod videa gde pilotira malim avionom. Mnogi su ga pomešali sa australijskim kriketašem koji je uhvatio loptu i eliminisao indijskog igrača Shubmana Gilla. Nekoliko korisnika je pokušalo da objasni da je u pitanju drugi Adam Zampa, ali konfuzija je ostala. Na samoj utakmici, pravi australijski kuglaš Adam Zampa je imao važnu ulogu, osvojivši jedan wicket za 44 run-a i pomogao timu da zadrži Indiju na 240 poena. Australija je stigla do cilja za 43 overa, uz sjajnih 137 poena Travisa Heada i 58 bez pogotka Marnusa Labuschagne-a. Ova pobeda je donela Australiji rekordnu šestu titulu svetskog prvaka.

A recent poll reveals that 31% of Italians would prefer their country to return to the lira, instead of remaining part of the eurozone. According to the survey, published in Corriere della Sera and conducted by ISPO, 65% of respondents believe the introduction of the euro has harmed, rather than benefited, the Italian economy. Confidence in the European Union is also low, standing at just 51%, the lowest in years.

These findings come as the European debt crisis deepens. Last Friday, Standard & Poor’s downgraded the credit ratings of nine eurozone countries, reflecting ongoing concerns. Italy, the third-largest economy in the eurozone, faces dire economic challenges and has seen borrowing costs rise to unsustainable levels.

Prime Minister Mario Monti, who leads a technocratic government formed in November, has implemented tough austerity measures, including tax increases and spending cuts, significantly impacting Italians. Despite austerity, Monti’s approval rating has climbed to 56%, up from 46% a month ago, even as the Italian economy edges towards recession. The poll found that while 31% want to go back to the lira, 60% accept that joining the euro was necessary and believe there is no turning back.

Italy’s debt-to-GDP ratio is 120%, second only to Greece in the eurozone, making it one of several countries hit by S&P’s downgrades. Italy’s sovereign credit rating was cut by two notches to BBB+. In contrast, France’s President Nicolas Sarkozy welcomed the decision by Moody’s to maintain France’s AAA rating, despite S&P’s recent downgrade due to uncertainties in managing the eurozone crisis.

Financial markets appeared relatively unshaken by the downgrades. The FTSE index rose by 0.43% to 5,660.78, while the DOW fell by 0.39% on the same day.

Meanwhile, the need to boost the stability of the shared eurozone fund, the EFSF, is being debated. German officials insist that countries downgraded by S&P should guarantee more of the fund’s contribution, while Germany, which was not downgraded, should keep its commitment unchanged.

Greece is preparing for difficult negotiations with its international creditors to secure a second bailout. The talks, which focus on a €130 billion package, hinge on an agreement with private sector creditors to swap bonds, reducing Greece’s debt by €100 billion. Disputes over interest rates temporarily stalled the talks, but they are expected to resume shortly. Failure to reach an agreement could result in a severe default with far-reaching economic consequences.

The European Central Bank, meanwhile, increased its bond purchases to €3.8 billion, a move that has helped some eurozone governments avoid collapse amid the crisis.

Nedavno istraživanje pokazuje da bi 31% Italijana radije želelo povratak lire, umesto da ostanu deo evrozone. Prema anketi koju je sproveo ISPO, a objavio Corriere della Sera, 65% ispitanika smatra da je uvođenje evra više štetilo nego koristilo italijanskoj ekonomiji. Poverenje u Evropsku uniju takođe je na samo 51%, što je najniži nivo u poslednjih nekoliko godina.

Ovi rezultati dolaze dok se evropska dužnička kriza produbljuje. Prošlog petka, Standard & Poor's je snizio kreditni rejting devet zemalja evrozone, što odražava sve veću zabrinutost. Italija, treća po veličini ekonomija u evrozoni, suočava se sa ozbiljnim ekonomskim problemima i rastom troškova zaduživanja na neodržive nivoe.

Premijer Mario Monti, koji vodi tehnokratsku vladu formiranu u novembru, uveo je stroge mere štednje, uključujući povećanje poreza i smanjenje javne potrošnje, što značajno utiče na građane. Uprkos tome, Montijeva podrška porasla je na 56% sa 46% mesec dana ranije, čak i dok italijanska ekonomija klizi ka recesiji. Anketa pokazuje da, iako 31% želi povratak lire, 60% smatra da je ulazak u evro bio neophodan i veruje da povratak nije moguć.

Odnos duga i BDP-a Italije iznosi 120%, što je drugo najviše u evrozoni nakon Grčke. Zbog toga je Italija među državama kojima je S&P snizio rejting; njen kreditni rejting smanjen je za dve ocene na BBB+. S druge strane, predsednik Francuske Nikola Sarkozi pozdravio je odluku agencije Moody's da zadrži AAA rejting Francuskoj, uprkos nedavnom snižavanju od strane S&P zbog neizvesnosti u rešavanju krize evrozone.

Finansijska tržišta su ostala uglavnom mirna nakon sniženja rejtinga. Indeks FTSE je porastao za 0,43% na 5.660,78, dok je DOW pao za 0,39% istog dana.

U međuvremenu se raspravlja o potrebi jačanja stabilnosti zajedničkog fonda evrozone (EFSF). Nemački zvaničnici zahtevaju da države kojima je snižen rejting više garantuju za fond, dok Nemačka, kojoj nije smanjen rejting, treba da zadrži svoj postojeći doprinos.

Grčka se priprema za teške pregovore sa međunarodnim poveriocima kako bi obezbedila drugi paket pomoći. Ovi pregovori, vezani za paket vredan 130 milijardi evra, zavise od dogovora s privatnim poveriocima o zameni obveznica, što bi trebalo da smanji grčki dug za 100 milijardi evra. Neslaganja oko kamatnih stopa privremeno su prekinula pregovore, ali se očekuje njihov nastavak uskoro. Neuspeh bi mogao dovesti do ozbiljnog bankrota sa širokim ekonomskim posledicama.

Evropska centralna banka, u međuvremenu, povećala je kupovinu državnih obveznica na 3,8 milijardi evra, što je pomoglo nekim vladama evrozone da izbegnu kolaps tokom krize.

article_content: Google is preparing to launch updates for its Drive app, particularly benefiting users of larger Android devices such as tablets and foldables. As stated in a post from Google Workspace, these enhancements are designed to give Drive a desktop-like experience on larger screens. The rollout includes three notable updates: a new folder hierarchy above the document list for easier navigation and quick access back to the main Drive view; new columns showing when files were last changed, their size, and who last edited them; and the adoption of Google’s latest Material 3 design language throughout the app. These features are now being introduced to Workspace users on rapid release domains, with a broader rollout to scheduled release domains set for November 27. Users with personal Google accounts are expected to receive the updates as well. Additionally, Google has recently enhanced editing in Docs, Sheets, and Slides. Docs now includes a mode switcher for toggling between edit, suggest, and viewing modes. Slides offers a persistent editing bar, and Sheets automatically selects a cell on app startup. These changes are slated for scheduled release domains on November 28, and will also reach personal accounts. Earlier in the year, Google began modernizing Drive for large Android devices by shifting the navigation bar to the left side and introducing a floating action button, similar to what users see on desktops. The Suggested and Notifications tabs were downsized so users can view more files on screen. The Pixel Fold is highlighted as a compact device that opens up to a 7.6-inch display with a 120Hz refresh rate, featuring impressive cameras despite its foldable design.

Kako je navedeno u objavi Google Workspace-a, ove promene su osmišljene da bi Drive na većim ekranima što više ličio na desktop verziju. Ažuriranje donosi tri značajne novine: novu hijerarhiju fascikli iznad liste dokumenata radi lakše navigacije i brzog povratka na glavni prikaz; nove kolone koje prikazuju kad su datoteke poslednji put menjane, njihovu veličinu i ko ih je poslednji uređivao; i usvajanje najnovijeg Google-ovog dizajn jezika, Material 3, kroz celu aplikaciju. Ove funkcije su već dostupne Workspace korisnicima na domenima sa brzim ažuriranjem, dok je šira dostupnost na domenima sa planiranim ažuriranjem zakazana za 27. novembar. Korisnici sa ličnim Google nalozima mogu takođe da očekuju ove novine. Takođe je Google nedavno unapredio rad u Docs, Sheets i Slides: Docs sada ima prekidač modova za izbor editovanja, sugestija ili režima za pregled. Slides nudi stalnu traku za uređivanje, a Sheets automatski selektuje ćeliju pri pokretanju. Ove promene biće dostupne na domenima sa planiranim ažuriranjem od 28. novembra, a pristupačne su i ličnim nalozima. Još ranije, početkom godine, Google je modernizovao Drive za veće Android uređaje premestivši navigacionu traku na levo i dodavši plutajuće dugme za akcije, kao na desktop verziji. Tasteri „Predloženo” i „Obaveštenja” su smanjeni da bi korisnici mogli da vide više svojih datoteka. Pixel Fold je predstavljen kao kompaktan uređaj koji se rasklapa do 7,6-inčnog ekrana sa osvežavanjem od 120Hz i ima impresivne kamere, iako je sklopivi.

article_content: For many boat owners, the idea of sailing around the world stays just a dream, sidelined by jobs and family duties. But Mike and Judy Ryan decided not to let life get in the way. In 2007, with their daughters Justine (12), Madeleine (10), and Fiona (8), they said yes to adventure. After Mike wrapped up a big project launching the Ritz Carlton in Grand Cayman and with a move to London on the horizon, the family chartered several boats to choose the right fit. Eventually, they bought 'Tenaz,' a 40-meter sailing yacht. Determined to keep their daughters' education on track, Mike and Judy hired two tutors to live aboard, in addition to a six-person crew led by first mate Amy Galloway—who would later become captain. After months of planning, the Ryans launched into a nine-month voyage together, with Judy chronicling each step on her blog.
translated_content: Za većinu vlasnika brodova, san o plovidbi oko sveta uglavnom ostaje neostvaren, jer svakodnevne obaveze poput posla i porodice prevladaju. Mike i Judy Ryan ipak su odlučili da im to ne bude prepreka. U 2007. godini, sa ćerkama Justine (12), Madeleine (10) i Fiona (8), hrabro su krenuli u veliku avanturu. Nakon što je Mike završio važan projekat otvaranja Ritz Carlton hotela na Grand Caymanu, i dok se porodica spremala za selidbu u London, iznajmljivali su brodove da pronađu onaj pravi za sebe. Na kraju su kupili jedrilicu „Tenaz“ dugu 40 metara. He accused Congress of engaging in dynastic politics and focusing on their own families over public interest. He announced that the central government’s free ration scheme, which benefits 80 crore underprivileged Indians, will be extended for another five years. Modi also highlighted the acclaim for the Madhya Pradesh government’s Ladli Behna and Ladli Laxmi schemes supporting women. Additionally, Modi accused Congress of being anti-tribal, citing their opposition to President Droupadi Murmu's election by supporting Yashwant Sinha. He expressed confidence that BJP will win the upcoming Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh assembly elections. article_content: Vat19, an American retailer, has launched the 'gummy party python,' a giant candy weighing 27 pounds and nearly eight feet long. With around 36,000 calories, this remarkable treat greatly exceeds the daily recommended calorie intake for an adult. Vat19 suggests that the candy be shared or consumed over 306 separate servings. Handmade with lifelike details—including scales, ridged coils, and intricate eyes—the python comes in two flavors: blue raspberry with green apple or red cherry. The candy, priced at $150, is nicknamed the 'Lamborghini of the sweet world.' Known for oversized candies, Vat19 also offers a 5-pound gummy bear (equal to about 1,400 regular bears), a giant gummy worm with 4,000 calories, and a gummy cola bottle that's 90 times larger than a regular one. The gummy python has been so popular that it is currently out of stock on the company's website. This sweet is not the largest ever made, as a 9,702-pound chocolate bar in Yerevan, Armenia surpassed it in 2010. The candy can be kept for up to a year if stored out of direct sunlight and away from extreme heat.

article_content: A revolutionary medical device inspired by the Star Trek tricorder has been created by California-based Scanadu Inc. The Scanadu Scout measures vital signs—including heart rate, body temperature, blood oxygen saturation, respiratory rate, blood pressure, ECG, and emotional stress—in just seconds. To use the device, users simply place it on their forehead. Within ten seconds, sensors and a camera gather data, which is then sent directly to the user's smartphone via Bluetooth. The Scout is compatible with both Android and iOS devices and supports Bluetooth 4.0. The Scanadu Scout stores previous readings, allowing users to monitor changes in their vital signs over time. Data can be easily shared with healthcare professionals, enabling more informed discussions about health. The gadget charges via micro-USB in less than an hour, with the battery lasting about a week with moderate use. Currently in the prototype stage, Scanadu's team plans to submit the Scout to the FDA for approval prior to consumer release. They are inviting volunteers to test the device and help refine its design. Through a campaign on Indiegogo, Scanadu reached its $200,000 crowdfunding goal in just two hours. Founded by Walter de Brouwer, Scanadu operates out of NASA Research Park in Moffett Field, California. The device is based on the 32-bit RTOS Micrium platform, previously used in NASA's Mars missions. The Scanadu team comprises experts in fields such as data science, mathematics, engineering, and molecular biology. Scanadu aims to give individuals unprecedented access to their own health data, empowering them to track wellness with precision and communicate more effectively with physicians. According to the company, the Scout is set to become the ultimate consumer health device.

article_content: VATICAN CITY – On Wednesday, Pope Francis opened a global gathering of bishops and laypeople to discuss key aspects of the Catholic Church's future, including topics previously considered off-limits. For the first time, women and laypeople are allowed to vote on specific proposals alongside bishops—a notable shift reflecting Francis’ belief that the Church serves its community. The Synod of Bishops, held from October 4-29, is the first part of a two-session event, with the second session scheduled for next year. That session is expected to produce proposals for Francis to consider in a future papal document. The Synod’s agenda was shaped by a committee following an unprecedented two-year survey of Catholics worldwide. The resulting working document is intended to spark debate, often presenting topics as questions. However, it also indicates areas of consensus, such as calls for concrete steps to increase women’s participation in decision-making roles, including possible ordination as deacons, and for greater lay involvement in Church governance. The document advocates for 'radical inclusion' of LGBTQ+ Catholics and others historically marginalized, and for new accountability measures regarding bishops’ use of authority to prevent abuses. 'From all corners of the world, greater inclusion and support for LGBTQ+ people have emerged as top pastoral issues for the Catholic Church,' noted New Ways Ministry, an advocate for LGBTQ+ Catholics. Some conservative Catholics have expressed concerns about the Synod since it was announced three years ago, warning that revisiting settled issues could risk division within the Church. Recently, five conservative cardinals from Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas publicly challenged Francis. In a letter with five questions—dubia—they asked him to clarify Church teachings on doctrine, homosexuality, female ordination, and church authority, arguing that the Synod is causing confusion. In response, Francis wrote that the evolving world encourages the Church to better understand and explain its teachings. He said the Synod is a way to discern the Church's path forward. 'With much sincerity, I tell you it’s not good to be afraid of these questions,' Francis said. The Synod includes 365 voting members, including the Pope, with 54 women. Delegates were chosen by national bishops' conferences, papal nominations, and religious orders. Around 100 non-voting experts and facilitators assist with the dialogue. This year, two bishops from China—Antonio Yao Shun (Jining, Inner Mongolia) and Yang Yongqiang (Zhoucun, Shandong Province)—were nominated after being recommended by the Chinese Catholic Church, a notable sign of growing Vatican-China cooperation. Cardinal Stephen Chow of Hong Kong called their participation significant for fostering closer relations between the Church in China and the global Catholic community. The Synod preparation was characterized by transparency and calls for listening. However, Francis has imposed a media blackout on the Synod itself. Though initial plans included livestreams and more communication officers, organizers clarified that this is a closed-door meeting and participants have been told not to speak to journalists. Paolo Ruffini, head of Synod communications, denied that deliberations fall under pontifical secrecy, explaining that it is a time for prayer and discernment. He referenced a 1990 essay advocating for the benefits of 'silence' in communication. Only five official briefings are planned during the meeting. Francis has defended this approach, stating he wants genuine dialogue without 'political gossip.' 'This isn’t a television show,' he told journalists in August.
translated_content: VATIKAN – Papa Franja je u sredu otvorio globalni skup biskupa i laika kako bi razgovarali o ključnim aspektima budućnosti Katoličke crkve, uključujući teme koje su ranije bile tabu. Prvi put žene i laici mogu glasati o konkretnim predlozima zajedno sa biskupima – značajna promena koja odražava Franjino uverenje da crkva postoji zbog svoje zajednice. Sinod biskupa, koji traje od 4. do 29. oktobra, prvi je deo dvodelnog događaja, dok je drugi deo zakazan za narednu godinu. Očekuje se da će tada biti izrađeni predlozi koje će papa Franja razmotriti u budućem papinskom dokumentu. Dnevni red Sinoda oblikovao je odbor na osnovu dosad nezapamćenog dvogodišnjeg istraživanja među katolicima širom sveta. Radni dokument ima za cilj da podstakne debatu, često postavljajući teme u vidu pitanja. Ipak, sadrži i oblasti konsenzusa, poput poziva na konkretne korake ka većem učešću žena u odlučivanju, uključujući moguću đakonsku službu, kao i na snažniju ulogu laika u upravljanju crkvom. Dokument se zalaže za 'radikalno uključivanje' LGBTQ+ katolika i ostalih ranije marginalizovanih, kao i za nove mehanizme odgovornosti u vezi sa autoritetom biskupa radi sprečavanja zloupotreba. 'Iz svih krajeva sveta, veće uključivanje i podrška LGBTQ+ ljudima izdvojili su se kao glavni pastoralni izazovi za Katoličku crkvu', navodi New Ways Ministry, organizacija za zagovaranje LGBTQ+ katolika. Neki konzervativni katolici izrazili su zabrinutost još od najave Sinoda pre tri godine, upozoravajući da ponovno otvaranje već rešenih pitanja može izazvati podele u crkvi. Nedavno je pet konzervativnih kardinala iz Evrope, Azije, Afrike i Amerike javno izazvalo papu Franju. U pismu sa pet pitanja – tzv. dubia – tražili su da papa razjasni crkvena učenja o doktrini, homoseksualnosti, ženskom sveštenstvu i crkvenoj vlasti, tvrdeći da Sinod unosi konfuziju. U odgovoru, Franja je napisao da promene u svetu podstiču crkvu da bolje razume i objasni svoja učenja. Istakao je da je Sinod način za razlučivanje pravca crkve. 'Iskreno vam kažem, nije dobro plašiti se ovih pitanja,' rekao je Franja. Sinod uključuje 365 članova s pravom glasa, uključujući papu i 54 žene. Delegati su izabrani preko nacionalnih biskupskih konferencija, papinskih nominacija i redovničkih zajednica. Oko 100 nevoting eksperata i facilitatora pomaže u dijalogu. Ove godine, dva biskupa iz Kine – Antonio Yao Shun (Đining, Unutrašnja Mongolija) i Yang Yongqiang (Žoucun, provincija Šandong) – nominovani su po preporuci kineske katoličke crkve, što je značajan signal sve bolje saradnje Vatikana i Kine. Kardinal Stefan Čou iz Hongkonga nazvao je njihovo učešće važnim za jačanje veza crkve u Kini sa svetskom katoličkom zajednicom. Priprema Sinoda obeležena je transparentnošću i pozivom na slušanje. Ipak, Franja je uveo medijsku blokadu tokom samog Sinoda. Iako su prvobitno bili planirani prenosi i više ljudi za komunikaciju, organizatori su naglasili da je reč o zatvorenom sastanku i da je učesnicima zabranjeno da govore za novinare. Paolo Rufini, šef komunikacija Sinoda, negirao je da se rasprava vodi pod crkvenom tajnom, objasnivši da je reč o vremenu molitve i razlučivanja. Pozvao se na esej iz 1990. godine u kome su istaknute koristi komunikacijske 'tišine'. Tokom sastanka planirano je samo pet zvaničnih izveštaja. Franja je podržao ovaj pristup, naglašavajući želju za iskrenim dijalogom bez 'političkih tračeva'. 'Ovo nije televizijski program', rekao je novinarima u avgustu.

article_content: A newly discovered tunnel running from Mexico into the United States has been found by customs officials. The sophisticated tunnel passes beneath the border, connecting the Mexican city of Tijuana with San Diego, California. Immigration and Customs Enforcement reported the passage was recently completed but did not provide further details in their statement. Mexican news outlets shared photographs showing a deep, well-constructed tunnel near Tijuana airport. Although the airport is about four miles from the American border by road, it is only a short distance away in a straight line. Tijuana's public safety chief, Alberto Capella, said a law enforcement operation is in progress and declined to share more information. Dozens of similar tunnels have been uncovered along the border in recent years, mostly designed for smuggling marijuana into the United States. In the previous year, authorities discovered a 240-yard drug-smuggling tunnel in Arizona. The Mexican Army also discovered an incomplete tunnel under a bathroom sink in Tijuana, which extended 200 yards into San Diego. U.S. authorities had been investigating the Tijuana tunnel for three months and found it unconnected to the Arizona smuggling route. The entrance to the Arizona tunnel measured 24 by 24 inches and descended 60 feet into a 240-yard passage. Authorities say building such a tunnel typically takes between six months and a year, with workers using shovels, pickaxes, and sometimes pneumatic tools, often sleeping at the tunneling sites until the work is complete. Since 1990, a total of 156 secret tunnels have been found along the border, most of which were unfinished. Police raids in November of the previous year uncovered two tunnels between San Diego and Tijuana, seizing a combined 52 tons of marijuana. In December 2009, authorities came across an incomplete tunnel nearly 900 feet long extending from Tijuana into San Diego, which had an elevator at its Mexican entrance and was estimated to cost more than £930,000 to build.
translated_content: Nedavno otkriveni tunel koji vodi iz Meksika u Sjedinjene Države pronašli su carinski zvaničnici. Sofisticirani tunel prolazi ispod granice, povezujući meksički grad Tihuanu sa San Dijegom u Kaliforniji. Imigraciona i carinska služba je izvestila da je prolaz nedavno završen, ali nije dala dodatne detalje u saopštenju. Meksički mediji su objavili fotografije na kojima se vidi dubok, dobro izgrađen tunel u blizini aerodroma u Tihuani. Iako je aerodrom udaljen oko četiri milje od američke granice putem, u pravoj liniji to je samo kratka razdaljina. Šef javne bezbednosti Tihuane, Alberto Kapela, rekao je da je u toku policijska akcija i da ne može da iznese više informacija. Desetine sličnih tunela otkriveno je poslednjih godina duž granice, uglavnom namenjenih za šverc marihuane u Sjedinjene Države. Prošle godine, vlasti su otkrile tunel za šverc droge dug 240 jardi u Arizoni. Meksička vojska je takođe pronašla nedovršen tunel ispod lavaboa u Tihuani, koji je išao 200 jardi u San Dijego. Američke vlasti su tri meseca istraživale tunel kod Tihuane i nisu pronašle vezu sa švercerskom rutom u Arizoni. Ulaz u arizonski tunel merio je 24 sa 24 inča i vodio je 60 stopa nadole u prolaz dug 240 jardi. Vlasti navode da izgradnja ovakvog tunela obično traje između šest meseci i godinu dana, radnici koriste lopate, pijuke, ponekad pneumatske alate i često spavaju na mestu iskopa dok posao ne završe. Od 1990. godine, ukupno je pronađeno 156 tajnih tunela duž granice, od kojih je većina bila nedovršena. Policijske akcije u novembru prošle godine otkrile su dva tunela između San Dijega i Tihuane, kada je zaplenjeno ukupno 52 tone marihuane. U decembru 2009. godine, vlasti su pronašle nedovršen tunel dugačak skoro 900 stopa od Tihuane do San Dijega, koji je na meksičkom ulazu imao lift i procenjuje se da je izgradnja koštala više od 930.000 funti.

Tensions are escalating between China and Western nations over artificial intelligence regulations, as the UK prepares to host the Global AI Safety Summit led by Prime Minister Rishi Sunak this week. Several leading Chinese AI experts have joined their Western counterparts in signing a significant statement warning about the 'existential risk' posed by advanced AI, and calling for stringent international oversight. According to a November 1 report from the Financial Times, the statement—signed by figures such as China's Andrew Yao and Canada's Yoshua Bengio—calls for the establishment of a global regulatory body to oversee AI. Key proposals include the mandatory registration and auditing of advanced AI systems, the implementation of 'shutdown' procedures, and a requirement that developers allocate 30% of their budgets to safety. These measures go beyond current regulatory suggestions from the US, EU, and UK.

China's apparent support for robust AI regulations stands in contrast to its domestic policy focus on using AI for censorship and social control, indicating that Beijing may push for strong AI safety measures at the summit. This position could diverge from Washington's focus on preventing AI discrimination and protecting privacy, highlighting ongoing global tensions over technology leadership.

Despite the urgency, the UK's draft communique for the summit, as reported by the Financial Times, does not propose specific regulations, but rather warns of the potentially catastrophic threats posed by AI. Rishi Sunak is seeking support for this non-binding statement from countries including the US, India, South Korea, Japan, and others. Prominent tech leaders such as OpenAI's Sam Altman and X (formerly Twitter) owner Elon Musk are expected to attend. In an effort to solidify the summit's legacy, the UK is expected to announce South Korea as the host of the next AI Safety Summit in 2024, with analysts considering South Korea a neutral convenor amid regulatory tensions between China and the West.

The contrasting visions for AI oversight on display at Bletchley Park underscore the challenge of reaching a global agreement on managing AI risks. As advanced AI technologies evolve, the divide between East and West on AI safety regulations continues to widen.

Nekoliko vodećih kineskih stručnjaka za veštačku inteligenciju pridružilo se svojim zapadnim kolegama potpisivanjem značajne izjave koja upozorava na 'egzistencijalni rizik' koji nosi napredna veštačka inteligencija i poziva na strogi međunarodni nadzor. Prema izveštaju Financial Timesa od 1. novembra, izjava—koju su potpisali ličnosti kao što su kineski Andrew Yao i Kanađanin Yoshua Bengio—poziva na osnivanje globalnog regulatornog tela za nadzor AI. Ključni predlozi uključuju obaveznu registraciju i reviziju naprednih AI sistema, uvođenje procedura za gašenje sistema u slučaju opasnosti i zahtev da developeri izdvoje 30% budžeta za bezbednost. Ove mere prevazilaze trenutne regulative koje predlažu SAD, EU i Velika Britanija.

Spremnost Kine da podrži snažnije AI regulative suprotstavlja se njenom internom fokusu na korišćenje AI za cenzuru i društvenu kontrolu, što ukazuje da bi Peking na samitu mogao insistirati na strožim merama za bezbednost AI. Ovaj pristup se može razilaziti sa američkim prioritetima zaštite privatnosti i sprečavanja diskriminacije putem AI, što naglašava aktuelne svetske tenzije oko tehnološkog liderstva.

Uprkos hitnosti, nacrt saopštenja Velike Britanije za samit, kako navodi Financial Times, ne predlaže konkretne regulacije, već upozorava na potencijalno katastrofalne pretnje koje nosi AI. Riši Sunak traži podršku za ovu neobavezujuću izjavu od zemalja kao što su SAD, Indija, Južna Koreja, Japan i drugih. Na samitu se očekuje prisustvo istaknutih tehnoloških lidera kao što su Sam Altman iz OpenAI i Elon Musk, vlasnik platforme X (bivši Twitter). U cilju ostavljanja nasleđa samita, očekuje se da će Velika Britanija najaviti da će sledeći Samit o bezbednosti AI 2024. godine biti održan u Južnoj Koreji, koju analitičari vide kao neutralnog domaćina zbog tenzija oko regulacije između Kine i Zapada.

Suprotstavljene vizije regulacije AI, koje će biti predstavljene u Bletchley Parku, naglašavaju koliko je izazovno postići globalni dogovor o upravljanju rizicima veštačke inteligencije. Kako se napredne AI tehnologije razvijaju, jaz između Istoka i Zapada o bezbednosnim regulacijama se i dalje produbljuje.

Former Super Eagles captains Daniel Amokachi and Joseph Yobo have expressed confidence that Nigeria will bounce back following their disappointing start in the 2026 World Cup qualifiers, according to SUNDAY PUNCH. The three-time African champions played to a 1-1 draw against Lesotho at home in their opening match at the Godswill Akpabio Stadium last Thursday.

Looking ahead to their second group game against Zimbabwe on Sunday in Kigali, Rwanda, both Amokachi and Yobo—winners of the AFCON as players in 1994 and 2013, respectively—remain optimistic about the Super Eagles' prospects of qualifying for the 2026 World Cup, which will be co-hosted by the USA, Canada, and Mexico. In separate conversations with SUNDAY PUNCH, they also stated that Jose Peseiro’s side have the quality needed to claim a fourth AFCON title.

"Many people have doubts after Thursday’s result against Lesotho, but football is unpredictable," Amokachi said during the unveiling ceremony of the Eagles’ ‘Let’s Do It Again’ campaign for the next AFCON tournament in Ivory Coast. "The beauty of football lies in having a quality team; good days will eventually come. I’m a huge fan of this generation of players. When things get tough, we respond. That’s what drives us as a nation—our determination and courage. Let’s do it again."

Yobo, who captained Nigeria to their third AFCON title in 2013, added: "Talent can take you far, but it’s teamwork and intelligence that win championships. We’re thinking long-term—it’s not just about one match. The NFF president reminded us this was just one game in a marathon. The qualifiers are not knockout rounds. What happened was actually good for the players’ morale, teaching them they can’t afford more mistakes, but it wasn’t a bad game."

Both former captains maintained their belief that the team can overcome a shaky start and succeed in their qualification campaign for both the AFCON and the 2026 World Cup.

Gledajući unapred na drugu utakmicu grupe protiv Zimbabvea u nedelju u Kigaliju, Ruanda, Amokachi i Yobo—pobednici AFCON-a kao igrači 1994. i 2013. godine—ostaju optimisti u vezi sa šansama Super Eaglesa da se kvalifikuju za Svetsko prvenstvo 2026, koje će biti održano u SAD, Kanadi i Meksiku. U odvojenim razgovorima za SUNDAY PUNCH, oni su takođe naglasili da tim pod vođstvom Josea Peseira ima kvalitet da osvoji četvrtu titulu na AFCON-u.

"Mnogi sumnjaju posle rezultata u četvrtak protiv Lesota, ali fudbal je nepredvidiv," rekao je Amokachi tokom ceremonije predstavljanja kampanje Eaglesa ‘Hajde da to ponovimo’ za naredni AFCON u Obali Slonovače. "Lepota fudbala je u kvalitetu ekipe; dobri dani će sigurno doći. Veliki sam fan ove generacije igrača. Kada je najteže, mi odgovorimo. To nas pokreće kao naciju—naša odlučnost i hrabrost. Hajde da to ponovimo."

Yobo, koji je predvodio Nigeriju do treće titule na AFCON-u 2013. godine, dodao je: "Talent može da vas odvede daleko, ali timski rad i inteligencija donose šampionske titule.
