article_content: The United States is engaged in talks with Israel about the possibility of releasing Jonathan Pollard, who is serving a life sentence for espionage, as an incentive to encourage progress in the Middle East peace negotiations, according to people with knowledge of the discussions. Such a release would signal a major change in US policy and reflect the seriousness of current diplomatic efforts. Sources stress that an early release for Pollard—an idea long opposed by US defense and intelligence authorities—is not guaranteed, and negotiations are ongoing. Those providing information requested anonymity due to the sensitive and unofficial nature of the talks. In return for Pollard’s release, Israel may be expected to make substantial moves, including pausing settlement construction in contested territories, freeing additional Palestinian prisoners beyond prior agreements, and staying in the peace talks beyond the current end-of-April deadline. US Secretary of State John Kerry recently met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, then with Palestinian chief negotiator Saeb Erekat and a second Palestinian official. Kerry scheduled another meeting with Netanyahu before leaving for Brussels to participate in NATO talks on Ukraine. The US defense and intelligence communities have historically rejected the idea of freeing Pollard, who as a Navy intelligence analyst gave classified information to Israel in the 1980s. Arrested in 1985 after seeking shelter at the Israeli embassy, Pollard pleaded guilty and received a life sentence. President Barack Obama, like predecessors, has denied previous requests from Israeli leaders to release Pollard, emphasizing that he must follow US law and review the case as with any other individual’s. Nonetheless, he acknowledged the depth of feeling surrounding the issue. Pollard, incarcerated in Butner, North Carolina, will become eligible for parole in November 2015, after serving 30 years. White House spokesperson Jay Carney has stated there are no new developments regarding Pollard’s status. Prisoner releases remain a contentious topic in the peace process. Israel has already released several groups of Palestinian prisoners, but the anticipated final round—which could include those convicted of deadly attacks—faces strong opposition within Netanyahu’s government. Netanyahu has persistently championed Pollard’s release, linking it to prior negotiations and appealing for humanitarian considerations. US intelligence officials have consistently opposed these requests. While American military and intelligence officials argue that releasing Pollard could damage US national security, support for his release has grown among some notable public figures, including former Secretaries of State Henry Kissinger and George Schultz, Senator John McCain, and former CIA Director R. James Woolsey. Pollard’s lengthy imprisonment is a highly charged issue in Israel, garnering wide public sympathy and regular appeals from leaders who describe his punishment as excessive.
translated_content: Sjedinjene Američke Države vode razgovore sa Izraelom o mogućnosti puštanja Džonatana Polarda, koji služi doživotnu kaznu zbog špijunaže, kao podsticaja za napredak u mirovnim pregovorima na Bliskom istoku, saopštili su izvori upoznati sa ovim pregovorima. Takav potez bi ukazivao na veliku promenu u američkoj politici i pokazao ozbiljnost trenutnih diplomatskih napora. Izvori naglašavaju da puštanje Polarda na slobodu—ideja kojoj su se američki zvaničnici odbrane i obaveštajnih službi dugo protivili—nije izvesno, a pregovori su i dalje u toku. Oni koji su dali informacije tražili su anonimnost zbog osetljivosti i neslužbenog karaktera razgovora. Zauzvrat, očekuje se da Izrael preduzme značajne korake, uključujući zaustavljanje izgradnje naselja na osporavanim teritorijama, oslobađanje dodatnih palestinskih zatvorenika izvan prethodnih dogovora i ostanak za pregovaračkim stolom i nakon trenutnog roka krajem aprila. Američki državni sekretar Džon Keri nedavno je razgovarao sa izraelskim premijerom Benjaminom Netanjahuom, a zatim i sa palestinskim glavnim pregovaračem Saebom Erekatom i još jednim palestinskim zvaničnikom. Keri je planirao još jedan sastanak sa Netanjahuom pre odlaska u Brisel na NATO razgovore o Ukrajini. Američke odbrambene i obaveštajne službe tradicionalno su se protivile puštanju Polarda, koji je kao obaveštajni analitičar mornarice predao poverljive informacije Izraelu tokom 1980-ih. Uhapšen je 1985. nakon pokušaja dobijanja azila u izraelskoj ambasadi, priznao je krivicu i osuđen je na doživotnu kaznu zatvora. Predsednik Barak Obama, kao i prethodnici, odbio je ranije zahteve izraelskih lidera za oslobađanje Polarda, naglašavajući da mora poštovati američki zakon i razmatrati slučaj kao i svaki drugi. Ipak, priznao je dubinu emocija koju ovaj slučaj izaziva. Polard, koji je u zatvoru u Baternu, Severna Karolina, stiče pravo na uslovno puštanje u novembru 2015, nakon što odsluži 30 godina. Portparol Bele kuće Džej Karni izjavio je da nema novih informacija o Polardovom statusu. Pitanje oslobađanja zatvorenika ostaje sporna tema u mirovnom procesu. Izrael je već oslobodio nekoliko grupa palestinskih zatvorenika, ali očekivano poslednje puštanje—koje bi moglo uključiti one osuđene za smrtonosne napade—izaziva snažno protivljenje u Netanjahuovoj vladi. Netanjahu je uporno zagovarao Polardovo oslobađanje, vezujući to za prethodne pregovore i obraćajući pažnju na humanitarne aspekte. Američki obaveštajni zvaničnici su dosledno odbijali te zahteve. Dok američki vojni i obaveštajni zvaničnici upozoravaju da bi oslobađanje Polarda moglo narušiti nacionalnu bezbednost SAD, podrška njegovom puštanju rasla je među poznatim javnim ličnostima kao što su bivši državni sekretari Henri Kisindžer i Džordž Šulc, senator Džon Mekejn i bivši direktor CIA Džejms Vulsej. Polardovo dugogodišnje zatvaranje veoma je emotivno pitanje u Izraelu, gde uživa veliku javnu podršku i gde lideri često ističu da je njegova kazna preterana.

article_content: Recent UK government data shows boys are twice as likely as girls to be identified with special educational needs (SEN) in England. Almost 1.5 million children attending state schools have learning difficulties or disabilities, with about 912,000 boys and nearly 488,000 girls affected. These needs include behavioral, emotional, and social issues, as well as speech and communication difficulties. The statistics also indicate a stronger prevalence of SEN among children from lower-income families, some ethnic minorities, and those in care. Approximately 29% of SEN pupils qualify for free school meals, compared to 13% of non-SEN students, and around 68% of children in care have special needs. Since 2010, the proportion of children with SEN has reduced from 21.1% to 17.9%. Nonetheless, there remains a significant disparity between boys and girls. Boys are more commonly diagnosed with autism and ADHD, though the specific reasons are not entirely known. Recent research published in the American Journal of Human Genetics suggests that girls require greater genetic mutations than boys to develop autism, leading to fewer diagnoses among girls. When it comes to academic results, children with SEN are at a marked disadvantage. Only 34% of these students meet expected standards in reading, writing, and mathematics at the end of primary school, in contrast to 88% of other pupils. In secondary education, only 23.4% of SEN teenagers achieve at least five C grades at GCSE, compared to 70% of their peers without SEN. To address these issues, a new integrated SEN support system called education, health, and care plans (EHCPs) now extends support from birth to age 25, replacing the previous frameworks. Researchers, including Dr Sébastien Jacquemont from Switzerland, have investigated why autism appears more frequently in boys. Studies of DNA from thousands of individuals indicate that girls with neurodevelopmental disorders, such as autism, often have more profound genetic changes than affected boys. This supports the theory that the female brain is more resilient, and that greater genetic alterations are needed for symptoms to manifest, which may explain the gender gap in diagnosis. The research also covered other neurodevelopmental conditions like Down’s syndrome, ADHD, Tourette’s syndrome, and injuries affecting the brain, suggesting the need for improved gender-sensitive diagnostic methods.
translated_content: Nedavni podaci britanske vlade pokazuju da su dečaci u Engleskoj dvaput češće nego devojčice identifikovani kao deca sa posebnim obrazovnim potrebama (SEN). Gotovo 1,5 miliona dece u državnim školama ima teškoće u učenju ili invaliditet, među kojima je oko 912.000 dečaka i skoro 488.000 devojčica. Ove potrebe obuhvataju probleme u ponašanju, emocionalne i socijalne teškoće, kao i poteškoće u govoru i komunikaciji. Statistika pokazuje i veću zastupljenost SEN-a među decom iz porodica sa nižim prihodima, određenih manjinskih grupa i decom na staranju. Približno 29% učenika sa SEN-om ima pravo na besplatne školske obroke, dok je taj procenat kod učenika bez SEN-a 13%, a oko 68% dece na staranju ima posebne potrebe. Od 2010. godine udeo dece sa SEN-om opao je sa 21,1% na 17,9%. I dalje postoji značajna razlika između dečaka i devojčica. Dečaci češće dobijaju dijagnoze poput autizma i ADHD-a, iako razlozi za to nisu sasvim poznati. Novo istraživanje objavljeno u časopisu American Journal of Human Genetics sugeriše da su ženama potrebne ozbiljnije genetske promene da bi razvile autizam, pa se on ređe dijagnostikuje kod devojčica. Školski uspeh dece sa SEN-om je znatno slabiji. Samo 34% ove dece dostiže očekivane standarde iz čitanja, pisanja i matematike na kraju osnovne škole, naspram 88% druge dece. U srednjoj školi, samo 23,4% SEN tinejdžera postigne najmanje pet ocena C ili više na završnim ispitima, dok je taj procenat kod druge dece 70%. Kako bi se poboljšala podrška, uveden je novi integrisani sistem podrške za SEN – obrazovni, zdravstveni i negujući planovi (EHCP), koji sada obuhvataju decu i mlade od rođenja do 25. godine, zamenjujući stare okvire. Naučnici, među njima i dr Sebastijan Žakmont iz Švajcarske, proučavali su zašto se autizam češće dijagnostikuje kod dečaka. Analiza DNK hiljada osoba sa neuro-razvojnim poremećajima pokazuje da devojčice sa tim dijagnozama imaju izraženije genetske promene nego dečaci sa istim poremećajem, što podržava teoriju da je ženski mozak otporniji i da su potrebne ozbiljnije genetske promene za razvoj simptoma. Istraživanje je obuhvatilo i druga neuro-razvojna stanja kao što su Daunov sindrom, ADHD, Turetov sindrom i povrede mozga, ističući potrebu za preciznijom dijagnostikom koja uzima u obzir pol.

In May 2022, New Yorkers marked one year since cannabis legalization, but the rollout of adult-use licenses has faced numerous challenges. The New York State Senate Subcommittee on Cannabis held a marathon seven-hour hearing on October 30, highlighting significant delays and problems within the state’s adult-use program.

Farmers like Ryan Andoos from Moriches, NY, testified about unsold product: Andoos has 3,250 pounds of frozen biomass and 1,600 pounds of dry biomass ready for processors. However, many retailers only have provisional licenses, leaving growers unable to move their inventory—and facing substantial financial losses.

Joseph Calderone, vice president of the Cannabis Farmers Alliance, described a system in which “major medical marijuana companies are rolling out millions of square feet of indoor growing capacity while small, independent farms are being crushed by misguided regulations and a failed retail launch.”

Yoko Miyashita, CEO of Leafly, an online cannabis education platform, testified that New York's Office of Cannabis Management (OCM) often warns about the dangers of 'corporate cannabis,' but has not effectively addressed the issue of the illicit market.

Larry Levy, founder and CEO of Lucid Green—a tech firm offering inventory-management software for cannabis—said the ongoing lack of full retail licensing in New York City is causing millions of dollars in unsold products to sit idle. According to Levy, this situation has cost the city an estimated $19.4 million in lost tax revenue.

In an interview, Levy criticized the OCM's delay in launching a comprehensive track-and-trace system—technology already implemented in two dozen other states. He argued that without such a system, transparency and communication are lacking. "New York is the only state to launch an adult-use program without a track and trace system in place," Levy stated.

Chris Alexander, executive director of the OCM, disputed some of Levy’s criticisms. Due to ongoing litigation over licensing, Alexander declined direct quotes, but clarified that a tracking system exists via biweekly reporting requirements for cultivators and processors. However, the company contracted to implement a more advanced seed-to-sale system, BioTrack, faces legal hurdles that have delayed full deployment. Until these issues are resolved, operators can select their own tracking solutions, provided their data can integrate with BioTrack once it is operational.

Levy and his team at Lucid Green continue to promote their Universal Product Code (UPC) technology, which is already used by 400 brands and 140 retailers, covering approximately 50 million product units. Lucid Green uses a UPC platform with regulatory-compliance labels, allowing for detailed tracking and transparency at every step, from manufacturing to the consumer’s purchase.

As demand remains high—legal cannabis revenues reached $101.4 million by the end of October—the lack of a streamlined supply chain and delays in licensing mean inventory is piling up with growers and retailers. Alexander acknowledged these challenges but said the tracking system is expected to be more fully implemented once litigation is resolved.

Levy emphasized the importance of adopting technological solutions and fostering a willingness among stakeholders to innovate, noting that industry-wide trust and transparency are essential for long-term success.

A recent study has revealed that 48 Antarctic ice shelves have shrunk by at least 30% since 1997, with 28 of these losing more than half their ice during this period. Of Antarctica's 162 identified ice shelves, 68 exhibited significant shrinkage between 1997 and 2021, while 29 grew, 62 remained stable, and three lost mass without a significant trend, according to research published in Science Advances.  

Ice shelves act as critical barriers that help contain massive glaciers from streaming into the ocean. The loss of these shelves allows glacial ice to flow more freely into the sea, contributing to global sea level rise over decades and centuries. Scientists are particularly concerned that climate change-driven melting in Antarctica and Greenland could have severe long-term consequences for coastal communities worldwide.

"Knowing exactly how and how much ice is being lost from these protective floating shelves is a key step in understanding how Antarctica is evolving," said Ted Scambos, an ice scientist at the University of Colorado who was not involved in the study. He highlighted that substantial freshwater is entering the Amundsen Sea, a primary area of concern for sea level rise. This process not only increases ocean volume but also lessens its density and salinity.

The largest losses over the past 25 years are linked to dramatic iceberg breakups, with giant icebergs the size of Delaware breaking off in 1999, 2000, and 2002. The study also examined melting caused by warmer water beneath the ice shelves.

Lead author Benjamin Davison, a glaciologist at the University of Leeds, emphasized that the patterns of individual ice shelf loss are most crucial for understanding the continent's changes. For example, four glaciers on the Antarctic Peninsula and western side each lost over a trillion tons of ice.

Some individual shelves have nearly vanished: the Wordie ice shelf has lost 87% of its mass since 1997, following a major collapse in 1989, while neighboring Larsen A and Larsen B have lost 73% and 57%, respectively. The largest Larsen shelf, Larsen C, lost about one-eighth of its mass, or 1.8 trillion tons of ice. The most severe loss occurred in the Thwaites ice shelf, often called the "Doomsday Glacier," which lost 70% of its mass—4.1 trillion tons—since 1997.

In contrast, shelves on the east side of the continent, where local weather patterns isolate the area from warmer ocean waters, have seen some growth, although at a slower pace compared to the shrinking shelves of the west.

Although it is difficult to directly attribute each instance of ice shelf loss to human-caused climate change, experts expect the steady decline to continue as the planet warms.

article_content: Royal Doulton, the iconic British brand known for its elegant porcelain, has introduced a fresh, street art-inspired collection. Traditionally renowned for serving the Royal Family with its distinguished tableware, Royal Doulton is breaking new ground by teaming up with acclaimed street artists Charles Uzzell Edwards—known as Pure Evil—and Nick Walker. The resulting limited editions feature colorful, graffiti-themed designs that mark a sharp departure from the brand’s classic look. The collection includes eight large 27cm plates, seven mugs, and two sets of four 17cm plates, each bearing unique artwork. Reflecting their exclusivity, mugs start at £18, with plates priced at £60 each. Pure Evil contributes four designs: 'Bunny Fingers,' 'Pure Evil in the Pillory,' 'Beautiful Thing,' and 'Marilyn Marlene Dali.' Nick Walker’s creations include 'Love Vandal,' 'Vandal Airways,' 'The Morning After New,' and 'Collage.' With origins dating back to 1815 in Stoke-on-Trent, Royal Doulton holds Royal Warrants from The Prince of Wales and The Queen. Company representatives describe the new collection as a modern take on ceramic art, designed to stand out and spark conversation.

An Australian university lecturer has become the subject of an internet joke after a photo of his injured thumb went viral. Stephen Owen cut his thumb while cooking for his family and shared an image of the bandaged injury on Instagram. He captioned the post, 'My thumb was in that band aid too long.' Instead of receiving questions about his recovery or messages of sympathy, Owen found himself ridiculed across social media, with users comparing the appearance of his thumb to male genitalia.

Some Instagram users approached the joke subtly, tagging friends and playfully asking, 'What does it look like though?', while others were more direct in their commentary. One user wrote, 'Looks like a penis.'

Despite the unexpected attention, Owen was more concerned about the lack of sympathy for his injured thumb than his newfound internet fame. He later updated his followers, writing, 'My thumb is better,' but the lighthearted teasing persisted. On Tuesday, he tweeted, 'Why has no one asked if my thumb is ok? You people are all monsters.' Even after posting an updated photo showing his thumb's improvement, comments continued, with one user replying, 'Still looks like a c**k.'

article_content: Boy George is set to make a return to Broadway in 'Moulin Rouge! The Musical.' The British pop star, well-known for hits like 'Karma Chameleon' and 'Do You Really Want to Hurt Me' with Culture Club, will portray the energetic club owner Harold Zidler. His run will last from February 6 to May 12 at the Al Hirschfeld Theater in New York. This marks Boy George’s first Broadway performance in two decades, following his debut in 'Taboo,' a Rosie O'Donnell-produced musical featuring his original songs. Currently, actor Tituss Burgess is playing the role of Harold Zidler, which was originally performed by Danny Burstein, the Tony Award winner for Best Featured Actor in a Musical. 'Moulin Rouge! The Musical,' based on Baz Luhrmann’s acclaimed 2001 film, is set in turn-of-the-century Paris and tells the story of a young composer who falls in love with a cabaret actress. The production is directed by Alex Timbers, with a book by John Logan, and has won 10 Tony Awards, including Best Musical. The show debuted in 2019 and, after a temporary closure due to the COVID-19 pandemic, reopened in 2021.

If you’re pressed for time when exploring a city, you may want a guaranteed great bar experience. That’s where the 2014 list of the world’s 50 best bars comes in, published by Drinks International magazine and revealed at a recent London event. The rankings were decided by more than 330 international industry experts. This year’s list features bars from 27 cities in 14 countries, with 14 new additions.

Europe stands out as a global leader in exceptional bars, claiming 21 spots, including eight for London alone—more than any other city. London’s Artesian clinched the top spot as ‘world’s best bar’ for the third consecutive year, joined in the top 10 by Nightjar and The American Bar at The Savoy.

The United States has the most growth, with 16 bars featured; four—Dead Rabbit, Attaboy, Employees Only, and Canon—placed in the top 10, hailing from New York and Seattle. Australia’s six entries all hail from Melbourne and Sydney. In Asia, four bars—representing Tokyo, Singapore, and Hong Kong—made the list, with Tokyo’s High Five ranking highest at ninth worldwide.

Latin America is represented by three bars, including Mexico City’s La Capilla and Licoreria Limantour, as well as Buenos Aires’ Floreria Atlantico.

Ten years ago, Silvia Ombellini and her husband Simone Riccardi struggled to book an eco-friendly hotel while visiting Potenza, Italy. This frustration led them to create Ecobnb, a platform that helps travelers connect with sustainable accommodations, from hotels and B&Bs to vacation homes. Now operating from Trento, Ecobnb lists over 3,000 properties around the world, including organic farms and eco-lodges.

To qualify for Ecobnb, properties must meet at least five of ten sustainability criteria, such as relying on renewable energy, offering organic or local food, collecting rainwater, using energy-saving lighting, and recycling waste. Users can filter accommodations for additional features like plant-based meals or electric car charging stations. Some hosts even reward guests arriving without cars.

Bookings are made directly with property owners, while Ecobnb earns income from monthly listing fees paid by venues. Since 2018, the platform has grown from 780,000 to 2.8 million users annually. Silvia Ombellini notes a growing movement, especially among young people, toward eco-friendly travel, which is backed by studies showing 69% of travelers now seek sustainable options.

Other companies underscore this trend. The Netherlands’ Conscious Hotels chain operates seven sustainable hotels that run on renewable power and serve only vegetarian menus using mainly local ingredients. In the UK, Byway Travel specializes in trips that avoid flights and encourage visits to less-traveled locations to combat over-tourism and support local communities.

Tourism expert Professor Marina Novelli emphasizes that sustainability means more than being green—it also covers fair pay and employment practices. She advises travelers to watch out for greenwashing and to ask critical questions, as consumer pressure can push businesses to be more authentically sustainable.

Despite the sustainability of many accommodations, air travel remains a key emission source. Ecobnb encourages local tourism and staycations to lower travel-related carbon impact. Ombellini is hopeful: growing numbers are choosing green options, proving that even small decisions can collectively create significant positive change.
translated_content:
Pre deset godina, Silvia Ombellini i njen suprug Simone Riccardi imali su poteškoća da pronađu ekološki prihvatljiv hotel tokom posete Potenzi u Italiji. Ova situacija inspirisala ih je da pokrenu Ecobnb, platformu koja povezuje putnike sa održivim smeštajem – od hotela i pansiona do kuća za odmor. Sedište Ecobnb-a je u Trentu, a na platformi se nalazi više od 3.000 objekata širom sveta, uključujući organske farme i eko-lodževe.

Da bi bio uvršten na Ecobnb, objekat mora da zadovolji najmanje pet od deset kriterijuma održivosti, kao što su korišćenje obnovljive energije, ponuda organske ili lokalne hrane, sakupljanje kišnice, upotreba štedljive rasvete i reciklaža otpada. Korisnici mogu da filtriraju smeštaj prema specifičnim zahtevima, poput veganskih obroka ili punjača na obnovljivu energiju za električne automobile. Neki domaćini nude i popuste za goste koji dolaze bez automobila.

Rezervacije se obavljaju direktno sa vlasnicima objekata, dok Ecobnb prihod ostvaruje kroz mesečne članarine koje plaćaju domaćini. Od 2018. godine, broj korisnika je porastao sa 780.000 na 2,8 miliona godišnje. Silvia Ombellini ističe da je, posebno kod mladih, porasla svest o ekološkom putovanju, na šta ukazuju i istraživanja – 69% putnika sada traži održive opcije.

Trend potvrđuju i drugi primeri. Holandski lanac Conscious Hotels ima sedam održivih hotela čija je energija iz obnovljivih izvora, koji nude samo vegetarijanske obroke i uglavnom koriste lokalne sastojke. Britanska kompanija Byway Travel se specijalizovala za putovanja bez avio-saobraćaja, podstičući posete manje posećenim destinacijama i podržavajući lokalne zajednice.

Stručnjakinja za turizam, Marina Novelli, naglašava da održivost nije samo ekologija, već i fer zarada i uslovi rada. Preporučuje putnicima da se paze "zelenog pranja" i da postavljaju pitanja, jer potražnja može da podstakne stvarne promene u poslovanju.

Iako je mnogo smeštaja održivo, avio-saobraćaj i dalje ima veliki ekološki uticaj. Ecobnb promoviše lokalni turizam i odmor u svojoj zemlji kako bi umanjio negativne posledice putovanja. Ombellini je optimista: sve više ljudi bira ekološke opcije, a čak i male odluke mogu zajedno doneti veliku pozitivnu promenu.

article_content: On Sunday, the Jharkhand Congress held a strategy session with district presidents and assembly in-charges to review their readiness for the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. State Congress chief Rajesh Thakur led the meeting, directing local leaders to finish key tasks quickly and ensure the party’s organizational work stays on schedule. Thakur said he was pleased with recent grassroots growth and remains optimistic about better performance in the upcoming polls, especially since Congress only won a single seat out of 14 in Jharkhand in 2019. To further boost collaboration between the party and government, parliamentary affairs minister Alamgir Alam said that later this month, four Congress ministers will meet district presidents. The Congress also reinforced its plan to strengthen the organization from block-level leadership to individual polling booths state-wide. In other business news, India approved the country’s first 100% foreign-owned defense project, with Sweden’s Saab set to build a rocket manufacturing plant. The State Bank of India reported a healthy 8% jump in second-quarter profits driven by strong loan demand and reduced reserves for bad debts. Edtech company Byju’s disclosed increased revenue in its main business for the 2022 financial year, though it still recorded an EBITDA loss.

Predsednik državnog Kongresa, Rađeš Takuar, vodio je sastanak i naložio lokalnim liderima da brzo završe ključne zadatke i obezbede da partijska organizacija ostane u planu. Takuar je izjavio da je zadovoljan nedavnim rastom na terenu i da je optimista kada je u pitanju bolji rezultat na predstojećim izborima, imajući u vidu da je Kongres 2019. osvojio samo jedno od 14 mesta u Džarkandu. Kako bi dodatno poboljšali saradnju između partije i vlade, ministar za parlamentarna pitanja Alamgir Alam najavio je da će kasnije ovog meseca četiri ministra Kongresa održati sastanak sa predsednicima okruga. Kongres je takođe potvrdio plan da ojača organizaciju od nivoa blokova do pojedinačnih izbornih mesta širom države. U ostalim poslovnim vestima, Indija je odobrila prvi projekat u odbrambenoj industriji sa 100% stranog vlasništva; švedska kompanija Saab će otvoriti fabriku za proizvodnju raketa. Državna banka Indije zabeležila je rast profita od 8% u drugom kvartalu zahvaljujući velikoj tražnji za kreditima i smanjenju rezervi za loše kredite. Edukaciona kompanija Byju’s objavila je rast prihoda u svojoj osnovnoj delatnosti za finansijsku 2022. godinu, iako i dalje beleži EBITDA gubitak.

article_content: Sleepless nights are a challenge for every new parent. However, one innovative father has not only managed to solve this issue for himself but is also earning £60,000 a year from his solution. Matthew Nifield, 33, created a mobile application to help his twin daughters fall asleep after discovering that certain sounds would calm them. Matthew developed the White Noise Ambience app for iPads and iPhones, which has since been downloaded by tired parents worldwide. Its popularity now brings him an income of around £60,000 annually. At the time of the app's creation, his one-year-old daughters, Madeleine and Gwyneth, rarely fell asleep at the same time. After some observation, Matthew noticed that some relaxing sounds would make them yawn and eventually drift off. He began recording soothing sounds like waves crashing, rain falling on a car roof, and even a cat purring. Whenever his daughters were wide awake, he would play one of these sounds to help them sleep. Matthew said, 'I looked on the iPhone app store for something to help the girls doze off but couldn’t find anything suitable. So I created my own app, White Noise Ambience. It worked for my daughters, and now many other tired parents are using it too.' Altogether, Matthew recorded 150 different sounds and tested them with his daughters, who were just six months old at the time. He said, 'Their favorite is waves crashing; something about it is very peaceful. Personally, I like the sound of rain on a car roof—it helps me fall asleep within ten minutes.' Other sounds in the app include a steam train, frogs croaking, a sprinkler, a tumble drier, and a lawnmower. The app has gained significant popularity in America, prompting Matthew to move to California, where he is now working on other tech products. He said, 'The app earns about £5,000 each month. There's a good living to be made from apps, especially those that address basic needs like sleep.'
translated_content: Nesane noći su izazov za svakog novog roditelja. Ipak, jedan inovativni otac ne samo da je uspeo da reši ovaj problem za sebe, već sada zarađuje i 60.000 funti godišnje zahvaljujući svom rešenju. Metju Nifild, 33, napravio je mobilnu aplikaciju kako bi pomogao svojim bliznakinjama da zaspe, nakon što je otkrio da ih određeni zvuci smiruju. Metju je razvio aplikaciju White Noise Ambience za iPad i iPhone, koja je do sada preuzeta od strane umornih roditelja širom sveta. Njena popularnost mu sada donosi prihod od oko 60.000 funti godišnje. U vreme kada je pravio aplikaciju, njegove jednogodišnje ćerke, Madlen i Gvinet, retko su istovremeno zaspale. Posle malo posmatranja, Metju je primetio da opuštajući zvuci izazivaju zijevanje i da ubrzo zaspu. Počeo je da snima umirujuće zvuke poput talasa koji udaraju o obalu, kiše koja pada na krov automobila, pa čak i predenja mačke. Kad bi devojčice bile budne, puštao bi im neki od tih zvukova kako bi lakše zaspale. Metju je rekao: 'Tražio sam u prodavnici aplikacija za iPhone nešto što bi im pomoglo da zaspe, ali nisam pronašao ništa odgovarajuće. Zato sam kreirao svoju aplikaciju, White Noise Ambience. Radila je za moje ćerke, a sada je koriste i drugi umorni roditelji.' Sve ukupno, Metju je snimio 150 različitih zvukova i testirao ih na svojim ćerkama koje su tada imale samo šest meseci. Rekao je: 'Njihov omiljeni zvuk su talasi koji udaraju o obalu, to je stvarno umirujuće. Lično, meni najviše prija zvuk kiše na krovu auta – zaspim za desetak minuta.' Ostali zvuci u aplikaciji uključuju parnu lokomotivu, žabe koje krekeću, prskalicu, sušilicu veša i kosilicu za travu. Aplikacija je postala veoma popularna u Americi, pa se zbog toga Metju preselio u Kaliforniju gde sada radi na drugim tehnološkim projektima. Rekao je: 'Aplikacija donosi oko 5.000 funti mesečno. Dobar prihod se može ostvariti od aplikacija, posebno onih koje rešavaju osnovne potrebe kao što je san!'

article_content: A powerful earthquake with a magnitude of 6.3 struck the area west of Herat city in western Afghanistan on Saturday morning, leading to significant loss of life and widespread destruction. Local authorities report that at least 100 people have died and more than 500 were injured, though some estimates suggest fatalities might be as high as 320. The disaster has sparked concerns that the toll could rise further as rescue teams continue to search for survivors trapped under debris from collapsed homes and buildings. The quake, which hit around 11:00 AM local time, was followed by several forceful aftershocks that were also felt in nearby Badghis and Farah provinces—worsening damage and panic in the region. Residents like Abdul Shakor Samadi described fleeing their homes as buildings shook violently multiple times, prompting mass evacuations from houses, offices, and shops. Local communities remain on edge, fearing further tremors. According to Afghanistan’s Ministry of Defence and the United Nations, emergency efforts are underway. The WHO dispatched a dozen ambulances to the hard-hit Zenda Jan district in Herat to help transport the injured to hospitals and provide urgent care. UN agencies stated that many of those affected are women and children, and teams continue to assess immediate needs on the ground. Taliban officials, including deputy prime minister Abdul Ghani Baradar, issued condolences and called on local organizations and citizens to support rescue, provide shelter, food, and transport for those impacted. Security agencies have been directed to deploy all available resources for relief operations. The administration further appealed to wealthy Afghans to assist their affected compatriots in this difficult time. This tragedy comes just over a year after a devastating 2022 earthquake in eastern Afghanistan—the country’s deadliest in two decades—highlighting the region’s vulnerability to such disasters and the pressing need for coordinated humanitarian assistance.
translated_content: Snažan zemljotres jačine 6,3 stepena pogodio je oblast zapadno od grada Herata u zapadnom Avganistanu u subotu ujutru, prouzrokujući veliku štetu i gubitke ljudskih života. Lokalni zvaničnici saopštavaju da je najmanje 100 ljudi poginulo, dok je više od 500 povređeno, a procene sugerišu da bi broj žrtava mogao dostići i do 320. Strahuje se da bi broj stradalih mogao dodatno rasti dok spasilačke ekipe nastavljaju potragu za preživelima zarobljenim ispod ruševina srušenih kuća i zgrada. Zemljotres, koji se dogodio oko 11 časova po lokalnom vremenu, pratile su brojne snažne naknadne potrese koji su se osetili i u susednim provincijama Badgis i Farah—dodatno povećavajući štetu i paniku u regionu. Stanovnici poput Abdula Šakora Samadija opisali su kako su bežali iz svojih domova dok su se zgrade više puta snažno tresle, što je izazvalo masovnu evakuaciju kuća, kancelarija i prodavnica. Lokalna zajednica je i dalje na oprezu, strepeći od novih potresa. Prema Ministarstvu odbrane Avganistana i Ujedinjenim nacijama, hitne mere pomoći su u toku. Svetska zdravstvena organizacija poslala je dvanaest ambulantnih vozila u posebno pogođenu oblast Zenda Džan u Heratu kako bi povređene prevezli u bolnice i obezbedili hitnu negu. UN agencije navode da su među pogođenima mnoge žene i deca, dok timovi procenjuju dodatne potrebe na terenu. Talibanski zvaničnici, uključujući zamenika premijera Abdul Ganija Baradara, izrazili su saučešće i pozvali lokalne organizacije i građane da pomognu u spasavanju, zbrinjavanju, ishrani i transportu pogođenih. Službe bezbednosti dobile su nalog da upotrebe sve raspoložive resurse za pomoć. Vlasti takođe apeluju na imućne Avganistance da pomognu svojim ugroženim sugrađanima tokom ovog teškog perioda. Ova tragedija dogodila se nešto više od godinu dana nakon razornog zemljotresa iz 2022. godine u istočnom Avganistanu—najsmrtonosnijeg u poslednje dve decenije—što još jednom pokazuje ranjivost regiona na ovakve katastrofe i hitnu potrebu za koordinisanom humanitarnom pomoći.

article_content: Senior officials from India and the United States reiterated their commitment to deepening defense and security cooperation after holding talks in New Delhi. U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken and Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin met with Indian leaders to discuss issues like regional security, China-related tensions, and the wars in Ukraine and Gaza. These talks were part of a broader effort to show a united response to Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and to manage differences regarding the Israel-Hamas conflict. Blinken emphasized that bilateral collaboration continues to grow across areas such as technology and defense, contributing to an open and resilient Indo-Pacific region. The two sides voiced concern over the Middle East conflict. While India strongly condemned the Hamas attacks, it also advocated for the peaceful creation of a sovereign Palestinian state alongside Israel. Discussions included the ongoing India-China border standoff, but no further details were made public. The U.S. brought up the recent fallout between India and Canada after allegations surfaced about India’s alleged role in the assassination of a Sikh separatist in Canada. The U.S. encouraged dialogue and cooperation between both countries to address the dispute. Regular two-plus-two meetings between India and the U.S., involving defense and foreign affairs leaders, have continued since 2018. This latest session produced agreements on boosting defense industry ties, sharing advanced technology, and working together on military equipment manufacturing. Notably, General Electric and Hindustan Aeronautics will co-produce jet engines in India, and India will receive U.S.-made MQ-9B SeaGuardian drones. The official joint statement reaffirmed commitments to enhancing defense collaboration, sharing technology, and improving supply chain resilience.
translated_content: Visoki zvaničnici Indije i Sjedinjenih Američkih Država ponovili su svoju posvećenost produbljivanju saradnje u oblasti odbrane i bezbednosti nakon sastanaka u Nju Delhiju. Američki državni sekretar Entoni Blinken i sekretar za odbranu Lojd Ostin sastali su se sa indijskim liderima kako bi razgovarali o regionalnoj bezbednosti, tenzijama sa Kinom i ratovima u Ukrajini i Gazi. Ovi razgovori deo su šireg napora da se prikaže jedinstven odgovor na rusku invaziju na Ukrajinu i upravljaju razlikama u vezi sa sukobom Izrael-Hamas. Blinken je istakao da bilateralna saradnja nastavlja da jača u oblastima poput tehnologije i odbrane, doprinoseći otvorenom i otpornom indo-pacifičkom regionu. Dve strane izrazile su zabrinutost zbog sukoba na Bliskom istoku. Dok je Indija snažno osudila napad Hamasa, istovremeno se zalaže za mirno uspostavljanje suverene palestinske države uz Izrael. Razgovaralo se i o dugotrajnom zastoju na granici sa Kinom, ali nisu izneti dodatni detalji. SAD su pokrenule pitanje novih tenzija sa Kanadom zbog optužbi o indijskoj umešanosti u ubistvo sikskog separatiste, pozivajući na dijalog i saradnju radi rešavanja spora. Redovni „dva plus dva” sastanci ministara odbrane i spoljnih poslova Indije i SAD održavaju se od 2018. Poslednja runda donela je dogovore o jačanju odbrambene industrijske saradnje, razmeni tehnologija i zajedničkoj proizvodnji vojne opreme. General Electric i Hindustan Aeronautics će zajedno proizvoditi mlazne motore u Indiji, a Indija će dobiti američke dronove MQ-9B SeaGuardian. Zajedničko saopštenje potvrdilo je posvećenost jačanju odbrambene saradnje, razmeni tehnologije i jačanju otpornosti lanaca snabdevanja.

article_content: George Zimmerman, recently acquitted for the shooting death of Trayvon Martin, has reemerged in public alongside his attorney, Mark O'Mara. Zimmerman visited Kel-Tec's headquarters in Cocoa, Florida—the firearms manufacturer of the 9mm pistol used in the 2012 incident. During his visit, Zimmerman expressed interest in the Kel-Tec KSG pump-action shotgun, a firearm notable for its capacity to hold up to 15 rounds of 12-gauge ammunition. Reports indicate he toured the factory with the owner's son and took photos with employees. It has not been confirmed if Zimmerman completed the purchase. The KSG is generally priced at $1,200 and is marketed as a home defense firearm, distinguished by a shell capacity greater than standard tactical shotguns. Zimmerman's reacquisition of his Kel-Tec pistol after the trial remains controversial, particularly in light of sharp public criticism and threats directed at him and his family following the racially charged trial. Due to the heightened attention, Zimmerman has spent much of his time out of the public eye since the case.
translated_content: Džordž Cimerman, koji je nedavno oslobođen optužbi za ubistvo Trejvona Martina, ponovo se pojavio u javnosti u pratnji svog advokata Marka O’Mare. Cimerman je posetio sedište kompanije Kel-Tec u Kokoa, Florida—proizvođača pištolja 9mm koji je korišćen u incidentu iz 2012. godine. Tokom posete, Cimerman je pokazao interesovanje za Kel-Tec KSG pumparicu, oružje poznato po kapacitetu od čak 15 patrona kalibra 12. Prema izveštajima, vlasnikov sin mu je pokazao fabriku i fotografisao se sa zaposlenima. Nije potvrđeno da li je Cimerman zapravo kupio pušku. KSG se generalno prodaje po ceni od oko 1.200 dolara i namenjena je pre svega za kućnu odbranu, izdvajajući se kapacitetom patrona u odnosu na standardne taktičke sačmare. Povratak Cimermanovog Kel-Tec pištolja posle suđenja izazvao je nove kontroverze, naročito zbog javnih kritika i pretnji koje su on i njegova porodica primili nakon suđenja koje je bilo u fokusu zbog rasnih tenzija. article_content: In Ajegunle, Lagos, children from low-income families have renewed hope for education by collecting discarded plastic bottles with their parents. These bottles are used as payment for school fees at Isrina Schools, a local institution that promotes recycling initiatives. Residents such as Kemi Saheed and Patience Onwuka describe their daily efforts to ensure their children's education while facing economic challenges. Parents are required to collect and deliver at least seven sacks of plastic bottles each term to help cover school fees, while the school also supports families in need by providing essentials like books, uniforms, and meals. The school operates with modest facilities, offering only a few potties for over 200 students, highlighting the urgent sanitation issues. UNICEF reports that millions of Nigerians lack access to adequate sanitation, and the country needs to construct millions of toilets to meet 2025 open-defecation-free targets. After primary school, many students struggle to continue to secondary education due to required levies and limited alternative payment options. Scholarships are few and highly competitive. The bottle-for-school-fees program is part of a partnership between Isrina Schools, the African Clean-Up Initiative, and other organizations. It aims to promote sustainability, keep children in school, and support underprivileged families. Despite its positive impact, the community faces ongoing hardships, aggravated by poor infrastructure and the aftermath of local disasters. The bottle-collection initiative frequently encounters logistical challenges that limit its full effectiveness. Nigeria still faces a significant out-of-school children crisis, worsened by insufficient governmental intervention and economic difficulties. Experts and organizations recommend expanding recycling programs, improving infrastructure, and increasing government support for education and sustainability.

Ove flaše se koriste kao plaćanje školske takse u školi Isrina, lokalnoj ustanovi koja promoviše reciklažu. Stanovnici poput Kemi Saheed i Patience Onwuka opisuju svakodnevne napore da omoguće obrazovanje deci i pored ekonomskih izazova. Škola radi u skromnim uslovima, s nekoliko noša za preko 200 učenika, što ukazuje na hitan problem sa sanitarijama. UNICEF navodi da milijoni Nigerijaca nemaju pristup osnovnoj sanitariji i da je potrebno izgraditi milione toaleta do 2025. godine za ostvarivanje cilja eliminacije obavljanja nužde na otvorenom. Uprkos pozitivnom uticaju, zajednica se i dalje bori sa mnogim izazovima, kao što su loša infrastruktura i posledice lokalnih nesreća. Program prikupljanja flaša često ima logističke prepreke koje umanjuju njegovu efikasnost. article_content:
Six-month-old Jovie Wyse faces a life-threatening battle every time she falls asleep: she has congenital central hypoventilation syndrome (CCHS), also referred to as Ondine’s curse. This rare condition means her body doesn't automatically breathe during sleep, forcing her to depend on a ventilator for 21 hours each day. After undergoing a tracheotomy at just two months old, Jovie was finally able to leave the hospital and come home.

Because of CCHS, Jovie will need respiratory support for the rest of her life—eventually, she may switch to a mask at bedtime as she grows stronger. Her parents, Chris and Lorna Wyse from Worcester, have received in-depth training to supervise her breathing and handle any ventilator issues. Since her birth in May, they have always ensured Jovie remains close to her lifesaving equipment, as even a brief, unsupervised nap could be dangerous.

With only about 300 reported cases worldwide and around 30 in the UK, CCHS is extremely rare. The term ‘Ondine’s curse’ originates from mythology, but today the medical community recognizes CCHS by its physiological impact: the body’s inability to respond to low oxygen or high carbon dioxide during sleep.

Jovie spent several months in Birmingham Children’s Hospital, undergoing extensive testing until a physician with previous CCHS experience recognized her symptoms. Gradually, she was able to come off the ventilator for three hours daily, though she must remain closely supervised by someone medically trained, especially at night.

Chris and Lorna describe the experience as daunting and emotionally taxing, with their daughter’s life relying on constant monitoring and equipment maintenance. They cannot leave Jovie with anyone who isn’t trained in her care. Despite these challenges, bringing her home was a joyful moment, and they are optimistic about her prospects as she grows, even though monitoring during sleep will always be required.

The family is grateful for the support of Birmingham Children’s Hospital and Ronald McDonald House. To express their thanks, they’re organizing a charity auction benefiting the latter, supported by contributions from local businesses.

Šestomesečna Jovie Wyse suočava se sa opasnošću svaki put kad zaspi – pati od kongenitalnog centralnog hipoventilacionog sindroma (CCHS), poznatog i kao Ondinino prokletstvo. Ovo retko stanje znači da njeno telo ne diše automatski tokom sna, pa mora koristiti ventilator 21 sat dnevno. Posle traheotomije u drugom mesecu života, Jovie je konačno puštena kući nakon dugog boravka u bolnici.

Zbog ove dijagnoze Jovie će ceo život morati da ima podršku za disanje – kasnije možda samo masku tokom spavanja, kada ojača. Njeni roditelji, Chris i Lorna Wyse iz Worcester-a, prošli su detaljnu obuku za nadgledanje njenog stanja i rukovanje opremom. Od njenog rođenja u maju, uvek su uz nju i paze da je pored aparata, jer i kratko nepažljivo dremanje može biti opasno.

CCHS je izuzetno redak, sa oko 300 slučajeva u svetu i oko 30 u Velikoj Britaniji. Naziv „Ondinino prokletstvo” dolazi iz mitologije, ali današnja medicina ga prepoznaje po nesposobnosti organizma da reaguje na manjak kiseonika i višak CO2 tokom sna.

Jovie je provela više meseci u Dečjoj bolnici u Birminghamu, gde joj je dijagnoza postavljena zahvaljujući lekaru sa iskustvom u sličnim slučajevima. Vremenom, uspela je da koristi ventilator samo 21 sat dnevno, ali neprekidan medicinski nadzor i dalje je neophodan, posebno noću.

Chris i Lorna kažu da je iskustvo teško, jer život njihove ćerke zavisi od stalne pažnje i održavanja opreme. Ne mogu je ostavljati nikome ko nije stručno obučen. Uprkos svemu, povratak kući bio je radostan trenutak, a nadaju se da će Jovie biti sve nezavisnija kako raste, iako će nadzor uvek biti potreban.

Porodica je zahvalna osoblju Dečje bolnice u Birminghamu i Ronald McDonald House-u. Kao znak zahvalnosti, organizuju humanitarnu aukciju u korist ove organizacije, uz pomoć lokalnih firmi.

article_content: High winds intensified wildfires in northern Texas on Wednesday, with firefighters battling several blazes across the extremely dry state. In Oklahoma City, a large grass fire destroyed several structures, including a barn, according to KFOR. Area residents were evacuated. The 101 Ranch fire in Palo Pinto County, Texas, grew to about 7,500 acres on Wednesday afternoon. The Texas Forest Service could not confirm how much had been contained. The fire was concentrated around the south side of Possum Kingdom Lake near Brad, about 50 miles west of the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Observers on the opposite shore had to withdraw when winds of about 20 mph pushed embers across the lake. At least 39 homes were destroyed, and about 125 households were evacuated, according to the Forest Service. Nine RVs also burned. Firefighters received help from aerial tankers and helicopters dropping water on the fire. On Wednesday morning, firefighters reported they had 'hooked the heel' of the fire, establishing an anchor point to expand containment lines. The cause of the fire was not yet known. Officials state that Texas is experiencing its worst fire season in history, with a record 3.5 million acres burned since last November. Hot and dry conditions, alongside severe drought, have made rapid fire growth likely. Firefighters are currently tackling nine major wildfires across Texas, which have consumed about 16,000 acres, the Forest Service reports. Residents Jerry and Silvia Overton were forced to flee as the 101 Ranch fire neared their home. When the fire became uncontrollable, they escaped by boat, taking others with them. After returning, they found their house largely undamaged apart from possible smoke damage. However, the experience was extremely frightening, especially as it was their second evacuation since April. 'The first time back in April was scary, but this was horrific,' Silvia Overton said. 'This time I really felt we could lose everything.' John Nichols of the Texas Forest Service highlighted ongoing efforts to protect homes and structures. Boats were used to ferry evacuees across Possum Kingdom Lake. 'I don't think I have seen it this bad anywhere,' Nichols said, describing the parched landscape. Elsewhere, firefighters in Huntsville, east Texas, battled a 100-acre blaze that destroyed two structures and threatened ten more homes. Texas and Oklahoma are facing the worst impacts of a drought stretching from Arizona to the East Coast. Over 90% of Texas is suffering from 'extreme' or 'exceptional' drought, according to the U.S. Drought Monitor at the University of Nebraska at Lincoln. Reporting contributed by CNN's Jim Spellman, Ed Payne, Dave Alsup, John Fricke, and Nick Valencia.

Požar 101 Ranch u okrugu Palo Pinto, Teksas, proširio se na oko 7.500 hektara u sredu popodne. Teksaška šumarska služba nije mogla da potvrdi koliki deo je stavljen pod kontrolu. Zvaničnici navode da Teksas prolazi kroz najgoru sezonu požara u svojoj istoriji, sa rekordnih 1,4 miliona hektara izgorelih od novembra prošle godine. Vrući i suvi uslovi, uz ozbiljnu sušu, olakšali su brzo širenje požara. Vatrogasci u Hantsvilu, istočni Teksas, borili su se sa požarom na 40 hektara koji je uništio dva objekta i ugrozio još deset kuća. article_content: Motorists faced dangerous attacks on a busy Essex road when a group of youths threw rocks at passing vehicles, smashing several car windows. Police are searching for those responsible for damaging 12 vehicles on the A1245 near Rawreth and deployed a helicopter as part of their search. The attacks occurred just weeks after a similar incident took place on the A14 in Suffolk. Paul Harvey, 41, of Rawreth, experienced the attack firsthand when the passenger window of his Land Rover was shattered. He emphasized how fortunate he was that no one was seriously injured. Harvey recounted, 'I can’t believe anyone would do this. It could have caused a major accident, especially at that busy time of night with cars traveling at 60 or 70 mph.' Harvey suspects the perpetrators were hiding in roadside trees during the incident. He added, 'It was lucky no one was in the passenger seat; the object completely imploded the window and dented the rear door.' After the attack, police stopped several cars outside the Gables car showroom and interviewed drivers. Glass covered the road, and several vehicles were damaged. Police comforted shaken motorists at Gables Cars while a helicopter searched for suspects. The investigation continues. In a related incident on the A14 in Suffolk, four vehicles, including an ambulance, were damaged when rocks and concrete rubble were thrown from a flyover. Police believe a group of young offenders is responsible and urge parents to ensure they know their children's whereabouts, particularly at night. Authorities are working to prevent further incidents like the recent A12 attack that left a woman, Carol Manley, seriously injured by a falling concrete block. Sgt Chris Bramhill urged parents to be vigilant, noting that 12 vehicles have been officially reported damaged but more cases may surface as motorists discover damage. Rochford district councillor Chris Black called the attacks 'stupid and dangerous,' emphasizing the importance of parental awareness and increased police patrols.

article_content: To protest Maharashtra’s policy of allowing government schools to be adopted, nearly 80 civic schools overseen by the Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation (NMMC) held regular classes on Sunday. About 50,000 students, 1,100 teachers, and 40,000 parents took part. Protesters argue this policy could undermine the public education system, especially for underprivileged children. In September, the Maharashtra government launched a scheme permitting donors, corporations, or NGOs to adopt government schools to help upgrade infrastructure and facilities. While government officials say the scheme aims to enhance infrastructure, stakeholders from the education sector have raised strong concerns. Leading the protest, former NMMC mayor Sudhakar Sonawane clarified, “There were no placards or slogans; our intention was to keep schools open with public involvement.” He added that the adoption policy focuses donor support solely on infrastructure, not on teacher salaries, electricity costs, or similar school expenses. Sonawane also mentioned that students, alumni, and parents participated to defend access to education for underprivileged children. He warned that once schools are adopted for five to ten years, there is uncertainty about their return to government control. Referring to earlier moves toward privatization, Sonawane expressed worry the new policy might lead to school closures and less affordable education.

U protestu je učestvovalo oko 50.000 učenika, 1.100 nastavnika i 40.000 roditelja. Protivnici tvrde da ova politika može narušiti javni obrazovni sistem, posebno za decu iz siromašnih porodica. Vlada Maharaštre je u septembru pokrenula program koji omogućava donatorima, kompanijama ili nevladinim organizacijama da usvoje državne škole i time pomognu poboljšanju njihove infrastrukture i uslova. Iako zvaničnici tvrde da je cilj unapređenje infrastrukture, akteri iz prosvetnog sektora izražavaju ozbiljnu zabrinutost. Predvodnik protesta, bivši gradonačelnik NMMC Sudhakar Sonavane, objasnio je: „Nije bilo transparenata ni slogana; želeli smo da škole budu otvorene uz učešće građana.“ On je dodao da se pomoć donatora prema ovoj politici odnosi isključivo na infrastrukturu, a ne na plate nastavnika, troškove električne energije i druge školske troškove. Sonavane je takođe istakao da su učenici, bivši učenici i roditelji učestvovali sa ciljem zaštite prava na obrazovanje za siromašnu decu. On je upozorio da, kada škole budu usvojene na pet do deset godina, nije sigurno da će se ponovo vratiti pod državnu kontrolu. article_content: The British are known for some unusual home remedies, from garlic sandwiches promised to enhance romance, to the belief that leeches can help deep vein thrombosis. However, few are as unconventional as what builders Simon and Andy claim: that applying industrial lubricant WD-40 can ease arthritis pain and relieve a congested chest. This eyebrow-raising remedy was discussed on Channel 4's documentary series, Health Freaks, where ordinary people share their favorite home treatments with a panel of doctors. According to Andy, who experiences arthritis, standard medications like paracetamol weren't helping, but using WD-40 seemed to offer relief for his knees. Simon shared that, after seeing Andy’s improvement, he gave it a try with similar results, insisting many fellow bricklayers do the same. Medical professionals on the show remained unconvinced. Dr. Ayan Panja, an experienced general practitioner, commented that aside from a cooling sensation and the physical act of rubbing, nothing in WD-40 should impact joint pain. He—and fellow GP Dr. Ellie Cannon—warned that the product could be dangerous when used on the body, especially since WD-40 contains petroleum derivatives. Despite Andy’s claim, there’s no evidence that WD-40 includes fish oils. Simon also suggested that the lubricant helped his smoker’s chest tightness, but Dr. Cannon explained that chest tightening in smokers is caused by the lungs, and WD-40 cannot treat respiratory issues. She emphatically advised the men to stop using the product for health issues and to seek appropriate care. WD-40’s manufacturer confirmed that the product is not meant for any medical purpose and should not be used on people. They highlighted that it contains chemicals that must be handled with caution. The Health Freaks episode also examined other alternative treatments, like amber necklaces for teething babies and duct tape for verrucas. While duct tape showed some success on verrucas, doctors said amber necklaces did not ease teething pain. Health Freaks airs tonight at 8:30 pm on Channel 4.
translated_content: Britanci su poznati po neobičnim kućnim lekovima, od sendviča sa belim lukom za bolji ljubavni život, do uverenja da pijavice mogu pomoći kod duboke venske tromboze. Ipak, malo koji lek je tako neobičan kao tvrdnja građevinara Simona i Endija da industrijsko ulje WD-40 može ublažiti bolove od artritisa i otčepiti zapušen grudni koš. Ovaj neobičan „lek“ bio je tema emisije Health Freaks na kanalu Channel 4, gde obični ljudi predstavljaju svoje omiljene kućne tretmane pred panelom doktora. Endi, koji ima artritis, rekao je da mu standardni lekovi poput paracetamola nisu pomogli, ali da mu je WD-40 doneo olakšanje za kolena. Simon je posle Endijevog poboljšanja rešio da i sam proba i tvrdi da su mnogi zidari širom zemlje pristalice toga. Međutim, lekari iz emisije ostali su skeptični. Dr Ajan Panja, iskusni doktor opšte prakse, rekao je da osim rashlađujućeg efekta i samog trljanja, nema ničega u WD-40 što bi trebalo da ublaži bolove u zglobovima. On i doktorka Eli Kenon upozorili su da može biti opasno koristiti tu supstancu na telu, posebno jer WD-40 sadrži petroleum i druge hemikalije. Uprkos Endijevoj tvrdnji, nema dokaza da WD-40 sadrži riblje ulje. Simon je takođe rekao da mu WD-40 pomaže kod stezanja u grudima zbog pušenja, ali doktorka Kenon je objasnila da je problem kod pušača u plućima, a WD-40 to ne može rešiti. Lekari su im jasno savetovali da prestanu sa ovakvim tretmanima i obrate se pravoj medicini. Proizvođač WD-40 istakao je da proizvod nije namenjen za medicinsku upotrebu i ne treba ga koristiti na ljudima. Naglašavaju da sadrži hemikalije koje zahtevaju oprez. U istom izdanju Health Freaks obrađeni su i drugi alternativni tretmani, kao što su ogrlice od ćilibara za nicanje zuba kod beba i lepljiva traka za uklanjanje bradavica. Dok je lepljiva traka imala određene efekte protiv bradavica, doktori smatraju da ogrlice od ćilibara ne pomažu kod zubića. Health Freaks se emituje večeras od 20:30 na kanalu Channel 4.

article_content: Kev Stoodley established the North East Young Dads and Lads Project (NEYDL) in 2017 after noticing that most support services focused on mothers, leaving young fathers under 25 without adequate help. Although there are no official statistics on young fathers in the UK, Kev knows firsthand the difficulties these men face—particularly the stereotypes labelling them as disinterested or even risky as parents. 'Young dads aren't celebrated in our society; they're seen as a problem,' he says. Tyler Reed, a 22-year-old father from Sunderland, experienced these challenges after his daughter Aurianna was born. He found that as a young dad, people rarely approached him or included him in conversations about parenting, often focusing solely on the mother. Even at hospital visits, he felt sidelined, saying, 'It's never questioned for the mum.' Tyler, who is a full-time parent and carer for his partner Destiny, receives regular support from NEYDL, which teaches valuable skills like nappy-changing, bathing, and first aid. The group has also found that young dads often struggle with mental health issues and loneliness after becoming fathers. Research shows that one in ten men experiences anxiety and depression symptoms in the first six months after their child’s birth. Tyler credits NEYDL with significantly improving his wellbeing during these challenges. Another dad supported by NEYDL is 21-year-old James Withycombe. James dropped out of university when his daughter, Violet, was born and later separated from her mother, leaving him suddenly responsible for creating a new home. He felt a lack of support and networks compared to his ex-partner but found connection and reassurance through NEYDL’s group activities for fathers and children. Official numbers of young fathers in the UK remain unknown, according to Anna Tarrant, a sociology professor at the University of Lincoln. Anna, who has worked with NEYDL, explains that there is no regular data collection about young dads, and sometimes fathers aren't even listed on birth certificates. Rough estimates suggest one in ten first-time dads is under 25, but this is largely based on teenage pregnancy data. Anna emphasizes the importance of supporting young fathers and bringing them together to share experiences. She notes, 'Young dads are often portrayed negatively, but they really love their children and want to stay involved in their lives.' NEYDL encourages dads who have been helped to become peer supporters, helping to grow a network of mutual aid. Kev reports that NEYDL works with over 100 young dads a year, with numbers rising as more former beneficiaries volunteer to help. One such peer supporter is Nathan Noble, a 27-year-old from Gateshead. He explains that shared activities, such as bike rides, make it easier for young dads to open up and connect. Nathan believes, 'All the young dads here are deeply committed to being the best fathers they can be.' For James, the support from NEYDL has made a big difference for himself and his daughter. He says, 'When she thinks of her time with me, she’ll remember the good parts—which is all I ever wanted as a dad.'
translated_content: Kev Stoodley je osnovao projekat North East Young Dads and Lads (NEYDL) 2017. godine nakon što je primetio da se većina podrške fokusira na majke, ostavljajući mlade očeve ispod 25 godina bez adekvatne pomoći. Iako ne postoje zvanične statistike o mladim očevima u Velikoj Britaniji, Kev iz ličnog iskustva zna sa kakvim se poteškoćama suočavaju – naročito kad ih stereotipi označavaju kao nezainteresovane ili čak rizične roditelje. 'Mladi očevi nisu cenjeni u našem društvu; na njih se gleda kao na problem,' kaže on. Tajler Rid, dvadesetdvogodišnji otac iz Sanderlenda, iskusio je ove izazove nakon rođenja svoje ćerke Aurianna. Kao mladog oca, ljudi ga retko uključuju u razgovore o roditeljstvu, najčešće se fokusirajući na majku. Čak i na bolničkim pregledima osećao se zapostavljeno, rekavši: 'Nikad niko ne postavlja ta pitanja majci.' Tajler, koji je stalno kod kuće i brine o svojoj partnerki Destini, redovno dobija podršku od NEYDL-a, gde uči korisne veštine kao što su presvlačenje pelena, kupanje i pružanje prve pomoći. Grupa je takođe otkrila da se mladi očevi često suočavaju sa mentalnim problemima i osećajem usamljenosti nakon što postanu roditelji. Istraživanja pokazuju da svaki deseti muškarac doživi simptome anksioznosti i depresije tokom prvih šest meseci nakon rođenja deteta. Tajler kaže da mu je podrška iz NEYDL-a značajno poboljšala blagostanje tokom tih izazova. Još jedan otac kojem je NEYDL pomogao je dvadesetjednogodišnji Džejms Vitikomb. On je napustio fakultet kada mu se rodila ćerka Violet, a kasnije se razišao sa njenom majkom, zbog čega je morao iznenada da stvara novi dom za njih. Osećao je manjak podrške i društvenih mreža u poređenju s bivšom partnerkom, ali je kroz grupne aktivnosti NEYDL-a našao povezivanje i utehu sa drugim očevima i njihovom decom. Zvaničan broj mladih očeva u Velikoj Britaniji i dalje nije poznat, kaže Ana Tarant, profesorka sociologije na Univerzitetu u Linkolnu. Ana, koja je sarađivala sa NEYDL-om, objašnjava da ne postoji redovno prikupljanje podataka o mladim očevima, a ponekad oni nisu ni upisani na izvod iz matične knjige rođenih. Procene sugerišu da je svaki deseti otac koji prvi put postaje roditelj mlađi od 25 godina, ali te brojke uglavnom potiču iz statistike o tinejdžerskim trudnoćama. Ana naglašava važnost podrške mladim očevima i okupljanja radi razmene iskustava. Navodi: 'Mladi očevi su često negativno prikazani, ali zaista vole svoju decu i žele da ostanu prisutni u njihovim životima.' NEYDL podstiče očeve koji su dobili pomoć da postanu vršnjački mentori, čime se širi mreža međusobne podrške. Kev kaže da NEYDL godišnje radi sa više od 100 mladih očeva, a taj broj raste jer sve više bivših korisnika postaje volonteri. Jedan od tih mentora je dvadesetsedmogodišnji Nejtan Noub iz Gejtsheda, koji objašnjava da zajedničke aktivnosti poput vožnje bicikla pomažu mladim očevima da se otvore i povežu. Nejtan veruje: 'Svi mladi očevi ovde su potpuno posvećeni tome da budu najbolji roditelji.' Za Džejmsa, podrška iz NEYDL-a je napravila veliku razliku za njega i njegovu ćerku. Kaže: 'Kada se bude prisećala vremena sa mnom, pamtiće samo lepe trenutke – a to mi je oduvek bio cilj kao ocu.'

article_content: Lawrence Poxton, 48, and his wife Teresa, 46, have moved into what is believed to be Britain’s cheapest home—a terraced property in Stoke-on-Trent, Staffordshire—which they paid just £1 for. The couple was selected from thousands of applicants after the council offered 33 derelict properties for £1 each in a bid to revitalize the area. After picking their new home from a model in November 2013, the Poxtons received a £30,000 low-interest loan from the council to completely renovate the house. While most of the surrounding homes remain boarded up, the couple’s two-bedroom mid-terrace has been transformed into a comfortable modern space, featuring a spacious bathroom, roomy kitchen, plush carpets, and a new staircase. The house, which was once just a shell, now has a new roof, windows, doors, central heating, and insulation. Previously, the Poxtons rented a similar house in the town centre, paying around £425 per month plus bills. Now, even after repaying the council loan over ten years, their monthly costs are almost half, allowing them to own their home and save money. The council has spent £3 million renovating properties as part of the scheme, but progress has been slow—on Denbigh Street, where the Poxtons live, only eight out of 90 houses have been renovated so far. The area faces ongoing challenges, with many properties owned by private landlords and left neglected by tenants. To ensure residents’ safety, security guards patrol the street 24 hours a day. The council also offers the £30,000 loan to landlords willing to modernize their properties. Despite the slow pace of regeneration, the Poxtons are optimistic and grateful for the opportunity, describing their new home as a dream come true and expressing hope that the neighborhood will continue to improve.
translated_content: Lorens Pokston (48) i njegova supruga Teresa (46) uselili su se u, kako se veruje, najjeftiniju kuću u Britaniji—red kuću u Stouk-on-Trentu, Staffordšir—koju su platili samo jednu funtu. Par je izabran među hiljadama prijavljenih nakon što je gradsko veće ponudilo 33 oronule kuće po ceni od jedne funte u pokušaju da oživi kvart. Posle izbora svog novog doma iz makete u novembru 2013, Pokstonovi su dobili kredit od 30.000 funti sa niskom kamatom od opštine za kompletnu obnovu kuće. Dok su većina okolnih kuća još uvek zatvorene daskama, njihova dvosobna red kuća pretvorena je u moderan i udoban prostor sa velikim kupatilom, prostranom kuhinjom, mekanim tepisima i novim stepeništem. Kuća je nekad bila samo prazna ljuštura, a sada ima novi krov, prozore, vrata, centralno grejanje i izolaciju. Pre toga, Pokstonovi su iznajmljivali sličnu kuću u centru grada, plaćajući oko 425 funti mesečno plus režije. Sada, čak i uz otplatu kredita narednih deset godina, njihovi mesečni troškovi su skoro upola manji, a pritom su i vlasnici svog doma, što im štedi novac. Gradsko veće je potrošilo tri miliona funti na renoviranje kuća kroz ovaj program, ali napredak je spor—na Denbigh ulici gde Pokstonovi žive renovirano je svega osam od 90 kuća. Kvart se susreće sa izazovima jer su mnoge nekretnine u vlasništvu privatnih iznajmljivača koji ih zapuštaju. Iz bezbednosnih razloga, obezbeđenje patrolira ulicom 24 sata dnevno. Opština nudi isti kredit i stanodavcima koji žele da obnove svoje kuće. I pored sporog napretka, Pokstonovi su optimisti i zahvalni na pruženoj prilici, nazivajući novi dom ostvarenjem sna i nadajući se daljem napretku komšiluka.

article_content: On Tuesday in Tel Aviv, women organized a symbolic dinner table to demand the release of Israeli hostages taken by Hamas during the October 7 attack. This demonstration underscores public concern as a potential prisoner-hostage exchange deal approaches, tied to a brief halt in hostilities. Tzachi Hanegbi, Israel's national security adviser, stated the exchange would not begin before Friday, as negotiations proceed. The deal is linked to a proposed four-day ceasefire, with the start still pending further discussions. According to the plan, at least 50 Israeli women and children abducted by Hamas would be freed in exchange for at least 150 Palestinian women and minors held by Israel. About 10 Israeli hostages would be released each day during the truce, alongside proportional daily releases of Palestinian detainees. The International Committee of the Red Cross will facilitate the exchange, coordinating daily lists from each side. The ratio stands at three Palestinian detainees for every Israeli hostage. ICRC is also authorized to visit the remaining hostages and deliver essential medicines. U.S. leaders have welcomed the deal and hope that several dual American-Israeli citizens could be among those freed, including a young girl whose fourth birthday is Friday. President Biden expressed gratitude to the mediators and relief for families awaiting reunification. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu attributed the breakthrough to a combination of military action and diplomatic pressure. He stressed that Israel's campaign against Hamas will persist beyond the temporary pause, reaffirming the goal to return all hostages and prevent future threats from Gaza. The conflict, triggered by Hamas's October assault resulting in about 1,200 Israeli deaths and hundreds taken hostage, has led to more than 12,700 Palestinians killed amid Israeli bombardment, per local officials. During the truce, humanitarian aid and fuel will be allowed into Gaza, where conditions remain severe. The list of Palestinians to be released includes 33 women and many teenage boys, some detained without formal charges or awaiting trial. Israel published the names to allow public objections, but judicial intervention is not anticipated. Both sides’ families now wait with hope and anxiety for the exchanges to begin. Pope Francis, after speaking with Israeli and Palestinian families affected by the conflict, recognized the deep suffering on both sides and suggested the violence has gone beyond conventional warfare. While the agreement allows for a pause in hostilities, both Israel and Hamas have vowed to continue their respective missions after the ceasefire. The arrangement enables the possibility of extending the ceasefire and increasing the number of releases if more hostages are set free.
translated_content: U utorak su žene u Tel Avivu organizovale simboličnu večeru zahtevajući oslobađanje izraelskih talaca koje je Hamas oteo tokom napada 7. oktobra. Ova demonstracija naglašava zabrinutost javnosti dok se približava mogući dogovor o razmeni talaca i zatvorenika, povezan sa privremenim prekidom sukoba. Izraelski savetnik za nacionalnu bezbednost, Cahij Hanegbi, izjavio je da razmena neće početi pre petka, dok se pregovori još vode. Dogovor je vezan za predložen četvorodnevni prekid vatre, čiji je početak još neizvestan i zavisi od daljih pregovora. Plan predviđa da najmanje 50 izraelskih žena i dece, koje je oteo Hamas, bude oslobođeno u zamenu za najmanje 150 palestinskih žena i maloletnika u izraelskim zatvorima. Tokom primirja, svakog dana bilo bi oslobođeno oko 10 izraelskih talaca, kao i odgovarajući broj palestinskih zatvorenika. Međunarodni komitet Crvenog krsta imaće ulogu posrednika u razmeni, koordinirajući dnevne liste sa obe strane. Odnos razmene je tri palestinska zatvorenika za jednog izraelskog taoca. MKCK je takođe ovlašćen da posećuje preostale taoce i donosi im neophodnu medicinsku pomoć. Američki zvaničnici pozdravili su dogovor i nadaju se da će među oslobođenima biti i nekoliko američko-izraelskih državljana, uključujući devojčicu koja će u petak napuniti četiri godine. Predsednik Bajden zahvalio se posrednicima i izrazio olakšanje zbog porodica koje čekaju povratak najmilijih. Premijer Benjamin Netanijahu istakao je da je napredak rezultat kombinacije vojne sile i diplomatije. On je naglasio da izraelska ofanziva protiv Hamasa neće prestati sa privremenim primirjem i ponovio je cilj povratka svih talaca i sprečavanja budućih pretnji iz Gaze. Sukob, izazvan Hamasovim napadom u oktobru, u kojem je poginulo oko 1.200 Izraelaca i na stotine oteto, doveo je do smrti više od 12.700 Palestinaca tokom izraelskih napada, navode lokalni izvori. Tokom primirja, humanitarna pomoć i gorivo biće dozvoljeni u Gazu, gde su uslovi veoma teški. Na listi za oslobađanje nalazi se 33 palestinske žene i više dečaka tinejdžera, od kojih su neki u zatvoru bez optužnice ili čekaju suđenje. Izrael je objavio ta imena zbog mogućih prigovora javnosti, ali se ne očekuje intervencija suda. Porodice sa obe strane iščekuju razmenu sa nadom i strepnjom. Papa Franja je, posle susreta sa porodicama izraelskih talaca i palestinskih zatvorenika, naglasio duboku patnju obe strane i ocenio da je nasilje prevazišlo običan rat. Dogovor predviđa privremeni prekid borbi, ali su i Izrael i Hamas najavili nastavak svojih ciljeva nakon isteka primirja. Plan omogućava produženje primirja i povećanje broja oslobađanja ako se oslobodi više talaca.

Ivanka Trump appeared as a witness in her father Donald Trump’s civil fraud trial in New York on Wednesday, reluctantly taking the stand but using her testimony to argue that their family business consistently exceeded expectations, even as she distanced herself from key financial documents. Ivanka, once deeply involved both in the Trump Organization as executive vice president and as an advisor in the White House, insisted she had little to do with preparing her father’s financial statements—documents that state prosecutors allege were fraudulently inflated to mislead lenders and banks.

During her appearance, which wrapped up the prosecution’s presentation, Ivanka emphasized the Trump Organization’s accomplishments, mentioning landmark projects like the Doral golf resort in Florida—described as a challenging but rewarding renovation—and the transformation of Washington, D.C.’s historic Old Post Office into a luxury hotel. She stated that the Trump companies “overdelivered on every metric” with such efforts. However, when questioned about how her father's financial claims factored into winning approval for major projects, she repeatedly said she could not recall specifics about those documents or discussions. For example, in the case of the Old Post Office, she said her main memory centered on the team's vision for the redevelopment rather than on financial statements.

Although Ivanka previously shared in the financial success of these ventures—earning around $4 million when the Old Post Office hotel sold—she is no longer a defendant in the case. Her lawyers tried to prevent her testimony, but she ultimately answered questions politely and often said she did not remember particular details. After her testimony, New York Attorney General Letitia James commented that, although Ivanka presented herself as courteous and restrained, she nonetheless profited from her father’s alleged fraudulent practices and should not be able to entirely distance herself from them.

Much of the day’s questioning centered around Ivanka’s role in Trump's dealings with Deutsche Bank, including discussions from 2013 involving her husband, Jared Kushner. While Kushner wasn’t part of the Trump Organization, his real estate background meant he sometimes offered advice, and he facilitated key introductions with bankers. Ivanka said her role was to help build lending relationships—Deutsche Bank eventually loaned the Trump companies hundreds of millions of dollars, requiring Donald Trump to submit financial statements annually. 

Prosecutors argue Ivanka received favorable treatment, such as discounted apartment deals while the organization claimed higher values for those properties in formal statements. Ivanka denied making a permanent home in her luxury apartment and said her investments were substantial. She also described scaling back her involvement with the Trump Organization before joining her father’s White House staff in 2017; after his presidency, she moved with her family to Florida.

Judge Arthur Engoron has already decided that Donald Trump engaged in fraud, leaving the remaining trial to determine possible penalties, which could include over $300 million in fines and barring Trump from conducting business in New York. For now, he still has control of his properties, pending appeal. The defense, which begins presenting its case next, argues that prosecutors failed to establish their claims and are seeking to have the case dismissed.
