article_content: Union Home Minister Amit Shah stated on Saturday that Prime Minister Narendra Modi has made India more secure by stopping illegal infiltration, a feat he claims the opposition INDIA alliance and Congress party are unable to accomplish. Shah addressed a public meeting in Manawar, located in Madhya Pradesh’s Dhar district, ahead of the November 17 assembly elections. He highlighted recent nationwide raids by the National Investigation Agency (NIA) to curb Rohingya infiltration, attributing such strong action to Modi's leadership. Shah questioned whether the INDIA alliance or Congress could prevent infiltration as effectively. Shah also cited the Modi government’s ban on the Popular Front of India (PFI) and the abrogation of Article 370 in Kashmir, asserting these steps solidified national integration. He recalled Congress leader Rahul Gandhi's concerns about violence following Article 370’s removal, noting that these predictions did not materialize. Shah contrasted the current administration with previous Congress governments, stating that attacks from Pakistan increased under Congress rule, while the present government responded swiftly with surgical and air strikes after the Uri and Pulwama terror attacks. He urged voters to secure the country's future by electing the BJP at both the national and state levels. During the campaign, Shah also spoke at events in Badnawar, Dhar, Manawar, and Gandhwani, and was scheduled for more engagements in Indore’s Depalpur area. After Diwali, Shah claimed, the Congress party—criticized for corruption and dynastic politics—will be defeated in Madhya Pradesh. Emphasizing the broader stakes, he described the election as crucial for both the state and country’s future direction. According to Shah, Congress leaders Digvijaya Singh and Kamal Nath led Madhya Pradesh into stagnation, but the BJP's 18-year tenure has transformed the state, in contrast to Congress's 53-year rule. Shah used the upcoming Diwali celebrations to underscore political milestones, saying Madhya Pradesh will mark Diwali three times: once as usual, again on December 3 if a new BJP state government forms, and once more on January 22 for the Ram temple inauguration in Ayodhya. He accused Congress of blocking the Ram temple’s construction in Ayodhya for decades and noted that the BJP government's pilgrimage scheme, Teerth Darshan Yojana, had been paused by Congress during its 15-month rule, but restored by the BJP. Shah concluded by listing religious and cultural projects advanced by the Modi government, emphasizing efforts to promote Indian culture and heritage.

Šah se obratio na javnom skupu u Manavaru, u okrugu Dhar u Madhja Pradešu, pred izbore koji se održavaju 17. novembra. On je istakao nedavne nacionalne akcije Nacionalne agencije za istragu (NIA) protiv infiltracije Rohindža i naglasio da je za takve odlučne poteze zaslužan upravo Modi. Šah je postavio pitanje da li INDIA savez ili Kongres mogu ovako efikasno da spreče infiltraciju. Šah je takođe naveo zabranu organizacije Popular Front of India (PFI) i ukidanje člana 370 u Kašmiru kao mere koje, prema njegovim rečima, učvršćuju nacionalno jedinstvo. Podsetio je na brige lidera Kongresa, Rahula Gandhija, povodom mogućih nemira nakon ukidanja člana 370, ističući da se te prognoze nisu ostvarile. Šah je uporedio sadašnju administraciju sa prethodnim vladama Kongresa, rekavši da su napadi iz Pakistana bili češći za vreme vlasti Kongresa, dok je aktuelna vlast brzo reagovala vojnim i vazdušnim udarima nakon napada u Uriju i Pulvami. On je pozvao građane da glasaju za BJP na nacionalnom i državnom nivou, ističući da tako mogu obezbediti budućnost zemlje. Tokom kampanje, Šah je govorio i na događajima u Badnavaru, Dharu, Manavaru i Gandvani, a planiran je i nastup u Depalpuru kod Indora. Šah je najavio poraz Kongresa u Madhja Pradešu posle Divalija, kritikujući ih zbog korupcije i dinastičke politike. Kako je rekao, izbori su presudni za budućnost države i cele zemlje. Prema Šahu, vođe Kongresa Digvidžaja Sing i Kamal Nat doveli su Madhja Pradeš u stagnaciju, dok je BJP tokom 18 godina vlasti doneo transformaciju, nasuprot 53 godine uprave Kongresa. Šah je upotrebio predstojeći Divali da istakne političke prekretnice, navodeći da će se praznik u Madhja Pradešu obeležiti tri puta: tradicionalno, 3. decembra ukoliko se formira nova vlast BJP-a, i 22. januara kada se otvara hram Ram u Ajodji. Optužio je Kongres da je decenijama opstruisao izgradnju hrama Ram u Ajodji, navodeći i da je tokom svoje 15-mesečne vladavine stopirao šemu Teerth Darshan Yojana, koju je BJP kasnije obnovio. Na kraju, Šah je naveo verske i kulturne projekte koje je unapredila Modi-jeva vlada, ističući zalaganje za promociju indijske kulture i nasleđa.

article_content: The Chhattisgarh assembly elections are shaping up to be a tight contest between Congress and the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), driven not only by issues but also by the personalities of leading candidates. Both parties have yet to officially declare their chief ministerial candidate, although current Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel remains the Congress’s likely choice. The BJP has introduced strong candidates in several key constituencies, including some Union ministers. Raman Singh, who served as chief minister for 15 years, remains a prominent BJP figure but is not considered the frontrunner for the chief minister’s post this time. Here are the leading faces from both parties who are at the forefront of the election. Bhupesh Baghel became the face of Congress in Chhattisgarh after the party’s 2018 victory. He overcame an internal rivalry with TS Singhdeo, now the deputy chief minister, securing full support from the party. Baghel is contesting from Patan in Durg district, his home constituency, where he has been an MLA five times, losing only in 2008 to his nephew Vijay Baghel (now a Lok Sabha MP), who is again his BJP opponent. While Bhupesh Baghel enjoys the advantage of incumbency and popular welfare schemes, his nephew is a strong challenger with a significant local following. Janata Congress Chhattisgarh (JCC-J) president Amit Jogi, son of former chief minister Ajit Jogi, is also running from Patan, intensifying the contest. TS Singhdeo, also known as TS Baba and the titular maharaja of Surguja, was considered for the chief minister’s post in 2018 but was appointed deputy chief minister after much speculation around rotational leadership. Singhdeo’s influence is significant in the Surguja division, winning Ambikapur three times and helping Congress sweep all 14 seats in the region in 2018. The division’s outcome could be pivotal, with the BJP fielding prominent candidates including a Union minister and local royals. Raman Singh, a well-known leader who led Chhattisgarh for 15 years, has lost some political ground since the BJP's substantial defeat in 2018. He narrowly retained his Rajnandgaon seat and is facing a tough contest from Girish Dewangan, a close ally of CM Baghel. Singh is currently the BJP vice-president, with the state unit now led by Arun Sao. Arun Sao, BJP’s 53-year-old Bilaspur MP and state party president, belongs to the influential OBC Sahu community. His appointment was seen as a strategic move to counter Congress’s OBC initiatives. Sao has a history of grassroots involvement and is contesting from Lormi, facing Congress’s Thaneshwar Sahu, another Sahu community leader. Renuka Singh, Union Minister of State for Tribal Affairs, is contesting from Bharatpur-Sonhat. She is a prominent tribal leader, having served as MLA for Prem Nagar and minister in the Raman Singh government. Her 2019 Lok Sabha win in Surguja, despite BJP not winning any assembly seats there in 2018, sets up a strong contest with Congress in the region. Renuka Singh is also considered a leading contender for the chief minister's post if BJP wins. In other news: India approved its first 100% FDI in defence with Sweden’s Saab manufacturing facility; SBI reported an 8% increase in net profit, and Byju’s announced FY22 revenue of ₹3,569 crore with an EBITDA loss of ₹2,253 crore.

article_content: South Africa is considering stricter laws on asylum and immigration, which could have significant effects on people seeking refuge there. Home Affairs Minister Aaron Motsoaledi introduced a White Paper outlining these proposed changes, marking a clear shift from the more welcoming stance that followed the end of apartheid in 1994. Motsoaledi expressed regret over the decision to sign certain international refugee agreements two years after South Africa's political transition, without exceptions that would limit the rights of refugees. Unlike many countries, South Africa gave refugees and asylum-seekers similar rights to its citizens, including access to jobs and education. Journalist Paddy Harper from the Mail & Guardian explains that the ruling African National Congress (ANC) welcomed immigrants after apartheid to reinforce solidarity and acknowledge international support in the country’s past struggles. However, shifting economic and political circumstances are driving a move toward tougher policies. One proposal is to require asylum-seekers to claim protection in the first safe country they enter, which would disproportionately impact arrivals from other African nations. The UN estimates about 250,000 refugees and asylum seekers currently live in South Africa, with significant numbers from Ethiopia, DRC, Somalia, Bangladesh, and Zimbabwe. While migrants represent only about 3% of South Africa’s population, increased unemployment (now near 32%) and a growing foreign-born community have fueled hostility and led to attacks on immigrant groups. Certain communities, especially Somalis and Bangladeshis, are accused of dominating township economies and taking local jobs. Motsoaledi’s policy changes come ahead of critical elections. The ANC is wary that opposition parties will leverage anti-immigration sentiment as a campaign issue, especially since public frustration over the economy and public services remains high—a situation some officials attribute to undocumented migrants. Recently, high-ranking ANC member Fikile Mbalula described undocumented immigrants as a potential crisis, claiming they place pressure on government services, healthcare, and employment. Official figures indicate that 2.4 million migrants now live in the country, the majority from Zimbabwe, Mozambique, and Lesotho. Motsoaledi acknowledged the persistent challenge in tracking undocumented migrants, with authorities deporting up to 20,000 people each year, though many return quickly. The government has established a Border Management Authority to better control illegal entries and is proposing the creation of special immigration courts and enhanced law enforcement powers. Khangelani Moyo, a University of the Free State academic, doubts that stricter enforcement will stop cross-border movement and suggests easier pathways to documentation. Regardless, the government appears set on pursuing these tougher measures, particularly as some polls show the ANC may lose its majority in the upcoming election. Political parties advocating stronger immigration controls have recently performed well in South Africa’s major urban centers.

Motsoaledi je izrazio žaljenje što je zemlja dve godine nakon političke tranzicije potpisala određene međunarodne sporazume o izbeglicama bez izuzetaka koji bi ograničili prava izbeglica. Ipak, promenjene ekonomske i političke okolnosti vode ka pooštravanju politike. Jedan od predloga je da tražioci azila moraju tražiti zaštitu u prvoj sigurnoj zemlji u koju uđu, što bi najviše pogodilo one koji dolaze iz drugih afričkih država. UN procenjuje da u Južnoafričkoj Republici trenutno živi oko 250.000 izbeglica i tražilaca azila, među kojima su najbrojniji oni iz Etiopije, DRC-a, Somalije, Bangladeša i Zimbabvea. Iako migranti čine svega oko 3% ukupnog stanovništva, rast stope nezaposlenosti (sada oko 32%) i sve veća brojnost stranaca doprinose netrpeljivosti i napadima na migrantske zajednice. Naročito se Somalijci i Bangladešani optužuju za dominaciju u ekonomiji naselja i oduzimanje radnih mesta lokalnom stanovništvu. Motsoaledijeve promene politike dolaze pred važne izbore. ANC strahuje da će opozicione partije iskoristiti protivmigrantska osećanja u predizbornoj kampanji, posebno jer je nezadovoljstvo javnosti privredom i javnim uslugama veliko, što neki zvaničnici pripisuju ilegalnim migrantima. Nedavno je visoki funkcioner ANC-a, Fikile Mbalula, opisao ilegalne migrante kao potencijalnu krizu, tvrdeći da oni dodatno opterećuju državne usluge, zdravstvo i tržište rada. Zvanični podaci pokazuju da trenutno u zemlji živi oko 2,4 miliona migranata, najviše iz Zimbabvea, Mozambika i Lesota. Motsoaledi je priznao postojanje stalnog izazova u praćenju ilegalnih migranata, pri čemu vlasti godišnje deportuju i do 20.000 ljudi, ali se mnogi brzo vraćaju. Vlada je osnovala Upravu za upravljanje granicama kako bi poboljšala kontrolu ilegalnih ulazaka i predlaže osnivanje posebnih imigracionih sudova i jačanje ovlašćenja nadležnih organa. Khangelani Moyo, profesor sa Univerziteta Slobodna država, sumnja da će stroža kontrola zaustaviti prekogranično kretanje i predlaže lakše puteve za legalizaciju. Ipak, vlasti ostaju pri čvršćem kursu, posebno jer ankete pokazuju da ANC možda više neće zadržati većinu na predstojećim izborima. Stranke koje zagovaraju strožu imigracionu kontrolu nedavno beleže uspehe u velikim gradovima Južnoafričke Republike.

article_content: On November 18, 2023, Russian forces conducted a major overnight drone attack on Ukraine, damaging energy infrastructure and causing power outages in more than 400 towns and villages across the south, southeast, and north of the country, according to Ukrainian officials. The Ukrainian air force reported that they shot down 29 out of 38 Iranian-made Shahed drones launched by Russia. The attack, which lasted from 8 p.m. Friday to 4 a.m. Saturday, targeted multiple regions. The Ministry of Energy stated that 416 settlements in the Odesa and Zaporizhzhia regions lost electricity after networks were damaged. Comparatively, last winter saw similar strikes that deprived millions of Ukrainians of electricity, heat, and water during the coldest months, though this autumn has been unusually warm. With temperatures now falling, Ukrainian officials are urging residents and businesses to prepare for possible renewed Russian attacks. 'We do not have a right to relax,' Volodymyr Kudrytskiy, head of Ukrenergo (the national power grid operator), told Ukrainian television. 'All of us—energy workers and defense forces—are preparing to repel possible Russian attacks on the energy infrastructure this winter.' The Ministry of Energy also reported an oil refinery in the Odesa region was hit. According to the southern military command, an administrative building was damaged and one civilian was wounded in the strike. In the northern Chernihiv region, near the borders with Russia and Belarus, two infrastructure buildings were damaged. Six settlements in Chernihiv are currently without power. Ukrainian officials added that this was the second drone attack on Kyiv this month, but all drones aimed at the capital were shot down before reaching the city.

Ukrajinsko ratno vazduhoplovstvo je saopštilo da su oborili 29 od 38 iranskih dronova tipa Šahed koje je lansirala Rusija. Napad je trajao od 20 časova u petak do 4 časa u subotu i bio je usmeren na više regiona. Prošle zime slični napadi ostavili su milione Ukrajinaca bez struje, grejanja i vode tokom najhladnijih meseci, dok je ova jesen bila neuobičajeno topla. Sa padom temperature, ukrajinski zvaničnici upozoravaju građane i preduzeća da se pripreme za moguće nove ruske napade. 'Nemamo pravo da se opustimo,' rekao je Volodimir Kudricki, direktor Ukrenerga (nacionalnog operatora prenosne mreže), za ukrajinsku televiziju. 'Svi mi – energetski radnici i snage odbrane – spremamo se da odbijemo moguće ruske napade na energetsku infrastrukturu ove zime.' article_content: According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the United States typically reports about 60 measles cases each year. However, in 2013, the country experienced a notable increase in cases, making it one of the worst years for measles in over a decade. Health officials point to people refusing to vaccinate their children as a major cause of the rise. By August 24, there had been 159 reported cases, making it the second-highest number since 2000, the year measles was declared eliminated in the US. In 2011, there were 222 cases. As of November, 175 cases had been reported, according to CDC Director Dr. Thomas Frieden. Elimination of measles means it no longer spreads year-round in the United States, though the disease remains common in many countries. Of this year's US cases, 172 were associated with importation, meaning they were brought in from overseas, while three others were directly imported, according to a study in JAMA Pediatrics. Measles is caused by a virus that typically grows in the cells lining the back of the throat and lungs. Symptoms include fever, runny nose, cough, red, watery eyes, a blotchy rash over the body, body aches, and tiny white spots with bluish centers inside the mouth. The rash usually starts three to five days after initial symptoms, beginning at the face and spreading downward. Fever can become quite high, reaching up to 104°F when the rash appears. Complications from measles can be severe: about 1 in 10 children develop an ear infection, up to 1 in 20 get pneumonia, about 1 in 1,000 develop encephalitis, and 1 or 2 out of every 1,000 die, according to the CDC. Measles can also cause miscarriage or premature birth in pregnant women. Globally, it kills an estimated 164,000 people each year, with more than half of these deaths occurring in India. Before the vaccine, nearly all children got measles by age 15 in the US. Annually, an estimated 450–500 people died, 48,000 were hospitalized, 7,000 had seizures, and about 1,000 suffered permanent brain damage or deafness. Measles is extremely contagious and can spread from four days before to four days after the rash appears. According to the CDC, 90% of unvaccinated people in close contact with a case will also get infected. The virus spreads through the air by coughing or sneezing and can survive on surfaces for up to two hours. People who have had measles are immune for life. The measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccine was licensed in 1971 and is given in two doses in the US: at 12–15 months and again between ages 4–6. Babies are vulnerable until vaccinated and can be infected by unvaccinated people. Although a 1998 study once claimed a link between the MMR vaccine and autism, it was discredited and retracted by The Lancet in 2010, and its author was found to have acted unethically. Vaccine resistance continues, with 92% of 2013 measles patients either unvaccinated or with unknown vaccination status. The largest outbreak occurred in New York, affecting 58 people in a community where many reject vaccines for religious reasons. The outbreak began with an unvaccinated 17-year-old who returned from London while infected. The CDC warns that anyone not protected against measles is at risk, especially when traveling internationally. Unvaccinated people not only put themselves at risk but also pose a threat to others by enabling measles to spread and cause severe complications.
translated_content: Prema podacima Centara za kontrolu i prevenciju bolesti (CDC), u Sjedinjenim Državama se obično prijavi oko 60 slučajeva malih boginja godišnje. Međutim, 2013. godine zabeležen je značajan porast broja slučajeva, što ovu godinu čini jednom od najgorih po pitanju malih boginja u poslednjih više od decenije. Zdravstveni zvaničnici ističu da je glavni uzrok ovog porasta odbijanje roditelja da vakcinišu svoju decu. Do 24. avgusta prijavljeno je 159 slučajeva, što je drugi najveći broj od 2000. godine, kada su male boginje proglašene iskorenjenim u SAD. U 2011. bilo je 222 slučaja, a do novembra 2013. zabeleženo je 175 slučajeva prema direktoru CDC-a, dr Tomasu Fridenu. Iskorenjavanje malih boginja znači da se one više ne prenose tokom cele godine u SAD, iako bolest i dalje ostaje česta u mnogim zemljama sveta. Od ovogodišnjih slučajeva u SAD, 172 je povezano sa unosom iz inostranstva, dok su preostala tri slučaja bila direktni uvozi, prema studiji objavljenoj u časopisu JAMA Pediatrics. Male boginje izaziva virus koji obično raste u ćelijama koje oblažu zadnji deo grla i pluća. Simptomi uključuju groznicu, curenje iz nosa, kašalj, crvene i suzne oči, osip po telu, bolove u telu i sitne bele tačkice plavičastih centara u ustima. Osip se obično javlja tri do pet dana nakon početka simptoma, počinje sa lica i širi se naniže. Temperatura može biti veoma visoka, dosežući do 40°C kada se pojavi osip. Komplikacije malih boginja mogu biti ozbiljne: oko 1 od 10 dece dobije infekciju uha, do 1 od 20 upalu pluća, oko 1 od 1.000 encefalitis, a 1 ili 2 od 1.000 umre, prema CDC-u. Male boginje mogu izazvati i spontani pobačaj ili prevremeni porođaj kod trudnica. U svetu godišnje od malih boginja umre oko 164.000 ljudi, preko polovine tih smrtnih slučajeva zabeleženo je u Indiji. Pre vakcine, skoro sva deca su do 15. godine preležala male boginje u SAD. Svake godine je umiralo 450–500 ljudi, 48.000 je hospitalizovano, 7.000 imalo napade, a oko 1.000 trpela trajna oštećenja mozga ili gubitak sluha. Male boginje su izuzetno zarazne i mogu se prenositi od četiri dana pre do četiri dana nakon pojave osipa. Prema CDC-u, 90% nevakcinisanih ljudi koji budu u blizini zaražene osobe takođe će se zaraziti. Virus se prenosi vazduhom kašljanjem ili kihanjem i može preživeti na površinama do dva sata. Ljudi koji su već preležali male boginje su trajno imuni. Vakcina protiv malih boginja, zauški i rubeole (MMR) licencirana je 1971. godine i daje se u dve doze u SAD: između 12. i 15. meseca života i ponovo između 4. i 6. godine. Bebe su ranjive dok ne prime vakcinu i mogu se zaraziti od nevakcinisanih osoba. Iako je 1998. jedna studija nakratko tvrdila moguću vezu između MMR vakcine i autizma, ta tvrdnja je diskreditovana i povučena iz časopisa The Lancet 2010. godine, a autor je proglašen neetičnim. Otpornost prema vakcinisanju i dalje traje, jer je 92% pacijenata sa malim boginjama u 2013. bilo nevakcinisano ili nepoznatog statusa vakcinacije. Najveća epidemija dogodila se u Njujorku, gde je 58 osoba obolelo u zajednici koja iz verskih razloga odbija vakcine. Epidemija je počela kad se nevakcinisani 17-godišnjak vratio iz Londona dok je bio zaražen. CDC upozorava da su svi koji nisu zaštićeni od malih boginja u riziku, posebno prilikom međunarodnih putovanja. Nevakcinisane osobe ne samo da ugrožavaju sebe već omogućavaju i širenje malih boginja i nastanak ozbiljnih komplikacija među drugima.

Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is now accepting applications for the Amrita Entrance Examination – Engineering (AEEE) 2024. Interested candidates should submit their applications online at amrita.edu. The exam will be administered as a computer-based test (CBT) in over 125 cities throughout India and in the UAE.

AEEE 2024 is a 2.5-hour test comprising 100 questions covering Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and English. The application fee is Rs 1200.

The entrance exam will be conducted in two phases: the first from January 19 to 22, and the second, tentatively, from May 10 to 14. Eligible applicants must have passed Class 12 or its equivalent from a recognized board, with at least 55% in each of Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics, and a minimum total of 60% across these subjects.

Scholarships are available for students from all branches, covering 85% of BTech program seats. Each year, approximately Rs 4.5 crore worth of scholarships are distributed among over 300 top-ranked students, determined by their AEEE or JEE Mains ranks for the first year, and CGPA in following years.

Admission to BTech programs at Amritapuri, Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, Amaravati, Mysuru, and Nagercoil campuses is based on results from AEEE 2024, JEE Mains 2024, SAT, or Pearson UG Engineering Entrance Examination.

article_content: The upcoming ICC Cricket World Cup match between New Zealand and Sri Lanka in Bengaluru may be disrupted by weather, creating uncertainty for New Zealand's chances to secure a place in the semifinals. The match is scheduled for Thursday, November 9, 2023, at 2pm local time (08:30 GMT), at M Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru, India. New Zealand captain Kane Williamson emphasized that his team will stay focused on their performance, despite concerns that rain could jeopardize their hopes of advancing. Last weekend, New Zealand lost a rain-affected match at the same venue against Pakistan, despite scoring 401 runs. This was their fourth consecutive defeat after a strong start in the tournament. Currently, New Zealand is fourth in the table and must win to strengthen their chances for the semifinals. A washout could allow Pakistan or Afghanistan, who are tied on points but have a lower net run rate, to advance instead. Williamson remarked, 'There are many things beyond our control, and the weather is one of them. Our main goal is to focus all our effort on playing our best cricket.' Sri Lanka, meanwhile, are aiming to maintain at least their current standing in order to qualify for the ICC Champions Trophy 2025. In their previous match against Bangladesh, Sri Lanka was involved in a controversy when Angelo Mathews became the first player in international cricket to be dismissed 'timed out.' Sri Lanka lost that game by three wickets and are eighth in the standings. Mathews publicly questioned the timing of his dismissal on social media, expressing concerns about player safety and the umpire's decision. Rain is forecasted for at least two hours during the match. While Chinnaswamy Stadium is well-equipped to handle rain delays, prolonged rainfall could prevent the match from finishing. New Zealand and Sri Lanka have faced each other 11 times in the ICC Cricket World Cup, with Sri Lanka holding a narrow lead with six wins to New Zealand's five. Both teams have struggled in recent matches. Sri Lanka has lost six out of eight games so far in the tournament, while New Zealand has lost its last four. For New Zealand, Lockie Ferguson returns from injury and is available for selection. Matt Henry is out of the tournament due to a hamstring injury and has been replaced by Kyle Jamieson. Predicted New Zealand XI: Devon Conway, Rachin Ravindra, Kane Williamson (captain), Daryl Mitchell, Mark Chapman, Glenn Phillips, Mitchell Santner, Tom Latham, Lockie Ferguson, Tim Southee, Trent Boult. Sri Lanka have also faced injury setbacks, including the loss of captain Dasun Shanaka. However, they are expected to select the same players as in their previous match. Predicted Sri Lanka XI: Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Perera, Kusal Mendis (captain), Sadeera Samarawickrama, Charith Asalanka, Angelo Mathews, Dhananjaya de Silva, Maheesh Theekshana, Dushmantha Chameera, Kasun Rajitha, Dilshan Madushanka.

Meč je zakazan za četvrtak, 9. novembar 2023. godine, u 14 časova po lokalnom vremenu (08:30 GMT), na stadionu M Činasvami u Bengaluruu, Indija. Kapiten Novog Zelanda, Kejn Vilijamson, naglasio je da će njegov tim ostati fokusiran na svoju igru, uprkos zabrinutosti da kiša može ugroziti njihove nade za prolazak dalje. Prošlog vikenda Novi Zeland je izgubio meč koji je prekinula kiša na istom stadionu protiv Pakistana, iako su postigli 401 poen. To im je bio četvrti uzastopni poraz nakon jakog starta na turniru. Trenutno je Novi Zeland četvrti na tabeli i mora da pobedi kako bi ojačao svoje šanse za polufinale. Otkazivanje meča zbog kiše moglo bi omogućiti Pakistanu ili Avganistanu, koji su izjednačeni po bodovima ali imaju lošiju net razliku poena, da se plasiraju umesto njih. Vilijamson je rekao: 'Mnogo je stvari koje ne možemo da kontrolišemo, a vreme je jedna od njih. Naš glavni cilj je da svu svoju energiju usmerimo na najbolju moguću igru.' Šri Lanka, sa druge strane, teži da bar zadrži trenutnu poziciju kako bi obezbedila plasman za ICC Champions Trophy 2025. U prethodnoj utakmici protiv Bangladeša, Šri Lanka je bila u središtu kontroverze kada je Anđelo Metyus postao prvi igrač u međunarodnom kriketu koji je diskvalifikovan zbog 'isteka vremena.' Šri Lanka je izgubila taj meč sa tri viketa i trenutno je osma na tabeli. Metyus je javno doveo u pitanje odluku sudije na društvenim mrežama, izražavajući zabrinutost za bezbednost igrača i donesenu odluku. Najavljuje se kiša tokom najmanje dva sata trajanja meča. Iako je stadion Činasvami dobro opremljen za kašnjenja zbog kiše, produženo nevreme može sprečiti završetak utakmice. Novi Zeland i Šri Lanka sastajali su se 11 puta na Svetskom prvenstvu u kriketu, a Šri Lanka ima malu prednost sa šest pobeda naspram pet Novog Zelanda. Oba tima imaju lošu seriju u poslednjim mečevima. Šri Lanka je izgubila šest od osam utakmica na turniru, dok Novi Zeland ima četiri uzastopna poraza. Za Novi Zeland se Loke Ferguson vraća posle povrede i dostupan je za selekciju. Met Henri više neće igrati zbog povrede zadnje lože i zamenio ga je Kajl Džemison. Prva postava Novog Zelanda: Devon Konvej, Račin Ravindra, Kejn Vilijamson (kapiten), Daryl Mičel, Mark Čepman, Glen Filips, Mičel Santner, Tom Lejtam, Loke Ferguson, Tim Sauti, Trent Boult. Šri Lanka je takođe imala problema sa povredama, uključujući kapitena Dasuna Šanaku, ali se očekuje da će igrati sa istim sastavom kao u prethodnom meču. Prva postava Šri Lanke: Patum Nisanka, Kusal Perera, Kusal Mendis (kapiten), Sadeera Samaravikrama, Čarit Asalanka, Anđelo Metyus, Danandžaja de Silva, Maheesh Theekshana, Dušmanta Čameera, Kasun Radžita, Dilšan Madušanka.

Prime Minister David Cameron has pledged to give up sugary foods and drinks for one day this week, with his wife's support, to back a national campaign against obesity. The campaign, known as Action on Sugar, aims to reduce the sugar content in food and beverages by up to 30%, responding to the issues of obesity and type 2 diabetes.

During Prime Minister’s Questions, senior Labour MP Keith Vaz encouraged Cameron to take part in the 'sugar-free challenge' and meet with health experts on sugar reduction. Vaz pointed out that voluntary efforts to urge manufacturers to cut sugar have not been effective.

Cameron replied: "I'm sure that proposal would have the strong support of Mrs Cameron, so I will take it up if I possibly can. I commend you for consistently highlighting diabetes and obesity, which are major health concerns for our country. We are taking them seriously and are rolling out the NHS health check programme to identify those aged 40 to 74 at risk of diabetes."

He added that, while childhood obesity rates are falling, more work remains. Cameron said he is happy to facilitate further discussions between Keith Vaz and Health Secretary Jeremy Hunt, and he noted that the government’s Responsibility Deal has seen positive outcomes but emphasized that further action is necessary.
translated_content:
Premijer Dejvid Kameron obećao je da će se odreći slatkiša i slatkih pića na jedan dan ove nedelje, uz podršku svoje supruge, kako bi podržao nacionalnu kampanju protiv gojaznosti. Kampanja, poznata kao Akcija za smanjenje šećera, ima za cilj da smanji količinu šećera u hrani i pićima za do 30%, kao odgovor na probleme gojaznosti i dijabetesa tipa 2.

Tokom poslaničkih pitanja, istaknuti laburistički poslanik Kit Vaz pozvao je Kamerona da se pridruži 'izazovu bez šećera' i sastane sa zdravstvenim stručnjacima o smanjenju šećera. Vaz je naglasio da dobrovoljni pokušaji da se proizvođači podstaknu na smanjenje šećera nisu bili dovoljno efikasni.

Kameron je odgovorio: "Siguran sam da bi taj predlog imao snažnu podršku moje supruge, pa ću ga prihvatiti ako budem mogao. Moram da vam odam priznanje što dosledno ističete dijabetes i gojaznost, koji su veliki zdravstveni problemi naše zemlje. Ozbiljno shvatamo ove probleme i uvodimo NHS program zdravstvenih pregleda kako bismo identifikovali one između 40 i 74 godine koji su u riziku od dijabetesa."

On je dodao da, iako stopa gojaznosti dece opada, potrebno je još rada. Kameron je istakao da je spreman da omogući dalje razgovore između Kita Vaza i ministra zdravlja Džeremija Hanta i naglasio da je Vladin Sporazum o odgovornosti doneo pozitivne rezultate, ali da je potrebna dodatna akcija.

Pc Simon Harwood, a Metropolitan Police officer, appeared at Southwark Crown Court today to face a charge of manslaughter in connection with the death of newspaper seller Ian Tomlinson at the G20 protests in central London on 1 April 2009. Mr Tomlinson, a 47-year-old homeless man, collapsed and died after being shoved to the ground during the demonstrations.

Harwood, 40, entered a plea of not guilty to the charge before the court. He showed no emotion as he confirmed his name and heard the formal accusation. Relatives of Mr Tomlinson, including his widow Julia and stepson Paul King, were present in court and visibly emotional during the hearing. Harwood's wife, Helen, also attended and remained composed.

While his trial was originally set for October 2012, Mr Justice Jeremy Cooke has brought the date forward to June 13, 2012. Harwood’s defence counsel, Patrick Gibbs QC, announced plans to address concerns about the possibility of a fair trial due to extensive media coverage. This application will be heard at the end of November.

Following the inquest into Mr Tomlinson’s death, the Director of Public Prosecutions, Keir Starmer QC, decided to prosecute Harwood after a jury concluded Mr Tomlinson was unlawfully killed. The jury found that Harwood had acted illegally, recklessly, and dangerously by pushing Mr Tomlinson to the ground and using 'excessive and unreasonable' force. Mr Tomlinson was not deemed a threat at the time.

The fatal incident became a subject of international scrutiny when video footage recorded by bystander Christopher La Jaunie was published by The Guardian. Additional CCTV, helicopter, and hand-held recordings documented Mr Tomlinson’s movements before his death. Shortly after being struck, Tomlinson staggered away from a police cordon, collapsed, and died a few minutes later.

Julia Tomlinson testified at the inquest that her husband’s death devastated the family. Ian Tomlinson, originally from Matlock, Derbyshire, struggled with alcoholism and multiple health issues, and had spent much of the previous 20 years without a permanent home.

Harwood has been released on unconditional bail. The trial is expected to last five weeks.
translated_content:
Policajac Metropolitanske policije, Sajmon Harvud, danas se pojavio na Kraljevskom sudu u Sautvorku, gde se suočio sa optužbom za ubistvo iz nehata u vezi sa smrću prodavca novina Ijana Tomlinsona tokom G20 protesta u centru Londona 1. aprila 2009. godine. Gospodin Tomlinson, beskućnik star 47 godina, srušio se i preminuo nakon što ga je Harvud oborio na zemlju tokom demonstracija.

Harvud, star 40 godina, izjavio je pred sudom da nije kriv. Bio je bez izraza na licu dok je potvrđivao svoje ime i slušao zvaničnu optužbu. Porodica gospodina Tomlinsona, uključujući njegovu suprugu Juliju i pastorka Pola Kinga, prisustvovala je suđenju i bila vidno potresena tokom ročišta. Harvudova supruga Helen je takođe bila prisutna i ostala smirena.

Iako je suđenje bilo prvobitno zakazano za oktobar 2012, sudija Džeremi Kuke pomerio je datum na 13. jun 2012. godine. Harvudov branilac, Patrik Gibs QC, najavio je planove da pokrene pitanje mogućnosti fer suđenja zbog velikog medijskog izveštavanja. Ova molba biće razmotrena krajem novembra.

Nakon istrage o smrti gospodina Tomlinsona, generalni tužilac Kijer Starmer QC odlučio je da podigne optužnicu protiv Harvuda, nakon što je porota zaključila da je u pitanju nezakonito ubistvo. Porota je utvrdila da je Harvud postupao nezakonito, nesmotreno i opasno obarajući Tomlinsona na tlo koristeći „prekomernu i neopravdanu silu“. Tomlinson u to vreme nije predstavljao pretnju.

Slučaj je izazvao međunarodnu pažnju kada je slučajni prolaznik Kristofer La Žani snimio događaj, a snimak objavio list Guardian. Dodatni snimci sa CCTV-a, policijskog helikoptera i ručnih kamera prikazali su kretanje Tomlinsona pre smrti. Ubrzo nakon što je udaren, Tomlinson je odšetao od policijske blokade, srušio se i preminuo nekoliko minuta kasnije.

Julija Tomlinson je tokom istrage izjavila da je smrt njenog supruga bila velika tragedija za porodicu. Ijan Tomlinson, poreklom iz Matloka u Derbiširu, borio se sa alkoholizmom i brojnim zdravstvenim problemima, a prethodnih 20 godina uglavnom je proveo bez stalnog doma.

Harvud je pušten da se brani sa slobode do početka suđenja, koje se očekuje da traje oko pet nedelja.

article_content: A new study from the Pew Research Center highlights that while Hispanic populations are increasingly settling throughout the United States, a majority still reside in a handful of states. More than half of all Hispanics in the U.S. live in California, Texas, or Florida—with California hosting one in four. When also considering New York, Illinois, Arizona, New Jersey, and Colorado, these eight states account for approximately 75% of the nation's Hispanic residents. Despite this concentration, other regions, particularly in the Southeast, are seeing rapid Hispanic population growth. Georgia stands out, with areas like Atlanta attracting people due to employment and educational opportunities. Mark Hugo Lopez, Pew's Hispanic research director, notes that this broader distribution could have significant political consequences by increasing Latino participation in voting and public office across more states. New Mexico leads the country in terms of Hispanic population share, with nearly 47% of its residents identifying as Hispanic. Conversely, the Hispanic population is smallest in Maine, West Virginia, and Vermont. Nationwide, individuals of Mexican descent represent about 65% of all U.S. Hispanics. Stewart County in southwestern Georgia saw the greatest percentage increase, growing its Hispanic community by more than 17 times in 11 years since 2000.
translated_content: Nova studija Centra za istraživanje Pew pokazuje da, iako se latinoamerička populacija sve više širi širom Sjedinjenih Država, većina i dalje živi u nekoliko ključnih država. Više od polovine svih Latinoamerikanaca u SAD živi u Kaliforniji, Teksasu ili Floridi – a Kalifornija je dom svakom četvrtom latinoamerikancu u zemlji. Uključujući još Njujork, Ilinois, Arizonu, Nju Džerzi i Kolorado, ovih osam saveznih država čini oko 75% hispanskog stanovništva u SAD. Ipak, drugi regioni, posebno jugoistok zemlje, beleže ubrzan rast latinoameričke populacije. Džordžija se izdvaja, a gradovi poput Atlante privlače nove stanovnike zbog mogućnosti zaposlenja i obrazovanja. Mark Ugo Lopez, direktor hispanskih istraživanja pri Pew centru, napominje da ova šira rasprostranjenost može imati značajne političke posledice, jer bi latino zajednica mogla više da učestvuje u glasanju i javnom životu u sve više država. Novi Meksiko prednjači prema udelu latinoameričkog stanovništva, jer gotovo 47% njegovih stanovnika ima hispansko poreklo. Nasuprot tome, Latinoamerikanci su najmanje zastupljeni u Menju, Zapadnoj Virdžiniji i Vermontu. Na nacionalnom nivou, osobe meksičkog porekla čine oko 65% svih Latinoamerikanaca u SAD. Okrug Stjuart u jugozapadnoj Džordžiji zabeležio je najveći procenat rasta, jer se broj Latinoamerikanaca u toj oblasti povećao više od 17 puta u 11 godina od 2000. godine.

article_content: The Election Petition Tribunal for the Edo State House of Assembly, sitting in Benin, has nullified the earlier declaration of Destiny Enabulele as the winner of the Ovia South West constituency seat. Enabulele of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) was previously announced as the victor by the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) following the March 15 polls. However, after considering a petition from Sunday Aghedo of the All Progressives Congress (APC), the tribunal declared Aghedo the rightful winner. The tribunal ruled that Aghedo and the APC substantiated their claims of election irregularities, misconduct, and breaches of the Electoral Act, prompting the reversal of the result and the removal of Enabulele from office.
translated_content: Tribunal za izborne žalbe Skupštine države Edo, koji zaseda u Beninu, poništio je prethodnu odluku kojom je Destiny Enabulele iz Narodne demokratske partije (PDP) proglašen pobednikom izbora za izbornu jedinicu Ovia South West. Enabulele je prethodno bio proglašen pobednikom od strane Nezavisne nacionalne izborne komisije (INEC) posle izbora održanih 15. marta. Međutim, nakon razmatranja žalbe koju je podneo Sunday Aghedo iz Sveprogresivne kongresne partije (APC), tribunal je odlučio da je Aghedo stvarni pobednik. article_content: OneWeb India, a subsidiary of Eutelsat Group and supported by India's Bharti Group, has received the necessary authorisations from the Indian National Space Promotion and Authorisation Centre (IN-SPACe) to launch commercial satellite broadband services in India. With this approval, OneWeb India becomes the first company in the country to secure regulatory clearance for satellite broadband services. However, the company cannot begin offering services until it is allocated the required satellite spectrum by the government. Eutelsat OneWeb announced on social media that it had received authorisation and is ready to launch services as soon as spectrum is assigned. IN-SPACe confirmed that the authorisation for Eutelsat OneWeb's satellite constellation is valid for five years. Sunil Bharti Mittal, chairman of Bharti Group and vice-chair of Eutelsat Group, welcomed the regulator’s approval and said the company is prepared to deploy services once it receives final spectrum clearance. OneWeb India already holds licences from the Department of Telecommunications to provide broadband services via satellite and has preliminary approval to establish gateways in Gujarat and Tamil Nadu. These gateways will enable high-speed, low-latency internet connectivity for customers across India once service is launched. Previously, ISRO and its commercial arm NSIL successfully launched 72 OneWeb satellites into low Earth orbit. Including launches by other agencies, a total of 618 satellites have been deployed for the OneWeb constellation, which requires 588 satellites for global coverage, with additional satellites for redundancy. OneWeb expects to achieve global coverage by the end of the year, expanding its existing services, currently available in regions north of 50 degrees latitude, by partnering with leading providers. The global commercial space market, estimated at $400 billion, is projected to reach $1 trillion by 2030, but India’s current share is just 2%, around $8 billion. The Indian government sets a target of increasing this to $40 billion by 2040.
translated_content: OneWeb India, podružnica Eutelsat Group-a i uz podršku indijske Bharti Group, dobila je potrebne dozvole od Indijskog nacionalnog centra za promociju i odobravanje svemira (IN-SPACe) za pokretanje komercijalnih satelitskih širokopojasnih usluga u Indiji. Ovim odobrenjem, OneWeb India postaje prva kompanija u zemlji sa regulatornim odobrenjem za satelitski internet. Međutim, kompanija ne može započeti pružanje usluga dok joj vlada ne dodeli potrebni satelitski spektar. Eutelsat OneWeb je na društvenim mrežama objavio da su dobili odobrenje i da mogu da pokrenu usluge čim spekar bude dodeljen. IN-SPACe je potvrdio da odobrenje za Eutelsat OneWeb-ovu satelitsku konstelaciju važi pet godina. Sunil Bharti Mittal, predsednik Bharti Group-a i zamenik predsednika Eutelsat Group-a, pozdravio je ovu dozvolu i izjavio da je kompanija spremna da započne pružanje usluga kada dobije finalno odobrenje za spektar. OneWeb India već ima licence Ministarstva telekomunikacija za pružanje širokopojasnih usluga putem satelita i preliminarno odobrenje za postavljanje pristupnih stanica u Gudžaratu i Tamil Nadu. Ove stanice će omogućiti brzu, stabilnu internet konekciju korisnicima širom Indije nakon pokretanja usluge. Ranije su ISRO i njena komercijalna jedinica NSIL uspeli da lansiraju 72 OneWeb satelita u nisku Zemljinu orbitu. Sa lansiranjima drugih agencija, ukupno je postavljeno 618 satelita za OneWeb konstelaciju, dok je za globalnu pokrivenost neophodno 588 satelita, uz dodatne za sigurnost. OneWeb očekuje da do kraja godine uspostavi globalnu pokrivenost, šireći svoje postojeće usluge (koje su trenutno dostupne u regionima severno od 50 stepeni geografske širine) saradnjom sa vodećim provajderima. Globalno tržište komercijalnog svemira, procenjeno na 400 milijardi dolara, trebalo bi da poraste na 1 bilion dolara do 2030. godine, dok indijski udeo sada iznosi samo 2% ili oko 8 milijardi dolara. Vlada planira da ta cifra poraste na 40 milijardi dolara do 2040.

Olivia University, situated in Bujumbura, the capital of Burundi, is inviting Nigerian students to enroll in programs such as medicine/surgery, nursing, pharmacy, and other specialized courses. The announcement came from the university’s Vice Chancellor, Prof. Josephat Obi-Oguejiofor, during an interactive event with stakeholders and prospective students in Awka, Anambra State, Nigeria.

The university has introduced a scholarship initiative that allows Nigerian students to study specific courses at half the standard tuition fee. Prof. Obi-Oguejiofor emphasized that the scholarship, established by the Pro-chancellor, Sir Chukwuma, reflects the institution’s dedication to promoting quality education for Nigerians and the wider African community. The faculties of Medicine, Pharmacy, and Nursing were recently launched, with scholarships available for foundation students.

Prof. Obi-Oguejiofor explained, “Nigerian students now have the opportunity to study medicine/surgery, pharmacy, and nursing at Olivia University for just half the regular tuition. This is a major opportunity for access to high-quality higher education.”

As an English-speaking institution—the first of its kind in East Africa—Olivia University assures an uninterrupted academic calendar, internationally trained lecturers, and a high standard learning environment. The university affirms adherence to global best practices in tertiary education in sub-Saharan Africa.

Beyond medical fields, students can enroll in areas like Artificial Intelligence, Mining Engineering, Software Engineering, Telecommunication Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Systems, Accounting, Architecture, Banking and Finance, Business Administration, and Economics.

Dr. Tochukwu Oguegbe, the institution’s South-East coordinator in Nigeria, underscored the inclusive nature of the scholarship, confirming its availability to all Nigerians regardless of background. He also indicated that students may have opportunities for international travel as part of their educational experience.

Olivia University Bujumbura is located at Mayugi, Avenue, Mukaza, Bujumbura, Burundi. More details are available on the university’s website.

article_content: Polling data suggests growing support for far-right ideologies in Germany, spanning across all age groups. The upcoming election in Bavaria could reveal whether this trend is spreading beyond the regions typically associated with the far right, like Saxony. Traditionally, Bavarian politics have been dominated by mainstream parties. At present, the state is governed by a coalition between the Christian Social Union (CSU) and the Free Voters (FW), a group of former independents with a range of political views. While the CSU is generally recognized for its moderate, center-right position, the FW includes figures such as deputy premier Hubert Aiwanger, who has faced criticism. Earlier this year, Aiwanger was linked to an antisemitic leaflet from his school days in the 1980s—his brother later claimed authorship, but Aiwanger admitted to distributing the pamphlet. Public attention intensified when the story was reported in the media. Although Aiwanger denied writing the document, Bavarian premier Markus Söder questioned him and ultimately allowed him to remain in office, albeit while condemning the pamphlet’s message. This episode underscores that far-right issues are not limited to the Alternative for Germany (AfD) or to eastern regions. According to researcher Franziska Schröter, while eastern Germany still shows higher levels of far-right support, the phenomenon is expanding westward, including into Bavaria. She attributes these variations to cultural and demographic factors, such as the predominance of older, rural populations and the migration of educated residents. Presently, the national governing coalition trails the AfD in polling. If the AfD and FW see increased backing in Bavaria in spite of scandals, it challenges the notion that far-right advances are isolated to economically challenged eastern states. Schröter also notes that many far-right organizers in the East originally come from West Germany, reflecting the movement's nationwide dimensions.
translated_content: Ankete pokazuju porast podrške krajnje desničarskim idejama širom Nemačke, među svim starosnim grupama. Predstojeći izbori u Bavarskoj mogli bi otkriti da li se taj trend širi i izvan regiona kao što je Saksonija, koji su tradicionalno povezani sa ekstremnom desnicom. Bavarsku su uglavnom vodile glavne partije. Trenutno vlast čini koalicija Hrišćansko-socijalne unije (CSU) i Slobodnih birača (FW), grupe bivših nezavisnih političara sa različitim stavovima. Iako je CSU poznat po svom umerenijem, desničarskom stavu, među članovima FW je i vicepremijer Hubert Ajvanger, koji je bio predmet kritika. Ove godine, Ajvanger je povezan sa antisemitskim letkom iz srednjoškolskih dana osamdesetih—njegov brat je priznao da je autor letka, dok je Ajvanger priznao da ga je delio. Pojačana pažnja medija dovela je do javne rasprave. Ajvanger je negirao da je autor, a pokrajinski premijer Markus Zeder ga je ispitivao, ali je dozvolio da ostane na funkciji, uz osudu sadržaja letka. Ovaj slučaj pokazuje da ekstremna desnica nije ograničena samo na Alternativu za Nemačku (AfD) ili na istočne regione. Istraživačica Franziska Šröter navodi da, iako na istoku broj pristalica jeste veći, ekstremna desnica se širi i na zapad, uključujući Bavarsku. Ona to objašnjava kulturološkim i demografskim faktorima, poput starije i ruralne populacije i migracije obrazovanih. Trenutno koalicione partije na saveznom nivou zaostaju za AfD-om u anketama. Ako AfD i FW ostvare uspeh na izborima u Bavarskoj uprkos aferama, to pobija mišljenje da je uspon ekstremne desnice vezan uz slabije razvijene istočne delove zemlje. Šröter dodaje da su mnogi organizatori krajnje desnice na istoku zapravo iz zapadnog dela Nemačke, što pokazuje koliku širinu ima ovaj pokret.

article_content:
German software company SAP has announced plans to recruit up to 500 autistic individuals to train as high-tech IT experts. The company states that it values the unique perspectives autistic people offer and wants to tap into their specific skills. With a global workforce of over 65,000, SAP aims to have autistic employees comprise 1% of its staff by 2020. Recruitment will begin this year in Germany, the United States, and Canada, supported by Danish experts who have experience in hiring autistic staff for large firms.

There is a higher proportion of autistic individuals working in the information technology industry than average, in part because autism is often associated with strengths such as attention to detail and strong information-processing skills. Public awareness of autism was notably raised by the film 'Rain Man,' starring Dustin Hoffman as an autistic character.

Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), which includes Asperger syndrome, refers to a range of developmental conditions. Individuals with ASD may have difficulties with social interactions and communication, as well as display repetitive behaviors. The condition can manifest with varying symptoms and abilities: some autistic people have significant difficulties with language and intellectual development, while others have advanced language skills but face social challenges.

Autism has a strong genetic component, although the genetics are complex and not fully understood. Signs are usually noticed by parents within the first two years of a child’s life, often developing gradually. Early behavioral or cognitive interventions can help autistic children develop self-care, social, and communication skills, although there is no known cure.

Scientific studies have found that, on certain cognitive tasks, people with autism can outperform non-autistic individuals. For example, a 2012 University College London study showed that adults with autism demonstrated a higher capacity for processing information as tasks became more complex. Previous research has also linked traits such as attention to detail and intense focus—characteristics often associated with genius—to autism.
translated_content:
Nemačka softverska kompanija SAP najavila je planove da zaposli do 500 osoba sa autizmom, kako bi ih obučila za stručnjake u oblasti informacione tehnologije. Kompanija ističe da ceni jedinstvene perspektive koje ljudi sa autizmom donose i želi da iskoristi njihove specifične veštine. Sa globalnim timom od preko 65.000 zaposlenih, cilj SAP-a je da do 2020. godine osobe sa autizmom čine 1% radne snage. Zapošljavanje počinje ove godine u Nemačkoj, Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama i Kanadi, uz podršku danskih stručnjaka sa iskustvom u angažovanju osoba sa autizmom u velikim kompanijama.

U IT sektoru prosečno radi više osoba sa autizmom nego u ostalim industrijama, delom zbog tipičnih snaga kao što su pažnja na detalje i razvijene sposobnosti za obradu informacija. Šira javnost je o autizmu postala svesna nakon filma „Kišni čovek“ (Rain Man), u kojem Dastin Hofman igra osobu sa autizmom.

Poremećaj iz spektra autizma (ASD), uključujući Aspergerov sindrom, označava grupu razvojnih stanja. Osobe sa ASD mogu imati poteškoće u društvenim interakcijama i komunikaciji, ali i pokazivati ponavljajuća ponašanja. Simptomi i sposobnosti su različiti: neki pojedinci imaju značajne poteškoće u komunikaciji i kognitivnom razvoju, dok drugi imaju razvijene jezičke veštine, ali im društvene norme teško padaju.

Autizam ima snažnu genetsku osnovu, mada je genetika i dalje predmet brojnih istraživanja. Znakove autizma roditelji obično primete u prve dve godine života deteta, najčešće postepeno. Rana bihejvioralna ili kognitivna intervencija može pomoći deci da razviju samostalnost, društvene i komunikacione veštine, iako za autizam trenutno nema poznatog leka.

Naučna istraživanja dokazala su da osobe sa autizmom u određenim kognitivnim zadacima mogu biti uspešnije od osoba bez autizma. Na primer, studija Univerzitetskog koledža u Londonu iz 2012. pokazala je da odrasli sa autizmom lakše obrađuju složenije informacije. Ranija istraživanja povezivala su osobine poput pažnje na detalje i izuzetne fokusiranosti – karakteristike često vezane za genijalnost – sa autizmom.

article_content: Kevin Turen, renowned producer of 'Euphoria' and 'The Idol,' passed away at 44. His death was sudden over the weekend, and the cause has not been disclosed. Turen is survived by his wife Evelina and their two sons, Jack and James. His father, Edward Turen, expressed his deep sorrow over the loss, emphasizing Kevin’s special significance. Turen’s filmography spans acclaimed projects, including Larry Clark’s 'Wassup Rockers,' 'Malcolm and Marie' with Sam Levinson, Trey Shultz’s 'Waves,' Nicholas Jarecki’s 'Arbitrage,' Nate Parker’s 'The Birth of a Nation,' Kornel Mondruczo’s 'Pieces of a Woman,' Ramin Bahrani’s '99 Homes,' and Ti West’s 'X' trilogy. In television, Turen worked on shows like Sam Levinson’s 'Euphoria' and 'The Idol,' as well as Olivier Assayas’s 'Irma Vep.' Jay Penske, CEO of PMC and Turen's friend, spoke about Kevin’s devotion to his family, highlighting how proud he was of his children and the values he and Evelina instilled in them. Penske called Turen one of Hollywood’s brightest rising talents, and said the loss is widely felt. Born in New York City on August 16, 1979, Turen studied cinema at Columbia University prior to moving to Los Angeles. (Report includes contributions from Dominic Patten.)

Iza njega su ostali supruga Evelina i njihova dva sina, Jack i James. Njegov otac Edward Turen izrazio je veliku tugu zbog gubitka i naglasio koliko je Kevin bio poseban. Tokom svoje karijere, Turen je radio na značajnim filmskim projektima, uključujući 'Wassup Rockers' Larryja Clarka, 'Malcolm and Marie' sa Samom Levinsonom, 'Waves' Treya Shultza, 'Arbitrage' Nicholasa Jareckog, 'The Birth of a Nation' Natea Parkera, 'Pieces of a Woman' Kornéla Mundruczóa, '99 Homes' Ramina Bahranija i trilogiju 'X' Ti Westa. Na televiziji je Turen bio producent serija kao što su 'Euphoria' i 'The Idol' Sama Levinsona, kao i 'Irma Vep' Oliviera Assayasa. Jay Penske, direktor PMC-a i Turenov prijatelj, govorio je o Kevinovoj predanosti porodici, ističući njegov ponos na decu i vrednosti koje su on i Evelina usadili. Penske je Turena nazvao jednim od najsjajnijih talenata Holivuda i naglasio da je njegov odlazak duboko pogodio filmsku zajednicu. article_content: According to a survey conducted by Mumsnet, nearly half of mothers reported enjoying giving birth, although 64% described it as the most painful experience of their lives. The study, which surveyed more than 1,662 users, found that 44% of women felt no one had honestly prepared them for childbirth. Despite these concerns, over half of respondents said they actually enjoyed the experience. However, just under half said they would either do things differently if they gave birth again or would choose not to give birth at all. A total of 64% agreed that giving birth was physically the most painful event they had experienced. A Mumsnet spokeswoman explained the contradiction between 47% enjoying birth and 64% citing intense pain as 'just one of those contradictions of birth.' The survey also revealed that 19% of women were still sexually active in their ninth month of pregnancy. The majority—81%—believed that portrayals of childbirth in television and film are generally unrealistic. Justine Roberts, Mumsnet founder, commented, 'It can be difficult to find the unvarnished truth about what giving birth is really like. We're either shown an idealized, gentle experience or frightened by extreme stories of pain and emergency.'
translated_content: Prema anketi koju je sproveo Mumsnet, skoro polovina majki izjavila je da je uživala u porođaju, iako je 64% opisalo to kao najbolnije iskustvo u svom životu. Istraživanje, koje je obuhvatilo više od 1.662 korisnica, pokazalo je da 44% žena smatra da ih niko nije iskreno pripremio za porođaj. Uprkos tim brigama, više od polovine ispitanica reklo je da su zapravo uživale u tom iskustvu. Međutim, nešto manje od polovine navelo je da bi sledeći put uradile nešto drugačije ili da ne bi ponovo rađale. Ukupno 64% žena složilo se da je porođaj bio fizički najbolniji događaj kroz koji su prošle. Two senior officials at the Department of Justice left their positions following an internal investigation into the Fast and Furious gun-trafficking scandal, although Attorney General Eric Holder was cleared of direct wrongdoing. A comprehensive 471-page report by Inspector General Michael Horowitz identified significant errors in judgment throughout the department. It also referred 14 individuals for potential disciplinary action related to both Operation Fast and Furious and the earlier Operation Wide Receiver, which took place during the Bush administration.

Operation Fast and Furious aimed to track illicit firearm sales to break up Mexican drug cartels, but federal agents lost track of approximately 1,400 out of 2,000 firearms, and many of these weapons ended up at crime scenes in both the United States and Mexico. The operation's failure became most evident in December 2010, when U.S. Border Patrol Agent Brian Terry was killed with weapons connected to the operation, leading to increased scrutiny and the inspector general's review.

The report did not recommend criminal charges and did not find fault with Attorney General Holder’s actions, although it noted he should have been briefed about the investigation sooner. Senior ATF leadership, the U.S. Attorney’s Office in Phoenix, and officials in the Justice Department’s criminal division were criticized for poor management, oversight, and internal communication, which resulted in Congress initially receiving inaccurate information.

In the wake of the report, former ATF acting director Kenneth Melson retired and Deputy Assistant Attorney General Jason Weinstein resigned, both of whom were subject to criticism in the inspector general’s findings. Weinstein’s attorney, however, disputed the report’s conclusions. The controversial gun-walking tactic—allowing so-called “straw buyers” to purchase firearms in order to trace them to higher-level criminals—was used during both the Bush and Obama administrations, but consistently failed, facilitating the trafficking of large numbers of guns to Mexico.

Congressional critics, especially Rep. Darrell Issa, cited the report as evidence of mismanagement and disregard for public safety. The inspector general’s findings concluded that major strategic and managerial failures were widespread among the offices involved in the operation. Several suspects in Brian Terry’s murder have been apprehended, while others remain at large.

Dva visoka funkcionera Ministarstva pravde napustila su svoje funkcije nakon interne istrage o aferi „Brza i žestoka“, iako je državni tužilac Erik Holder oslobođen bilo kakve direktne odgovornosti. Obimni izveštaj glavnog inspektora Majkla Horovica, na 471 strani, identifikovao je velike propuste u proceni i vođenju slučaja u ministarstvu. Četrnaest osoba je upućeno na moguću disciplinsku odgovornost u vezi sa operacijama „Brza i žestoka“ i ranijom „Široki prijemnik“ iz vremena Bušove administracije.

Cilj operacije „Brza i žestoka“ bio je praćenje ilegalnih prodaja oružja radi razbijanja meksičkih narko-kartela, ali su federalni agenti izgubili trag za oko 1.400 od 2.000 komada oružja, a mnoga su završila na mestima zločina u SAD i Meksiku. Najveći neuspeh operacije dogodio se u decembru 2010. godine, kada je američki granični agent Brajan Teri ubijen oružjem povezanim sa ovom akcijom, što je izazvalo dodatnu pažnju i pokrenulo istragu glavnog inspektora.

Izveštaj nije preporučio pokretanje krivičnih postupaka niti je direktno okrivio Holdera, ali je ukazao da je morao ranije biti obavešten o istrazi. Nakon objave izveštaja, bivši v.d. direktora ATF-a Kenet Melson je otišao u penziju, a zamenik pomoćnika državnog tužioca Džejson Vajnstin podneo je ostavku, i obojica su bili predmet kritike u izveštaju. Vajnstinov advokat je, ipak, osporio zaključke izveštaja. Kontroverzna „taktika sledljivog kupca”, korišćena i za vreme Buša i Obame, pokazala se neuspešnom, što je olakšalo šverc velikog broja oružja u Meksiko.

Kongresmeni, posebno Darrel Isa, naveli su izveštaj kao dokaz lošeg vođenja i zanemarivanja javne bezbednosti. Glavni inspektor je zaključio da su teški strateški i menadžerski propusti bili prisutni u više kancelarija uključenih u ovu operaciju. Nekoliko osumnjičenih za ubistvo Brajana Terija je uhapšeno, dok su drugi još u bekstvu.

article_content: Kevin McCaffery, an animal lover from Kentucky, was subjected to homophobic harassment at work and eventually lost his job because he is gay. He found comfort running LLA-Nanny Farms, his animal sanctuary for over 300 animals—including llamas, cats, dogs, chickens, donkeys, and pigs—on his Kentucky property. The sanctuary now faces an uncertain future after McCaffery’s lawsuit against the day care center that forced him to resign was unsuccessful; Kentucky does not prohibit workplace discrimination based on sexual orientation. At the Ashland day care, McCaffery says he was repeatedly mocked with nicknames like 'twinkle toes' by co-workers. Mounting bills, legal fees, and the absence of a steady income have made it difficult for him to support the animals. Out of work for over a year and relying on food stamps, he has struggled to find new employment. 'It's hard to keep my head up anymore,' he wrote on Facebook. In response to his circumstances, a supporter created an online fundraising page to help feed the animals—the campaign quickly surpassed its $1,800 goal, raising over $8,000. McCaffery, a former public school teacher of 15 years, returned to work as a day care director and encountered persistent harassment leading to his forced resignation, despite a spotless professional record. Although a judge acknowledged he was treated unfairly, he could not be compensated because Kentucky lacks laws protecting against anti-gay discrimination. This case has spurred renewed advocacy for the Employment Non-Discrimination Act (ENDA), which would protect LGBT employees nationwide. Though ENDA was introduced in 2011 and has broad support, it has not yet become law. Supporters are now seeking a Senate vote and urging President Obama to take executive action against workplace discrimination.

U vrtiću u Ashlandu, McCaffery kaže da su ga kolege više puta ismevale nadimcima poput "twinkle toes" (plesačica). Sa nagomilanim računima, pravnim troškovima i bez stalnih prihoda, teško obezbeđuje sredstva za brigu o životinjama. Više od godinu dana je bez posla i koristi bonove za hranu, a pokušaji da pronađe novi posao nisu uroditi plodom. "Teško mi je više da zadržim optimizam," napisao je na Fejsbuku. Kao odgovor na njegovu situaciju, jedna žena je pokrenula stranicu za prikupljanje donacija radi ishrane životinja, koja je brzo premašila cilj od 1.800 dolara i skupila više od 8.000 dolara. Iako je sudija priznao da je nepravedno tretiran, nije dobio odštetu jer u Kentakiju ne postoji zakon koji štiti LGBT osobe od diskriminacije na radu. Zagovornici sada traže glasanje u Senatu i apeluju na predsednika Obamu da preduzme izvršnu akciju protiv diskriminacije na radnom mestu.

article_content: Leah Walton, a 19-year-old transgender woman from Mississippi, is enjoying life as her true self after overcoming religious protests against her gender identity. On her first day attending school as a woman, Leah faced opposition from fellow students and parents, some wearing T-shirts with hostile slogans such as 'You're going to hell' and 'Abomination.' Despite ongoing abuse, Leah refused to stop living openly. Born as Dylan Walton, Leah realized early that she identified as female. By age 17, she began dressing as a woman at school and started using the name Leah. She recounts her excitement about becoming Leah, even though she faced protests on her first day presenting as female. Leah experienced stares and whispers from classmates but managed to cope with support from her friends and, especially, her mother Kim Hood, who helped her through difficult times. Leah says that, although the initial reaction was frightening, her self-confidence improved over time, and some people even congratulated her bravery. As a child, Leah felt uncomfortable in her body. At seven, her mother found her wearing lipstick while imitating Britney Spears, which initially led to discouragement. By 13, Leah felt increasingly out of place among boys. At 16, after seeing a transgender woman online, she was inspired to pursue her transition. Her mother became supportive, and Leah was diagnosed with gender dysphoria, receiving counseling and starting hormone therapy at 17. At first, Leah had to follow the school dress code, but with help from her mother and the American Civil Liberties Union, she persuaded South Panola High School to let her dress as a woman. Although some accused Leah of receiving special treatment, she maintained she was simply exercising her right to express her identity. Living openly as a woman, Leah now works at a deli and is saving for gender reassignment surgery, which is estimated to cost $25,000. She describes her journey as challenging but ultimately rewarding and expresses gratitude for her support network. Leah criticized Mississippi's Religious Freedom Restoration Act, which allows people to voice religious objections to LGBT lifestyles without legal consequences, and feels this is unfair. South Panola High School did not respond to requests for comment regarding Leah's treatment.

article_content: During an event organized by the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) in New Delhi, Attorney General R. Venkataramani voiced concerns about the persistent view of legal aid as an inferior or charitable activity within the legal profession. He strongly rejected the attitude that supporting access to justice is a lesser form of charity and criticized lawyers who focus exclusively on corporate or government work. Venkataramani emphasized that participation in legal aid is a fundamental ethical and moral responsibility for lawyers. He acknowledged progress made under the Legal Services Authorities Act but highlighted the ongoing challenge of granting dignity and respect to legal service work. Addressing a gathering that included Chief Justice D Y Chandrachud, Justice Sanjay Kishan Kaul (NALSA executive chairman), Justice Sanjiv Khanna, and Law Minister Arjun Ram Meghwal, the Attorney General argued that true professional advancement is achieved by contributing to social justice. He encouraged lawyers to participate actively in legal aid, associating such involvement with significant recognition. He proposed the establishment of government oversight to monitor and report on legal aid efforts, advocating a shift from superficial political incentives to more substantial community engagement. The conference received support from organizations like the International Legal Foundation, UNDP, and UNICEF. Venkataramani also noted the reduction in government funding for legal services, which declined from Rs 140 crore in 2018-19 to Rs 100 crore in 2021, and expressed concern over its impact. He reiterated that barriers such as poverty and inequality continue to limit access to justice, emphasizing that real progress occurs only when everyone feels included in the justice system. He linked legal assistance to broad topics like equitable income distribution, poverty reduction, job creation, rural advancement, and education. Venkataramani advocated for legally empowering centers in rural and underserved urban communities to close justice gaps. He stressed the importance of experiential learning for law students, ensuring exposure to the real struggles faced by citizens. Ultimately, he asserted that investing in fair and accessible justice systems contributes directly to national happiness and well-being.
translated_content: Tokom događaja koji je u Nju Delhiju organizovala Nacionalna služba za pravnu pomoć (NALSA), državni tužilac R. Venkataramani izrazio je zabrinutost zbog toga što se pravna pomoć u pravničkoj profesiji i dalje posmatra kao manje vredna ili samo humanitarna aktivnost. Oštro je osudio stavove da je podrška pristupu pravdi samo vid milosrđa i kritikovao advokate koji se bave isključivo korporativnim ili državnim poslovima. Venkataramani je naglasio da je bavljenje pravnom pomoći osnovna etička i moralna obaveza advokata. Pomenuo je napredak postignut sprovođenjem Zakona o službama pravne pomoći, ali je istakao i da je i dalje izazov obezbediti dostojanstvo i poštovanje za ovaj rad. Obraćajući se prisutnima, među kojima su bili i predsednik Vrhovnog suda D Y Chandrachud, sudija Sanjay Kishan Kaul (izvršni predsednik NALSA), sudija Sanjiv Khanna i ministar pravde Arjun Ram Meghwal, tužilac je rekao da se istinska profesionalna dostignuća postižu doprinosom socijalnoj pravdi. Pozvao je advokate na aktivno učestvovanje u pravnoj pomoći i rekao da takav angažman donosi priznanja i ugled. Predložio je uvođenje državnog nadzora za praćenje i izveštavanje o pružanju pravne pomoći, naglašavajući potrebu da se pređe sa političkih podsticaja na suštinsko uključivanje zajednice. Konferencija je bila podržana od strane organizacija kao što su International Legal Foundation, UNDP i UNICEF. Venkataramani je istakao i pad državnog finansiranja za pravne službe, sa 140 crore rupija u 2018-19. na 100 crore u 2021. godini, i izrazio zabrinutost zbog posledica. Naglasio je da prepreke kao što su siromaštvo i nejednakost i dalje otežavaju pristup pravdi i da do istinskog napretka dolazi tek kada se svi građani osećaju uključeno u pravosudni sistem. Povezao je pravnu pomoć sa širim pitanjima kao što su pravična raspodela prihoda, smanjenje siromaštva, zapošljavanje, razvoj sela i obrazovanje, ističući važnost osnivanja centara za pravno osnaživanje u ruralnim i manje razvijenim urbanim područjima. Takođe je podvukao značaj da studenti prava imaju praktično iskustvo u radu sa stvarnim slučajevima građana. Zaključio je da ulaganje u pravičan i pristupačan pravosudni sistem utiče pozitivno na opštu sreću i dobrobit društva.

The United States has reiterated its support for India's emergence as a key global power and its vital role in promoting a peaceful, stable, and prosperous Indo-Pacific region. According to a US State Department fact sheet, the partnership between the US and India is among the most strategic and consequential of the 21st century. The 2+2 Ministerial Dialogue—held between the US Secretaries of State and Defense and their Indian counterparts—serves as the premier forum for advancing initiatives across the broad US-India partnership.

US Secretary of State Antony Blinken arrived in New Delhi on Friday to co-chair the 5th India-US 2+2 Ministerial Dialogue. Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Arindam Bagchi welcomed Blinken's visit, noting that it would further bolster the India-US Comprehensive Global Strategic Partnership. US Secretary of Defense Lloyd Austin had also arrived in New Delhi earlier for the two-day event.

US State Department Principal Deputy Spokesperson Vedant Patel highlighted that the dialogue will deepen security cooperation and that counter-terrorism is also on the agenda. The dialogue provides a platform for in-depth discussions on key bilateral and global issues—particularly those affecting the Indo-Pacific—between US Secretaries Blinken and Austin and their counterparts, Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar and Defense Minister Rajnath Singh.

The 2+2 Ministerial Dialogue, held annually since 2018, underscores coordination on common issues of concern between the two countries at the highest levels of foreign and defense ministries.

In related economic news: Indian Public Sector Banks (PSBs) have assured the government that small unsecured loans are not posing systemic risks. India is considering allowing surpluses in Special Rupee Vostro Accounts (SRVAs) to be invested in corporate bonds to further international trade settlement in rupees. Separately, the Burman family, major shareholders of Religare Enterprises Ltd, have requested regulators to investigate share trades by the company's chairperson.

article_content: Canada faces a severe housing affordability crisis that arguably surpasses the situation in the United States. Since 2011, the average Canadian home price has more than doubled, mainly because demand is far greater than available supply. Analysts say municipal policies often favor homeowners, restricting new housing construction and inflating prices. Increasing investment activity and a surge in immigration have only heightened the competition for homes. While the U.S. experiences similar issues, many experts believe the problem is even worse in Canada. The Bank of Canada recently raised its key interest rate to 5%, the highest in 22 years, which was meant to address inflation but has made mortgages more expensive. Canadian mortgages typically require refinancing every five years, unlike U.S. loans which are often fixed for 30 years, leaving Canadians more vulnerable to rising rates. Now, Canada holds the highest household debt-to-GDP ratio in the G7, with mortgage debt accounting for three-quarters of it. With housing becoming increasingly unaffordable, public frustration is sometimes directed towards higher levels of immigration, and polling shows an uptick in anti-immigration attitudes. However, experts stress that the housing crisis existed long before the recent rise in immigration. Despite lower home sales in recent months and more stable prices, economists do not expect a market crash like the U.S. experienced in 2008. Strict regulation and the dominance of a few major banks in Canada's financial sector are believed to prevent risky lending practices. Recent surveys indicate that around 70% of Canadians would be happy if home prices dropped, despite most owning their homes and potentially losing equity. There is still debate among analysts about whether Canada is currently in a housing bubble. The federal government has implemented measures like limiting foreign buyers, taxing property flippers, and penalizing owners of vacant homes. Though these steps have reduced demand, most experts agree that such efforts haven't had a significant impact on prices. Many believe that restoring real affordability will require long-term, gradual change.
translated_content: Kanada se suočava sa ozbiljnom krizom pristupačnosti stanovanja, za koju se smatra da je čak teža nego u Sjedinjenim Državama. Od 2011. godine prosečna cena kuće u Kanadi se više nego udvostručila, uglavnom zato što potražnja znatno premašuje ponudu. Analitičari navode da gradske politike često favorizuju vlasnike nekretnina, ograničavajući izgradnju novih stanova i podižući cene. Ulagači i porast imigracije dodatno su pojačali pritisak na tržište nekretnina. Iako slični problemi postoje i u SAD-u, mnogi stručnjaci veruju da je situacija u Kanadi još ozbiljnija. Banka Kanade je nedavno povećala ključnu kamatnu stopu na 5%, što je najviši nivo u poslednje 22 godine. Ova odluka je imala za cilj kontrolu inflacije, ali je istovremeno poskupela hipotekarne kredite. Za razliku od američkih hipoteka koje su fiksirane na 30 godina, kanadski krediti se uglavnom refinansiraju na svakih pet godina, što Kanadjanima otežava izbegavanje rasta kamata. Kanada sada ima najviši odnos duga domaćinstava prema BDP-u u G7, a hipoteke čine čak tri četvrtine tog duga. Pošto je stanovanje sve manje dostupno, deo građana frustracije usmerava na povećanje imigracije, a istraživanja pokazuju sve izraženiji negativan stav prema migrantima. Ipak, stručnjaci naglašavaju da je kriza na tržištu stanova počela pre porasta broja doseljenika. Iako je prodaja nekretnina opala poslednjih meseci a cene su stabilnije, ekonomisti ne očekuju krah poput onog u SAD-u 2008. godine. Stroga regulativa i dominacija nekoliko velikih banaka na kanadskom tržištu nekretnina smatraju se zaštitom od rizičnih kredita. Ankete pokazuju da bi čak 70% Kanadjana bilo zadovoljno padom cena nekretnina, iako većina poseduje svoj dom i time rizikuje smanjenje vrednosti imovine. Analitičari se još uvek ne slažu oko pitanja da li u Kanadi postoji balon na tržištu stanova. Vlada Kanade je donela mere kao što su ograničenja za strane kupce, oporezivanje preprodaje nekretnina i naplaćivanje poreza na prazne stanove. Iako su te mere delimično smanjile potražnju, većina stručnjaka smatra da nisu dovoljno uticale na cene. Smatra se da će povratak priuštivosti zahtevati dugoročne, postepene promene.
