According to Dawn, Kermani said the event was held to celebrate the birthday of King Charles III, with a guest list that included artists, politicians, parliamentarians, bureaucrats, and other officials. Kermani recounted that she chanted 'Ceasefire Now' when guests were making speeches and congratulating Britain. Security personnel then approached her and tried to remove her from the venue. 'That's when I asked them not to touch me—I'd see myself out,' Kermani said regarding the incident. She expressed disappointment that none of the other guests supported her as she left. A spokesperson for the British Deputy High Commission said Kermani was shouting during an important speech about climate change being given by the Deputy High Commissioner. The spokesperson clarified that security personnel intervened to stop the disruption, but that Kermani left on her own. 'So it would not be correct to say that we threw her out,' they added. The National Economic Council (NEC) has unveiled plans to direct at least $1.52 billion in donor funding toward the creation of 36 Special Agro-Industrial Processing Zones (SAPZs) across Nigeria. The initiative targets the creation of over 18.1 million jobs and will support about 100,000 farmers across the country.

The program's first phase is ongoing in Kano, Kaduna, Kwara, Ogun, Oyo, Imo, Cross River states, and the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), with an investment exceeding $520 million and projected completion by 2028. An additional 26 states have expressed interest in joining the second phase, which will be backed by another $1 billion from the African Development Bank (AfDB), Islamic Development Bank, and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD). Documentation for this second phase is expected to begin in early 2024.

Abubakar Kyari, Minister of Agriculture and Food Security, outlined these developments after the 137th NEC meeting chaired by Vice-President Kashim Shettima in Abuja. Kyari stated that the funding was originally pledged during the Norman Borlaug International Dialogue, World Food Prize 2023, in Iowa, USA.

The SAPZs aim to attract private investment, enhance agricultural processing, reduce post-harvest losses—especially tomato waste in Kano—and promote both food security and employment. Kyari estimates over 3,000 construction jobs per zone and up to 500,000 operational jobs per participating state. Approximately 100,000 farmers will also benefit.

The council recognized Ogun State’s key role, despite earlier delays in signing project agreements, and noted the renewed commitment from the state government.

To speed implementation, the NEC authorized prompt processing of documents and performance allowance waivers for project staff, addressing potential project risks.

The council urged all state governments to join the initiative, emphasizing its significant benefits for Nigeria's agricultural sector, job creation, and economic growth.

Kjari procenjuje da će tokom izgradnje biti otvoreno više od 3.000 radnih mesta po zoni, a do 500.000 radnih mesta u svakoj uključujućoj državi nakon završetka projekta. Savet je pozvao sve državne vlade da se priključe inicijativi, ističući njene velike koristi za poljoprivredni sektor Nigerije, zapošljavanje i ekonomski rast.

Animal educator Phil Rakoci, known as 'Wildman Phil,' was the victim of a theft this week when his SUV packed with twenty exotic animals was stolen outside a Walmart in Denver. Rakoci had left the vehicle running to keep the animals warm, relying on a remote lock for their security. Unfortunately, the remote failed, allowing thieves to drive off with the car and its unusual cargo.

Rakoci, who uses these animals to educate children about wildlife, expressed deep concern over their welfare. 'They're not just props; they're live animals. They know me. I know them,' he told 9News. 'I don't care about the car or my belongings. I just want the animals back and for them to survive this.'

Among the stolen animals were a three-legged, 50-pound African tortoise named Stumpy—a particular favorite of Rakoci's—along with a 13-foot Burmese python, a rattlesnake, five non-venomous snakes, three scorpions, five lizards, two turtles, one gecko, and one tarantula. The animals are usually transported in sturdy gray tubs.

Stumpy the tortoise has a special story. Abandoned on Rakoci's doorstep seven years ago, he was missing part of one front leg and had lost the other. Rakoci named him Stumpy and equipped his shell with wheels so he could get around. Over the years, Stumpy has become the star of Rakoci's educational presentations and has gained more than 1,000 Facebook fans. 'He's pretty friendly for a tortoise,' Rakoci said. 'He loves people.'

Englewood police are urgently searching for the missing animals and the vehicle, described as a dark blue Suburban SUV with an Arizona license plate reading 'TEDDIJO.' However, authorities have yet to find any leads. Rakoci continues to hope for the safe return of his animal companions.

New information has surfaced regarding an alarming incident involving an off-duty Alaska Airlines pilot, Joseph David Emerson, accused of attempting to disable an aircraft’s engines mid-flight. Emerson, scheduled to fly another plane later that day, had reportedly not slept for 40 hours and had discussed using psychedelic mushrooms, as stated in a criminal complaint.

According to Alaska Airlines, Emerson was seated in the cockpit’s jump seat and engaged in casual conversation with the pilots before allegedly trying to pull two red fire handles that would have activated the plane’s emergency fire suppression system, cutting off fuel to the engines. Prosecutors say that after Emerson stated, “I’m not OK,” he tried to pull the handles but was prevented from fully activating them thanks to the pilots’ quick actions. The ordeal, from Emerson’s statement to him being removed from the cockpit, lasted about 90 seconds.

The fire suppression system, featuring T-handle valves for each engine, is designed to shut off fuel if fully deployed. Alaska Airlines credited the flight crew’s rapid response with preventing loss of engine power. The flight, en route from Everett, Washington, to San Francisco, was diverted safely to Portland, Oregon.

Flight attendants restrained Emerson and seated him at the back of the plane. Emerson reportedly told a flight attendant, “you need to cuff me right now or it’s going to be bad.” He also allegedly attempted to grab an emergency exit handle during descent but was stopped by crew. Authorities took Emerson into custody upon landing in Portland. He faces charges including 83 counts of attempted murder. In court, his attorney entered a not guilty plea, and Emerson awaits a release hearing this week. Alaska Airlines confirmed he has been removed from service indefinitely, pending investigation.

Emerson told officers he thought he was having a nervous breakdown and believed he was dreaming when he tried to pull the emergency handles, according to the complaint. He said he had used psychedelic mushrooms 48 hours prior, struggled with depression for six years, and was affected by a recent friend’s death. The FBI is investigating whether the incident was a result of psychedelic use, a mental health crisis, or another cause. Alaska Airlines stated no impairment was detected by staff prior to boarding, and all crew are trained to identify such signs. There were 80 passengers and four crew members onboard.

Passenger accounts described hearing about an emergency from flight attendants, who later told passengers that someone suffered a mental breakdown. Alaska Airlines provided background on Emerson’s career, noting he joined the company in 2001, left for Virgin America in 2012, and returned in 2016 after Alaska acquired Virgin America. Emerson was promoted to Captain in 2019. Throughout his career, he completed FAA medical certifications without suspension or denial. Law enforcement and the FAA continue to investigate and affirm there is no ongoing threat as a result of this event.

Emerson, koji je tog dana trebalo da leti drugim avionom, navodno nije spavao 40 sati i govorio je o upotrebi psihodeličnih pečuraka, navodi se u krivičnoj prijavi.

Prema Alaska Airlines-u, Emerson je sedeo na pomoćnom sedištu u pilotskoj kabini i vodio neobavezan razgovor sa pilotima pre nego što je, navodno, pokušao da povuče dve crvene ručice protivpožarnog sistema, što bi aktiviralo hitno gašenje motora i presecanje dovoda goriva. Tužioci navode da je, nakon što je Emerson rekao „Nisam dobro“, pokušao da povuče ručice, ali su ga piloti brzom reakcijom sprečili da ih potpuno aktivira. Incident, od Emersonove izjave do njegovog udaljavanja iz kabine, trajao je oko 90 sekundi.

Protivpožarni sistem sa T-ručkama za svaki motor služi za blokadu goriva kada se potpuno aktivira. Alaska Airlines je pohvalio brzo reagovanje posade, čime je sprečen gubitak snage motora. Let na relaciji Everett, Vašington – San Francisko preusmeren je bezbedno na Portland, Oregon.

Stjuardese su Emersona vezale i smestile ga u zadnji deo aviona. Emerson je navodno rekao jednoj stjuardesi: „Morate me vezati odmah ili će biti loše.“ Takođe je pokušao da tokom spuštanja uhvati ručku izlaza u nuždi, ali ga je posada sprečila. Vlasti su ga privele odmah po sletanju u Portland. Suočen je sa 83 optužbe za pokušaj ubistva. Na sudu, njegov advokat je izjavio da nije kriv, a Emerson čeka saslušanje za puštanje na slobodu. Alaska Airlines je potvrdio da je udaljen sa dužnosti dok traje istraga.

Emerson je policiji rekao da je mislio da ima nervni slom i verovao da sanja kada je pokušao da aktivira ručice, prema prijavi. Naveo je i da je koristio psihodelične pečurke 48 sati ranije, da se šest godina bori sa depresijom i da ga je pogodila smrt bliskog prijatelja. FBI istražuje da li je incident posledica uticaja psihodelika, mentalne krize ili nečeg drugog. Alaska Airlines je istakao da osoblje nije primetilo znake ugroženosti pre poletanja i da su svi članovi posade obučeni za prepoznavanje takvih simptoma. U avionu je bilo 80 putnika i četiri člana posade.

Putnici su rekli da su o vanrednoj situaciji saznali preko stjuardesa, koje su kasnije navele da je jedna osoba imala nervni slom. Alaska Airlines je izneo podatke o Emersonovoj karijeri: kompaniji se pridružio 2001, 2012. prešao je u Virgin America, a vratio se 2016. kada je Alaska preuzela Virgin America; kapetan je postao 2019. Tokom karijere redovno je obnavljao FAA medicinske sertifikate koji mu nikada nisu bili uskraćeni ili oduzeti. Policija i FAA nastavljaju istragu i ističu da nakon ovog događaja nema dalje pretnje.

article_content: Noice is an innovative streaming platform that enters its beta phase today. Developed by experienced industry professionals and led by CEO Jussi Laakkonen—formerly Executive Vice President at Unity Technologies—Noice introduces a unique prediction metagame allowing viewers to actively participate in streams. When a streamer plays a supported title, such as Fortnite or Apex Legends (both available in the beta), viewers can use collectible cards to predict upcoming events. For instance, in Fortnite, a card might predict 'the next kill will be with a shotgun' or 'the next material collected is wood.' Points are awarded for correct predictions, and top scorers are featured on an in-stream leaderboard at the end of each match. Streamers have the option to create custom 'creator cards,' often featuring clips from previous streams and corresponding predictions, providing an alternative revenue stream beyond subscriptions. These cards can be acquired using Noice’s platform currency, which is purchased with real money. Standard cards are unlocked via loot boxes, also bought with the Noice currency. While microtransactions exist, the platform’s currency appears to be readily available, with additional opportunities to earn it through watching ads. Importantly, ads are not automatically shown during streams; they are optional and solely provide extra currency if viewers choose to watch. Participation in the prediction game is not mandatory—viewers can simply watch and enjoy the stream. Currently, streamers must be invited to join the open beta, but broader sign-ups are planned. Streamers receive 70% of all revenue from subscriptions and card sales. Viewers also create customizable avatars that can emote during live streams. Between games, a lobby screen displays all participants’ avatars, giving users a chance to showcase their characters. Although the initial focus is on individual streamers, Noice sees potential for esports broadcasts and sponsor integrations—for example, allowing predictions on outcomes in professional tournaments with sponsor-provided prizes. Expansion into esports is planned but not included in the beta release. Ultimately, Noice’s success hinges on attracting prominent streamers. With competitors like Kick vying for an audience alongside Twitch, the streaming landscape is increasingly competitive. However, if Noice can broaden its technological compatibility and user base, it stands a solid chance of cementing its place in the market.
translated_content: Noice je inovativna platforma za striming koja danas ulazi u svoju beta fazu. Razvijena od strane iskusnih profesionalaca iz industrije i pod vođstvom generalnog direktora Jussija Laakkonena, bivšeg izvršnog potpredsednika Unity Technologies, Noice uvodi jedinstvenu metaihru predviđanja koja omogućava gledaocima aktivno učešće tokom strimova. Kada strimer igra podržanu igru, kao što su Fortnite ili Apex Legends (obe dostupne u beti), gledaoci mogu koristiti kolekcionarske karte kako bi predvideli buduće događaje. Na primer, u Fortnite-u, karta može predvideti 'sledeće ubistvo biće sačmarom' ili 'sledeći materijal koji sakupe je drvo'. Za tačne prognoze se dobijaju poeni, a najbolje plasirani su istaknuti na tabeli sa rezultatima tokom strima na kraju svake partije. Strimeri imaju mogućnost kreiranja sopstvenih 'kreatorskih karata', koje često prikazuju klipove sa prethodnih strimova i povezane prognoze, nudeći tako dodatni izvor prihoda osim pretplata. Ove karte se mogu nabaviti pomoću Noice valute, koja se kupuje pravim novcem. Standardne karte se otključavaju putem loot box-ova, koji se takođe kupuju Noice valutom. Iako mikrotransakcije postoje, čini se da je valuta na platformi lako dostupna, uz dodatne mogućnosti da se zaradi gledanjem reklama. Važno je napomenuti da reklame nisu automatski prikazane tokom strimova; one su opciona opcija samo ako gledaoci žele dodatnu valutu. Učešće u igri predviđanja nije obavezno—gledaoci mogu jednostavno da gledaju i uživaju u strimu. Trenutno je za strimere potreban poziv za učešće u otvorenoj beti, a kasnije se planira šire prijavljivanje. Strimeri dobijaju 70% svih prihoda od pretplata i prodaje karata. Gledaoci takođe mogu kreirati prilagodljive avatare koji mogu da koriste emote tokom strimova. Između partija, na ekranu lobija prikazuju se svi avatari učesnika, što korisnicima omogućuje da prikažu svoje likove. Iako je početni fokus na pojedinačnim strimerima, Noice vidi potencijal u esport prenosima i sponzorskim integracijama—na primer, omogućavanje predviđanja ishoda u profesionalnim turnirima gde nagrade obezbeđuju sponzori. Ekspanzija na polje esporta je u planu, ali nije deo beta verzije. Na kraju, uspeh Noice platforme zavisiće od pridobijanja poznatih strimera. Sa konkurentima poput Kick-a i Twitch-a, tržište striminga postaje sve konkurentnije. Ipak, ako Noice proširi svoju tehničku kompatibilnost i korisničku bazu, ima dobre šanse da se pozicionira na tržištu.

article_content: During his weekly address at St Peter's Square, Pope Francis delivered a sharp critique of today's 'culture of waste,' especially as it relates to food. He emphasized that discarding good food is comparable to taking it from the poor, urging society to reconsider its tendency toward consumerism and daily waste. The pope reflected on how previous generations, like our grandparents, were careful not to waste food, noting that modern consumer habits have dulled our appreciation of food's real worth. He called on people to stop wasting food, describing it as effectively robbing the hungry. Pope Francis' remarks are the latest in his ongoing appeals for heightened social responsibility among the world's estimated 1.2 billion Catholics. Since his inauguration in March, he has repeatedly championed the defense of the poor and called for the Church itself to embrace greater austerity, alongside advocating for global financial system reforms. Supporting his argument, the United Nations' food agency reports that about one third—1.3 billion tonnes—of all food produced for humans is lost or wasted every year. In industrialized nations, the majority of this waste comes from consumers, who often purchase more than they can consume. A new study, endorsed by the U.N. and published today, suggests that straightforward solutions like improved storage and offering more reasonable portion sizes can significantly curb food waste. In U.S. restaurants, customers discard around nine percent of their meals, partly due to a trend toward larger portion sizes. Pope Francis denounced the culture of waste as particularly troubling given ongoing global hunger—the UN estimates that 870 million individuals suffer from hunger, and around 2 billion lack adequate nutrition. The Argentinian pope also cautioned against placing excessive importance on money and material goods, pointing out that financial downturns are often seen as great tragedies, even as widespread human suffering is overlooked. He warned, 'In this way, people are discarded as if they were garbage.'
translated_content: Tokom svog nedeljnog obraćanja na Trgu Svetog Petra, papa Franja je oštro kritikovao savremenu 'kulturu bacanja', posebno kada je u pitanju hrana. Istakao je da je bacanje dobre hrane slično oduzimanju hrane od siromašnih i pozvao društvo da preispita sklonost ka konzumerizmu i svakodnevnom rasipanju. Papa je podsetio kako su prethodne generacije, poput naših baka i deka, bile pažljive da ne bacaju hranu, napominjući da su savremene potrošačke navike smanjile naše uvažavanje prave vrednosti hrane. Pozvao je ljude da prestanu da rasipaju hranu, opisujući to kao praktično oduzimanje od onih koji su gladni. Papa Franjine reči su najnoviji apel za veću društvenu odgovornost među oko 1,2 milijarde katolika širom sveta. Od svog izbora u martu, više puta je naglasio potrebu odbrane siromašnih i pozvao Crkvu na veću skromnost, kao i na reforme globalnog finansijskog sistema. U prilog svojoj poruci, agencija Ujedinjenih nacija za hranu navodi da se oko trećina, odnosno 1,3 milijarde tona hrane namenjene ljudima, svake godine izgubi ili baci. U industrijalizovanim zemljama, najveći deo tog otpada potiče od potrošača, koji često kupuju više nego što im je potrebno. Novo istraživanje podržano od strane UN-a, objavljeno danas, predlaže da bi jednostavne mere poput boljeg skladištenja i manjih porcija znatno smanjile količinu bačene hrane. U američkim restoranima, gosti bace oko devet procenata svojih obroka, delom zbog trenda uvećanja porcija. Papa Franja je osudio kulturu bacanja kao posebno problematičnu s obzirom na stalnu glad u svetu—UN navodi da 870 miliona ljudi gladuje, a oko 2 milijarde nemaju dovoljno nutrijenata. Argentinac je, takođe, upozorio na preteranu opsednutost novcem i materijalnim vrednostima, ukazujući da se finansijske krize često tretiraju kao veće tragedije nego ljudska patnja. Upozorio je: 'Na ovaj način, ljudi se odbacuju kao da su smeće.'

article_content: Shahab Reza, a resident of Perivale in London, has admitted to his part in a substantial benefits fraud scheme. He now faces a potentially long prison term. Prosecutors allege that, together with his wife Shehnaz and their children, Zainab and Abbas, the family deceitfully obtained approximately £900,000 designated for sign language interpreter services. Instead, the funds were reportedly diverted to finance luxury items including vacations, expensive property, jewelry, and higher education expenses. Over the course of four years, the Rezas are said to have submitted fraudulent invoices and utilized multiple companies under their control to facilitate the elaborate fraud against the Department of Work and Pensions (DWP). While Shahab Reza has acknowledged his involvement and leadership in the operation, Shehnaz and their children deny any conspiracy or wrongdoing. The court learned that Abbas, a qualified doctor, and Zainab, a university graduate, aided their parents by formalizing documents for the fraudulent companies, purportedly at their father's direction. Evidence described by prosecutors also suggests Shehnaz was involved in submitting suspicious expenses—such as travel and domestic bills—as business claims. Authorities assert that the family additionally misrepresented their finances to Harrow Council, profiting from nearly £100,000 in illicit benefits, and that Abbas unlawfully received a student bursary. When police searched the home, they recovered significant amounts of gold jewelry and a valuable diamond. Four associates—Saifur Rahman, Ahsan Naseer, Natela Babina, and Daiva Alisauskaite—are accused of participating in the DWP fraud as well. All accused parties, except for Shahab Reza, continue to deny the fraud charges. The trial remains underway at Southwark Crown Court in London and is expected to proceed for two months.

Tužioci navode da je, zajedno sa suprugom Šehnaz i njihovom decom, Zainab i Abbasom, porodica nezakonito pribavila oko 900.000 funti namenjenih za usluge tumača znakovnog jezika. Umesto toga, novac je navodno korišćen za finansiranje luksuznih stvari kao što su odmor, skupa nekretnina, nakit i troškovi visokog obrazovanja. Tokom četiri godine, Rezaovi su, prema optužbi, podnosili lažne fakture i koristili više firmi pod svojom kontrolom kako bi izveli složenu prevaru na štetu Ministarstva za rad i socijalnu zaštitu (DWP). Dok je Šahab Reza priznao umešanost i rukovođenje operacijom, Šehnaz i njihova deca negiraju bilo kakvu zaveru ili prevaru. Sud je čuo da su Abbas, kvalifikovani lekar, i Zainab, diplomirana studentkinja, pomagali roditeljima formalizujući dokumenta za lažne kompanije, navodno po zahtevu svog oca. Tužioci su izneli i dokaze da je Šehnaz bila uključena u prijavljivanje sumnjivih troškova, poput putovanja i računa za domaćinstvo, kao poslovnih izdataka. Vlasti tvrde da je porodica dodatno lažno prikazala svoje finansijsko stanje opštini Harrow, čime su ostvarili skoro 100.000 funti nedozvoljenih beneficija, a da je Abbas neosnovano dobio studentsku stipendiju. Tokom pretresa kuće, policija je pronašla značajne količine zlatnog nakita i vredan dijamant. Četiri prijatelja porodice—Saifur Rahman, Ahsan Naseer, Natela Babina i Daiva Alisauskaite—takođe su optuženi za učešće u prevari DWP-a. Svi okrivljeni, osim Šahaba Reze, i dalje negiraju prevaru. Suđenje u Sudu Kraljevskog okruga Southwark u Londonu je u toku i očekuje se da će trajati dva meseca.

article_content: Christine Drane, 53, from Scunthorpe, lost an impressive ten stone after struggling with obesity for years. Her weight had reached 24 stone (size 28) due to overeating and frequent snacking on treats and chocolate. Christine decided to make a change after her sofa broke under her weight following a long day. Determined to lose weight, Christine tried various diets, including juice cleanses and calorie counting, but found progress difficult. She rejected the option of gastric band surgery, choosing instead to lose weight through lifestyle changes. Her breakthrough came when she started following the 80/20 diet, which encourages healthy eating 80% of the time and permits treats for the remaining 20%. With guidance from weight loss expert Steve Miller, whom she saw on Sky's 'Fat Families,' Christine finally found a regime she could stick with. Christine has now reduced her weight to 14st and is on track to reach her goal of 11st. She enjoys wearing fitted dresses and has started wearing make-up again, boosted by the compliments she now receives. Christine credits her success to persistence and support from Steve.

Kristin je odlučila da se promeni nakon što joj se sofa slomila pod njenom težinom posle napornog dana. Odlučna da smrša, Kristin je probala razne dijete, uključujući sokove i brojanje kalorija, ali je napredak bio težak. Odbila je opciju ugradnje gastričnog stenta i odlučila da izgubi težinu promenom životnih navika. Prekretnica je nastupila kada je počela da sledi dijetu 80/20, koja podrazumeva zdravo jedenje 80% vremena, dok je uživanje u omiljenim poslasticama dozvoljeno u preostalih 20%. Uz pomoć stručnjaka za mršavljenje Stiva Milera, kog je gledala u emisiji 'Fat Families' na Skaj televiziji, Kristin je konačno pronašla režim koji može da prati. Kristin je sada smanjila težinu na 89 kg i na dobrom je putu da dostigne svoj cilj od 70 kg. Uživa u nošenju uskih haljina i ponovo koristi šminku, zahvaljujući komplimentima koje sada dobija. Kristin svoj uspeh pripisuje upornosti i podršci Stiva.

article_content: On the anniversary of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attack, Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized India's resilience, stating that the country not only overcame the tragic events but is also actively fighting terrorism with courage. In his Mann Ki Baat radio address, Modi paid tribute to those who lost their lives in the Mumbai attack and remembered the bravery of the martyrs. Modi remarked, "We can never forget November 26. On this day, the most heinous terrorist attack occurred in our country. Terrorists shook Mumbai and the entire nation. However, India demonstrated its strength by recovering from the attack and is now confronting terrorism with full courage." On November 26, 2008, ten Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorists from Pakistan arrived by sea and attacked Mumbai, resulting in the deaths of 166 people, including 18 security personnel, and causing numerous injuries over a 60-hour siege. The prime minister also highlighted that November 26 is significant as, in 1949, the Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution of India. He recalled celebrating the 125th birth anniversary of BR Ambedkar in 2015, which led to November 26 being declared Constitution Day, and conveyed his best wishes on the occasion. "By prioritizing the duties of citizens, we will certainly fulfill our resolve to make India a developed nation," Modi stated. He also mentioned that economic activity worth around Rs 4 lakh crore took place during recent festivals, with a notable increase in the purchase of made-in-India products. Additionally, Modi questioned the trend of families hosting weddings abroad and urged everyone to celebrate such occasions within the country.
translated_content: Povodom godišnjice terorističkog napada na Mumbaj 26/11, premijer Narenda Modi je istakao otpornost Indije, poručujući da je zemlja ne samo prevazišla tragične događaje, već se sada hrabro bori protiv terorizma. U svom obraćanju Mann Ki Baat, Modi je odao počast žrtvama napada na Mumbaj i prisetio se hrabrosti poginulih. Modi je rekao: „Nikada ne možemo zaboraviti 26. novembar. Tog dana dogodio se najstrašniji teroristički napad u našoj zemlji. Teroristi su uzdrmali Mumbaj i celu naciju. Ipak, Indija je pokazala svoju snagu time što se oporavila od napada i sada se s punom hrabrošću suprotstavlja terorizmu.“ Dana 26. novembra 2008. godine, deset terorista iz grupe Lashkar-e-Taiba iz Pakistana je morskim putem stiglo i napalo Mumbaj, pri čemu je ubijeno 166 osoba, uključujući 18 pripadnika bezbednosnih snaga, a mnogi su ranjeni tokom opsade koja je trajala 60 sati. Premijer je takođe istakao značaj 26. novembra kao dana kada je 1949. godine Ustavotvorna skupština usvojila Ustav Indije. Podsetio je na obeležavanje 125. godišnjice rođenja BR Ambedkara 2015, nakon čega je 26. novembar proglašen Danom ustava, te je uputio čestitke povodom tog dana. „Dajući prioritet dužnostima građana, sigurno ćemo ostvariti našu odluku da Indija postane razvijena država“, izjavio je Modi. On je takođe naveo da je tokom nedavnih festivala ostvarena ekonomska aktivnost od oko 4 lakh crore rupija, uz značajan porast kupovine proizvoda proizvedenih u Indiji. Dodatno, Modi je postavio pitanje trenda organizovanja svadbi u inostranstvu i pozvao sve da takva slavlja obeležavaju u zemlji.

article_content:
Oppenheimer surpassed Barbie in U.S. households during their respective premiere weekends on video-on-demand (VOD), according to data from Samba TV. Drawing from 3 million opted-in Smart TVs, Samba TV reports Oppenheimer was watched in 388,000 households during its VOD debut, while Barbie was viewed in 363,000 households during its own opening weekend in September.

Oppenheimer became available for digital purchase on November 21 for $19.99. Warner Bros.' Barbie arrived earlier on VOD on September 12, with a purchase price of $29.99 and a rental option at $24.99.

Samba TV highlighted strong Millennial engagement with Oppenheimer’s VOD release: the 25-34 age group over-indexed by 15% and the 35-44 group by 11%. During Oppenheimer’s first weekend, the 18-24 age group comprised the largest share at 32%, followed by 25-34 (28%), over 55 (14%), and 35-44 (13%).

When released in theaters, Christopher Nolan’s biographical drama grossed $82.4 million domestically and $180 million worldwide over opening weekend (July 21-23), coming in second to Barbie’s $162 million domestic and $356.3 million global gross. This was the first time in U.S. box office history that two films debuted to over $80 million each in the same weekend.

Barbie is currently the highest-grossing film of the year and Warner Bros.’ biggest release ever, reaching $1.44 billion worldwide. Oppenheimer is the third-highest-grossing film globally so far this year, earning $950.2 million. Both films are being strongly promoted for awards this season.

Samba TV’s viewership data is collected via proprietary content recognition technology from opt-in Smart TVs and reflects household-level viewing only. Figures do not cover viewing on non-TV devices or estimate the number of people watching together. The numbers are independently sourced from Samba TV, not supplied by Universal Pictures or Warner Bros.
translated_content:
Oppenheimer je nadmašio Barbie u američkim domaćinstvima tokom njihovih premijernih vikenda na video na zahtev (VOD), prema podacima kompanije Samba TV. Na osnovu 3 miliona pametnih televizora koji su pristali da dele podatke, Samba TV izveštava da je Oppenheimer gledan u 388.000 domaćinstava tokom svog premijernog VOD vikenda, dok je Barbie gledana u 363.000 domaćinstava tokom otvaranja u septembru.

Oppenheimer je postao dostupan za digitalnu kupovinu 21. novembra po ceni od 19,99 dolara. Barbie iz Warner Bros-a stigla je ranije na VOD, 12. septembra, sa cenom za kupovinu od 29,99 dolara i opcijom iznajmljivanja za 24,99 dolara.

Samba TV je naglasila snažno interesovanje milenijalaca za Oppenheimerovo VOD izdanje: starosna grupa 25–34 godine gledala je film za 15% više od proseka, a grupa 35–44 godine za 11% više. Tokom prvog vikenda, najbrojniju publiku Oppenheimera činili su mladi od 18 do 24 godine (32%), zatim 25–34 (28%), stariji od 55 (14%) i 35–44 godine (13%).

Na bioskopskom otvaranju, biografska drama Kristofersa Nolana zaradila je 82,4 miliona dolara u SAD i 180 miliona dolara globalno tokom prvog vikenda (21–23. jul), što je drugo mesto iza Barbie sa 162 miliona dolara u SAD i 356,3 miliona dolara globalno. Prvi put u istoriji američkog bioskopa, dva filma otvorila su sa više od 80 miliona dolara istog vikenda.

Barbie je trenutno najuspešniji film godine i najveći hit Warner Bros-a svih vremena sa 1,44 milijarde dolara širom sveta. Oppenheimer je treći najuspešniji film globalno do sada ove godine, sa zaradom od 950,2 miliona dolara. Oba filma intenzivno se promovišu tokom sezone nagrada.

Podaci Samba TV prikupljaju se pomoću vlasničke tehnologije za prepoznavanje sadržaja sa pametnih televizora koji su pristali na deljenje podataka i odnose se samo na gledanost domaćinstava. Brojevi ne uključuju gledanje na drugim uređajima niti procenjuju broj gledalaca po domaćinstvu. Ove podatke nezavisno je prikupila Samba TV, a ne Universal Pictures ili Warner Bros.

article_content: The White House has declined to comply with a congressional subpoena calling for David Simas, Director of the Office of Political Strategy & Outreach, to testify. Simas was summoned to address inquiries about whether his office’s activities violate the Hatch Act, a federal law restricting most executive branch employees from political involvement. White House Counsel W. Neil Eggleston responded that senior advisors to the president have legal immunity from such testimony due to constitutional separation of powers. Despite Simas’s absence, Oversight Committee Chairman Darrell Issa proceeded with the hearing, emphasizing Congress’s duty to supervise the proper use of taxpayer money. The White House insists Simas has not violated any statutes and referenced a Justice Department legal opinion affirming the immunity of presidential advisers from congressional subpoenas. Republican lawmakers have raised concerns about the White House’s political strategy office, which recently reopened and may, in their view, risk partisan or illegal activities. Though White House officials have provided briefings and answered committee staff’s questions, Issa has demanded Simas’s direct testimony, which remains pending. Democratic committee members, led by Rep. Elijah Cummings, argue that the Republican inquiry is unwarranted given the absence of evidence indicating wrongdoing. Cummings criticized Issa for overusing subpoenas, suggesting that the ongoing investigation serves political motives more than legitimate oversight. Meanwhile, White House Press Secretary Josh Earnest reproached Issa’s aggressive approach. Disagreement within the committee highlighted growing partisan friction, with both sides claiming the other is weakening the oversight process. The next steps for the investigation remain uncertain as the standoff continues.

Syrian President Bashar al-Assad delivered a 100-minute address on January 10, 2012, vowing to respond forcefully to 'terrorists' and blaming both foreign and Arab actors for attempts to destabilize Syria. Amid ongoing unrest and accusations that Syrian security forces killed 10 people during mass protests, Assad criticized the Arab League's mediation, dismissing their efforts as ineffective and historically unsuccessful.

In his first public speech since June, Assad offered only vague promises of reform and indicated no intention to relinquish power, insisting he would step down only if the people demanded it. He emphasized restoring security through strong measures and declared there would be no leniency for 'those who work with outsiders against the country.'

Assad's remarks came as Turkey, once a close ally, warned of the risk of civil war, and Israel prepared for potential regime collapse and a refugee influx. While Assad stated any transition of leadership would depend on the people's will, his comments raised concerns about a forthcoming intensified military crackdown.

Opposition leaders, including Burhan Ghalioun of the Syrian National Council, condemned the speech as dangerous and out of touch with reality, arguing that Assad's focus on fighting 'terrorists' would hinder political solutions. Activists claimed Syrian forces had recently killed protestors in Deir el-Zour despite the presence of Arab League observers, who were monitoring compliance with a regional peace plan.

The United Nations estimates that 5,000 civilians have died since the uprising began in March 2011, while Syrian authorities report about 2,000 security personnel have been killed, blaming violence on armed groups and defecting soldiers. Ongoing protests have been met with a heavy response from government forces, and critics claim the Arab League's monitoring mission has failed to halt the bloodshed.

Regional anxieties about the conflict's consequences are increasing. Turkish Prime Minister Tayyip Erdogan warned of the risk of religious and sectarian war, while Israel's military chief, Lieutenant-General Benny Gantz, said Israel was preparing for possible refugee inflows and security threats if Assad's regime were to fall.

Twenty-four prominent US law firms have collectively urged law school deans to address the growing problem of antisemitism on college campuses. In their open letter, the firms stated that future recruitment would focus on graduates committed to fostering inclusive communities that reject discrimination and harassment. The message follows a series of reported instances of antisemitic harassment, vandalism, and violence at universities, events described by the firms as deeply concerning.

The letter includes signatures from six of the ten largest US law firms by revenue: Kirkland & Ellis, Latham & Watkins, Skadden, Sidley Austin, Morgan, Lewis & Bockius, and Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher. The document specifically points to campus protests advocating violence against Jews and calls for the eradication of Israel, highlighting the safety risks posed by such rhetoric and actions.

This intervention comes in the wake of heightened tensions triggered by the October 7 attacks by Hamas in Israel and subsequent conflict in Gaza. The Anti-Defamation League has reported a nearly 400% increase in antisemitic incidents in the US since then. The White House has also voiced alarm about the rise in such incidents, particularly within educational institutions.

Additionally, a recent incident at Cornell University saw student Patrick Dai arrested after he made online threats against Jewish students. Jewish student groups are now preparing to sue top universities like Cornell and Harvard for allegedly inadequate responses to antisemitic incidents.

The letter goes beyond antisemitism, condemning Islamophobia, racism, and all forms of bigotry. The law firms urge educators to prepare students for civil discourse on contentious issues and express readiness to collaborate with university leadership on solutions. In response, Columbia University and the University of Pennsylvania have launched new task forces dedicated to addressing campus antisemitism.

article_content: Pakistani actress Veena Malik has found herself at the center of controversy after nude photographs of her appeared in the December issue of FHM India. Malik has accused the magazine of digitally altering the images and insists she never agreed to pose nude. FHM, however, maintains that the photo shoot was consensual and that the images were not manipulated. A key image fueling the scandal shows Malik with the letters 'ISI'—the acronym for Pakistan’s Inter-Services Intelligence agency—painted on her upper left arm. Malik says FHM editor Kabeer Sharma suggested she add the ISI tattoo to help her image. Legal proceedings are now being initiated. Malik’s lawyer, Ayaz Bilawala, told CNN she is seeking $1.9 million in damages from FHM, claiming the magazine breached an agreement and altered the photos. He asserts Malik was supposed to approve the images before they were published, a stipulation FHM allegedly ignored. Although Bilawala acknowledged the ISI acronym in the photos, he explained it's used globally by many groups. He declined to comment on an image of Malik holding a grenade. FHM, on the other hand, strongly denies the accusations, and editor Sharma said they are considering counter-legal action against Malik for what they call false claims. The case has ignited passionate debate in Pakistan. Malik remains defiant, stressing that if she had consented to a nude shoot, she would openly admit it. Instead, she says she is shocked and deeply hurt by the incident. This isn't Malik’s first brush with controversy. She previously accused her former boyfriend, Pakistani cricketer Mohammad Asif, of involvement in match fixing—a charge for which he was later convicted. Malik has also faced criticism from Pakistani religious leaders for her actions on the Indian reality TV show 'Big Boss.' Malik, however, maintains that many fans stand by her and says criticism from home does not overly trouble her. 'I’m not perfect,' she says, 'but I haven’t committed a crime.' Reporting by Harmeet Shah Singh in New Delhi and Shaan Khan in Islamabad.

article_content: Ed Miliband’s position as Labour leader remains secure for now, as none of his possible rivals have announced plans to challenge him. Many Members of Parliament support Alan Johnson, a popular former Home Secretary, believing he has greater appeal to voters than Miliband. However, Johnson has almost entirely ruled himself out, stating last month that he has 'no appetite for being on the frontbench.' With Johnson not entering the contest, attention turns to shadow Home Secretary Yvette Cooper and shadow Health Secretary Andy Burnham as the leading contenders if Miliband were to step down. Burnham has gained increased support, especially after a well-received speech on the NHS during Labour’s September conference, contrasting Miliband’s less successful address. Bookmakers have improved Burnham’s odds to 4/1, while Cooper remains the overall favorite at 7/2. Union leader Len McCluskey has also publicly praised Burnham. Cooper, backed by her husband, Shadow Chancellor Ed Balls, remains favored if a leadership change occurs. Johnson currently holds odds of 12/1, while younger frontbenchers like Chuka Umunna (8/1), Rachel Reeves, and Tristram Hunt (both 16/1) are considered outside possibilities. David Miliband, once a popular choice, is no longer eligible after stepping down as an MP and moving to the United States. Labour Party rules make replacing the leader difficult before the next general election. A leadership challenge requires a vote of no-confidence at the annual party conference, which has not occurred and is not expected before the upcoming election. Discontented MPs' only recourse is to hope Miliband voluntarily steps down. For a new candidate to run, they must secure nominations from 15% of Labour MPs (currently 39 of 257). The process now operates on a 'one member, one vote' system, including MPs, MEPs, party members, and affiliated union members.

Bernam je stekao dodatnu podršku, naročito nakon dobrog govora o državnoj zdravstvenoj službi na Laburističkoj konferenciji u septembru, za razliku od manje uspešnog Milibandovog izlaganja. article_content: For the first time, residents of Shergaon in the Abu-Pindwara Assembly constituency will be able to vote in their own village, according to Chief Electoral Officer Praveen Gupta. To make voting more accessible and inclusive, the Election Commission has set up polling stations in remote, rugged, and sparsely populated regions of Rajasthan. Shergaon, located at 4,921 feet in Sirohi district, now has a polling station serving its 117 eligible voters, saving them from having to travel to the remote village of Utraj as they did before. Gupta noted that to reach Shergaon, polling staff must trek about 18 kilometers through dense forest with help from forest guards. Other small and isolated villages are also gaining polling centers: Barmer Ka Paar near the international border for 35 voters, Manjholi in Barmer district for 49 voters, Kantal Ka Paar for 50 voters, and Mainau in Jaisalmer for 50 voters. At Mainau, voting will take place in a tent set up for the day. In addition, Baseri Assembly constituency in Dholpur district will have its first polling station at Kali Teer for 682 voters, eliminating the need for them to travel 7.5 km to vote. Elections for all 200 assembly seats in Rajasthan will be held on November 25, with vote counting on December 3.

Izbori za svih 200 poslaničkih mesta u Radžastanu biće održani 25. novembra, dok je brojanje glasova planirano za 3. decembar.

Recent research demonstrates that humans can perceive three-dimensional images using just one eye, potentially paving the way for more affordable and accessible 3-D technology. Dhanraj Vishwanath, a psychologist at the University of St. Andrews in Scotland, published findings in the journal Psychological Science showing that simply looking through a small hole enables individuals to experience 3-D depth without both eyes.

Current 3-D technology in movies and media typically relies on presenting separate images to each eye, which the brain then combines to create the perception of depth. However, Vishwanath's research shows that viewing a regular picture with one eye through a small aperture produces a 3-D effect on par with traditional stereoscopic experiences. This phenomenon has been recognized before but is often overlooked. The new study confirms that monocular aperture viewing can replicate the depth sensation of standard 3-D methods.

While 3-D technology is increasingly used in movies, gaming, TV, and other media, it frequently causes headaches, dizziness, or nausea in about 10% of viewers. Many experts believe that cumbersome 3-D glasses are a significant barrier to wider adoption, especially for television users.

The method studied by the St. Andrews team could allow people with sight in only one eye, or those who find standard 3-D difficult, to enjoy the immersive effect. Vishwanath points out that many such people have never experienced true 3-D vision, and these findings offer new opportunities.

The research also suggests that future 3-D imaging could rely on much higher image resolution instead of stereoscopic glasses, potentially reducing eye fatigue and other side effects. The St. Andrews researchers are conducting further studies with larger participant groups and plan to share more results on 3-D vision later this year.

Dhanraj Višvanat, psiholog sa Univerziteta Sent Endruz u Škotskoj, objavio je u časopisu Psychological Science nalaze da jednostavno gledanje kroz malu rupicu omogućava ljudima da dožive dubinu slike u 3D-u bez potrebe za oba oka.

Trenutna 3D tehnologija u filmovima i medijima obično se zasniva na prikazivanju različitih slika svakom oku, koje mozak kombinuje kako bi stvorio osećaj dubine. Međutim, Višvanatovo istraživanje pokazuje da gledanje obične slike jednim okom kroz malu rupicu može izazvati 3D efekat sličan tradicionalnom stereoskopskom iskustvu. Ovaj fenomen je ranije bio poznat, ali je često zanemarivan. Nova studija potvrđuje da monokularno posmatranje kroz mali otvor može da replicira osećaj dubine kao kod standardnih 3D metoda.

Iako se 3D tehnologija sve više koristi u filmovima, igrama, televiziji i drugim medijima, često izaziva glavobolje, vrtoglavicu ili mučninu kod oko 10% gledalaca. Mnogi stručnjaci smatraju da su glomazne 3D naočare glavna prepreka široj upotrebi, naročito među TV korisnicima.

Metod koji je proučavao tim sa Sent Endruza mogao bi omogućiti ljudima koji vide samo jednim okom ili onima kojima standardni 3D nije pristupačan da uživaju u ovakvim efektima. Višvanat naglašava da mnogi od tih ljudi nikada nisu doživeli pravi 3D efekat i da ova saznanja nude nove mogućnosti.

Istraživanje takođe sugeriše da bi se u budućnosti 3D prikazi mogli zasnivati na znatno višoj rezoluciji slike umesto na stereoskopskim naočarima, što bi potencijalno smanjilo zamor očiju i druge nuspojave. Istraživači iz Sent Endruza trenutno sprovode dodatna testiranja sa većom grupom učesnika i planiraju da tokom godine objave još rezultata o 3D viziji.

article_content: New Zealand maintained a solid grip on the second Test against Pakistan in Dubai, thanks to timely wickets taken by their pace bowlers. Despite Pakistan’s attempts to recover—which included a century partnership and two fifty-run stands—New Zealand's bowlers repeatedly seized back control. At the end of the third day, Pakistan was still 122 runs behind, having reached 281 for six wickets in their first innings. Azhar Ali and Younis Khan began strongly, putting together a 113-run partnership that lifted Pakistan from their overnight 34 for two. Younis Khan made 72 before being caught at cover by Mark Craig off James Neesham's bowling. Misbah-ul-Haq then joined Azhar for another important 50-run partnership, but the arrival of the second new ball after tea changed the momentum. Trent Boult, who had been bowling a series of in-swingers, managed to find Misbah's outside edge, dismissing him for 28. Azhar’s patient knock of 75, lasting over five hours, ended when leg-spinner Ish Sodhi trapped him leg-before-wicket. Pakistan mounted another resistance through a 57-run partnership between Asad Shafiq and Sarfraz Ahmed. However, Tim Southee’s return just before stumps produced the breakthrough, as Shafiq edged to slip for 46, just short of his half-century. Boult finished the day with figures of 1-46, including eight maidens, with his wicket seen as crucial.

Caste and reservation issues have once again taken center stage in India. Articles 15 and 16 of the Constitution enable reservations for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and socially and educationally backward classes, with reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) introduced in 2019. As long as the reservation system exists, it is logical to count caste to ensure accurate data. Amid growing demands for reservation, the ideal of a casteless society is being overshadowed.

BJP leader and Maharashtra’s Deputy Chief Minister, Devendra Fadnavis, recently remarked, “I cannot change my caste,” addressing his difficult position during the Maratha reservation agitation. While the statement is straightforward, it raises questions about why Mr. Fadnavis’s caste is a focal issue. For many of India’s past leaders, like Mahatma Gandhi, Jawaharlal Nehru, Vallabhbhai Patel, Subhas Chandra Bose, and Rajendra Prasad, caste was not central to their identity or public life. They were widely respected for their humanity, and attempts to associate them with caste would have been inappropriate.

In India, nearly everyone is born into a caste, except children of inter-caste or inter-faith couples. Encouragingly, many educated young people, especially in urban areas, are beginning to move beyond caste identity. Inter-caste marriages are more common than generally perceived, signaling progress toward a more secular and egalitarian society.

Yet, caste remains deeply ingrained in the Indian psyche, largely due to the absence of alternative, inclusive social structures. Institutions that defend rights, support people in need, and guarantee equality before the law are rare. Without such options, marginalized and oppressed groups often turn to their caste for support. Gandhi attempted to establish community organizations, but many have lost strength and independence over time, as seen with the Sabarmati Ashram in Gujarat.

Political parties, as major voluntary organizations, are also influenced by caste identities brought in by their members. Leaders often find themselves associated with their caste, which is the dilemma facing Mr. Fadnavis. Even leaders who do not identify with caste are entangled in ongoing debates.

To weaken caste’s influence, individuals can take steps such as dropping caste surnames, avoiding caste-specific organizations, fostering inter-caste relationships and marriages, and treating everyone equally at home and the workplace. While these steps may seem simplistic, they are essential first moves. As Ambedkar highlighted in his unfinished lecture, 'Annihilation of Caste,' fully eliminating caste is not easy, but its impact can be reduced through sustained effort by ordinary citizens and leaders alike. Striving for an idealistic, casteless India, though challenging, remains a worthy goal.

Pitanja kaste i rezervacija ponovo su u centru pažnje u Indiji. Članci 15. i 16. Ustava omogućavaju rezervacije za članove nižih kasti, plemena i društveno i obrazovno zaostale grupe, dok je rezervacija za ekonomski slabije slojeve (EWS) uvedena 2019. godine. Dokle god postoji sistem rezervacija, logično je brojati kaste kako bi se obezbedili tačni podaci. U jeku sve glasnijih zahteva za rezervacijama, ideal društva bez kasti potiskuje se u drugi plan.

Lider BJP-a i zamenik glavnog ministra Maharaštre, Devendra Fadnavis, nedavno je izjavio: „Ne mogu da promenim svoju kastu“, govoreći o svojoj nezavidnoj situaciji tokom protesta za rezervacije za zajednicu Maratha. Iako je izjava jasna, postavlja se pitanje zašto je njegova kasta uopšte predmet rasprave. Za mnoge velike lidere iz prošlosti Indije, poput Mahatme Gandija, Džavaharlala Nehrua, Valabaj Patel-a, Subhaš Čandra Bose-a i Radžendre Prasada, kasta nije bila centralna za njihov identitet ili javni život. Bili su široko poštovani zbog svog čovečanstva, a pokušaji da ih se poveže s kastom bili bi neprimereni.

U Indiji se gotovo svi rađaju u nekoj kasti, osim dece izmešanih brakova ili različitih veroispovesti. Ohrabrujuće je da sve više obrazovanih mladih ljudi, posebno u gradovima, napušta kasti kao deo identiteta. Brakovi između različitih kasti češći su nego što se misli, što pokazuje napredak ka sekularnijem i ravnopravnijem društvu.

Ipak, kasta je duboko ukorenjena u indijskoj svesti, prvenstveno zbog nedostatka alternativnih, sveobuhvatnih društvenih struktura. Institucije koje brane prava, pomažu ljudima u nevolji i garantuju jednakost pred zakonom su retke. Zbog toga se marginalizovane i potlačene grupe često oslanjaju na svoju kastu kao podršku. Gandi je pokušao da osnuje zajedničke organizacije, ali su mnoge s vremenom izgubile snagu i nezavisnost, kao što je slučaj sa Sabarmati ašramom u Gudžaratu.

Političke partije, kao najveće dobrovoljne organizacije, podložne su uticaju kaste koju njihovi članovi unose. Lideri se često poistovećuju sa svojom kastom, što je i dilema gospodina Fadnavisa. Čak i oni koji ne žele da se identifikuju sa kastom, uvlače se u aktuelne rasprave.

Da bi se uticaj kaste umanjio, pojedinci mogu da naprave korake poput napuštanja prezimena po kasti, izbegavanja kasti specifičnih organizacija, podsticanja međukastinskih odnosa i brakova i jednakog odnosa prema svima – kod kuće i na poslu. Iako ovi koraci deluju jednostavno, oni su prvi i neophodni. Kao što je Ambedkar naglasio u svom nedovršenom predavanju „Uništenje kaste“, potpuno iskorenjivanje kaste nije lako, ali se njen uticaj može smanjiti upornim trudom običnih građana i lidera. Težnja ka idealističkom društvu bez kasti, iako izazovna, i dalje je dostojan cilj.

As London prepares for the future with its futuristic cable cars crossing the Thames for the 2012 Games, a remarkable piece of Olympic history has resurfaced. A newly discovered poster from the 1908 London Olympics offers a fascinating look at how the Games have evolved over time. In 1908, 2,000 athletes from 22 countries competed in 110 events, whereas this summer, over 10,000 athletes from 200 nations will participate in more than 300 events. The poster, which highlights the small group of 1908 medalists, is set to appear on tonight’s Antiques Roadshow alongside other memorabilia from the event held at London’s White City Stadium.

The items originally belonged to William Knightsmith, the official announcer and a renowned royal toastmaster, who is pictured on the poster with his megaphone. Before public address systems existed, Knightsmith’s role was to relay competition results to the audience, especially the royal box, often dressed in his signature red coat and top hat. According to his great-grandson, Patrick Stevenson, Knightsmith designed the red coat to distinguish himself from waiters and was one of the most famous toastmasters of his era, favored by royalty.

Stevenson's memorabilia, including Knightsmith's megaphone and top hat, will also feature on the show. The poster was produced by the London department store Gamages, which closed in 1972. A rare gold medal from the 1908 Games, awarded to British runner Emil Voigt in a now-defunct five-mile event, is another highlight. Voigt, who was born in Manchester to German parents, is shown on the poster sprinting toward Knightsmith. The expert Paul Viney called the print ‘a wonderful glimpse into Olympic history,’ noting events such as tug of war and tandem cycling that have long since vanished from the Games.

Viney valued Knightsmith's gold medal at £6,000–£8,000 (potentially up to £10,000 at auction), the megaphone at £1,500–£2,000, and the poster at £400–£500. He also remarked on how drastically the costs of hosting the Olympics have changed, from the £20,000 spent on the 1908 Games to the estimated £10 billion for London 2012.

The U.S. Army’s Fort Gordon was officially renamed Fort Eisenhower during a ceremony in Augusta, Georgia, on Friday. This marks the final stage in the Department of Defense’s initiative to rename nine Army posts that previously honored Confederate soldiers. Many of the new names pay tribute to Civil War veterans, Medal of Honor recipients, and influential Army leaders. Fort Gordon, originally named after Confederate Lt. Gen. John Brown Gordon, now honors General and former President Dwight D. Eisenhower—the 34th president of the United States and Supreme Allied Commander in Europe during World War II.

Maj. Gen. Paul Stanton, Commanding General of the U.S. Army Cyber Center of Excellence and Fort Gordon, highlighted Eisenhower’s remarkable military career and leadership at the renaming ceremony, describing him as an innovative leader and champion of peace, prosperity, civil rights, desegregation, and information advantage.

Eisenhower also held a special admiration for Augusta, seeking solace in the community during his presidency, according to the U.S. Army Cyber Center of Excellence. During the ceremony, Eisenhower’s granddaughter, Susan Eisenhower, spoke about his dedication to the nation and his connection to Augusta, stating, “This is where the past and the future can now comfortably reside,” and expressing gratitude for those supporting the renaming.

Maj. Gen. Stanton emphasized that renaming U.S. posts helps the nation remain a champion of liberty, equality, and freedom. Secretary of the Army Christine E. Wormuth discussed the broader significance of the renaming effort, noting it followed the civil unrest of 2020 after the death of George Floyd in police custody. She said bipartisan consensus recognized that retaining Confederate names on military bases perpetuated division in the country. Wormuth expressed appreciation for leaders who helped achieve the redesignations, acknowledging that while change can be necessary, it is rarely easy.

Romanian billionaire and agriculture magnate Ioan Niculae, considered the richest person in his country, spent £20,000 to hunt a bull elephant in Hoedspruit, Limpopo province, South Africa, in February last year. Niculae paid an additional £30,000 to have the animal taxidermied, mounted, and shipped to his home in Romania.

The taxidermy process, conducted by specialists near Pretoria, took seven months. During this time, the elephant’s hide was treated, and a fiberglass structure replaced its interior, reducing the animal’s weight from around four-and-a-half tons when alive to about half a ton in its preserved state. The real tusks were removed and replaced with fiberglass replicas for mounting, while the originals were stored separately in a glass display case.

Deiter Ochsenbein, 51, head of Highfield Taxidermists, oversaw the project. He explained that assembling the elephant required six people and was made up of 47 separate pieces. In total, Niculae commissioned taxidermy for 19 animals, amounting to a bill of £60,000. Smaller animals will be shipped by air, while the larger specimens, including elephants and lions, are being transported by ship from the port city of Durban to Niculae’s home in Romania. As reported by Forbes, Niculae is currently valued at $1.1 billion and built his fortune after founding Romania's leading agricultural and fertilizer company.

Niculae je platio dodatnih 30.000 funti kako bi životinju dali preparirati, montirati i poslati u njegov dom u Rumuniji.

Proces preparacije, koji su izvodili stručnjaci blizu Pretorije, trajao je sedam meseci. Tokom tog perioda, koža slona je obrađena, a unutrašnjost je zamenjena stakloplastičnom strukturom, što je smanjilo težinu životinje sa oko četiri i po tone dok je bila živa, na približno pola tone u prepariranom stanju. Pravi kljove su izvađene i zamenjene stakloplastičnim replikama za montažu, dok su originali smešteni posebno u staklenu vitrinu.

Deiter Oksenbajn, 51, direktor kompanije Highfield Taxidermists, nadgledao je projekat. On je objasnio da je za sastavljanje slona bilo potrebno šestoro ljudi i da je slon bio sastavljen od 47 odvojenih delova. Ukupno je Niculae naručio preparaciju 19 životinja, što je ukupno koštalo 60.000 funti. Manje životinje transportuju se avionom, dok se veći primerci, uključujući slonove i lavove, šalju brodom iz luke Durban do Niculaeovog doma u Rumuniji. Prema pisanju Forbesa, Niculae trenutno vredi 1,1 milijardu dolara i bogatstvo je stekao osnivanjem vodeće rumunske poljoprivredne i fabrike đubriva.

David Baillie, a 39-year-old taxi driver from Sunderland, was found guilty of causing the death of 17-year-old Sarah Jane Burke by dangerous driving. Burke, a promising art and design student at Sunderland College, died after being struck by Baillie’s Volvo while crossing the road on her way home from college on September 17 last year. Baillie, who was off-duty at the time, was attempting an aggressive overtaking maneuver when he hit her, causing catastrophic injuries. She was thrown into the air and landed head-first approximately 20 metres away. Despite being airlifted to the Royal Victoria Infirmary in Newcastle, Burke died from her injuries five days later.

The court heard that Baillie had a history of motoring offenses, including prior convictions for dangerous driving, theft of motor vehicles, driving while disqualified, and driving without insurance. Witnesses described Baillie’s driving at the time as reckless, with some stating it appeared as though he was acting out of road rage. Video footage from passing buses captured the moments before and after the collision.

During the trial at Newcastle Crown Court, Baillie claimed responsibility for causing death by careless driving, but denied that his actions amounted to dangerous driving. Prosecutor Nick Dry argued that Baillie was determined to overtake another vehicle at any cost, losing focus on the road ahead. After deliberating for just over an hour, the jury returned a unanimous guilty verdict. Judge Paul Sloan QC told Baillie that he faces a substantial prison sentence. Baillie was remanded in custody ahead of sentencing, with Burke’s grieving parents present in court throughout the proceedings.

Berk, talentovana učenica umetnosti i dizajna na Koledžu Sanderlend, preminula je nakon što ju je Bejlijev Volvo udario dok je prelazila ulicu na putu kući sa koledža, 17. septembra prošle godine. Bejli, tada van dužnosti, pokušavao je da opasno pretekne drugo vozilo kada je udario u nju, izazvavši katastrofalne povrede. Od siline udarca bila je odbačena u vazduh i pala na glavu oko 20 metara dalje. Iako je helikopterom prevezena u bolnicu Royal Victoria Infirmary u Njukaslu, Berk je preminula od povreda pet dana kasnije.

Na sudu je rečeno da Bejli ima istoriju saobraćajnih prekršaja, uključujući prethodne presude za opasnu vožnju, krađu vozila, vožnju tokom zabrane i vožnju bez osiguranja. Svedoci su njegovu vožnju opisali kao nesmotrenu, a neki su rekli da je izgledao kao da ga obuzima saobraćajni bes. Video snimci sa autobusa u prolazu zabeležili su trenutke pre i posle nesreće.

Tokom suđenja na Kraljevskom sudu u Njukaslu, Bejli je priznao odgovornost za smrt iz nehata, ali je negirao da se radilo o opasnoj vožnji. Tužilac Nik Draji tvrdio je da je Bejli bio rešen da po svaku cenu pretekne drugo vozilo, pri čemu je izgubio fokus na put ispred sebe. Porota je posle malo više od sat vremena jednoglasno donela osuđujuću presudu. Sudija Pol Sloan QC rekao je Bejliju da ga očekuje ozbiljna zatvorska kazna. Bejli je zadržan u pritvoru do izricanja presude, a roditelji Sare Džejn Berk prisustvovali su suđenju tokom celog procesa.

In his autobiography, Kevin Pietersen delivers sharp criticism of former teammate Matt Prior, frequently referring to him as 'Cheese'—a nickname Prior allegedly used for himself when he joined the England cricket team. Pietersen describes Prior as 'the schoolyard bully who is also the teacher’s pet' and claims he was the main reason for resentment towards him in the dressing room. Pietersen questions coach Andy Flower's decision to make Prior vice-captain—a role Pietersen himself wanted.

Pietersen recounts that after falling out with Prior during the New Zealand tour, their issues were addressed in a one-on-one meeting mediated by team psychologist Mark Bawden. Pietersen accused Prior of not being captaincy material and criticized the way he spoke about others behind their backs and belittled younger players. He also remarks that Prior often complained about then-coach Duncan Fletcher, whom Pietersen considers a friend.

Pietersen alleges that Prior, together with Graeme Swann and Stuart Broad, formed a dominant clique in the team, though he notes that Jimmy Anderson, while friendly with them, was fundamentally a nice person. He relates further disputes with Prior during tours in India and New Zealand, including mocking Prior for bringing his own bike and cycling gear on tour, likening his outfit to that of Clark Kent.

Since launching its multi-pronged attack on Israel one month ago, Hamas militants in the Gaza Strip have fired over 9,500 rockets into Israeli territory, according to Israeli Foreign Ministry data released Tuesday. The ministry noted that these figures are continually being updated. Multiple air-raid sirens sounded throughout Tuesday in central Israel and in communities near the Gaza border.

Since October 7, approximately 1,400 people in Israel have been killed and 7,198 injured. As of Tuesday evening, 342 people remain hospitalized, including 51 in serious condition, according to the Israeli Health Ministry.

Hamas is believed to be holding at least 239 hostages in Gaza, a group that includes Israeli citizens and foreign nationals: 25 from Thailand, 21 from Argentina, 18 from Germany, 10 from the United States, 7 from France, 7 from Russia, 4 from Hungary, 3 from Poland, 3 from Portugal, 2 from the United Kingdom, 2 from the Philippines, 2 from Romania, 2 from Tanzania, and individuals from Canada, Austria, Brazil, China, South Africa, Denmark, Ireland, Lithuania, Mexico, Nepal, the Netherlands, Serbia, Ukraine, and Uruguay.

Since the start of "Operation Swords of Iron," the Israel Airports Authority announced that over 330,000 Israeli citizens have returned from abroad, boosting the population by nearly 3.5%. Meanwhile, arrivals of foreign visitors have dropped sharply: only about 98,600 entered Israel in October—a 73% decrease compared to October 2022, according to the Central Bureau of Statistics.

The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) have attacked over 14,000 targets in Gaza since October 7, according to IDF Spokesman Brig. Gen. Daniel Hagari. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated that thousands of militants have been killed in ground and underground operations in Gaza.

On Wednesday, Foreign Minister Eli Cohen is scheduled to travel to Brussels with some families of hostages. Reports indicate he will address the European Parliament and meet with senior EU officials. On Tuesday, Cohen posted on social media, marking one month since the Hamas attack and vowing that Israel will never forget or forgive. He reiterated that Israel will do everything possible to secure the release of the hostages and called on the international community to support Israel’s fight against Hamas.

Public outrage swept across Greece after it was announced that journalist Costas Vaxevanis will face a retrial for publishing the names of over 2,000 Greeks with Swiss bank accounts. Earlier this month, Vaxevanis had been acquitted of breaking data privacy laws in connection with the publication of the so-called 'Lagarde List.' However, the Athens Public Prosecutor’s office has now declared his acquittal 'faulty,' ordering him to be tried again by a higher court on the same charges.

Vaxevanis claims he received the Lagarde List from an anonymous source because government ministers had failed to act on it. If convicted, he could face up to two years in prison or a fine. According to a court official, the prosecutor believes the original acquittal was legally incorrect. The swift arrest, trial, and subsequent acquittal of Vaxevanis drew international attention and resonated with Greeks frustrated by economic hardship and the privileges of the elite.

The Lagarde List is named after Christine Lagarde, current head of the IMF and then-French finance minister, who provided the list to Greek authorities in 2010. It details 2,059 Greek account holders at HSBC in Switzerland and was intended to be used to investigate possible tax evasion. The publication of the list and the lack of subsequent investigation has captivated the Greek public.

In his defense, Vaxevanis accused politicians of shielding an 'untouchable' elite and described the legal proceedings as politically motivated and vengeful. To date, Greece has not convicted any high-profile individuals for tax evasion, deepening public discontent with a political class that promised to address wealth inequality following the debt crisis. The daily newspaper Ta Nea also published the list and emphasized there is no evidence those named have broken tax laws. Supporters of Vaxevanis argue that the focus should be on investigating possible tax evasion rather than prosecuting a journalist.

article_content: Upconversion (UC) luminescence is a process that transforms low-energy photons into higher-energy photons, promising significant applications across diverse fields. Historically, UC mechanisms have mainly emphasized energy transfer between metal ions, leaving the influence of organic ligands less explored. Lanthanide-organic assemblies, constructed through coordination assembly, have gained considerable attention in supramolecular chemistry for their wide-ranging applications in sensing, bioimaging, and cancer theranostics. However, due to the challenges posed by long-distance energy transfer between sensitizers and activators, achieving efficient UC in multicomponent lanthanide-organic assemblies has proven difficult. In a study published in the Journal of the American Chemical Society, a research team led by Prof. Sun Qingfu from the Fujian Institute of Research on the Structure of Matter at the Chinese Academy of Sciences introduced excited-multimer mediated supramolecular upconversion in multicomponent lanthanide-organic assemblies. Their research revealed that subtle modifications to the peripheral substituents of ligands can control the metal-centered stereoconfiguration. This led to the creation of two distinct Ln8L12-type (Ln representing a lanthanide ion; L for organic ligands L1 or L2R/S) lanthanide-organic complexes. Advanced techniques—including nuclear magnetic resonance, electrospray ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry, and X-ray crystallography—confirmed the formation of rhombohedral Ln8(L1)12 and octahedral Ln8(L2R/S)12 structures. Photophysical studies on these assemblies showed highly efficient sensitization of Eu3+, Sm3+, and Yb3+ in the homometallic Ln8L12 through the traditional antenna effect. These supramolecular structures, which resemble pseudo-cubes, exhibited assembly-induced excited-multimer states by suppressing intramolecular orientation and vibration. Despite large distances between lanthanide ions (>1.4 nm), the Yb8(L2)12 assembly demonstrated unprecedented upconverted green fluorescence (500 nm) under 980 nm excitation. The quadratic relationship between upconverted intensity and laser power density matches a two-photon UC mechanism. Importantly, the energy of excited-multimer states can be transferred to Eu3+ ions in heterometallic (Yb/Eu)8L12 assemblies, achieving upconverted red emissions via excited-multimer-mediated cooperative sensitization upconversion. No detectable Eu3+-centered UC emission was observed in post-assembly mixtures of 7 equivalents of Yb8L12 and 1 equivalent of Eu8L12 under 980 nm excitation, confirming that Yb3+ to Eu3+ energy transfer is an intramolecular process rather than intermolecular. This study offers a novel strategy for designing advanced UC materials, which is pivotal for unlocking new photofunctional applications of multicomponent lanthanide-organic complexes.
translated_content: Upkonverzija (UC) luminiscencije je proces koji pretvara fotone niske energije u fotone više energije, obećavajući značajne primene u raznim oblastima. Tradicionalno, UC mehanizmi su uglavnom naglašavali prenos energije između metalnih jona, dok je uticaj organskih liganada manje proučavan. Objedinjavanja lantanoid-organskih jedinjenja putem koordinacione hemije privukla su veliku pažnju u supramolekulskoj hemiji zbog široke primene u senzorstvu, bioimidžingu i terapiji raka. Međutim, zbog izazova koje donosi prenos energije na velikim udaljenostima između senzibilizatora i aktivatora, postizanje efikasne UC u višekomponentnim lantanoid-organskim sklopovima je teško. U studiji objavljenoj u časopisu Journal of the American Chemical Society, istraživački tim na čelu sa prof. Sun Qingfu sa Instituta za istraživanje strukture materija iz Fujianskog ogranka Kineske akademije nauka predstavio je UC posredovanu pobuđenim multimerima u višekomponentnim lantanoid-organskim sklopovima. Njihovo istraživanje je otkrilo da suptilne izmene perifernih supstituenata liganada mogu kontrolisati stereo-konfiguraciju oko metala. To je dovelo do stvaranja dva različita Ln8L12 tipa (Ln označava lantanoidni jon; L su organski ligandi L1 ili L2R/S) lantanoid-organskih kompleksa. Napredne tehnike—uključujući nuklearnu magnetnu rezonancu, elektrosprej jonizacionu spektrometriju i rendgensku difrakciju—potvrdile su formiranje romboedarskih Ln8(L1)12 i oktaedarskih Ln8(L2R/S)12 struktura. Fotofizička ispitivanja ovih sklopova pokazala su veoma efikasnu senzibilizaciju Eu3+, Sm3+ i Yb3+ u homometalnim Ln8L12 pomoću tradicionalnog 'antenna' efekta. Ove supramolekulske strukture, koje podsećaju na pseudo-kocke, pokazuju stanja pobuđenih multimera izazvana sklapanjem, suzbijanjem unutarmolekulskih orijentacija i vibracija. Uprkos velikoj udaljenosti između lantanoidnih jona (>1,4 nm), Yb8(L2)12 sklop je pokazao jedinstvenu UC zelenu fluorescenciju (500 nm) pod ekscitacijom od 980 nm. Kvadratna zavisnost intenziteta UC u odnosu na gustinu snage lasera ukazuje na mehanizam dvofotonske UC. Važno je napomenuti da se energija iz pobuđenih multimer stanja može preneti na Eu3+ jone u heterometalnim (Yb/Eu)8L12 sklopovima, postižući UC crveno zračenje putem kooperativne senzibilizacije posredovane pobuđenim multimerima. Nije zabeleženo UC emitovanje centrirano na Eu3+ u mešavinama dobijenim nakon sklapanja sa 7 ekvivalenata Yb8L12 i 1 ekvivalentom Eu8L12 pod 980 nm ekscitacijom, što potvrđuje da je prenos energije sa Yb3+ na Eu3+ intramolekulski proces, a ne intermolekulski. Ova studija nudi novu strategiju za dizajn naprednih UC materijala, što je ključno za razvoj novih fotofunkcionalnih aplikacija višekomponentnih lantanoid-organskih kompleksa.

article_content: Paraguayan striker Roque Santa Cruz aims to revive his career after rejoining his former club, Blackburn Rovers, on loan from Manchester City for the remainder of the season. The 29-year-old departed Manchester City, where he struggled to make an impact following his $28 million move from Blackburn in 2009. Speaking to Blackburn's official website, Santa Cruz shared, "It feels like coming home. This was the easiest decision of my career. I want to get back to playing and scoring goals, and this is a real opportunity to prove myself after a frustrating period. Everyone knows what Blackburn Rovers means to me." During his previous spell at Ewood Park, Santa Cruz scored 29 goals in two seasons after joining on a free transfer from Bayern Munich. He later followed then-manager Mark Hughes to Manchester City. However, injuries and competition from the likes of Carlos Tevez, Emmanuel Adebayor, Mario Balotelli, and recent signing Edin Dzeko limited his opportunities, particularly under manager Roberto Mancini. This week, Mancini also allowed former England defender Wayne Bridge to join West Ham United on loan. Since Venky's took over Blackburn, the club has attempted to sign high-profile players such as Ronaldinho and David Beckham. Manager Steve Kean believes the loan signing of Santa Cruz demonstrates the new owners' commitment to success, saying, "This shows fans we can now compete and can challenge other teams both domestically and internationally." Elsewhere, Italian club Genoa signed Argentinian striker Mauro Boselli on loan from Wigan Athletic. Boselli, 25, struggled to settle in England after being top scorer at Estudiantes. Wigan manager Roberto Martinez said, "At the moment, he can't help the club, but I'm confident he'll return better after his time in Italy." In addition, South African midfielder Steven Pienaar is expected to leave Everton after manager David Moyes confirmed an accepted bid. Pienaar, linked with Tottenham and Inter Milan, is out of contract at the end of the season and has declined a new deal. Moyes told Everton's website, "We have had two offers—one has been accepted—and Pienaar's representatives are now in talks with the interested club."
translated_content: Paragvajski napadač Roque Santa Cruz želi da oživi svoju karijeru nakon što se vratio u svoj bivši klub Blackburn Rovers, na pozajmicu iz Manchester Cityja do kraja sezone. Dvadesetdevetogodišnjak je napustio Manchester City, gde nije uspeo da ostavi značajan trag nakon transfera od 28 miliona dolara iz Blackburna 2009. godine. Govoreći za zvanični sajt Blackburna, Santa Cruz je rekao: "Osećam se kao da sam se vratio kući. Ovo je bila najlakša odluka u mojoj karijeri. Želim ponovo da igram i postižem golove, a ovo je prava prilika da se dokažem nakon frustrirajućeg perioda. Svi znaju šta mi Blackburn Rovers znači." Tokom prethodnog boravka na Ewood Parku, Santa Cruz je postigao 29 golova u dve sezone nakon što je došao bez obeštećenja iz minhenskog Bayerna. Kasnije je pratio tadašnjeg trenera Marka Hughesa u Manchester City. Ipak, povrede i konkurencija igrača poput Carlosa Teveza, Emmanuela Adebayora, Marija Balotellija i Edina Džeka ograničili su njegove šanse, naročito pod trenerom Robertom Mancinijem. Ove nedelje, Mancini je takođe dozvolio bivšem engleskom reprezentativcu Wayneu Bridgeu da ode na pozajmicu u West Ham United. Od kada je Venky's preuzeo Blackburn, klub pokušava da dovede velike zvezde kao što su Ronaldinho i David Beckham.
