Imagine this: two dogs, dressed in classic checked flannel shirts, lounging on a porch and strumming out a bluegrass tune on a banjo and mandolin. That's exactly what you get in a lighthearted viral video on YouTube, where these canine performers—outfitted in full country style—deliver southern melodies on their instruments. Naturally, off-screen human help is involved, but it doesn't detract from the hilarious and charming scene.

In a nearly one-minute clip, the dogs show impressive calm as they play along with the bluegrass music. The fun-filled video was created by Cameron Owens, a musician from Johnson City, Tennessee. Owens, originally from Boone, North Carolina, plays mandolin and sings in bands Sons of Bluegrass and The Honey Chasers, as listed on his Facebook page. It’s likely Owens is behind the mandolin-picking dog.

Titled 'Dogs play Dueling Banjos,' the video playfully suggests a showdown between the two furry musicians, though it comes across more as a friendly jam. The description features the duo, Mrs Molly and her loyal companion Smoke, and in the spirit of good fun, Mrs Molly is declared the winner.

article_content: The Colombian military has announced the seizure of a submarine designed to transport over seven tons of cocaine from Colombia to Mexico. According to local media, this is the most sophisticated vessel discovered to date for drug trafficking operations in Colombia. Authorities stated that the submarine was found in Timbiqui, Cauca, a small town on the Pacific Coast, and was ready to be loaded with drugs. The vessel measures 31 meters (102 feet) in length and is capable of submerging to a depth of 9 meters (about 30 feet), making it difficult to detect. This marks the first time a submarine of this kind has been found in Colombia. Previously, Mexican authorities seized a similar vessel in 2008, with experts suggesting its technology was of Russian origin.

According to new data, cancer survival rates in England are gradually improving, but the country still falls behind other parts of Europe, such as France and Scandinavia. The Office for National Statistics released figures showing that in 2012, five-year survival rates for major cancers increased compared to the previous year. Breast cancer survival rates climbed to 85.8%, prostate cancer improved to 83.6%, and bowel cancer rose slightly to 57.6%. Overall, 19 of the 24 most common cancers saw modest improvements, which health experts attribute to earlier detection and better treatments. 

However, survival rates for five specific cancers—bladder cancer in women, thyroid cancer in both sexes, testicular cancer, Hodgkin lymphoma in women, and mesothelioma in men—either remained steady or declined slightly, with no clear explanation for these changes. At the same time, the National Health Service has experienced longer wait times for essential diagnostic tests as more people seek evaluations.

Public health advocates stress that England's cancer outcomes remain significantly lower compared to countries like France, Germany, and Sweden. The gap is partly blamed on patients delaying doctor visits and general practitioners occasionally missing early signs. Experts note that women generally act on possible symptoms sooner than men.

Nick Ormiston-Smith from Cancer Research UK said recent progress in survival rates reflects the benefit of research, heightened awareness, and improved treatments. However, survival remains poor for certain types of cancer, such as lung, pancreatic, esophageal, and brain cancers, largely due to late-stage detection.

The Health Secretary, Jeremy Hunt, has called for more accountability by identifying practices that fail to promptly refer patients with possible cancer, and the government invested an additional £60 billion in 2011 to help GPs access diagnostic scans. Lung cancer continues to have one of the lowest survival rates, with only 10.7% of men and 14.1% of women surviving five years after diagnosis—a slight increase over the previous year.

Stopa preživljavanja raka dojke porasla je na 85,8%, prostate na 83,6%, a raka creva blago na 57,6%. Ukupno, 19 od 24 najčešća raka bilježe skromna poboljšanja, što stručnjaci pripisuju ranijem otkrivanju i boljim tretmanima.

S druge strane, stope preživljavanja kod pet specifičnih karcinoma – raka bešike kod žena, raka štitne žlezde kod oba pola, testisa, Hodgkinovog limfoma kod žena i mezotelioma kod muškaraca – ostale su iste ili su se blago pogoršale, bez jasnog razloga za te promene. Istovremeno, Nacionalna zdravstvena služba se suočava s dužim listama čekanja za ključne dijagnostičke testove zbog sve više pacijenata koji traže procenu.

Zagovornici javnog zdravlja naglašavaju da su rezultati lečenja raka u Engleskoj znatno slabiji nego u zemljama kao što su Francuska, Nemačka i Švedska. Nik Ormston-Smit iz Cancer Research UK rekao je da nedavni napredak u stopama preživljavanja pokazuje koliko su istraživanja, podizanje svesti i bolji tretmani korisni. Ipak, preživljavanje kod određenih karcinoma – kao što su rak pluća, pankreasa, jednjaka i mozga – i dalje je nisko, uglavnom zbog kasne dijagnoze.

Ministar zdravlja Džeremi Hant pozvao je na veću odgovornost tako što će se identifikovati ordinacije koje ne šalju hitne upute za pacijente sa sumnjom na rak, a vlada je 2011. godine uložila dodatnih 60 milijardi funti da pomogne lekarima opšte prakse da lakše dođu do dijagnostičkih pregleda. Rak pluća i dalje ima jednu od najnižih stopa preživljavanja – samo 10,7% muškaraca i 14,1% žena preživi pet godina nakon dijagnoze, što je blago poboljšanje u odnosu na prošlu godinu.

article_content: Students are being warned by university officials that posting personal stories about partying and private encounters on social media could make it harder to find a job. Throughout the UK, students anonymously submit accounts of heavy drinking and sexual behavior on Facebook pages like 'Swansea Uni Confessions.' Both the university and student union have expressed strong concerns, highlighting that the owners of these confession pages are anonymous and unaccountable. They note that employers increasingly review applicants’ social media, so sharing explicit or private information could backfire. The university also reminds students that their rules prohibit any actions, including online activities, that could damage the university’s reputation, and disciplinary action may result. Additionally, posts online must comply with laws about defamation and public order; complete freedom of speech does not exist online.

article_content: Britain’s net worth has more than doubled in under two decades, reaching a record £7.6 trillion by the end of 2013, according to new data from the National Balance Sheet. This total wealth is equivalent to £119,000 per person or £289,000 per family in the UK. Homeownership plays a major role, with the value of houses accounting for almost two-thirds of the country's entire net worth. Since 1997, the nation's net wealth has risen from approximately £3 trillion to £7.6 trillion in 2013, more than doubling over the period. The value of Britain increased every year except during the economic downturn in 2008 and 2009. The Office for National Statistics (ONS) reported that by the end of 2013, the UK’s wealth saw a 4% rise (£324 billion) from the previous year, continuing a long-term upward trend. The combined net wealth of households and non-profit institutions, such as charities and trade unions, stood at £8.5 trillion in 2013—an average of £320,000 per household—up from £7.6 trillion in 2012. Houses were the most valuable asset in this sector, valued at £4.7 trillion in 2013, over three times their estimated value in 1997 (£1.4 trillion, not adjusted for inflation). The average house price increased by 234% between 1997 and 2013. The value of other buildings—including warehouses, infrastructure, and sports venues—increased by £86 billion (5%) to £1.7 trillion. Meanwhile, machinery, transport equipment, and ICT rose by £14 billion to reach £814 billion. However, the rise in national debt has caused central government net worth to fall sharply, reaching minus £663 billion by the end of 2013—more than eight times lower than in 2006. Government net worth has declined every year since 2001. Insurance, pension, and guarantee schemes held assets worth £3.1 trillion, while cash and savings were valued at £1.4 trillion. Growing national debt reduced the UK's total value, with the government owing £158 billion more than it owns in assets.

Ovo bogatstvo je ekvivalentno 119.000 funti po osobi ili 289.000 funti po porodici. Vlasništvo nekretnina ima ključnu ulogu, jer vrednost kuća čini skoro dve trećine ukupnog bogatstva zemlje. Najvrednija imovina u ovom sektoru su kuće, procenjene na 4,7 biliona funti (više od tri puta više nego 1997. godine — 1,4 biliona funti, bez prilagođavanja za inflaciju). Vrednost mašina, transportne i IKT opreme porasla je za 14 milijardi na ukupno 814 milijardi funti. Rastući državni dug uzrokovao je pad neto vrednosti centralne vlade, do minus 663 milijarde funti do kraja 2013. — više od osam puta manje nego 2006. godine. Neto vrednost vlade opada svake godine od 2001. godine. Imovina iz osiguranja, penzionih i garancijskih šema iznosila je 3,1 bilion funti, dok su gotovina i štednja procenjeni na 1,4 biliona. Porast nacionalnog duga smanjio je ukupnu vrednost UK, s državom koja duguje 158 milijardi funti više nego što poseduje.

article_content: Zelle, a digital payment platform owned by seven of America’s leading banks, has introduced a new policy to compensate victims of imposter scams. According to a statement from Early Warning Services—the network's operator—banks and credit unions participating in Zelle will process refunds for consumers who were deceived into sending money to fraudsters, covering scams going back to June 2023. This marks a notable shift for U.S. banks, which have historically been reluctant to reimburse these types of fraud claims. A spokesperson for Early Warning Services confirmed the change, stating that beginning June 30, 2023, participating institutions must reimburse consumers for qualifying imposter scams, such as when scammers pretend to be bank representatives and trick users into transferring funds. This adjustment comes after increased scrutiny from lawmakers like Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren, who raised concerns about fraud risks on Zelle during a 2022 Senate hearing. JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon responded at the hearing, arguing that requiring banks to cover all fraud claims would be unreasonable. Previously, Zelle only reimbursed users when their accounts were directly compromised by hackers, but the updated policy includes a broader range of scams involving impersonators. U.S. banks have long tried to avoid liability in such instances, but public and regulatory pressure has driven this recent shift. Zelle is co-owned by Bank of America, Truist, Capital One, JPMorgan Chase, PNC Bank, U.S. Bank, and Wells Fargo, and connects more than 2,100 financial institutions nationwide. Data from Zelle indicates that 99.9% of transactions are free from fraud, yet given the $629 billion processed in 2022, even marginal fraud represents significant losses. In 2022, impersonator scams cost Americans $2.6 billion, according to the Federal Trade Commission. Though there is no law obliging Zelle to refund money lost to imposter scams, growing demand for consumer protections has spurred this policy change. Regulatory interest remains strong, and other payment processors like Apple and PayPal also face pressure to enhance their scam prevention measures.

Prema saopštenju Early Warning Services, operatera mreže, banke i kreditne unije koje učestvuju u Zelle-u obradiće povraćaj novca korisnicima prevarenim da pošalju sredstva prevarantima, uključujući prevare koje su se desile od juna 2023. godine. Ovo predstavlja značajnu promenu za američke banke koje su se ranije retko odlučivale na ovakve povraćaje. Generalni direktor JPMorgan-a Džejmi Dajmon odgovorio je na saslušanju tvrdeći da nije realno da banke pokrivaju sve prijave prevara. Ranije je Zelle nadoknađivao sredstva korisnicima samo kada su njihovi nalozi bili direktno hakovani, dok nova politika uključuje i širi spektar prevara sa lažnim predstavljanjem. Zelle je u zajedničkom vlasništvu banaka Bank of America, Truist, Capital One, JPMorgan Chase, PNC Bank, U.S. Bank i Wells Fargo, i povezuje više od 2.100 finansijskih institucija širom zemlje. Iako zakon ne obavezuje Zelle da vraća novac izgubljen u ovakvim prevarama, sve veća tražnja za zaštitom potrošača doprinela je uvođenju ove politike. Interesovanje regulatora je i dalje veliko, a i druge platforme za plaćanje, poput Apple-a i PayPal-a, suočavaju se sa pritiscima da unaprede mere protiv finansijskih prevara.

article_content: A sperm donor in the United States has fathered up to 150 children, drawing increasing concerns about the lack of regulation in sperm banking. The donor’s identity isn't public, but he is tracked by a number, enabling half-siblings to connect and learn about their extended families. Wendy Kramer, who started the Donor Sibling Registry after having her son Ryan via donor in Pasadena, California, helps link families. Cynthia Daily, a 48-year-old mother from Washington who used the same donor in 2004, has uncovered a large network of her son's half-siblings, even vacationing with some of their families. There are growing worries among parents, health professionals, and geneticists that allowing one donor to father so many children heightens the risk of spreading inherited diseases. There’s also concern that half-siblings living near one another might form relationships, unaware they are biologically related. Families often discover more siblings than expected, sometimes finding dozens through online registries. Debora Spar, president of Barnard College, has highlighted that US rules for sperm donation are weaker than those in the UK or France, where strict limits exist. Many critics say fertility clinics and sperm banks value profit over ethics when they let popular donors produce numerous offspring. The issue has even been depicted in the Oscar-nominated movie 'The Kids Are All Right,' which tells the story of donor-conceived children meeting their biological father. More families and advocates are now calling for stronger regulations to avoid these problems in the future.

article_content: Jacques Roy, a Texas physician, has been charged in what officials describe as one of the largest healthcare fraud cases in U.S. history, alleging that nearly $375 million was illegally billed to Medicare and Medicaid. Roy, who operated Medistat Group Associates in DeSoto, Texas, stands accused with six others of submitting fraudulent claims for home health services that were unnecessary, improperly billed, or never provided. According to a federal indictment unsealed Tuesday, intermediaries reportedly recruited thousands of patients—enticed with cash, grocery vouchers, or food stamps—to participate in the scheme. From January 2006 to November 2011, Roy allegedly approved home health services for over 11,000 Medicare beneficiaries, collaborating with more than 500 home health agencies. This volume surpassed any other medical practice in the nation. As a result, Medicare payments to over 75 of these agencies have been suspended. U.S. Attorney Sarah Saldana accused Roy of 'selling his signature,' enabling agencies to bill federal health programs regardless of actual patient need. Saldana stated that recruiters working for Roy enlisted large numbers of people—many who did not require home health services—to join agency lists. In some instances, alleged participants targeted homeless shelters, offering recruiters money for every enrolled person. Now 54, Roy faces multiple counts of health care fraud and conspiracy, with a possible sentence of up to 100 years if convicted. He briefly appeared in court and, through his attorney Patrick McLain, said it is too early to comment as much of the evidence has yet to be disclosed. Authorities are also moving to seize Roy’s assets, including cash, cars, and sailboats. Other individuals, such as home health agency owners Cynthia Stiger and Charity Eleda, are also charged in the alleged scheme. Stiger pleaded not guilty, insisting the government's figures are overstated. Investigators note that limitations in previous government tracking systems allowed the fraud to go unnoticed for years, but improvements in data analytics recently exposed the operation. Officials estimate that fraud drains at least $60 billion annually from public healthcare programs, resulting in new task forces and increased oversight. Saldana stressed the importance of protecting such programs for coming generations.

Roj, koji je vodio kompaniju Medistat Group Associates u DeSoto-u u Teksasu, zajedno sa još šest osoba optužen je za podnošenje lažnih zahteva za kućnu zdravstvenu negu koja nije bila potrebna, nije bila pravilno naplaćena ili uopšte nije pružena. Prema federalnoj optužnici koja je otvorena u utorak, posrednici su navodno regrutovali hiljade pacijenata – podstaknute novcem, bonovima za namirnice ili kuponima za hranu – da učestvuju u šemi. Od januara 2006. do novembra 2011. godine, Roj je navodno odobravao kućne zdravstvene usluge za više od 11.000 korisnika Medicare-a, sarađujući sa više od 500 agencija za kućnu negu. Ovaj obim premašio je bilo koju drugu medicinsku praksu u zemlji. Kao rezultat toga, Medicare je obustavio uplate više od 75 ovih agencija. Američka tužiteljka Sara Saldana optužila je Roja da je „prodavao svoj potpis“, omogućavajući agencijama da naplaćuju federalnim zdravstvenim programima bez obzira na stvarnu potrebu pacijenata. Saldana je istakla da su Rojovi regruteri upisivali veliki broj ljudi – od kojih mnogi nisu imali potrebu za kućnom zdravstvenom negom – na spiskove agencija. U nekim slučajevima, navodni učesnici su ciljali prihvatilišta za beskućnike, nudeći regruterima novac za svakog upisanog korisnika. Sada, sa 54 godine, Roj se suočava sa više tačaka optužnice za zdravstvene prevare i zaveru, sa mogućom kaznom do 100 godina zatvora ukoliko bude osuđen. On se kratko pojavio pred sudom i, preko svog advokata Patrika MekLejna, izjavio da je još prerano za komentar jer većina dokaza još nije dostupna. Vlasti su takođe pokrenule postupak zaplene Rojove imovine, uključujući gotovinu, automobile i jedrilice. Druge osobe, poput vlasnica agencija za kućnu negu Sintije Stiger i Čeriti Elede, takođe su optužene u navodnoj šemi. Stiger je izjavila da nije kriva, tvrdeći da su podaci državnih organa preuveličani. Istražitelji ističu da su ograničenja tadašnjih sistema praćenja omogućila da prevara godinama prođe nezapaženo, ali da su poboljšanja u analizi podataka nedavno otkrila ovu operaciju. Zvaničnici procenjuju da ovakve prevare godišnje oduzimaju najmanje 60 milijardi dolara iz javnih zdravstvenih programa, zbog čega su formirani novi timovi i pojačan nadzor. Saldana je istakla važnost zaštite tih programa za buduće generacije.

article_content: Kano City remained calm on Friday despite the Appeal Court’s decision to remove Governor Abba Yusuf of the New Nigeria Peoples Party (NNPP) and declare Nasiru Gawuna of the All Progressives Congress (APC) as the duly elected governor. According to our correspondent, residents continued their daily activities as usual, with no disturbances reported. Human and vehicular movement proceeded without restriction. Armed security personnel were stationed at major streets and strategic locations to maintain peace and order. Marketplaces, filling stations, and other businesses operated normally. Leaders of the NNPP and APC had signed a peace accord at the state police command on Thursday, calling on their supporters to remain peaceful and abide by the law ahead of the court’s ruling. They urged followers to avoid actions that could disrupt public order. During the accord signing, the State Commissioner of Police, Hussaini Gumel, explained that the police, in collaboration with the military and other security agencies, had implemented security measures to ensure peace before, during, and after the judgment. He assured the public that sufficient security personnel had been deployed to prevent any breakdown of law and order. Commissioner Gumel added that both political party leaders had pledged to communicate the importance of peace to their supporters. He warned that no politically motivated gatherings would be tolerated in any location. As of 2:30 pm, there were no reports of violence or protest related to the court’s judgment anywhere in Kano State.

Prema izveštaju našeg dopisnika, stanovnici su nastavili sa svojim svakodnevnim aktivnostima, bez incidenata. Ljudi i vozila su se kretali bez ograničenja. Na glavnim ulicama i strateškim mestima bili su raspoređeni naoružani pripadnici bezbednosti radi održavanja reda i mira. Pijace, benzinske pumpe i ostale firme radile su normalno. Lideri NNPP i APC su u četvrtak u policijskoj stanici potpisali mirovni sporazum, pozivajući pristalice da ostanu mirni i poštuju zakon pred sudsku odluku. Zamolili su ih da izbegavaju bilo kakve postupke koji bi mogli narušiti javni red. Tokom potpisivanja, državni komesar policije Husaini Gumel rekao je da su policija, vojska i druge bezbednosne agencije sprovele sve potrebne mere da obezbede mir pre, tokom i posle sudske odluke. Uverio je javnost da je raspoređen dovoljan broj pripadnika bezbednosti kako bi sprečili narušavanje reda i mira. Komesar Gumel je dodao da su lideri obe političke partije obećali da će preneti važnost mira svojim pristalicama. Upozorio je da politički motivisana okupljanja neće biti dozvoljena ni na jednom mestu. Do 14:30 nije bilo izveštaja o nasilju ili protestima povodom odluke suda bilo gde u državi Kano.

article_content: Reporting neighbors, colleagues, and even strangers to authorities was common during the Soviet era in Russia. This practice has re-emerged as the government cracks down on critics of the war in Ukraine, with people driven by personal grudges or political beliefs denouncing others. A woman using the pseudonym Anna Korobkova says she lives in a large Russian city but does not disclose the location. She claims her grandfather was an anonymous informant for the Soviet secret police under Stalin, when denunciations were a part of daily life, and says she is following in his footsteps. Korobkova reports anyone she suspects of criticizing the war in Ukraine. Since Russia's full-scale invasion, she claims to have written 1,397 denunciations, resulting in people being fined, fired, or labeled as foreign agents. She expresses no remorse, stating she feels satisfaction when her denunciations lead to punishment. New censorship laws introduced following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 impose severe penalties on those accused of 'discrediting the Russian army' — including fines up to 50,000 roubles (about $560 or £450), or up to five years in prison for repeat offenses. Korobkova is cautious, only willing to communicate via email, avoiding revealing her identity due to frequent death threats and concerns for her safety. She says she denounces people to assist Russia in the conflict and to protect her own financial situation, fearing reparations could impact the economy and her savings. Korobkova, who works part-time as a humanities professor and lives alone, relies on her savings and fears a Ukrainian victory would threaten her finances. Since the introduction of the new censorship laws, OVD-Info, an independent Russian human rights group, reports more than 8,000 cases filed against people accused of discrediting the military. Korobkova often targets those who speak with the media, especially international outlets like the BBC. Anthropologist Aleksandra Arkhipova, currently in exile, says Korobkova has reported her seven times and believes this contributed to her being labeled a foreign agent. Arkhipova adds that Korobkova’s actions have discouraged other experts from commenting publicly. Teacher Tatiana Chervenko was also targeted after choosing to teach mathematics instead of participating in new patriotism classes. Following Korobkova’s complaints to Chervenko’s employer and government officials, Chervenko was dismissed in December 2022. Korobkova maintains a database of those she has reported and the repercussions. She claims her denunciations led to six people losing their jobs and 15 others being fined or facing administrative charges. While Korobkova insists she only targets 'enemies of the state,' others report that denunciations are sometimes used to settle personal vendettas. Fisherman Yaroslav Levchenko from Kamchatka was reported for anti-war views after a dispute with a colleague. Levchenko, who was later arrested and charged with 'justifying terrorism' (charges he denies), believes the report diverted attention from his own assault and violations on board the ship. Levchenko communicates with the BBC only through letters via his lawyer, describing his harsh experiences in custody. Russian police have acknowledged their workload has increased significantly due to the surge in denunciations since the war began. Officials told the BBC anonymously that much time is being spent on these cases. A retired officer noted that such complaints can distract from more serious investigations. With President Putin continuing to urge citizens to 'punish betrayers' and the war ongoing, serial informants like Korobkova appear determined to continue. She told the BBC she will keep writing denunciations, saying, 'I have a lot of work to do.'
translated_content: Prijavljivanje komšija, kolega, pa čak i nepoznatih osoba vlastima bilo je uobičajeno tokom sovjetske ere u Rusiji. Ova praksa ponovo je oživela dok vlasti pooštravaju obračun sa kritičarima rata u Ukrajini, pri čemu ljudi, vođeni ličnim zamerkama ili političkim uverenjima, prijavljuju druge. Žena pod pseudonimom Ana Korobkova kaže da živi u velikom ruskom gradu, ali ne otkriva koji. Tvrdi da joj je deda bio anoniman doušnik sovjetske tajne policije za vreme Staljina, kada su prijave bile deo svakodnevice, i smatra da nastavlja njegovim stopama. Korobkova prijavljuje svakoga za koga sumnja da kritikuje rat u Ukrajini. Od početka ruske invazije tvrdi da je napisala 1.397 prijava, zbog kojih su ljudi kažnjavani novčano, otpuštani ili proglašavani stranim agentima. Ne pokazuje kajanje, već kaže da oseća zadovoljstvo kad njene prijave dovedu do kazni. Novi zakoni o cenzuri, uvedeni nakon ruske invazije na Ukrajinu u februaru 2022, uvode stroge kazne za one optužene za „diskreditaciju ruske vojske“ – uključujući novčane kazne do 50.000 rubalja (oko 560 dolara ili 450 funti) ili do 5 godina zatvora za ponovljene prekršaje. Korobkova je izuzetno oprezna, pristaje samo na kontakt putem mejla, jer često prima pretnje smrću i strepi za svoju bezbednost. Navodi da ljude prijavljuje kako bi pomogla Rusiji i zaštitila svoje finansije, jer se plaši da bi eventualna ratna odšteta mogla uticati na njenu ušteđevinu. Korobkova, koja radi skraćeno kao profesorka humanističkih nauka i živi sama, oslanja se na svoju ušteđevinu i brine da bi pobeda Ukrajine ugrozila njenu finansijsku situaciju. Od uvođenja novih cenzorskih zakona, OVD-Info, nezavisna ruska organizacija za ljudska prava, beleži više od 8.000 slučajeva protiv građana optuženih za diskreditaciju vojske. Korobkova često prijavljuje one koji govore za medije, posebno međunarodne poput BBC-a. Antropološkinja Aleksandra Arhipova, sada u egzilu, kaže da ju je Korobkova prijavila sedam puta i veruje da je to doprinelo njenom proglašenju za stranog agenta. Arhipova dodaje da su Korobkovine prijave obeshrabrile druge stručnjake da komentarišu javno. Meta Korobkove bila je i profesorka Tatjana Červenko, koja je odlučila da predaje matematiku umesto da vodi nove patriotske časove. Posle Korobkovinih prijava njenom poslodavcu i državnim organima, Červenko je otpuštena u decembru 2022. Korobkova vodi bazu podataka o osobama koje je prijavila i posledicama po njih. Navodi da su zbog njenih prijava šest osoba ostale bez posla, a 15 dobilo kazne ili administrativne mere. Dok Korobkova tvrdi da prijavljuje isključivo „neprijatelje države“, drugi navode da se prijave često koriste i za lične obračune. Ribar Jaroslav Levčenko sa poluostrva Kamčatka prijavljen je zbog anti-ratnih stavova nakon sukoba sa kolegom. Levčenko, kojeg su kasnije uhapsili i optužili za „opravdavanje terorizma“ (što poriče), smatra da je prijava skrenula pažnju sa njegovog napada i kršenja zabrane alkohola na brodu. Levčenko komunicira sa BBC-jem isključivo putem pisama preko advokata, opisujući teške uslove pritvora. Ruska policija priznaje znatno veći obim posla zbog porasta prijava od početka rata. Zvaničnici anonimno navode da dosta vremena troše na ovakve slučajeve, a penzionisani policajac ističe da takve prijave često odvlače pažnju sa ozbiljnijih istraga. Uz stalne Putinove pozive građanima da „kažnjavaju izdajnike“ i nastavak rata, serijski doušnici poput Korobkove ne planiraju da stanu. BBC-u je rekla da će nastaviti sa prijavama, uz komentar: „Imam puno posla.“

article_content: "E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial" remains one of Steven Spielberg's most admired films, holding a special place in the hearts of many moviegoers. When the film was re-released in 2002 for its 20th anniversary, Spielberg made several changes to the original. These included updating E.T.'s face with CGI, re-inserting a couple of deleted scenes, and replacing the rifles carried by police officers pursuing Elliott and his friends with walkie-talkies. Fans were not pleased with the changes, and the decision even became the subject of parody on "South Park." In 2011, Spielberg acknowledged he regretted these alterations and promised the Blu-ray would present the unaltered 1982 theatrical version. The upcoming 30th-anniversary Blu-ray, releasing this October, delivers on that promise—walkie-talkies have been removed, and the film is restored to its classic form. The Blu-ray features two new bonus featurettes: one documenting the making of the film, and another featuring a new interview with Spielberg reflecting on the movie. The two deleted scenes will be available separately, and most bonus features from the previous DVD edition will return on the Blu-ray. For more details, visit EW.com. © 2011 Entertainment Weekly and Time Inc. All rights reserved.

Dve izbačene scene će biti dostupne odvojeno, a većina bonus sadržaja sa prethodnog DVD izdanja biće uključena i na Blu-ray disku. article_content: The first official nuclear negotiations since Hassan Rouhani became president of Iran have concluded in Geneva. While talks between Iran and the P5+1 (Britain, China, France, Russia, the United States, and Germany) will continue in November, this week's meetings have raised important questions. Were these talks positive diplomatic and political steps for all parties? How should we evaluate the Iranian presentation, 'Closing an unnecessary Crisis: Opening new horizons,' which proposed ways to resolve international concerns over Iran’s nuclear program in exchange for sanctions relief and global recognition of Iran's right to enrich uranium? These two-day discussions should be seen as part of a broader process involving Iran, the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), and the P5+1. This initial round cannot be considered the sole indicator of success or failure regarding Iran's nuclear enrichment program. Notably, several signs from these first formal talks suggest a constructive atmosphere. Michael Mann, spokesman for Catherine Ashton, the EU's top foreign policy official and chief negotiator, said that the Iranian proposal had been 'very useful ... For the first time, very detailed technical discussions continued this afternoon.' Further diplomatic progress was evident in bilateral meetings between the U.S. and Iranian delegations, viewed as an extension of a potential U.S.-Iran rapprochement, boosted by Rouhani's diplomatic outreach and exchanges with U.S. President Barack Obama. Though only in the early stages, the talks appear to have given Iran some early diplomatic advantages over the U.S. and Western allies. Speaking in English and using PowerPoint, Foreign Minister Javad Zarif, who was educated in the U.S., made a positive impression, helping set the tone for future talks and possible sanction relief to aid Iran’s struggling economy. Iran described the talks as 'serious' and conducted in a 'highly positive atmosphere.' These developments have made it harder for Western powers to justify further sanctions. The main issue, however, remains whether both Iran and P5+1 representatives have met their key political and diplomatic objectives concerning Tehran’s nuclear program. The details of these objectives remain unclear following this round in Geneva. Tehran’s central aim is sanctions relief and an end to economic isolation, achieved by softening its diplomatic posture and seeking resolution. The West seeks to move from cautious optimism to confidence that Iran’s nuclear program is strictly peaceful and transparent. It is uncertain if Iran and the P5+1 can reach agreement, given the significant political gaps between their stances on uranium enrichment. Iran insists on its right to enrich uranium under the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty, while Western leaders urge slowing or suspending enrichment until a deal is reached. The next round of negotiations will likely provide further clarity. Only then will it become clear if these talks represent a fresh start in Iran’s relations with the West, or a continuation of past difficulties.
translated_content: Prva zvanična nuklearna pregovaranja otkako je Hasan Rohani postao predsednik Irana završena su u Ženevi. Razgovori između Irana i P5+1 (Velika Britanija, Kina, Francuska, Rusija, SAD i Nemačka) nastavljaju se u novembru, a sastanci ove nedelje otvorili su važna pitanja. Da li su ovi pregovori bili pozitivan diplomatski i politički korak za sve strane? Kako treba proceniti iransku prezentaciju „Zatvaranje nepotrebne krize: Otvaranje novih horizonata“, koja je predložila rešenja za međunarodne brige o iranskom nuklearnom programu u zamenu za ukidanje sankcija i priznanje prava Irana na obogaćivanje uranijuma? Ovi dvodnevni razgovori treba posmatrati u širem kontekstu procesa u kojem učestvuju Iran, Međunarodna agencija za atomsku energiju (IAEA) i P5+1. Prva runda ne može biti jedini pokazatelj uspeha ili neuspeha u vezi iranskog programa obogaćivanja uranijuma. Posebno se izdvaja nekoliko signala iz ovih prvih formalnih razgovora koji ukazuju na konstruktivnu atmosferu. Majkl Men, portparol Ketrin Ešton, glavne zvaničnice EU za spoljnu politiku i glavne pregovaračice, izjavio je da je iranski predlog bio „veoma koristan... prvi put su tokom popodneva nastavljeni izuzetno detaljni tehnički razgovori.“ Napredak je viđen i u bilateralnim sastancima američke i iranske delegacije, što se vidi kao korak ka potencijalnom zbližavanju SAD i Irana, podstaknuto Rohaniovim diplomatskim angažovanjem i razmenom poruka sa predsednikom Obamaom. Iako su pregovori još u ranoj fazi, čini se da su dali Iranu određene diplomatske prednosti u odnosu na SAD i zapadne saveznike. Govoreći na engleskom i uz PowerPoint, ministar spoljnih poslova Džavad Zarif, obrazovan u SAD, ostavio je pozitivan utisak, doprinoseći budućim pregovorima i mogućem ublažavanju sankcija za jačanje iranske ekonomije. Iran je razgovore ocenio kao 'ozbiljne' i održane u 'izuzetno pozitivnoj atmosferi.' Ovi događaji otežavaju zapadnim silama opravdanje novih sankcija. Ipak, ostaje pitanje da li su Iran i predstavnici P5+1 postigli svoje ključne političke i diplomatske ciljeve u vezi iranskog nuklearnog programa. Detalji tih ciljeva i dalje su nejasni posle ove runde u Ženevi. Glavni cilj Teherana je ukidanje sankcija i kraj ekonomske izolacije, kroz ublažavanje retorike i napor za rešenje. Zapad želi da pređe iz opreznog optimizma u poverenje da je iranski program mirnodopski i transparentan. Neizvesno je da li Iran i P5+1 mogu pronaći zajednički jezik, s obzirom na velike razlike u stavovima oko obogaćivanja uranijuma. Iran insistira na svom pravu na obogaćivanje uranijuma prema Sporazumu o neširenju nuklearnog oružja, dok zapadni lideri traže usporavanje ili obustavu dok se ne postigne dogovor. Sledeća runda pregovora verovatno će doneti više jasnoće. Tada će se videti da li su ovo novi početak odnosa Irana i Zapada ili nastavak starih problema.

article_content: Growers want to produce wildlife-friendly plants, and consumers are interested in buying them, according to new University of Florida research. However, while buyers express a desire to purchase wildlife-friendly plants, many are unsure how to recognize them, say UF/IFAS researchers. Furthermore, UF/IFAS experts aim to ensure these plants are truly beneficial for wildlife. "Our research indicates significant interest among Floridians in buying and growing wildlife-friendly plants, as well as opportunities to improve public understanding of what this means and how to find such plants," said Laura Warner, a UF/IFAS associate professor of agricultural education and communication, and a co-author of the study. In the future, researchers hope to establish a 'University of Florida Biodiversity Certified Plants' program. UF/IFAS scientists plan to label potted plants to confirm their biodiversity certification. Currently, researchers are assessing the level of consumer and grower interest in wildlife-friendly plants. They are also working to define what 'wildlife-friendly' means. Caroline Nickerson, a doctoral student supervised by Warner, led the study, which defines 'wildlife-friendly' as native or non-native ornamental plants that attract and safely support beneficial insects, birds, and other wildlife. These species offer resources such as pollen, nectar, berries, fruit, foliage, and seeds that are safe for wildlife. The findings are published in the journal HortTechnology. Among 868 consumers surveyed, about 90% said they were likely or very likely to buy certified wildlife-friendly plants, believing they would benefit from them. Around 75% of consumers said they could explain the difference between wildlife-friendly and non-wildlife-friendly plants. Of the 75 growers surveyed, 70% indicated they would likely add certified wildlife-friendly plants to their inventory. Growers were also asked about their innovation level; about 40% saw themselves as 'innovators,' or early adopters of new ideas. "That means they're ahead of the curve in trying new approaches," Warner said. Researchers highlight why certification matters: a consumer may buy a plant from a retail store, unaware that it was treated with insecticides during production. Depending on the pesticides used, there can be residual toxicity that affects the wildlife feeding on these plants after purchase. Thus, a plant intended to attract wildlife might actually harm them. "We want to collaborate with growers to ensure they cultivate plant species valuable to wildlife and use suitable methods for pest control, minimizing risks to the wildlife the plants are meant to support," said Adam Dale, a UF/IFAS associate professor of entomology and study co-author. "If growers follow recommended practices, consumers will know certified plants are safe." "Although certification may take time to implement, we want to enable consumers to buy with confidence," said Jaret Daniels, a UF/IFAS professor of entomology and curator at the Florida Museum of Natural History. "Ultimately, we aim to reduce confusion and risk by labeling plants as UF-certified, giving growers confidence in their products and allowing consumers to identify wildlife-safe plants that have been thoroughly evaluated."

Ipak, iako kupci izražavaju želju da nabave takve biljke, mnogi nisu sigurni kako da ih prepoznaju, navode istraživači sa UF/IFAS-a. Takođe, stručnjaci sa UF/IFAS-a žele da obezbede da su ove biljke zaista korisne za divlje životinje. "Naše istraživanje pokazuje značajno interesovanje stanovnika Floride za kupovinu i gajenje biljaka prijateljskih prema divljim životinjama, ali i mogućnosti da se unapredi razumevanje javnosti o tome šta to znači i kako pronaći takve biljke," rekla je Laura Warner, vanredna profesorka poljoprivrednog obrazovanja i komunikacija na UF/IFAS-u i koautorka studije. U budućnosti, istraživači se nadaju da će pokrenuti program 'Biljke sa sertifikatom biodiverziteta Univerziteta Floride'. Naučnici sa UF/IFAS-a planiraju da postavljaju oznake na saksijske biljke koje potvrđuju ovaj sertifikat. Trenutno istražuju nivo interesovanja potrošača i proizvođača za ovakve biljke, kao i šta zapravo znači 'prijateljska prema divljim životinjama'. Kejroline Nikerson, doktorantkinja pod mentorstvom Warnerove, vodila je studiju koja definiše 'prijateljske prema divljim životinjama' kao autohtone ili alohtone ukrasne biljke koje privlače i bezbedno podržavaju korisne insekte, ptice i druge životinje. Ove vrste nude resurse poput polena, nektara, bobica, voća, lišća i semenki koje su bezbedne za životinje. Rezultati su objavljeni u časopisu HortTechnology. Od 868 anketiranih potrošača, oko 90% je izjavilo da bi verovatno ili vrlo verovatno kupilo sertifikovane biljke prijateljske prema divljim životinjama, smatrajući da su korisne. Oko 75% potrošača tvrdi da može da objasni razliku između biljaka koje jesu i koje nisu prijateljske prema divljim životinjama. Od 75 anketiranih proizvođača, 70% je navelo da bi verovatno uvelo sertifikovane biljke ovog tipa u svoju ponudu. Proizvođače su pitali i koliko su inovativni – oko 40% sebe smatra inovatorima, odnosno onima koji prvi prihvataju nove ideje. "To znači da prednjače kada je reč o isprobavanju novih pristupa," rekla je Warner. Istraživači naglašavaju zašto je sertifikacija važna: potrošač može kupiti biljku u prodavnici, ne znajući da je tokom proizvodnje tretirana insekticidima. U zavisnosti od upotrebljenih pesticida, može doći do ostataka koji negativno utiču na divlje životinje koje kasnije koriste biljku. Dakle, biljka koja bi trebalo da privuče životinje može im zapravo štetiti. "Želimo da sarađujemo sa proizvođačima kako bismo bili sigurni da gaje vrste koje su vredne za divlje životinje i koriste odgovarajuće mere kontrole štetočina, uz minimiziranje rizika za divlje životinje kojima su biljke namenjene," rekao je Adam Dale, vanredni profesor entomologije na UF/IFAS-u i koautor studije. "Ako proizvođači prate preporučene postupke, potrošači mogu biti sigurni da su sertifikovane biljke bezbedne." "Iako sertifikacija može zahtevati vreme, želimo da omogućimo potrošačima sigurnu kupovinu," rekao je Jaret Daniels, profesor entomologije na UF/IFAS-u i kustos na Prirodnjačkom muzeju Floride. "Cilj nam je da smanjimo zabunu i rizik označavanjem biljaka UF-sertifikatom, čime obezbeđujemo poverenje proizvođača u svoj proizvod i potrošačima omogućavamo da prepoznaju biljke bezbedne za divlje životinje koje su detaljno proverene."

Former police officer Jonathan Webb has been sentenced to six years in prison for theft, fraud, and forgery. Webb, previously with South Yorkshire Police, stole £23,000 from a 94-year-old widow and forged her will in an attempt to inherit the majority of her £400,000 estate. Described by colleagues as a ‘disgrace to the uniform,’ Webb gained the victim's trust after responding to a call when she had a fall. He continued to visit her in hospital and, upon her recovery, obtained access to her bank accounts. Webb set up internet banking and a cash card, allowing him to withdraw funds at will, sometimes taking £300 per day. He also closed one of her pension accounts to access her life savings.

Leeds Crown Court heard that Webb wrote a false will on the victim’s typewriter, using details from her original document to draft a new one naming himself the primary beneficiary. His crimes came to light after suspicions arose in another case involving the theft of £1,000 and 500 US dollars recovered from a burglary. During the investigation, officers found the forged will in the boot of his car and a box of Second World War medals, also stolen, in his locker.

Webb, 45, from Millhouses, Sheffield, resigned in May after 20 years of service. He pleaded guilty to five theft charges, five of fraud, and one count of forgery. Judge Guy Kearl QC said Webb’s actions were 'sophisticated and planned acts of fraud and theft against a frail and confused elderly lady,' adding that Webb had 'brought disgrace upon yourself and upon the police service.' Prosecutor Alisha Kaye told the court that Webb visited the pensioner more than 30 times, targeting her vulnerability and trust, particularly because he was a police officer. The victim, who has no surviving relatives, is reportedly struggling to trust people as a result. Defense barrister Sam Green stated that Webb recognized his behavior was ‘disgraceful and despicable’ and wished to apologize unreservedly.

The decentralized finance (DeFi) sector is experiencing significant developments. A common question arises: who is depositing such massive sums—millions and sometimes billions of dollars—into DeFi platforms? For instance, Compound (COMP) and Aave (AAVE) collectively manage billions in deposits, providing users with the chance to earn interest. These platforms resemble traditional banks in that they hold substantial assets in digital 'vaults', but unlike banks, they also face the risk of hacking.

The source of these large deposits is transparent; they are visible within the platforms’ smart contracts. Unlike certain collapsed services such as BlockFi and Celsius, these funds are not based on unclear promises. Most large deposits originate from exchanges and institutional investors, which helps explain why deposit rates for assets like Ethereum are typically low—few are willing to risk vast sums for minimal returns.

Currently, activities such as short-selling are popular in DeFi. For example, one might use Ethereum as collateral to borrow a stablecoin, purchase a token like Solana, and then sell that token—effectively taking a short position. These strategies can serve hedging or speculative purposes.

Recently, Compound’s USD Coin (USDc) annual percentage yield (APY) in a non-incentivized pool rose sharply above its usual 2-3% range. This indicates considerable borrowing, likely for short-selling, where large deposits are used as collateral for stablecoin loans. If borrowers anticipate a drop in token prices, even high borrowing rates can be profitable. However, such moves might also trigger a short squeeze rather than a market-wide sell-off.

It's important for investors to stay informed about these margin activities. In the broader context, improving economic indicators—such as inflation, interest rates, and quantitative tightening—could impact the cryptocurrency market, potentially affecting narratives around ETFs and the upcoming Bitcoin halvening. Despite inherent risks, this period remains relatively favorable for DeFi depositors.

article_content: An increasing 'compensation culture,' similar to that seen in the U.S., is placing significant financial strain on the NHS and UK schools, warns Professor Frank Furedi, an eminent sociologist. According to Furedi, some teachers have become so anxious about potential lawsuits that school trips now often involve nothing more than taking pupils out to the playground. He attributes this trend to a combination of aggressive legal practices and a rise in compensation claims, resulting in billions of pounds in taxpayer costs. Furedi, whose report was commissioned by the Centre for Policy Studies, notes that teachers and doctors are now routinely focused on 'ticking boxes' to comply with health and safety regulations, sometimes prioritizing these over students' or patients' best interests. This excessive risk-aversion has prompted schools to ban playground games or restrict trips, with some notable compensation payouts including £3,000 for a student cut by rose bushes and £30,000 for a pupil injured after falling off a bench. Furedi also observes that some teachers are seeking compensation for their own workplace injuries, with local councils paying out around £6.7 million in 2010 alone. He points out that compensation claims are increasingly viewed not as selfish acts but as responsible efforts to prevent future accidents. The NHS has also seen a rise in such claims. The NHS Litigation Authority estimates that potential negligence claims could cost up to £16.6 billion. Since 2001, there have been 63,800 medical negligence claims against the NHS; only about 2,000 were determined by courts, while 28,700 were settled out-of-court. Furedi argues that the prevailing fear of litigation undermines professional autonomy, discourages innovation, and leads to bureaucratic and defensive practices. He calls for a broader examination of the cultural factors underpinning this trend, rather than focusing solely on lawyers’ actions. Tim Knox, director of the Centre for Policy Studies, echoes these concerns, stating that professionals now often prioritize avoiding litigation over doing what is best for students or patients. He notes that this has led to fewer enriching extracurricular activities in schools and more medical staff following strict 'best practice' guidelines rather than exercising their professional judgment.

Prema Furediju, neki nastavnici su toliko zabrinuti zbog mogućih tužbi da se školske ekskurzije sada često svode na izvođenje učenika samo do školskog dvorišta. On ovaj trend pripisuje kombinaciji agresivnih pravnih postupaka i porasta broja zahteva za odštetu, što poreske obveznike košta milijarde funti. Furedi, čiji izveštaj je naručio Centar za političke studije, navodi da su nastavnici i lekari sada rutinski fokusirani na 'popunjavanje kvadratića' kako bi ispunili zdravstvene i bezbednosne propise, ponekad stavljajući ovo ispred najboljeg interesa učenika ili pacijenata. Ova preterana opreznost dovela je do toga da škole zabranjuju igre na igralištu ili ograničavaju izlete, uz neka zapažena isplaćena odštetna potraživanja kao što su 3.000 funti za učenika koji se posekao na ružino žbunje i 30.000 funti za učenika povređenog padom sa klupe. Furedi takođe primećuje da neki nastavnici traže odštetu za sopstvene povrede na radnom mestu, pri čemu su lokalni saveti samo 2010. godine isplatili oko 6,7 miliona funti. NHS Litigation Authority procenjuje da bi potencijalne tužbe za nemar mogle koštati do 16,6 milijardi funti. Od 2001. godine, bilo je 63.800 zahteva za medicinsku nepažnju protiv NHS-a; samo oko 2.000 je rešeno na sudu, dok je 28.700 rešeno vansudskim putem. Tim Noks, direktor Centra za političke studije, deli ova zabrinutost, navodeći da profesionalci sada često daju prednost izbegavanju tužbi u odnosu na ono što je najbolje za učenike ili pacijente. article_content: CANBERRA, Australia — Survivors of the harmful morning sickness drug thalidomide were present in the public gallery on Wednesday as Australia’s Parliament offered a national apology on the 62nd anniversary of the drug being withdrawn from sale in the country. Thalidomide, also marketed under the brand names Contergan and Distaval, was available in 46 countries and caused birth defects, stillbirths, and miscarriages. Survivors with limb deformities, including one individual with no limbs, attended the House of Representatives gallery to hear Prime Minister Anthony Albanese’s apology. “Today, on behalf of the people of Australia, our government and this Parliament offers a full, unreserved and overdue apology to all thalidomide survivors, their families, loved ones, and carers,” Albanese said. “This apology responds to one of the darkest chapters in Australia’s medical history.” Doctors had once assured pregnant women that thalidomide was safe. “There was no system for properly evaluating the safety of medicines, and the terrible cruelty of thalidomide is that, far from being safe, just one dose was enough to cause devastating harm,” Albanese added. Trish Jackson, a survivor with heart and lung problems and limb deformities caused by her mother taking the drug while pregnant, welcomed the apology. “All those years of ... banging our heads against brick walls of politicians have finally paid off,” Jackson told the Australian Broadcasting Corporation. The apology was recommended in 2019 by a Senate inquiry into available support for aging thalidomide survivors. On Thursday, the government will fulfill another recommendation by unveiling a memorial in Canberra to recognize thalidomide survivors and their families. Australia established a support program in 2020 that now provides lifelong assistance to 148 survivors. Albanese said the government was reopening the program to allow additional survivors to register. Jackson noted the need for the support program to be simplified, saying, “It is so physically demanding to get anything back, like for medications and things, that a lot of survivors just don’t bother because it’s too hard for them.” She also said some doctors are unaware of thalidomide and do not understand survivors' unique medical issues. “It’s not just the missing limbs. There’s so much internal damage as well,” Jackson explained. “Thalidomide’s a drug that just keeps on giving us problems.” A class-action lawsuit by Australian and New Zealand thalidomide survivors against the drug’s British distributor, Diageo Scotland Ltd., was settled a decade ago for 89 million Australian dollars (US$81 million).

Talidomid, takođe poznat pod imenima Contergan i Distaval, bio je dostupan u 46 zemalja i izazvao je deformitete pri rođenju, mrtvorođenost i pobačaje. Preživele osobe sa deformitetima udova, uključujući jednu osobu bez udova, prisustvovale su zasedanju Predstavničkog doma kako bi čule izvinjenje premijera Entonija Albanizija. „Danas, u ime naroda Australije, naša vlada i ovaj parlament upućuju potpuno, bezrezervno i odavno zasluženo izvinjenje svim preživelim žrtvama talidomida, njihovim porodicama, voljenima i negovateljima“, rekao je Albanizi. „Ovo izvinjenje se odnosi na jedno od najmračnijih poglavlja u medicinskoj istoriji Australije.“ Lekari su nekada uveravali trudnice da je talidomid bezbedan. „Nije postojao sistem za pravilno procenjivanje bezbednosti lekova, a strašna surovost talidomida je u tome što je i samo jedna doza bila dovoljna da nanese razornu štetu“, dodao je Albanizi. Trish Džekson, preživela sa problemima sa srcem i plućima i deformitetima udova koje je uzrokovalo uzimanje leka tokom trudnoće njene majke, pozdravila je izvinjenje. „Sve te godine… udarali smo glavom o zidove političara, ali se to napokon isplatilo“, rekla je Džekson za Australian Broadcasting Corporation. Izvinjenje je preporučeno 2019. godine od strane Senatske istrage o dostupnoj podršci za starije preživele žrtve talidomida. U četvrtak će vlada ispuniti još jednu preporuku tako što će otkriti spomenik u Kanberi u čast preživelih i njihovih porodica. Australija je 2020. uspostavila program podrške koji sada pruža doživotnu pomoć za 148 preživelih. Albanizi je izjavio da vlada ponovo otvara program kako bi omogućila još preživelih da se registruju. Džekson je istakla potrebu za pojednostavljenjem programa podrške, rekavši: „Toliko je fizički naporno dobiti bilo kakvu nadoknadu, na primer za lekove i ostalo, da mnogi preživeli jednostavno ne pokušavaju jer im je previše teško.“ Takođe je navela da neki lekari nikad nisu čuli za talidomid i ne razumeju jedinstvene medicinske probleme preživelih. „Nisu problem samo nedostajući udovi. Ima mnogo unutrašnjih oštećenja isto tako“, objasnila je Džekson. „Talidomid je lek koji nam stalno stvara nove probleme.“ Kolektivna tužba australijskih i novozelandskih preživelih protiv britanskog distributera leka, Diageo Scotland Ltd., okončana je pre deset godina nagodbom vrednom 89 miliona australijskih dolara (81 milion američkih dolara).

The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) announced on Tuesday that Ebonyi State recorded the highest number of arrested electoral offenders during the 2023 general elections. According to Rotimi Oyekanmi, Chief Press Secretary to the INEC Chairman, a total of 1,076 electoral offenders were arrested across 35 states during the elections in February and March 2023.

Of the 191 case files prepared for prosecution, Ebonyi leads with 64 cases involving 216 suspects. Edo follows with 22 cases and 80 suspects, and Anambra is third with 12 cases and 66 suspects. Kaduna is fourth with 11 cases and 36 suspects; Adamawa ranks fifth with 10 cases and 17 suspects. Kano, Rivers, and Osun each have nine cases involving 74, 68, and 47 suspects, respectively. Yobe State has the lowest, with a single case implicating two suspects.

Oyekanmi specified that alleged electoral offences include culpable homicide, unlawful possession of firearms, snatching and destruction of INEC items, possession of offensive weapons, misconduct at polling units, and theft of election results.

He added that prosecution of these 1,076 offenders will be handled through a partnership between INEC, the Nigerian Bar Association (NBA), and the Nigeria Police. The NBA will provide 191 lawyers—including 16 Senior Advocates of Nigeria—to handle these cases pro bono. Evidence has been gathered and suspects are in custody awaiting trial.

NBA returned 26 case files to INEC to refer to the police, as those offences were not considered electoral under the Electoral Act 2022. For 22 of those cases, the suspects are either at large or were never apprehended.

Prema rečima Rotimija Oyekanmija, glavnog sekretara za štampu predsednika INEC-a, ukupno je 1.076 izbornih prestupnika uhapšeno u 35 saveznih država tokom izbora u februaru i martu 2023. godine.

Kano, Rivers i Osun imaju po devet slučajeva sa 74, 68 i 47 osumnjičenih. Jobe ima najmanje, sa jednim slučajem protiv dva osumnjičena.

Oyekanmi je precizirao da su navodni izborni prekršaji obuhvatali teško ubistvo, nelegalno posedovanje vatrenog oružja, otimanje i uništavanje INEC-ovih materijala, posedovanje opasnog oružja, nepravilnosti na biračkim mestima i krađu izbornih rezultata.

article_content: India’s economy is projected to have expanded by 6.7% between July and September 2023, according to a median poll of 10 economists cited by Economic Times. This outpaces the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) own forecast of 6.5% for the same period, as robust activity in services, manufacturing, and construction sectors fueled economic momentum. Growth estimates shared by the surveyed experts ranged from 6.2% to 7%. For comparison, India’s GDP grew by 7.8% during the April-June quarter and 6.2% in the same quarter last year. Chief economist Aditi Nayar from ICRA expressed the highest optimism at a 7% growth forecast, citing a less favorable base but resilience in economic activity. Official national accounts data for the second quarter (Q2) of the current fiscal year (FY24) will be published at the end of November. Economists highlight that a thriving services sector, evidenced by soaring services PMI (averaging 61.1 during the quarter), alongside healthy passenger movement numbers, played a major role in this uptick. Manufacturing also picked up, underpinned by stronger export demand and increased domestic consumption and state-level investments. Rural consumer demand showed signs of improvement as packaged consumer goods sales grew 9% by value and 8.6% by volume compared to a year ago, according to NielsenIQ. This surge has been linked to easing inflation, lower unemployment, and reduced cooking gas prices. Experts believe urban spending surpassed rural demand, though the latter has made some gains. Researchers caution that growth prospects for the full fiscal year (2024) may slow: economists now predict an annual growth rate of 6.3%, slightly lower than the RBI's 6.5% projection. The change is mainly attributed to potential setbacks in agricultural output affecting rural demand. The article also notes possible policy reforms. India may soon raise the minimum threshold for criminal GST evasion charges from ₹2 crore to ₹3 crore, aiming to lower business harassment and improve ease of doing business. In technology developments, the telecom industry has expressed strong opposition to hasty implementation of direct-to-mobile TV content delivery, arguing that existing technology is not yet mature. Overall, while services and manufacturing are helping India outperform many other economies, sustained growth in upcoming quarters will depend on manageable inflation and rising real wages.

Ovaj rezultat prevazilazi prognozu Rezervne banke Indije (RBI), koja je za isti period predviđala rast od 6,5%, pri čemu su snažne aktivnosti u sektoru usluga, industrije i građevinarstva podstakle ekonomski zamah. Procene rasta među anketiranim stručnjacima kretale su se od 6,2% do 7%. Poređenja radi, BDP Indije je rastao 7,8% tokom april–jun kvartala i 6,2% tokom istog perioda prošle godine. Glavni ekonomista ICRA, Aditi Nayar, dala je najoptimističniju prognozu od 7%, naglašavajući otpornost privrede, iako je osnovica za poređenje manje povoljna. Zvanični podaci nacionalnih računa za drugi kvartal (Q2) tekuće fiskalne godine (FY24) biće objavljeni krajem novembra. Ekonomisti ističu da je rast sektora usluga, potvrđen visokim indeksom PMI za usluge (prosek 61,1 tokom ovog kvartala) i dobrim brojem putnika, imao ključnu ulogu u ovom skoku. Industrijski sektor je takođe zabeležio napredak, zahvaljujući snažnijoj tražnji za izvozom, kao i većoj domaćoj potrošnji i ulaganjima na nivou država. Potrošnja u ruralnim sredinama pokazala je znake poboljšanja; prodaja pakovane robe široke potrošnje porasla je za 9% po vrednosti i 8,6% po količini u odnosu na isti period prethodne godine, prema podacima NielsenIQ. Ovaj rast pripisan je smanjenju inflacije, nižoj nezaposlenosti i jeftinijem gasu za domaćinstva. Stručnjaci smatraju da je gradska potrošnja nadmašila onu u ruralnim oblastima, iako se i ona polako oporavlja. Istraživači upozoravaju da bi perspektiva rasta za celu fiskalnu godinu (2024) mogla biti skromnija: sada se predviđa stopa rasta od 6,3%, što je nešto niže od projekcije RBI od 6,5%. Glavni razlog za to su mogući problemi u poljoprivredi i njihov uticaj na potražnju u ruralnim područjima. U tekstu se takođe spominju moguće regulatorne promene. Indija razmatra povećanje minimalnog iznosa za krivično gonjenje za utaju poreza na GST sa 2 na 3 crore rupija, s ciljem smanjenja administrativnog pritiska na biznis i poboljšanja poslovnog okruženja. U tehnološkoj sferi, telekom industrija se snažno protivi ubrzanom uvođenju servisa za direktno emitovanje TV sadržaja na mobilne telefone, tvrdeći da trenutna tehnologija još uvek nije dovoljno zrela. Zaključno, dok sektor usluga i industrije pomažu Indiji da ostane ispred mnogih drugih ekonomija, održivost rasta u narednim kvartalima zavisiće od nivoa inflacije i rasta realnih plata.

article_content: A recent study by the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) Center for Scholars and Storytellers reveals that today's young people want to see more stories about friendship in media. The "Teens and Screens" survey included 1,500 participants aged 10 to 24. More than half of them said they would like to see content that focuses on platonic relationships rather than romance or sex. Nearly 40% specifically expressed interest in media with non-romantic relationships or asexual characters. Most respondents felt that romance is overused in shows and movies aimed at their age group. The survey found that this preference, which researchers call 'nomance,' may be rooted in young people's desire for feel-good friendships, especially after experiencing pandemic-driven isolation. UCLA researchers Stephanie Rivas-Lara and Hiral Kotecha wrote that young people crave close friendships and community, and that media has overlooked these needs. While the survey did not address whether young people seek out sexual or pornographic content elsewhere, UCLA Center for Scholars and Storytellers founder Yalda Uhls noted that this could influence their preferences. Uhls suggested that the easy access to explicit content might explain why Gen Z wants to see more diverse relationships, not just romance, in traditional media.

Anketa "Teenageri i ekrani" obuhvatila je 1.500 učesnika uzrasta od 10 do 24 godine. Više od polovine izjavilo je da bi volelo da gleda sadržaj koji se fokusira na platonske odnose, umesto na romantiku ili seks. article_content: The UK Conservative government has recently scaled back climate legislation and continues to support the expansion of domestic oil and gas reserves. However, new research suggests this may be based on a misunderstanding of public opinion. After winning the July 2023 by-election in Uxbridge, a London suburb, the government made polarizing voters on climate policy a central political strategy. The Conservative campaign focused on opposing a new low emission zone for cars, with Prime Minister Rishi Sunak interpreting the victory as support for a 'pro-motorist' and anti-climate policy stance. A supposed lack of public backing for strict climate policies, such as banning fossil-fuel cars, is now being used as justification for rolling back measures that are vital to achieving net zero targets. However, a recent study published in the journal Climate Policy challenges this narrative. Researchers surveyed 1,911 people representing the UK population by age, gender, and ethnicity. The findings reveal that nearly two-thirds of respondents support even the most stringent climate policies, with some measures receiving even higher levels of support. Overall, people in the UK favor a broad range of climate policy instruments, including strict regulations. The study categorized policy proposals into four groups: regulation (e.g., banning fossil-fuel-powered car sales, halting oil and gas drilling), market instruments (e.g., carbon trading, removal of fossil fuel subsidies), informational tools (e.g., consumer labels, advertising campaigns), and voluntary initiatives (e.g., carbon offsets, non-binding product standards). Contrary to government rhetoric, the research indicates a majority of voters support robust climate action. Support rates are high for strict regulations and even higher for market-based initiatives (78%), informational tools (86%), and voluntary measures (87%). Importantly, the desire for a mix of policy instruments to decarbonize the economy is widespread, but continued efforts are needed to increase backing for stricter measures. The study identifies key factors influencing support for climate policy: stronger environmental values correlate with higher support, while stronger free-market beliefs correspond to less support, regardless of income. This challenges claims that income drives attitudes toward ambitious climate action. The research also underscores significant regional differences in support. Londoners are much more likely to support regulatory and market climate policies than people elsewhere in the UK, who are about 30% less likely to back these measures. These differences are both ideological (free-market beliefs) and structural (urban vs. rural infrastructure, reliance on high-emission vehicles). The study highlights the need to improve public infrastructure, particularly in rural areas, by investing in affordable, low-carbon transportation. Media, especially social networks, can entrench existing beliefs by providing echo chambers that reinforce policy preferences and polarization. Repeated exposure to specific viewpoints – known as 'repeated priming' – can shift public opinion, as seen in Germany with opposition to the gas boiler phase-out. To prevent a weakening of public support for robust climate policy, the study recommends that UK opposition parties communicate climate action and its benefits consistently and persistently. This article is republished from The Conversation under a Creative Commons license. Original article: 'Poll finds British public largely supports strong climate policies' (2023, November 13).
translated_content: Konzervativna vlada Velike Britanije nedavno je umanjila klimatske zakone i nastavlja da podržava širenje domaćih izvora nafte i gasa. Međutim, nova istraživanja sugerišu da je ovo možda zasnovano na pogrešnom razumevanju javnog mnjenja. Nakon pobede na julskim vanrednim izborima 2023. u Uxbridgeu, londonskom predgrađu, vlada je polarizaciju birača po pitanju klimatske politike postavila kao centralnu političku strategiju. Konzervativna kampanja fokusirala se na protivljenje novoj zoni niskih emisija za automobile, a premijer Riši Sunak ovu pobedu tumači kao podršku 'pro-vozačkoj' i anti-klimatskoj politici. Navodno odsustvo javne podrške strogim klimatskim merama, poput zabrane vozila na fosilna goriva, sada se koristi kao opravdanje za povlačenje mera neophodnih za dostizanje neto-nultih ciljeva. Ipak, nedavna studija objavljena u časopisu Climate Policy osporava ovu naraciju. Istraživači su anketirali 1.911 osoba koje predstavljaju populaciju UK po uzrastu, polu i etničkoj pripadnosti. Rezultati pokazuju da skoro dve trećine ispitanika podržava čak i najstrože klimatske politike, dok neke mere imaju još veću podršku. Generalno, ljudi u Velikoj Britaniji podržavaju širok spektar instrumenata klimatske politike, uključujući stroge regulative. Studija je predloge politika podelila u četiri grupe: regulativa (npr. zabrana prodaje vozila na fosilna goriva, obustava bušenja nafte i gasa), tržišni instrumenti (npr. trgovina ugljenikom, ukidanje subvencija za fosilna goriva), informativni alati (npr. potrošačke etikete, reklamne kampanje) i dobrovoljne inicijative (npr. ugljenična kompenzacija, neobavezujući standardi proizvoda). Suprotno vladinoj retorici, istraživanje pokazuje da većina birača podržava snažnu klimatsku akciju. Stope podrške visoke su za stroge regulative, još veće za tržišne inicijative (78%), informativne alate (86%) i dobrovoljne mere (87%). Važno je napomenuti da je želja za kombinacijom različitih instrumenata politike u cilju dekarbonizacije ekonomije široko rasprostranjena, ali su potrebni dalji napori za jačanje podrške strožim merama. Studija identifikuje ključne faktore uticaja na podršku klimatskoj politici: jače ekološke vrednosti povezane su sa većom podrškom, dok izraženija vera u slobodno tržište znači manju podršku, bez obzira na prihod. Ovo dovodi u pitanje tvrdnje da prihodi određuju stavove prema ambicioznoj klimatskoj akciji. Istraživanje takođe ukazuje na značajne regionalne razlike. Londonci znatno češće podržavaju regulatorne i tržišne klimatske politike nego ljudi u drugim delovima UK, koji su oko 30% manje skloni podršci ovim merama. Razlike su i ideološke (verovanje u slobodno tržište) i strukturne (infrastruktura grada u odnosu na selo, oslanjanje na vozila sa visokim emisijama). Studija naglašava da je potrebno unaprediti javnu infrastrukturu, posebno u ruralnim oblastima, ulaganjem u pristupačan, nisko-ugljenični saobraćaj. Mediji, posebno društvene mreže, mogu dodatno učvrstiti postojeća uverenja pružanjem eho-komora koje pojačavaju političke preferencije i polarizaciju. Ponavljano izlaganje određenim stavovima – poznato kao 'ponovljeno usmeravanje' – može promeniti javno mnjenje, kao što se videlo u Nemačkoj sa protivljenjem ukidanju gasnih kotlova. Da bi se sprečilo slabljenje javne podrške za snažnu klimatsku politiku, studija preporučuje da opozicione partije u UK dosledno i uporno komuniciraju klimatske mere i njihove koristi. Ovaj članak je preuzet i prilagođen sa portala The Conversation pod Creative Commons licencom. Originalni tekst: 'Poll finds British public largely supports strong climate policies' (13. novembar 2023).

Israeli forces have reached the gates of Al Shifa hospital, Gaza City's largest medical facility and the primary focus of their operations to gain control of northern Gaza. Medical staff report that patients, including newborns, are dying due to a lack of fuel to run hospital equipment.

International tensions remain high, with increased clashes on Israel's northern border with Lebanon and US airstrikes on Iran-linked militia targets in Syria. Israel's campaign against Hamas, which governs Gaza, began last month after Hamas fighters launched a deadly attack in southern Israel, killing around 1,200 and taking about 240 hostages, according to Israeli sources. This attack marked the deadliest day in Israel's 75-year history.

Since then, thousands of Gazans have been killed and over half of the territory's population has been displaced by Israeli military operations. Israel ordered the evacuation of northern Gaza, and local health authorities report more than 11,000 deaths—with nearly 40% being children. Israeli ground forces entered Gaza in late October and quickly surrounded Gaza City, focusing much of the fighting around Al Shifa hospital, where thousands of civilians have sought shelter.

Israel claims that Hamas has constructed command centers in tunnels below the hospital and is using patients as human shields—a claim Hamas denies. Ashraf Al-Qidra, spokesman for Gaza's Health Ministry, stated that an Israeli tank is stationed at the hospital gate. He said the hospital desperately needs between 8,000 and 10,000 liters of fuel daily, much more than the 300 liters reportedly offered by Israel, which would provide power for only half an hour. An Israeli official, anonymously cited, said the smaller amount could last longer with only the emergency room functioning.

Of the 45 babies in incubators at Al Shifa, three had died as of Sunday, according to the Health Ministry. Dr. Ahmed El Mokhallalati, a surgeon at the hospital, warned that more newborns could die if the situation persists. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said Al Shifa "is not functioning as a hospital anymore," and patient fatalities have risen sharply, urging the world not to ignore attacks on hospitals.

The conflict has polarized global opinion. Many international leaders question whether Israel's response to Hamas is proportional, while Israel argues it must destroy Hamas and says militants are responsible for endangering civilians. Israel has refused to agree to a ceasefire, a stance supported by Washington, despite US calls for civilian protection. “The United States does not want to see firefights in hospitals where innocents are caught in crossfire,” said White House National Security Adviser Jake Sullivan.

Hundreds of thousands are believed to remain in northern Gaza despite Israeli evacuation orders. Israel continues airstrikes in the south, leaving many civilians saying there is no safe place to go. Ahmed, a resident of Jabalia refugee camp, said, “The choice is to stay in your home or leave for nowhere and risk being bombed.”

In Khan Younis, Israeli airstrikes hit several houses, reportedly killing seven and injuring more. Casualties, including children, are being taken to Nasser Hospital amid ongoing calls for ambulances to rescue others trapped under rubble.

The fighting has raised fears of a broader conflict, with Hezbollah and other Iranian-backed groups exchanging attacks with Israel, and the US striking such groups in Syria. Iran has praised Hamas’s actions but denies direct involvement.

Izraelske snage stigle su do kapija bolnice Al Šifa, najveće zdravstvene ustanove u Gazi i glavne tačke svojih operacija za preuzimanje kontrole nad severnim delom Gaze. Medicinsko osoblje javlja da pacijenti, uključujući novorođenčad, umiru zbog nedostatka goriva za rad bolničke opreme.

Međunarodne tenzije rastu, uz sve češće sukobe na izraelsko-libanonskoj granici, kao i američke vazdušne udare na mete milicija povezanih sa Iranom u Siriji. Izraelska kampanja protiv Hamasa, koji upravlja Gazom, počela je prošlog meseca nakon što su borci Hamasa izveli smrtonosni napad na jug Izraela, ubivši oko 1.200 ljudi i odveli oko 240 talaca, navode izraelski izvori. Taj dan bio je najsmrtonosniji u 75 godina izraelske istorije.

Od tada, hiljade stanovnika Gaze su ubijene, a više od polovine populacije je raseljeno zbog izraelskih vojnih akcija. Izrael je naredio evakuaciju severa Gaze, a lokalne zdravstvene vlasti izveštavaju o više od 11.000 poginulih, od kojih je skoro 40% dece. Izraelske kopnene snage ušle su u Gazu krajem oktobra i brzo opkolile Gazu Siti, fokusirajući žestoke borbe oko bolnice Al Šifa, gde su se hiljade civila sklonile.

Izrael tvrdi da Hamas ima komandne centre u tunelima ispod bolnice i da koristi pacijente kao živi štit - što Hamas negira. Portparol Ministarstva zdravlja Gaze, Ašraf Al-Kidra, izjavio je da je izraelski tenk stacioniran ispred ulaza u bolnicu. On navodi da je bolnici hitno potrebno između 8.000 i 10.000 litara goriva dnevno, mnogo više od 300 litara koje je Izrael navodno ponudio, što bi obezbedilo struju za samo pola sata. Jedan izraelski zvaničnik, koji je želeo da ostane anoniman, izjavio je da bi ta količina goriva mogla trajati duže, jer sada radi samo hitna služba.

Od 45 beba u inkubatorima u Al Šifa bolnici, tri su do nedelje preminule, saopštava Ministarstvo zdravlja. Hirurg dr Ahmed El Mokhalalati upozorava da bi još novorođenčadi moglo umreti ako se situacija ne promeni. Generalni direktor Svetske zdravstvene organizacije Tedros Adhanom Gebrejesus rekao je da Al Šifa "više ne funkcioniše kao bolnica" i da je broj preminulih pacijenata značajno porastao, te je pozvao svet da ne ignoriše napade na bolnice.

Sukob je polarizovao svetsko mnjenje. Mnogi međunarodni lideri dovode u pitanje proporcionalnost izraelskog odgovora na Hamas, dok Izrael tvrdi da mora uništiti Hamas i smatra borce odgovornim za ugrožavanje civila. Izrael odbija prekid vatre, što podržava i Vašington, iako SAD insistira na zaštiti civila. „Sjedinjene Države ne žele da vide vatrene okršaje u bolnicama gde nevini ljudi bivaju pogođeni unakrsnom vatrom“, izjavio je Džejk Salivan, savetnik Bele kuće za nacionalnu bezbednost.

Pretpostavlja se da stotine hiljada ljudi i dalje ostaje na severu Gaze uprkos naredbi za evakuaciju. Izrael nastavlja vazdušne napade i na jugu, pa mnogi stanovnici tvrde da nema bezbednog mesta za odlazak. Ahmed, stanovnik izbegličkog kampa Džabalija, rekao je: „Izbor je da ostaneš u svom domu ili odeš nigde i rizikuješ bombardovanje.“

U Han Junisu, izraelski vazdušni napadi pogodili su više kuća, a prema izveštajima ubijeno je sedmoro i povređeno više ljudi. Povređeni, uključujući decu, prevezeni su u bolnicu Naser dok se i dalje upućuju pozivi za spasavanje ljudi zarobljenih pod ruševinama.

Borbe su povećale strah od šireg regionalnog sukoba: Hezbolah i druge iranske saveznike razmenjuju udare sa Izraelom, a SAD izvode napade na te grupe u Siriji. Iran je pohvalio postupke Hamasa, ali negira direktnu umešanost.

article_content: To address the widespread problem of anaemia in Karnataka, the state government is rolling out a large-scale screening program for first- and second-year pre-university students. Launching on November 22, health workers will perform finger-prick tests on approximately 1.36 million students in both government and private institutions. This initiative is part of the first phase of the Anaemia Muktha Poushtika Karnataka campaign, developed in partnership with central and state health authorities. Historically, Karnataka depended on limited sample surveys and manual methods, but the new campaign will utilize digital hemoglobinometers to streamline and accelerate the testing process. Initial assessments will occur at colleges, followed by plans for house-to-house screening to reach even more people. Officials decided to expand the screening after observing stubbornly high anaemia rates, despite previous government efforts. Students found to be anaemic will receive folic acid and iron supplements. Future stages of the program will target younger children, pregnant and breastfeeding women, and women of reproductive age. Other recent developments include Maharashtra’s decision to expand its health insurance to cover 200-plus advanced cancer tests, recommendations by Tata Memorial Centre, health updates on Tamil Nadu Minister V Senthil Balaji post-surgery, and the arrest of a young man in Karnataka for manipulating images of a female student and her friends after his romantic proposal was rejected.
translated_content: Kako bi se izborili s velikim problemom anemije u Karnataki, državna vlada pokreće obimni program skrininga za učenike prve i druge godine pre-univerzitetskih škola. Od 22. novembra, zdravstveni radnici će raditi testove kapilarne krvi na oko 1,36 miliona učenika u državnim i privatnim ustanovama. Ova inicijativa je deo prve faze kampanje Anaemia Muktha Poushtika Karnataka, razvijene u saradnji s centralnim i državnim zdravstvenim vlastima. Karnataka se dosad oslanjala na ograničene uzorke i ručne metode testiranja, ali nova kampanja koristi digitalne hemoglobinomere za brže i efikasnije testiranje. Prvo testiranje biće sprovedeno u školama, a kasnije su planirane i kućne posete radi obuhvata većeg broja ljudi. Zvaničnici su odlučili da prošire skrining jer su stope anemije i dalje visoke, uprkos dosadašnjim naporima. Učenici kod kojih se otkrije anemija dobiće folnu kiselinu i suplemente gvožđa. Sledeće faze programa obuhvatiće mlađu decu, trudnice, dojilje i žene reproduktivnog doba. Među ostalim vestima: Maharashtra proširuje zdravstveno osiguranje na više od 200 naprednih testova za rak prema preporukama Tata Memorial Centra, informacije o zdravlju ministra Tamil Nadua V Senthil Balaji posle operacije, i hapšenje mladića u Karnataki zbog obrade slika studentkinje i njenih prijateljica nakon što je odbijen njegov ljubavni predlog.
